jobs.title: Systems Administrator (Senior-Level)
jobs.description:
Link Solutions is seeking a Systems Administrator (Senior-Level) to join our team in Fort Huachuca, AZ.

• Active DoD Top Secret Clearance required
• IAT Level II Certification equivalent or higher
• Non-remote (relocation incentive available)

The Systems Administrator will support the U.S. Army Information Systems Engineering Command (USAISEC), Communications Security Directorate (CSD), by administering and sustaining mission-critical enterprise infrastructure supporting secure communications and national defense operations. This position provides senior-level support across Windows and Linux server environments, virtualization platforms, Active Directory services, network infrastructure, and cybersecurity compliance activities in classified and unclassified environments.

Join our dynamic team at a top-tier organization, where work-life balance and employee well-being take center stage. This exciting opportunity lets you contribute to cutting-edge projects while safeguarding our national security.

Job Responsibilities:

• Administer, maintain, and support physical and virtual Windows, Linux/UNIX, and Active Directory server environments to ensure system availability, performance, and security.
• Install, configure, patch, upgrade, and sustain operating systems, applications, and enterprise services in accordance with Government and organizational requirements.
• Monitor system and network performance; troubleshoot and resolve hardware, software, connectivity, and operational issues across classified and unclassified environments.
• Provide Tier II/III technical support for end users, including workstation deployment, peripheral support, user account administration, and technical training.
• Manage user accounts, permissions, privileged access, and authentication services while enforcing cybersecurity and access control policies.
• Administer and support network infrastructure, including routers, switches, firewalls, encryptors, LAN/WAN connectivity, and copper/fiber cabling systems.
• Maintain network documentation, configurations, and port assignments while monitoring uptime, traffic, and overall network health.
• Support cybersecurity operations by implementing RMF requirements, managing security controls, conducting vulnerability assessments, supporting continuous monitoring activities, and maintaining ATO compliance documentation.
• Respond to cybersecurity incidents, malware infections, and classified spillage events, including system isolation, evidence preservation, and remediation support.
• Execute and validate backup, recovery, contingency, and disaster recovery procedures to ensure system resilience and operational continuity.
• Coordinate with vendors, Government stakeholders, and support organizations to resolve technical issues, manage support tickets, and oversee warranty and maintenance activities.
• Support system modernization, technology evaluations, lifecycle replacement planning, system testing, and implementation of new technologies and capabilities.
• Prepare and deliver technical briefings, reports, recommendations, and analysis to leadership, stakeholders, and technical governance boards.
• Develop, maintain, and update system documentation, standard operating procedures (SOPs), configuration records, and troubleshooting guides to support operations and rapid onboarding of new personnel.
• Identify and implement process improvements, automation opportunities, and operational efficiencies in support of mission requirements and organizational objectives.

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties, or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job.

• Active DoD Top Secret Clearance required.
• Ten (10+) years of experience administering, maintaining, and supporting enterprise information technology systems, including Windows and/or Linux server environments, virtualization platforms, Active Directory, and networked infrastructures.
• IAT Level II Certification equivalent or higher per DoD 8570/DoD 8140 (CompTIA Security+ CE, CCNA Security, GICSP, GSEC, SSCP, etc.).
• In addition to the required IAT Level II certification, candidates must possess a second industry-recognized certification in a relevant technical discipline. Acceptable certification areas include systems and network administration, operating systems, server virtualization, videoconferencing technologies, fiber optic cabling, audio/visual systems, network and systems management and control, media access and digital interfaces, Voice over Internet Protocol (VoIP), or system and network protocols.
• Experience administering Microsoft Windows Server environments, Active Directory, Group Policy, and virtualized infrastructure such as VMware vSphere/ESXi.
• Knowledge of network management, monitoring, and troubleshooting for enterprise server and communications environments.
• Ability to install, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot network, server, and communication technologies.

Preferred:

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
• Experience supporting Department of Defense (DoD), Army, DISA, NETCOM, USAISEC, or other federal government environments.
• Experience supporting videoconferencing, VoIP, and audio/visual technologies.
• Familiarity with fiber optic cabling, digital media interfaces, and communications infrastructure.
• VMware Certified Professional (VCP), Microsoft, Cisco CCNA/CCNP, or equivalent industry certifications.
• Experience providing support for mission-critical systems and VIP end users.
• Experience administering VMware vSphere/ESXi, Windows Server, Active Directory, and Group Policy in enterprise environments.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
• Strong organizational skills with attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities.
• Proven problem-solving and troubleshooting skills in complex technical environments.
• Self-motivated with the ability to work independently with minimal supervision.

Candidates must provide proof of certification and maintain all required credentials throughout their employment.

Link Solutions Inc. offers a competitive compensation and benefits package to include paid holidays, paid time off, medical, dental, vision, company-paid long and short-term disability, life insurance, referral bonuses, relocation reimbursement program, certification reimbursement program, retirement, and more.

Link Solutions, Inc. is an EOE. AA/M/F/D/V.  We participate in the E-Verify Employment Verification Program. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

jobs.title: Automation Engineer IV
jobs.description:
As an Automation, Instrumentation and Controls (AIC) Engineer at CRB, you are essential to the creation of purposeful, high-performance processes and facilities that have a positive, lasting impression on people, our clients and the community. Your experience allows you to execute and lead large projects through all phases of design, documentation and administration, as well as actively support large projects within a multi-discipline team setting. You will leverage your creativity with your knowledge of mechanical system controls, process automation controls and regulatory standards to solve problems that balance technical and design excellence.

About the Role

The Senior Automation Engineer has a thorough understanding of the development and field implementation of documents through all project phases, sizes and levels of complexity. Their knowledge and skill set is expanding to more complex and larger control systems such as those with advanced hardware and networks for reliability, or integrated Safety Systems. This individual has stronger interest in managing or working with the technical aspects of projects as opposed to overall staff or project management roles performed by the Lead Automation Engineer and may focus on and develop expertise around technologies or applications.

Responsibilities

• Interfaces with clients and external partners.
• Plans and directs work and manages a project budget from a discipline design perspective on large complex projects.
• Supports Project Manager in proposal development, man-hour planning and project scheduling for the discipline scope of work on large/complex projects.
• Possesses advanced experience conducting and leading field surveys of existing conditions and support of field reporting.
• Identifies and resolves intermediate non-compliant existing conditions during site walks and construction field surveys.
• Develops intermediate internal discipline design and engineering training presentations.
• Develops construction drawing packages and writes construction specifications on advanced and complex projects with little oversight.
• Provides lead and advanced support of construction activities such as RFI responses, submittal reviews, punch list development and construction progress reports.
• Conducts quality checking of documents for intermediate and complex projects (e.g., technical verification of design calculations and documentation) and drives overall project quality.
• Provides mentorship to discipline Engineer I, II and III and/or Designer I and II.
• Leads a team of discipline staff in the execution of advanced projects, discipline design and engineering.

Minimum Qualifications

• ABET-accredited Bachelor’s degree in discipline-specific field of study (ChemE, ME or EE)
• Minimum of 15 years of experience, preferably in a design firm setting
• Knowledge of Control System Application software development methodologies

Preferred Qualifications

• Professional Engineer registration
• ISA Certified Automation Professional
• Proficiency in AutoCAD and Revit
• Proficiency in Microsoft Office
• Proficiency in discipline-specific software
• Advanced knowledge of GMP manufacturing environments
• Advanced experience with performing instrumentation and controls engineering calculations, and developing and implementing instrumentation and control system design
• Advanced experience with implementing fundamental design aspects of control system schematics, panel fabrication drawings and field wiring plans design
• Advanced experience developing Piping and Instrumentation Diagrams (P&IDs)
• Advanced experience with the electrical code
• Advanced experience with other applicable industry standards
• Advanced experience with applicable mechanical and building codes
• Intermediate experience and knowledge of designing Safety Instrumented Systems
• Proficient with advanced internal and external cross-discipline project team coordination
• Proficient with advanced coordination with construction trade partners, vendors and manufacturers
• Proficient with advanced design calculations with limited supervision

jobs.title: CNC Manual Machinist - 5:00AM-3:30PM Mon-Thur
jobs.description:
Vestcom, an Avery Dennison Company Vestcom is the industry leader in shelf-edge technology and a proud subsidiary of Avery Dennison, a global leader in materials science. By joining our team, you gain the agility of a specialized industry leader backed by the global scale, benefits, and stability of Avery Dennison.

Why Join Avery Dennison? At Avery Dennison, we don’t just follow instructions; we solve problems. We are looking for a CNC Machinist who acts as a "Technical Pilot"—someone with a "zero-defect" mindset and a deep curiosity for how things work. Here, you’ll have the autonomy to own your workstation and the support to grow your technical skills.

Shift & Compensation

• 1st Shift: 5:00 AM – 3:30 PM (4-day work week! Enjoy 3 days off).
• Benefits: Comprehensive medical, 401K matching, and paid time off starting Day 1.

Your Impact (Essential Duties)

• Manual & Precision Machining: Set up and manually operate conventional lathes, vertical milling machines, and machining centers with high precision to fabricate complex, one-off, or high-tolerance custom parts without relying on automated G-code programs.
• Technical Troubleshooting: Use machine manuals, precise measuring tools, and hands-on mechanical diagnostics to independently identify, troubleshoot, and resolve machining issues or mechanical setups on the fly.
• Blueprint Mastery: Read and interpret complex blueprints, engineering drawings, and schematics to manually layout, calculate, and machine intricate profiles involving tight radiuses, angles, and varied tangent points.
• Equipment Care & Continuous Improvement: Perform routine light maintenance, continuous cleaning, and preventative upkeep on your assigned manual machines to ensure peak operational accuracy and maintain a safe workspace.
• Shop-Wide Collaboration: Partner with cross-functional shop team members, support plant-wide facility projects, and lend machining expertise across the floor wherever needed.

Who You Are (Qualifications)

• Education: High School Diploma/GED required. A Technical Certificate or Associate’s Degree in CNC Machining is highly preferred.
• Experience: 3-5 years of hands-on CNC experience or equivalent training.
• Technical Skills: * Proficiency with precision measuring instruments and hand/power tools.Basic computer skills (Outlook, Word, Excel).The "Plus" Factor: Familiarity or working knowledge of G-code is a significant advantage.
• Physical Readiness: Ability to stand for 75% of the shift, lift up to 50 lbs, and work in a loud manufacturing environment with appropriate PPE.

The Ideal Fit You are a proactive professional who works well under minimal supervision. You value Accountability and Curiosity, always looking for ways to improve a process rather than just finishing a task.

jobs.title: Project Manager - Energy/Solutions for Industry
jobs.description:
Key Responsibilities

• Serve as the primary client contact throughout the project lifecycle, building trusted relationships, managing expectations, and identifying opportunities for future work.
• Lead project planning and execution by managing scope, schedule, budget, resources, and risk to successfully deliver complex projects from kickoff through closeout.
• Align clients, project teams, and subcontractors around project objectives, deliverables, and success criteria while proactively managing scope changes and resolving issues.
• Direct multidisciplinary project teams to achieve goals related to quality, cost, schedule, safety, and sustainable project delivery.

Your Starting Point for Constant Growth

From the moment you join Ramboll, we will support your personal and professional development so that you grow with the company. For this role, we believe your starting point is:

Education & Experience

• Bachelor's degree in engineering, construction management, or a related discipline, plus 6+ years of relevant project management experience in industrial, EPC/EPCM, or advanced-manufacturing environments; or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
• Demonstrated experience managing multi-million-dollar capital projects from initiation through closeout, including budget, schedule, and client-relationship ownership.
• Experience in the energy transition, industrial manufacturing, or heavy-industrial construction sectors is strongly preferred.

Technical Skills

• Strong working knowledge of project controls, including earned value management, resource/cost loading, and schedule (critical path) analysis.
• Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, specifications, and project schedules.
• Proficiency with Primavera P6 or Microsoft Project, and the Microsoft Office Suite.
• Familiarity with Work Breakdown Structure (WBS) and Cost Breakdown Structure (CBS) development.
• Experience with project financial systems and reporting tools (e.g., Maconomy or a similar ERP).

Project Management & Leadership

• Lead cross-discipline project teams, including engineers, construction managers, schedulers, and procurement specialists.
• Develop and drive the project execution strategy for each assignment, translating it into execution plans, risk registers, and contingency plans that align the project team around a clear path to delivery.
• Facilitate client and internal steering-committee meetings, and represent Ramboll in client-facing project reviews.
• Mentor and develop junior project staff, and support succession planning within the project delivery team.
• Proactively manage change orders, claims, and project risk related to quality, safety, schedule, and revenue recognition.

Collaboration & Communication

• Work closely with Project Owners, Engineering Managers, and Construction Managers to align delivery across the project lifecycle.
• Maintain clear, regular communication with clients, subcontractors, and internal stakeholders.
• Strong interpersonal, negotiation, and presentation skills.

Professional Attributes

• Self-motivated, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple concurrent priorities.
• Strong problem-solving skills and sound judgment under schedule and budget pressure.
• Commitment to safety, quality, and client-service excellence.

Preferred Certifications

Project Management Professional (PMP) by the Project Management Institute (PMI), Certified Construction Manager (CCM), or a similar project management certification preferred.

​​

Solutions for Industry partners with clients across advanced manufacturing, energy, and other industrial sectors to deliver capital projects that support the transition to a more sustainable, resilient industrial base. jobs.description:
Role Overview

The Managing Directory, Private Equity (PE) is a senior commercial leadership role within RRD’s RevTeam. This individual is responsible for establishing relationships with the Private Equity ecosystem to build strategic, long-term sales momentum. Unlike traditional high-volume

sales roles, this position requires a nuanced, high-trust, low-volume "Account-Based Selling" approach.

The primary mission is to identify, secure, and expand relationships directly with PE Operating Partners, Portfolio Operations leads, and Value Creation directors who are under immense pressure to drive EBITDA growth. By deeply understanding the financial objectives of PE firms, this leader will position RRD’s specialized portfolio of services and our unique consultative assessment process as the go-to solution for driving enterprise value across portfolio companies.

Key Responsibilities

• Target Identification & Strategic Relationship Building

• Identify & Engage Key Stakeholders: Target and build deep, recurring relationships with Portfolio Operations leads, Operating Partners, and Value Creation directors within targeted funds, segmented by sector and strategy.
• Network Utilization: Leverage an existing professional network to gain access to highly gatekept PE environments and create meaningful business conversations.
• Peer-to-Peer Engagement: Speak the distinct financial and operational vocabulary of the PE universe to establish immediate credibility with operational leadership.

• Master Service Agreement (MSA) Navigation

• Navigate complex PE procurement processes to secure Master Service Agreements (MSAs) within their portfolio of operating companies.
• Short-List Positioning: Ensure that when an Operating Partner identifies an operational inefficiencies or cost takeout initiative within a portfolio company (PortCo), RRD is automatically positioned on the short-list to call.

• Portfolio Company (PortCo) Expansion

• Expand Success: Actively expand RRD’s footprint across multiple targeted portfolio companies by leveraging and proving early success in initial PortCo engagements.
• Account Growth: Network across the firm’s broader ecosystem to cross-sell and scale RRD’s services into additional portfolio assets.

jobs.title: Internal Relief Veterinarian
jobs.description:
Three Hospitals. One Culture. One Standard of Care.

As our Internal Relief Veterinarian, you’ll travel between three sister hospitals in southeastern New Hampshire—covering for doctors on vacation or leave, stepping in seamlessly, and bringing your best every time you walk through the door.

• Canobie Lake Veterinary Hospital — Windham, NH | 2024 AAHA Practice of the Year
• All Pets Veterinary Hospital — Nashua, NH
• Greenland Veterinary Hospital — Greenland, NH

All three hospitals are AAHA-accredited, busy, and fully equipped. Each runs on the same culture—Conscious Care®—our owner’s trademarked program built around compassion for self, team, clients, patients, and community. You won’t feel like a stranger walking in. You’ll feel like you belong.

What Makes This Role Unique

Relief veterinarians at most practices still carry the full weight—the callbacks, the follow-up lists, the administrative details that were never really yours. That’s not how we do it.

Here, you are a doctor. Full stop.

• You see appointments, perform exams, make diagnostic and treatment plans, and do surgery and dentals (don’t like surgery and dentals, no problem)
• Client follow-up and administrative detail stay with the permanent team—not you
• Your task list is lean by design, so your headspace stays on medicine
• A personal assistant supports your appointments—checking in and checking out clients and monitoring your flow throughout the day
• We stay on schedule so you walk out on time, every shift
• You are not expected to cover every vacancy—you have ample room in your schedule for the time off you’ve earned

Your Schedule: Flexible by Design

Your schedule will shift depending on where coverage is needed—but it will always work within your life, not against it. We’re open Monday through Friday only. No weekends. No on-call. No emergencies pulling you in on your days off.

What you can count on:

• Monday–Friday only, no weekend shifts ever
• You are not obligated to fill every open shift—your time off is protected
• 5 weeks of PTO annually
• 30 hours of CE per year, covered
• $2,500 CE allowance to invest in your continued growth
• Hospital closes 2 hrs/week for rounds and training—you’re always in the loop, never out of it

What Relief Actually Looks Like Here

We know what bad relief work feels like. You show up to chaos. Nobody knows you’re coming. The team is frazzled, the systems are unclear, and you spend half the day figuring out where things are instead of practicing medicine.

That is not what you’ll find here. Our hospitals are well-run, team-driven, and deeply collaborative. When you arrive, the staff knows who you are, what you need, and how to support you. You’ll be welcomed—not just tolerated.

Each hospital is powered by three integrated teams—the Customer Experience Team (CET), Technicians (TT), and Veterinary Assistants (VA)—all working in sync to make sure every appointment runs smoothly and every patient gets top-notch care. You step in, you do the medicine, and the team handles the rest.

Who You Are

• DVM or equivalent, with an active New Hampshire veterinary license (or eligibility to obtain)
• Confident and adaptable—you walk into new environments and hit the ground running
• Proficient in general medicine, surgery, and dentistry (surgery and dental optional)
• Experience with avian and exotic species is a welcome bonus, not a requirement
• A clear communicator who works well with teams you’ve never met before
• Reliable and accountable—you show up, you do the work, and you do it well
• A great attitude, because culture matters and kindness travels with you from hospital to hospital

What We Offer

• Competitive compensation
• 5 weeks of PTO annually—real time off, not just a number on paper
• 30 hours of CE + $2,500 CE allowance
• Full benefits: medical, dental, vision, life, liability, 401(k), EAP, pet discounts
• No administrative tail—your after-shift hours are yours
• No weekends, ever
• Advanced equipment at all three hospitals: digital rads, dental rads, Class IV laser, ultrasound, full in-house lab
• Specialist access: boarded surgeon, cardiologist, two traveling internists
• The full support of a 28-year owner who understands the demands of a veterinary career and genuinely invests in her team
• A path forward: if a permanent role, mentorship, or future partnership ever interests you—the door is open

New Hampshire: The Best Place to Be

40 min to Boston  •  45 min to the beaches  •  45 min to ski mountains  •  No income or sales tax

New Hampshire is consistently ranked among the top 3 best states to live in the U.S., frequently securing the #2 spot overall in U.S. News & World Report's annual rankings for 2024 and 2025. It is lauded for its high quality of life, often ranking #1 in safety (crime and corrections), top-tier education, and economic opportunity.

Four seasons of beauty: summer lakes, peak foliage, ski slopes, and flowers in March. New Hampshire isn’t just a great place to work—it’s a great place to live.

Qualifications

• DVM/VMD from an accredited institution
• Active New Hampshire veterinary license (or eligibility to obtain)
• DEA license preferred, not required
• USDA Accreditation preferred, not required

The Balance You’ve Been Looking For Is Real

You’ve worked hard to become an exceptional doctor. You deserve a role that honors that—one where you can practice great medicine, protect your personal time, and move between three outstanding hospitals knowing you’re backed by a team that wants you to succeed.

This isn’t just relief work. It’s a career designed around you.

Apply today at canobievet.com

Drug-free  •  Smoke-free  •  Equal Opportunity Employer  |  Discrimination prohibited by company policy and federal & state law.

jobs.title: Security Engineer II (Defensive Operations)
jobs.description:
At Flywire, we are looking for a Security Engineer II to join our global Security Engineering team. In this role, you will serve as a technical authority owning secure software design, cloud-native infrastructure defense, offensive penetration testing, and real-time incident detection across Flywire’s global footprint. You will combine a "breaker" mindset with a builder’s engineering empathy, operating fluidly across the entire product and infrastructure security lifecycle.

This role demands an "automation-first" approach embedded within a high-velocity fintech ecosystem. You will actively partner with software engineering and SRE squads to integrate security controls directly into our public cloud and GitLab CI/CD pipelines using AI workflows. Simultaneously, you will serve as an operational responder for threat detection engineering, red team penetration testing, and live incident containment.

Key Responsibilities:

• Secure SDLC & CI/CD Automation: Own, design, and drive the end-to-end integration of automated technical security requirements and validation tools into high-velocity engineering pipelines. Build custom internal tooling, wrappers, and automated controls to maximize development velocity without friction.
• SRE & Cloud Infrastructure Hardening: Partner directly with SRE and DevOps teams to establish secure cloud architecture blueprints, manage Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) security scans (Terraform), and enforce Zero Trust boundaries in containerized environments (Docker/Kubernetes).
• AI-Driven Security & Governance: Design and deploy automated security review workflows using LLM APIs (e.g., Claude). Establish controls to protect generative AI features against prompt injection, insecure output handling, model inversion, and data poisoning.
• Offensive Penetration Testing & Red Teaming: Adopt an attacker's mindset to discover logic flaws, perform exploit research, and emulate zero-day adversarial behavior across financial platforms through manual source code audits, API exploitation, and cloud penetration testing.
• Incident Response & Threat Detection: Lead technical containment, forensic collection, and rapid threat eradication during active security incidents. Design and deploy high-fidelity detection rules and automated alert workflows within the SIEM environment.
• Cross-Functional Collaboration & Mentorship: Embed within software development and infrastructure sprint planning from inception to ensure security is built-in from day one. Provide actionable code modifications and mentor junior engineers.

Basic Qualifications:

• Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Cyber Security, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline (or equivalent experience).
• Experience: 3+ years of progressive engineering experience moving fluidly between Application Security, Cloud Architecture Defense, and Active Security Operations (SecOps/Incident Response/Penetration Testing).
• Advanced Exploitation & Defense: Proven track record of independently performing deep manual penetration testing, web application exploitation, and incident containment without relying solely on commercial automated scanners.
• Cloud & DevOps Stack: Strong practical knowledge of AWS or public cloud topologies, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), network security, and building/maintaining GitLab CI pipelines.
• Programming Languages: Foundational proficiency with modern web development frameworks and programming languages including Python, Ruby on Rails, Java, or Node.js.
• AI & Security Domains: Solid understanding of the OWASP Top 10 for LLMs framework, applied cryptography, cloud network isolation, and federated authentication architectures (OAuth2, SAML, OIDC, Zero Trust IAM).
• SecOps & Forensics: Working proficiency with modern EDR platforms, SIEM systems, network packet analysis (PCAP), threat intelligence frameworks (MITRE ATT&CK), and forensic collection tools.
• Compliance: Practical experience aligning technical software and infrastructure controls with standards like PCI-DSS (v4.0), SOC 1, SOC 2, or DORA.

Preferred Qualifications / Certifications:

• Offensive/Red Team: OSCP, OSCE, or SANS GXPN.
• Cloud & Architecture: AWS Certified Security - Specialty, CKS (Certified Kubernetes Security Specialist), or CISSP.
• Incident Response: GCIH, GCFA, or specialized Blue Team certifications.
• AI Security: OffSec OSAI.

jobs.title: Business Development Executive – Public Sector (State and Local Government)
jobs.description:
CapTech is seeking an experienced Colorado-focused Business Development Executive. You will own business development for Colorado executive-branch agencies, departments, boards, and authorities, plus select county and municipal governments. You will collaborate with Colorado account and delivery leadership. You will be responsible for identifying strategic opportunities, developing new clients and identifying new opportunities within current accounts. While your primary focus is Colorado, you may support portfolio business development efforts in other markets; travel to other markets or CapTech offices may be required. Successful candidates should be entrepreneurial, have significant public-sector experience, a history of strong relationship management and a proven track record in selling IT consulting services to State and Local Governments. Must demonstrate strong prospecting and client facilitation of the full consulting sales cycle.

CapTech does not assign individual quotas; we offer competitive pay plus uncapped commission. We hold this role accountable for a portfolio-level growth plan you help build, including new agency relationships opened, competitive prime contracts won, and engagements our delivery teams are proud to put their names on.

Specific responsibilities for the Business Development Executive – Public Sector (State and Local Government) position include:

Own the Colorado pipeline

• Build and maintain a named-account plan for the State of Colorado: which agencies, which programs, which funding streams, which decision makers, and what we are going after in each over the next 24 months.

• Work the pipeline end to end – originate, qualify, shape, price, and close. Advance the opportunities we can both win and deliver well, and kill the ones we can't, early and without drama.

• Track the legislative and budget cycle, federal pass-through funding, and agency IT roadmaps so we are in front of a procurement well before it posts.

• Keep the CRM current enough that portfolio and firm leadership can forecast from it.

Lead our solicitation response effort

• Run capture planning before an RFP exists: intelligence gathering, incumbent assessment, competitive positioning, teaming and subcontractor decisions, and the go/no-go recommendation.

• Shape solicitations legitimately and early, including RFI responses, market research submissions, capability briefings, demonstrations, and vendor Q&A.

• Actively write and shape the response, not just review it. You will own win themes and the executive summary, write or heavily edit the approach and management sections, drive pricing strategy with portfolio leadership, and hold the capture team accountable.

• Navigate Colorado procurement mechanics, including competitive solicitations, sole source and emergency justifications, statewide price agreements, and cooperative contract vehicles.

Sell as a team with delivery leadership

• Partner day to day with portfolio and account leaders to set targets, growth objectives, and pursuit priorities, then execute them together.

• Coach delivery leaders into confident, effective sellers. Prep them for client meetings, debrief with them afterward, teach them to recognize and qualify an opportunity inside their own accounts, and build the pursuit rhythms and habits that outlast any single deal.

• Mine existing accounts with the delivery teams who serve them.

• Transition wins cleanly to delivery, then stay close enough to protect the client experience and spot the follow-on.

Represent CapTech in the Colorado market

• Be visible and known at agency events, state IT community forums, industry associations, and the national bodies our clients belong to.

• Act as a genuine advisor to agency executives on strategy, outcomes, and where technology actually helps.

• Feed market intelligence back into the portfolio, including trends, competitor moves, procurement patterns, and the capability gaps we should close.

Specific qualifications for the Business Development Executive – Public Sector, (State and Local Government) position include:

• 8+ years selling professional services, with at least 3–5 of those years selling consulting or systems integration work to state or local government. This is a consulting sales role and experience is measured in scoped, priced, multi-phase engagements you shaped and closed, not in staff augmentation placements, software licenses, or reseller volume.

• Current, senior relationships inside State of Colorado organizations, including agency executive directors and deputies, CIOs and CISOs, division and program directors, OIT leadership, and procurement officials.

• Demonstrated hands-on ownership of competitive public-sector proposals, including orals evaluations and negotiation.

• Experience selling with and through delivery practitioners.

• Command of the public-sector buying cycle: appropriations and funding sources, procurement rules and timelines, evaluation and scoring mechanics, and contract vehicles.

• Ability to assess a client's real problem, find the gaps in how they have framed it, and shape a solution with our practitioners that we can deliver profitably.

• Strong writing and the ability to create dynamic presentations.

• Bachelor's degree in business, technology, or a related discipline, or equivalent experience.

• Residence in the Denver metro area, with the ability to be onsite at agency offices as needed.

Preferred

• Domain depth in one or more of: workforce and labor, health and human services, revenue and tax, transportation, or public safety.

• Experience with large modernization and legacy-replacement programs.

• Established standing in the Colorado technology and government community.

• Familiarity with agile product delivery, cloud and data platform modernization, human-centered design, and artificial intelligence.

jobs.title: Senior Network/Infrastructure Engineer, Onsite in Charlotte, NC
jobs.description:
Senior Network/Infrastructure Engineer, Onsite in Charlotte, NC

We are seeking a Senior Network/Infrastructure Engineer with strong experience in designing, deploying, and supporting enterprise networks and modern infrastructure platforms.  This hands-on role focuses on secure data transfer, infrastructure optimization, and day-to-day management of networking hardware, virtualization, and cloud workloads, with a strong bias toward automation and operational rigor.  This position is 100% Onsite in Charlotte, NC.

Senior Network/Infrastructure Engineer Responsibilities:

Infrastructure Management

- Own day-to-day operations of the VMware environment (vSphere/ESX/ESXi): lifecycle management, capacity, performance tuning, patching, upgrades, backup/DR coordination, and incident response.

- Partner on the virtualization roadmap, including planning and execution for migration from VMware to Nutanix (or Nutanix-based platforms), minimizing downtime and risk.

- Operate and optimize storage and compute platforms (e.g., Cisco UCS, SAN/NAS such as NetApp FAS/AFF, FlexPod), including performance troubleshooting and resilience planning.

Cloud & Platform Operations

- Manage and optimize Microsoft Azure workloads: networking, compute, storage, security controls, cost optimization, and operational monitoring.

- Operate Kubernetes environments (cluster upgrades, reliability, networking, ingress, policy, and workload troubleshooting).

- Build, deploy, and support Docker containerized applications and supporting infrastructure (registries, image hygiene, runtime security, scaling).

- Implement and maintain load balancing solutions (L4/L7), including TLS configuration and operational monitoring.

Network Engineering & Communications

- Design, implement, and support enterprise data/voice/video networks across LAN/WAN/Wi-Fi.

- Configure and support routing/switching and core network services (TCP/IP, BGP, OSPF, VLANs, QoS, DHCP/DNS).

- Administer and harden firewalls/VPNs (SonicWall, Cisco ASA, Palo Alto) and support secure remote access patterns.

Security, Secure Transfers, and Compliance Support

- Maintain secure internal and external data transfer mechanisms (e.g., SFTP/managed file transfer), including certificate/keys, access controls, and auditing.

- Support vulnerability remediation, security hardening, and practical control implementation aligned to customer/security expectations (e.g., PCI/SOC-related controls where applicable).

- Own SSL/TLS certificate lifecycle management across infrastructure components.

Operational Excellence & Automation

- Build repeatable, automated operations (Infrastructure-as-Code and configuration management preferred), reducing manual work and increasing reliability.

- Improve observability and troubleshooting practices (monitoring, alerting, packet capture, traffic analysis) and drive root-cause prevention.

- Participate in on-call/after-hours support rotations as needed for high-priority incidents and maintenance windows.

Collaboration

- Collaborate across internal teams and external vendors/clients to plan changes, execute upgrades, resolve incidents, and document outcomes.

- Create and maintain clear technical documentation (runbooks, diagrams, standards) to improve operational consistency and knowledge sharing.

Senior Network/Infrastructure Engineer Required Qualifications:

- 5+ years in a senior network/infrastructure engineering role supporting enterprise environments (hybrid datacenter + cloud).

- Strong, hands-on experience with Kubernetes, VMware (vSphere/ESX/ESXi), and Microsoft Azure (these are must-haves).

- Proven experience designing/supporting enterprise networks: LAN/WAN/Wi-Fi, routing/switching, VPNs, QoS, and troubleshooting (packet capture/traffic analysis).

- Firewall administration experience with one or more of SonicWall, Cisco ASA, and Palo Alto (policy, VPN, logging/triage).

- Experience with virtualization operations and performance tuning (compute, storage, networking).

- Windows Server administration experience (including legacy environments as needed), Active Directory, Group Policy, and Exchange in enterprise contexts.

- Working knowledge supporting SQL Server environments (AlwaysOn preferred).

- Strong operational habits: change management discipline, incident response, documentation, and clear communication.

Senior Network/Infrastructure Engineer Preferred Qualifications:

- Bachelor’s degree in a related field and significant datacenter operations experience.

- Certifications such as CCNA/CCNP, VCP, Nutanix (NCP), Azure (AZ-104/AZ-305), Security+, or equivalent experience.

- Experience with Cisco UCS, NetApp FAS/AFF, and FlexPod architectures in production environments.

- Familiarity with IIS/Tomcat administration and email security tooling (e.g., SpamTitan).

- Experience with tools such as Jira, Kace, SolarWinds, PRTG, Cerberus SFTP, Zerto, Trend Micro, WSUS, and related monitoring/endpoint/security platforms.

Benefits include medical insurance, Dental, Vision, Savings Plan Options, PTO, etc.

jobs.title: Director of Technology, Hands-on, Onsite in Charlotte, NC
jobs.description:
Director of Technology, Hands-on, Onsite in Charlotte, NC

The Director of Technology is responsible for the entire technology platform, overseeing both customer-facing systems and internal infrastructure to ensure 24x7 availability, security, and scalability across Azure Cloud and on-premises environments.  This hands-on leadership role balances technical execution and strategic management, including building a high-performing team, driving operational excellence, implementing security controls, and supporting the company’s rapid growth.  This position is a 50% hands-on and 50% management type of a role. Hands-on capabilities with infrastructure/data center management, cloud transformation and DevOps is necessary for this role.  This position is 100% Onsite in Charlotte, NC.

Director of Technology Responsibilities:

Leadership & Strategy:

- Build, mentor, and retain a team of 8 engineers across Infrastructure/Network, DevOps/SRE, and Desktop/End-User Support, providing technical coaching, career development, and performance management.

- Own platform strategy, roadmap, and execution to meet business goals and customer SLAs.

- Define and track operational KPIs (availability, Mean Time to Repair (MTTR), change success rate, incident volume, cloud cost efficiency) and present regular updates to the Chief Technology Officer (CTO) and executive team.

- Take full ownership of platform strategy, roadmap, and execution aligned with business objectives, product needs, and customer Service Level Agreements (SLA)s.

- Establish operational cadence: incident reviews, change advisory board, service desk metrics, team retrospectives, and continuous improvement of culture.

Platform Operations & Architecture:

- Own the design, implementation, and 24x7 operation of the company’s hybrid infrastructure (Azure and on-premises) supporting both production and internal corporate systems.

- Ensure high availability, scalability, performance, security, and cost efficiency across all environments.

- Hands-on architecture and implementation of cloud infrastructure, networking, identity management (Azure AD/Entra, RBAC), storage, backup, monitoring, and observability.

- Drive cloud optimization initiatives:  rightsizing, reserved capacity, architectural improvements, and cost governance across Azure workloads.

- Define and enforce platform standards for networking, security, identity, logging, alerting, and operational discipline.

DevOps & Site Reliability Engineering:

- Lead DevOps and SRE transformation: implement CI/CD pipelines, Infrastructure as Code (IaC) (Terraform, ARM/Bicep), containerization (Kubernetes), and modern deployment practices.

- Hands-on implementation of Kubernetes clusters, container orchestration, service mesh, and cloud-native architecture patterns.

- Establish Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) principles:  error budgets, SLOs/SLIs, blameless postmortems, observability (metrics/logs/traces), and reliability engineering culture.

- Build and optimize CI/CD tooling and workflows to improve release velocity, reduce deployment risk, and increase developer productivity.

- Implement robust change management processes (risk assessment, testing, communication, rollback procedures) that balance speed, safety, and audit readiness.

Information Security & Compliance:

- Implement security and compliance controls, including access management, logging and monitoring, vulnerability management, incident response, and audit evidence collection.

- Establish security best practices across infrastructure: network segmentation, firewall rules, encryption (data at rest/in transit), secrets management, privileged access management.

- Lead incident response for infrastructure and platform issues, including root cause analysis, remediation, and process improvements.

- Own Disaster Recovery strategy and execution: define RPO/RTO targets, architect multi-region and hybrid DR solutions, develop runbooks, and conduct regular DR testing.

- Ensure backup and restore capabilities across all critical systems with documented procedures and validated recovery processes.

Desktop & End-User Support:

- Oversee desktop, endpoint, and telecom services (laptops, mobile devices, productivity tools, collaboration platforms, voice/conferencing) to deliver reliable, secure employee experiences.

- Implement IT service management practices (incident, request, problem, asset management) with clear SLAs and user satisfaction metrics.

- Manage vendor relationships across infrastructure, telecom, SaaS, and managed services—evaluate contracts, optimize licensing, and ensure service quality.

Director of Technology Qualifications:

- 10+ years of progressive experience in IT infrastructure and operations, with at least 3–5 years in a leadership role managing teams delivering hybrid cloud environments.

- Need to be 50% hands-on and 50% management.

- Need hands-on capabilities with infrastructure/data center management, cloud transformation and DevOps is - Deep expertise with Microsoft Azure including computing (VMs, App Services, Functions), Networking (VNets, NSGs, load balancers), identity (Azure AD/Entra, RBAC), security, monitoring, and cost management.

- Proven track record architecting and operating highly available, mission-critical systems supporting 24x7 customer-facing platforms at enterprise scale.

- Strong background in security and compliance, with experience implementing controls.

- Demonstrated leadership of DevOps/Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) teams with hands-on experience building CI/CD pipelines, managing Kubernetes clusters, implementing Infrastructure as Code (IaC) (Terraform, ARM/Bicep), and operating observability platforms.

- Solid understanding and ownership of change management processes (Information Technology Infrastructure Library (ITIL) or similar) including change advisory boards, risk assessment, and audit-ready documentation.

- Hands-on experience designing and executing Disaster Recovery (DR) strategies in cloud and data center environments, including Disaster Recovery (DR) testing and runbook development.

- Experience overseeing desktop/end-user support and telecom services in a growing, distributed organization.

- Proven ability to recruit, develop, and retain high-performing technical teams with a coaching-oriented leadership style.

- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills and ability to translate technical complexity into business impact for executive and non-technical audiences.

- Thrives in fast-paced, dynamic environments with rapidly changing priorities and ambiguity.

- Strong ownership mentality: you take accountability for outcomes, drive issues to resolution, and lead by example.

Director of Technology Preferred Skills:

- Experience in B2B SaaS, telematics, fleet management, Internet of Things (IoT), or other real-time, data-intensive platforms serving enterprise customers.

- Familiarity with Information Technology Service Management (ITSM) tools (Jira Service Management, ServiceNow), configuration management databases (CMDB), and IT asset management practices.

- Experience with observability and monitoring platforms (Datadog, New Relic, Prometheus/Grafana, Azure Monitor, Application Insights).

- Background supporting real-time GPS tracking, vehicle telematics, or Internet of Things (IoT) device management platforms.

- Relevant certifications: Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate, Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP), Certified Information Security Manager (CISM), Information Technology Infrastructure Library (ITIL) Foundation or higher.

- Experience scaling infrastructure to support rapid business growth (2x–3x revenue in 2–3 years).

- Prior experience operating in regulated or compliance-driven environments (SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, FedRAMP).

- Hands-on experience with Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or similar CI/CD platforms.

jobs.title: Senior Data Analyst
jobs.description:
Ubisoft Barcelona Mobile is currently seeking a Senior Data Analyst / Data Scientist to help our team on their next adventure.

You will support insight initiatives for our Data and Analytics team across the modern data stack (Redshift, dbt, Power BI, GitLab) to turn raw data into decisions, and will be reporting to our Director of Data & Analytics.

Please note that a work permit for Spain obtained prior to applying for the position is mandatory.

Your daily adventure:

• Turning data into actionable insights, by performing hands-on research, data exploration and analysis, to drive decisions and strategies for user acquisition, retention, and monetization.

• Work with the game teams to provide insights into user behaviour, answer key business questions and support A/B test design and analysis.

• Build and maintain reliable, well-documented data models and pipelines that the wider organization can trust and self-serve from.

• Carry out projects in machine learning for behavioural segmentation and monetization.

• Design, build and maintain clear, actionable Power BI dashboards and reports for stakeholders across the studio.

• Debug and problem-solve issues to ensure the delivery of accurate and clear analysis, reports, and tools — versioning your work in GitLab following good CI/CD practices.

• Effectively communicate results and insights to senior stakeholders throughout the organization.

• Coordinate, challenge and share the best analytical practices and methods within the organization.

• Explore and prototype applications of AI and Generative AI (LLMs, AI agents, copilots) to accelerate analysis, automate reporting, and uncover new player insights.

• Stay up to date with the latest developments in Machine Learning, Data Science, and AI/GenAI trends.

• Contribute to the knowledge base and culture of the team.

YOUR SKILLS

• Master's degree in a quantitative field (i.e. Physics, Mathematics, Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science...). PhD in any of these disciplines is a plus.

• 5+ years of relevant work experience in similar positions, ideally in the mobile gaming industry.

• Highly proficient in SQL as well as Python for data exploration and analysis.

• Hands-on experience with cloud-based data warehouses, ideally Amazon Redshift, and data transformation tools such as dbt.

• Solid experience building dashboards and reports in Power BI (or similar BI tools).

• Comfortable working with version control (Git/GitLab) as part of the daily analytics workflow.

• Robust understanding of advanced statistics suitable for the analysis of skewed populations.

• Experience designing effective ways of communicating, visualising and reporting results/analysis.

• Experience in predictive analytics and segmentation.

• Excellent problem-solving capabilities with strong attention to detail.

Nice to Have:

• Hands-on experience using AI-assisted tools (e.g. GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude) to speed up analysis, coding, or documentation.

• Exposure to applying Generative AI / LLMs to analytics use cases (e.g. natural-language querying, automated insight generation, player-facing chat experiences).

• Experience with Agile methodologies (e.g. Scrum, Kanban, XP) and project management tools (e.g. JIRA).

• Software engineering best practices beyond Git, such as CI/CD pipelines and code review.

• Self-motivation, organizational skills, team spirit, proactivity.

• Passion for games. Interest in mobile F2P games.

YOUR LIFE AT UBISOFT BARCELONA MOBILE (and PERKS)

• Ticket Restaurant: 220€ per month, and a flexible compensation plan (ticket transport & ticket nursery).
• Flexible working hours: 40-hour workweek with start times between 8 AM and 10 AM (or from 7:30 AM when working onsite to avoid traffic jams), and early leave from 4 PM (Fridays from 2 PM).
• Reduced schedule (35 hrs per week) in July and August, Easter, Christmas holidays, and special days like Sant Jordi and Revetlla de Sant Joan.
• Personal Matters Hours: 24 hours paid for by Ubisoft that you can use for personal matters during your work schedule
• Holidays: 25 days per year + 1 day on your Ubi-Birthday.
• 5 extra holiday days on the year you celebrate your 5th/10th/15th/20th year with us.
• Health insurance with Cigna, including physiotherapy and psychology sessions at a reduced price.
• Life Insurance with AXA.
• Mobile Device Grant of 400 EUR starting in your 1st year in the company.
• Language training in English, Spanish, and French.
• Professional development training & programs, based upon request.
• Ubisoft games are available at a discount , and Ubisoft Connect in PC is free
• Locally roasted craft coffee by INCAPTO (it’s very, very good).

Ubisoft is committed to creating an inclusive work environment that reflects the diversity of our player community. We are an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to their race, ethnicity, religion, gender sexual orientation, age or disability status.

jobs.description:

The Technical Product Manager of Artificial Intelligence (AI) Systems is a deeply technical, hands-on role.  The Technical Product Manager of Artificial Intelligence (AI) Systems will work directly with engineers on system design, evaluation, and trade-offs-defining requirements, but shaping how the system works for global users.  The Technical Product Manager of Artificial Intelligence (AI) Systems will work at the intersection of user needs, model capability, and system constraints, and are responsible for turning AI potential into real, reliable behavior in a real-world application.  This position is 100% Remote.

MUST BE WILLING TO TAKE A 60 MINUTE CODING ASSESSMENT.

Technical Product Manager of Artificial Intelligence (AI) Systems Responsibilities:

- Research and define end-to-end Artificial Intelligence (AI) system requirements from capability to behavior to user impact.

- Translate model capabilities, data constraints, and evaluation results into clear product and system decisions.

- Make hard trade-offs across quality, latency, cost, reliability, and UX.

- Work closely with Machine Learning (ML), backend, and mobile engineers on system design, evaluation, and iteration.

- Define and evolve evaluation frameworks across offline metrics, online experiments, and human feedback.

- Drive execution with clear specs, strong judgment, and disciplined prioritization.

- Ensure systems ship quickly, safely, and reliably, with strong feedback loops.

- Own product quality end-to-end correctness, predictability, and user trust.

Technical Product Manager of Artificial Intelligence (AI) Systems Outcomes:

- Product strategy clearly aligns Artificial Intelligence (AI) capabilities with user needs and company priorities.

- AI features deliver real value, are understandable, predictable, and trusted by users.

- Decisions balance quality, speed, cost, and reliability effectively under uncertainty.

- Roadmaps and priorities are clear, with fast iteration based on real user feedback.

- Teams are aligned, focused, and able to execute on AI product goals with minimal friction.

Technical Product Manager of Artificial Intelligence (AI) Systems Qualifications:

- Hands-on exposure to Artificial Intelligence (AI)-powered products, including LLM-based systems.

- Artificial Intelligence (AI) experience required.

- Experience working with model evaluation, prompt or pipeline iteration, and feedback loops.

- Strong intuition for model limitations, hallucinations, bias, and drift.

- Strong grounding in computer science fundamentals, including algorithms, data structures, and system design.

- Solid understanding of Machine Learning (ML) fundamentals and how modern Artificial Intelligence (AI) systems behave in production.

- Comfort reading, reviewing, and discussing technical design documents.

- Significant experience owning complex, technical products end-to-end.

- Proven ability to work closely with senior engineers and ML teams.

- Strong judgment and decision-making ability in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.

- Ability to balance ambition with technical and operational reality.

- Experience shipping Artificial Intelligence (AI)-heavy consumer products is a plus.

- Background as an engineer or highly technical product manager is a plus.

- Experience defining evaluation metrics for Machine Learning (ML) systems is a plus.

- Strong intuition for Artificial Intelligence (AI) User Experience (UX) patterns and failure handling is a plus.

- Prior experience in zero-to-one product environments is a plus.

Benefits include medical insurance, Dental, Vision, Savings Plan Options, PTO, etc.

jobs.title: Senior Construction Safety Professional
jobs.description:
AECOM has a position available for Senior Construction Safety Professionals in Pittsburgh, PA. In this role, the person will be working at a client’s site full-time and act as an owner's representative at local utility construction sites. As the owner's representative and along with the construction general contractor, this person will review and collaborate on their safety programs to promote a culture of safety across the sites.

The responsibilities of this role include, but may not be limited to, the following:

• Monitor and advise on client’s EHS culture and support implementation of EHS procedures and regulatory requirements at the site.
• Conduct daily EHS inspections of construction site(s) to identify health and safety risks or areas of non-compliance with regulations, policies and procedures, contractor safety plans, and other related health and safety requirements.
• Review conformance with contractor hazard analyses and assess whether additional controls are needed to eliminate exposure or reduce the risk of incident or injury.
• Prioritize inspections and assessments associated with high-risk work activities.
• Maintain site postings and worker awareness of owner’s code of conduct, code of ethics, and policies.
• Identify areas of concern or non-compliance; provide recommendations to owners’ Project Managers and Safety & Security to verify approved process changes are accepted and implemented.
• Review contractor safety plans and corresponding hazard analyses.
• Review health and safety records, documentation of personnel training and certification, equipment certification, and health and safety metrics.
• Attend construction project meetings, such as kick-off and progress meetings, to represent owners’ safety & security.
• Respond to incidents and participate in investigations; review corresponding corrective actions and provide feedback or subject matter expertise as necessary.
• Provide Health & Safety and Security training to contractor staff prior to the start of work (typically every Monday).
• Complete Safety and Compliance Reviews (SCR) in owners’ contractor management system and review contractor submissions as requested.
• Report compliance findings as soon as possible to the contractor’s EHS Manager.
• A minimum of 60% of working hours shall be in the field engaging, coaching, walking.
• May need to travel to multiple project locations, as needed.

Minimum Qualifications:

• BS/BA in safety or related field +6 years of construction safety or related experience or demonstrated equivalency of experience and/or education.
• Safety Certification and familiar with 29 CFR 1926
• Valid Driver’s License and as a condition of employment must be able to pass AECOM’s Motor Vehicle Records review.
• Due to the nature of work, US citizenship is required.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Extensive knowledge of health and safety (OSHA 1926) regulations combined with basic environmental requirements for construction sites.
• Environmental, Health & Safety credential from a board-certified organization (i.e. CSP, ASP, CHMM, CHST) preferred.
• OSHA Outreach 10-Hour Training in Construction.
• Physically able to conduct routine field inspections and prolonged periods of walking or standing. Inspections may need to be conducted in inclement weather and require traversing rough or uneven terrain.
• Must be able to lift up to 25 pounds at a time.
• Experience overseeing a variety of construction trades
• NFPA 70E Certification
• OSHA 30 Construction Safety Training
• OSHA Authorized Trainer
• Certified Safety Professional or similar certifications
• Effective verbal and written communication skills with a variety of stakeholders

• Typically, be on-site 6:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m., Monday through Friday. Weekend or after-hours coverage may be required

jobs.title: Lead Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Job Title: Lead Software Engineer

Department: Product Development

About the Role:

Unite Us is seeking a Lead Software Engineer to provide senior technical leadership for our Platform Services team, the core APIs and services that power the entire Unite Us product suite. This is a senior individual-contributor role, not a people-management role: the Lead Engineer sets technical direction, raises the bar on engineering quality, and multiplies the team's effectiveness through mentorship, architecture, and hands-on delivery, rather than through direct reports. The Lead Engineer acts as the primary technical counterpart to the Senior Engineering Manager, translating team goals and long-term architectural context into concrete technical plans, and representing Platform Services' technical perspective in conversations with other engineering teams and stakeholders. This role requires deep experience with large-scale, object-oriented backend systems, APIs, and interoperability standards, along with the judgment to make and defend significant design and architecture decisions. A background in the healthcare or social care problem space is useful but not required.

What You'll Do:

• Own and evolve the technical architecture of Platform Services' core APIs and interoperability solutions, ensuring they remain scalable, secure, and maintainable as usage grows.

• Lead the design and implementation of complex, cross-cutting technical initiatives (e.g., FHIR-based interoperability, authentication frameworks such as SAML, SCIM, OAuth, and SMART), from proposal through delivery.

• Set technical standards and best practices for the team; review designs and code to maintain quality, consistency, and long-term maintainability across new and legacy codebases.

• Mentor and grow other engineers on the team, including pairing, technical coaching, and helping less experienced engineers reason through design trade-offs.

• Partner closely with the Senior Engineering Manager to translate team vision and business priorities into a concrete technical roadmap, and surface technical risks early.

• Represent Platform Services in cross-team technical discussions, building consensus with other technical leads on shared approaches and integration points.

• Break down ambiguous or large-scale problems into well-scoped technical plans that others on the team can execute against.

• Stay hands-on: contribute production code, especially for the highest-leverage or highest-risk parts of the system.

• Contribute to a positive, solution-focused, and collaborative team culture.

You’re a great fit for this role if:

• 7-8+ years of relevant experience as a software engineer, with a track record of increasing technical scope and ownership.

• Demonstrated experience leading the design and delivery of complex, large-scale, or cross-team technical initiatives.

• Deep understanding of CS fundamentals and of building and operating large-scale distributed backend systems and APIs.

• Strong track record of mentoring engineers and raising the technical bar of a team, without formal management authority.

• Experience making and communicating significant architecture and design trade-offs, and influencing technical direction beyond your own immediate work.

• Experience writing code that is clear, concise, testable, and easily understood by other engineers, and holding others to that same bar.

• Proficiency with modern web development technologies and techniques for building web services; strong back-end and API integration background.

• Experience with cloud-based SaaS development and CI/CD practices.

• Comfortable navigating ambiguity and multiple concurrent stakeholder demands.

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related engineering field required; equivalent practical experience will be considered in lieu of a degree.

Preferred

• Experience with open standards-based authentication frameworks such as OAuth and SAML.

• Experience with Ruby or Ruby on Rails, Python, or with object-oriented and/or functional programming generally.

• Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and monitoring systems like New Relic or DataDog.

• Experience working in Agile teams, particularly remotely.

• Experience with healthcare or social care technologies such as Fast Healthcare Interoperability Resources (FHIR).

Our Mission:

Unite Us’ mission is to unlock the potential of every community. Our co-founders started Unite Us in 2013 to serve the people they served with. They witnessed firsthand the barriers and inefficiencies in trying to navigate health and social services, and set out to improve that experience for veterans and their families. Unite Us quickly expanded to serving all people who need connections to care across our country. Through Unite Us’ national network and software, community-based organizations, government agencies, and healthcare organizations are all connected to better collaborate to meet the needs of the individuals in their communities. We drive the collaboration to predict, deliver, and pay for services that impact whole-person health. If you want to do well and do good, join Unite Us.

Environmental Job Requirements and Working Conditions:

• This position is remote, U.S. based.

• This position may require 5% travel

• The target pay range for this role is: $160,000-$190,000. This salary range represents our target hiring range for this role. The proposed salary will be dependent on the candidate's skills, experience, and competencies, as well as location.

• All team members will be required to pass a background check which includes criminal, employment, and education verification

Benefits provided by Unite Us:

Medical, Dental, and Vision

We offer insurance to team members and eligible partners and dependents, including unlimited virtual mental health and acute medical visits.

Wellness

Mental health benefits, such as the Employee Assistance Program (EAP) and wellness platform subscription, are available to all team members.

Flexible Time Off

Take what you need, including volunteer days and mental health days. We also offer 14 paid, company-wide holidays.

Paid Parental Leave

Adoptive parents are included.

Employee Resource Groups

Join our ERGs to connect and engage with colleagues, like Military Veterans

Spending Accounts

We offer tax-advantaged health savings accounts (HSAs), flexible spending accounts (FSAs), and commuter benefits.

401(k) + Employer Match

Enjoy matching, immediate vesting and financial wellness resources

Additional Benefits

Life and AD&D - a company paid benefit, with the option to purchase additional coverage for yourself and your dependents

Disability Coverage

Accident Insurance

Pet Insurance

As part of this work at home job, we will provide you with all the necessary equipment to perform your duties, including a computer, mouse, keyboard as well as other items on our approved list of WFH supplies.

Unite Us is committed to building a diverse team and fostering an inclusive culture, and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We embrace and encourage our employees' differences in race, religion, color, national origin, gender, family status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, veteran status, disability, pregnancy, medical conditions, and other characteristics. jobs.title: Construction Project Manager

As a Construction Project Manager, your main focus will be to lead and manage construction projects end‑to‑end, ensuring they are delivered efficiently, professionally, and in full compliance with company standards, policies, quality requirements, and timelines. You oversee planning, budgeting, contracting, execution, documentation, and collaboration with internal and external partners to secure sustainable, safe, and cost‑efficient project outcomes.

This on-site role reports into our Construction Manager and is based out of one of our Sales Region locations (New York/LA/Houston/Miami)

A Day in the Life

Working at H&M means no two days are ever the same, but a typical day will include the following responsibilities*

Planning, Budgeting & Pre-Construction

• Prepare investment project budgets and business cases in line with global Construction Processes

• Conduct site surveys, perform value engineering, and prepare risk analyses to support decision‑making

• Develop detailed project plans based on input from internal teams and external consultants, optimizing timelines and reducing installation, labour and related costs

• Align with Leasing and Legal on contractual obligations and project demarcation

• Liaise with consultants and authorities to secure all required permits

• Continuously improve planning and follow‑up tools and share best practices across the team

• Apply retro planning using input from other departments and consultants to minimize installation, labor, and other costs

Procurement, Contracting & Partner Management

• Support (Procurements Specialist) with external partners sourcing

• Support the pre‑qualification of new contractors to maintain a strong, high‑quality supplier base

• Review contracts to ensure all project and country‑specific risks are covered and attach execution and payment schedules accordingly

• Ensure all contracts and appendices are approved and signed before any work begin

• Secure contractual obligations through qualitative contract management throughout the project lifecycle

• Ensure country‑specific risks are incorporated in contracts and that payment schedules follow legal/market norms

• Ensure that all contracts are stored and signed according to approval rights and governance rules

Project Execution, Quality and Health & Safety

• Secure that stores are designed and built in line with building specifications and interior guidelines

• Follow up on construction progress through site visits and project meetings, ensuring deadlines, quality standards and compliance are met

• Ensure Health & Safety requirements are in place and consistently followed

• Manage change orders, secure transparency in all project finances, and keep the project budget within approved forecasts

• Ensure invoices reflect contractual terms and that landlord contributions are followed up

Documentation, Handover & Collaboration

• Ensure project timelines are accurately updated in LIMA (Planon) to support internal planning and future benchmarking

• Secure complete documentation before, during and after the project, stored according to global guidelines

• Challenge change orders proactively and ensure financial transparency for all projects

• Proactively share relevant information with other departments in a timely and structured way

• Experience from managing external suppliers and follow-up on contractual obligations

• Experience from working in a role with several stakeholders

• Work experience in large international organization is meriting

• You are communicative and supportive, with a consultative and creative mindset. You value teamwork, work methodically, and remain resilient and achievement-oriented, maintaining focus and drive even under pressure
