business need and/or on the selected candidate’s experience, knowledge and skills.

Compensation will be based primarily on the job level at which the role is filled and the

candidate’s qualifications, consistent with applicable law.

Accommodation & Accessibility Notice:

Intuitive is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. If you require assistance or an accommodation during any part of the application or interview process, please contact People Services at HRHelpNow@intusurg.com.

We provide market-competitive compensation packages, inclusive of base pay, incentives, benefits, and equity. jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Samsara’s Customer Success team is on the front lines of business value delivery by helping customers adopt our platform, realize measurable business value, and renew and expand with confidence. Our Mid-Market Customer Success Managers pick up where our Implementation team leaves off, working closely with our customers to understand their fleet and unique challenges, advising on how to customize Samsara for their needs, and becoming their long-term partner.

You’ll manage a portfolio of 100-200 named accounts, using AI tooling to Mid-Market your reach and prioritize where you spend your time. You won’t shy away from rolling up your sleeves on integrations and the more technical aspects of the Samsara platform — you’ll learn, understand, and convey the value of our most complex products and features.

Your role will be cross-functional, working alongside and connecting Sales, Support, Sales Engineering, and Product, enabling you to experience multiple aspects of a hyper-growth company from within. The Mid-Market CS team is still being built, and you’ll help write its next chapter — shaping the playbooks, workflows, and AI-powered motions that define how we Mid-Market.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the US except Alaska, Austin Metro, Boulder Metro, California, Chicago Metro, Connecticut, Dallas Metro, Denver Metro, Houston Metro, Maryland, Massachusetts, New Jersey, New York, Rhode Island, Seattle Metro, and Washington, D.C.

You should apply if:

• You want to impact the industries that run our world: Every phone call you answer and every email you send can affect whether truck drivers deliver goods on time and without accidents, whether students get dropped off safely from school, or whether power gets restored quickly after a natural disaster.

• You thrive the most when solving problems: Our constantly expanding technology and the complexities faced by our customers provide an exciting range of challenges for our Customer Success teams. With a growth mindset and a desire to learn, you will strategically partner with our customers to find unique solutions to help keep their operations safe, efficient, and sustainable.

• You are a natural relationship builder: Whether the relationship is with our customers or with cross-functional teams in Samsara, you are in constant communication and collaboration with key stakeholders to win as a team.

• You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. This Customer Success team is still shaping its future and you will have plenty of autonomy and opportunities to master your craft in a hyper growth environment.

• You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by the best and brightest professionals out there.

In this role, you will:

• Be on the front lines and ensure our customers increase the safety, efficiency, and sustainability of their operations with our IoT platform.

• Manage a portfolio of ~100-200 named accounts, using AI tooling to Mid-Market your engagement, prioritize proactively, and drive efficiency and outcomes across your book of business.

• Demonstrate a willingness to understand and explain technical issues to a non-technical audience and to engage the right cross-functional partners to drive resolution.

• Compose joint success plans with customers, outlining their objectives, metrics, and timelines, and effectively removing any barriers to achieving business value.

• Conduct workshops with customers to understand their current operations and recommend workflow changes to maximize the value of their Samsara products.

• Deeply understand the Samsara platform’s capabilities — including its more technical and integration-related features — and explain them to businesses of all types: field services, utilities, long-haul transportation, school buses, and many more.

• Help build the next chapter of Mid-Market CS at Samsara by contributing to the playbooks, workflows, and AI-powered motions that define how the team Mid-Markets.

• Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

Minimum requirements for the role:

• 2 - 4+ years of experience in a customer success, account management, sales, or strategic consulting role. Enterprise SaaS experience preferred.

• This is a demanding position with high internal visibility that requires strong priority management and high emotional intelligence.

• Experience supporting or working with technical products.

• Solutions-oriented with strong problem-solving skills.

• Proven track record of building trust and communicating effectively with a wide variety of internal and external stakeholders: executives, Sales, Product, Support, and Engineering leadership, and day-to-day users of our software.

• Passion for going above and beyond the call of duty, taking initiative, and thriving in a fast-paced, change-heavy environment.

• Diplomacy, tact, and poise under pressure when working through customer issues.

• Bachelor’s degree from a 4-year institution.

An ideal candidate also has:

• Experience working on a Renewal + Growth Quota

• Has a strong bias for action, the ability to think big, and insistence on high standards.

• Has experience serving and supporting large-Mid-Market business solutions at Fortune 500 companies.

• Thrives in an unstructured, fast-paced, and change-heavy environment.

• AI First: Experience using AI tooling to drive efficiency and outcomes.

• Technical Proficiency: Comfort with APIs and integrations.

The range of annual base salary for full-time employees for this position is below. Please note that base pay offered may vary depending on factors including your city of residence, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.

Annual Base Salary

$65,598.75—$88,200 USD

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email accessibleinterviewing@samsara.com or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

jobs.title: Associate Sales Relationship Manager
jobs.location: New York, New York, United States
jobs.description:
About Us

MarketAxess is on a journey to digitally transform one of the world’s largest financial markets, enabling the shift from analog, phone-based trading to a fully electronic marketplace. Why does this matter? Because our platform makes trading fixed-income more accessible, ultimately improving transparency, efficiency, and competition in the marketplace. Changing the way an established industry transacts is no easy feat. There will be twists and turns, because no one’s ever done this before. But now, more than 2,000 clients around the world rely on our solutions, and that number is only expected to grow in the years ahead. We know where we’re going. How we get there is up to us. Join us and help Take Us There.

The Role

Expand your career at the intersection of financial markets, technology, and client relationships. As an Associate Sales Relationship Manager, you'll partner with the New York Sales team to deliver exceptional client support, market insights, product expertise, and operational excellence that drive client success and adoption of MarketAxess solutions.

This role offers a unique opportunity to develop deep knowledge of the corporate bond market and the evolving electronic trading landscape while working alongside experienced Relationship Managers and Sales professionals. You'll gain valuable exposure to some of the industry's leading institutional investors and dealers, building the skills and expertise needed for a successful long-term career in capital markets.

How You'll Help Take Us There

Product & Market Knowledge

• Build a strong working knowledge of MarketAxess products and services, with a specialized focus on Investment Grade and High Yield bonds.

• Develop understanding of client workflows and how MarketAxess supports trading, liquidity, and execution.

• Stay current on credit market developments, supported by senior team members.

Client Support & Relationship Assistance

• Support Senior Relationship Managers in managing client relationships, acting as a reliable point of contact for day‑to‑day requests.

• Assist with client onboarding activities, follow‑ups, and end‑user training support.

• Help gather and document client feedback, escalating insights and themes to senior team members.

Analytics, Research & Reporting

• Support the preparation of client analytics, reports, and data extracts relating to trading activity and platform usage.

• Assist with research on existing and prospective clients to support sales planning and meeting preparation.

• Contribute to the production of monthly statistics, presentations, and internal reporting for the Sales team.

Sales & Internal Collaboration

• Work closely with the Sales Team and Senior Relationship Managers to support client meetings and ongoing engagements.

• Assist with preparation of client materials, agendas, and post‑meeting follow‑ups.

• Collaborate with internal partners (e.g. Marketing, Product, Technology) to support client‑facing initiatives.

Marketing & External Support

• Support the coordination and maintenance of client‑facing and marketing collateral, working with the US Marketing team as needed.

• Assist with logistics and preparation for industry events or client forums and attend where appropriate alongside senior colleagues.

AI & Data‑Driven Growth Mandate

• Automate routine tasks such as reporting, account analysis, and meeting preparation

• Generate tailored insights, summaries, and dealer materials using AI tools

• Improve speed and quality of decision‑making by combining AI outputs with market understanding

• Experiment with new AI‑enabled workflows to enhance dealer engagement and execution outcomes

• Partner with internal teams to support adoption of data‑driven and AI‑enabled solutions

What We’re Looking for

• 3+ years experience in a sales, relationship management or client-facing role within fixed income.

• Strong analytical skills and comfort working with data, Excel, and presentations.

• Ability to quickly learn financial products, platforms, and market concepts.

• Clear, professional written and verbal communication skills.

• Confident interacting with internal stakeholders and clients under guidance.

• Willingness to ask questions, seek feedback, and continuously improve.

• Highly organized with strong attention to detail.

• Proactive, reliable, and eager to learn.

• Able to manage multiple tasks and deadlines in a team‑based environment.

• Demonstrates professionalism when engaging with clients and representing the firm.

• Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Business, or a related field.

• Early‑career experience or internships in financial services, sales support, analytics, or client services preferred.

• Interest in market structure, trading technology, or capital markets.

• Must have or obtain SIE, 7 and 63 within 4 months of commencing the role

What You Can Expect from Us

• Free Food: We provide free lunch for employees when they are working in the office. Plus, our offices are stocked with snacks.

• Paid Time Off: Competitive PTO package including vacation and personal days, sick leave and charity days

• Generous Parental Leave: Up to 20 weeks fully paid leave

• 401(k): Dollar-for-dollar employer match up to $17,500

• Wellness Stipend: We provide employees with up to $1K annually towards gym memberships, home office equipment and more

• Onsite Healthcare: We offer convenient access to world-class care through Mount Sinai at our Hudson Yards location

• Tuition Assistance and Professional Development: Benefit from live and on-demand learning, role-specific training, employee-led Lunch and Learns and guest speakers

• Core benefits: Highly competitive medical, dental, and vision programs

For job positions in NYC, NY, and other locations where required, the estimated salary range for a new hire into this position is $90,000 USD to $125,000 USD. Actual salary may vary depending on job-related factors, which may include knowledge, skills, experience, and location. You may also be eligible for annual cash incentives, equity, and other benefit programs.

MarketAxess Corporation and its affiliates provide equal employment opportunities to all persons regardless of age, color, national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, race, religion, creed, gender, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristic in the location in which the candidate is applying.

Collaboration and innovation are integral to our success – it's how we got to where we are and how we’ll maintain and grow our competitive advantage. We believe this best happens in an office environment. Employees in Sales work in the office 4 or more days a week. This approach still allows for flexibility depending on the business function you work within but also helps us maintain a collaborative office environment long-term.

jobs.title: Change Management Lead
jobs.description:
At Accenture Federal Services, nothing matters more than helping the US federal government make the nation stronger and safer and life better for people. Our 13,000+ people are united in a shared purpose to pursue the limitless potential of technology and ingenuity for clients across defense, national security, public safety, civilian, and military health organizations.

Join Accenture Federal Services, a technology company within global Accenture. Recognized as a Glassdoor Top 100 Best Place to Work, we offer a collaborative and caring community where you feel like you belong and are empowered to grow, learn and thrive through hands-on experience, certifications, industry training and more.

Join us to drive positive, lasting change that moves missions and the government forward!

Fueling Federal Transformation:

Are you passionate about helping people and organizations embrace change. At Accenture Federal Services, we’re looking for a Change Management Consultant who thrives on solving complex challenges and driving transformation so federal government agencies can deliver on mission-critical initiatives. Our clients need someone experienced in building and executing change management strategies, working directly with teams to ensure smooth adoption of new processes, technologies, and ways of working. A change practitioner’s expertise lies in crafting actionable plans, engaging stakeholders, and delivering results that drive lasting impact in complex, federal environments.

The work:

• Work closely with project teams to integrate change management strategies into broader project plans.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams and federal stakeholders to align change efforts with organizational goals and mission objectives.

• Conduct readiness assessments and change impact analyses to identify risks, challenges, and mitigation strategies.

• Develop detailed change management plans, including stakeholder engagement, communications, and training strategies, to support federal client transformation efforts.

• Execute change management activities, such as facilitating workshops, conducting impact analyses, and implementing engagement strategies to drive adoption.

• Create and deliver tailored communications and materials to prepare and support end-users through change initiatives.

• Monitor and evaluate the effectiveness of change management activities, collecting feedback and making real-time adjustments to improve outcomes.

• Support the development of tools, templates, and methodologies to enhance the Talent & Organization practice and ensure repeatable success.

Here’s what you need:

• Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent experience

• 4+ years’ experience in one or a mix of the following areas: Change Management Workforce Transformation Agile Change Change Analytics Design Thinking

• Include 2-3 years of experience delivering change in a federal environment

• Familiarity with a digital technology platform (e.g. Salesforce, Pega, ServiceNow, Appian, etc.), a Cloud Service Provider (e.g. Amazon, Microsoft, Google), or Cyber Security

• U.S. citizenship required to meet federal client requirements

• Willingness to be on-site 100%

Bonus points if you have:

• Experience working as a consultant on change management

• Certified Change Management Professional (CCMP) Certifications or PROSCI

• Experience with designing, developing, and rolling out a change management plan for a mid- or large-scale program

• Experience leveraging artificial intelligence (AI) tools and techniques to solve client challenges and enhance change management efforts

• Familiar with digital authoring tools like Adobe Creative Cloud, PowToon, Mentimeter, Camtasia, SnagIt, Adobe Captivate, and Articulate 360 to accelerate learning and adoption

jobs.title: Power Service Technician
jobs.description:
This role supports the Field Services team by performing testing, maintenance, and repair of electrical systems across generation, renewable energy, industrial, and commercial installations. You’ll be responsible for ensuring the integrity and reliability of high- and low-voltage systems, directly impacting system safety, equipment performance, and customer satisfaction.

Success in this role means delivering high-quality, accurate technical work in dynamic field environments, all while upholding KE’s commitment to Safety, People, Passion, and Performance. If you're someone who takes pride in doing things the right way and thrives in a fast-moving environment, this position is built for you.

What You’ll Do

You’ll be part of a team that gets things done, works with purpose, and takes pride in the results. Your day-to-day responsibilities may include:

• Travel to customer sites for inspection, testing, troubleshooting, and start-up on electrical systems (240V to 765kV)
• Perform testing on power transformers (e.g., Power Factor, TTR, Insulation Resistance) and collect oil samples
• Test and troubleshoot protective relays, LV/MV/HV cables, switchgear, switches, and circuit breakers
• Test and troubleshoot instrument transformers and control circuits
• Read and interpret schematics, wiring diagrams, and electrical drawings
• Follow NETA ATS/MTS specifications and guidelines
• Manage project files, drawings, and technical documentation
• Provide excellent customer communication and service
• Train apprentices and other team members
• Be available for occasional evening, weekend, holiday, and emergency work
• Conduct hands-on execution including start-up, commissioning, and repairs
• Handle power delivery systems: transformers, switchgear, busways, UPS, ATS, PLCs, relays, and power control systems
• Prepare and maintain detailed reports, checklists, and documentation

What You Bring

You’re someone who shows up ready to work hard, learn fast, and contribute to a team that takes pride in doing things right. Successful candidates typically bring:

• At least 5 years of experience in electrical apparatus testing and troubleshooting
• NETA or NICET certification preferred
• Familiarity with power distribution, AC/DC voltage, and circuit theory
• Ability to read and interpret schematics, blueprints, and electrical drawings
• Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, Outlook, and diagnostic software
• Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills
• Valid driver’s license with a safe driving record
• Ability to pass a pre-employment drug screen and background check
• OSHA 30-hour, MSHA, NFPA 70E, CPR/First Aid/BBP/AED training preferred (training available through KE if needed)

Pay Range

We believe in paying for the value you bring to the team, and we aim to be competitive in every market we hire in.

$40 - $60 per hour plus per diem

Total Rewards

As a full-time employee at KE, you'll have access to a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your health, wellbeing, and future.

• 100% employer-paid health and dental coverage for employees
• HSA contributions to support your medical expenses
• Company-paid life insurance and disability coverage
• 401(k) with competitive company match
• Paid weekly with competitive wages
• PTO, six paid holidays, and education reimbursement
• Exclusive employee discounts through Working Advantage

We believe your work should be rewarded with more than just a paycheck. At KE, we invest in your total wellbeing.

Physical Requirements

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be provided for individuals with disabilities.

Typical requirements may include:

• Ability to lift and/or move up to 50 pounds
• Ability to sit, stand, walk, stoop, kneel, and climb ladders
• Tolerance to working in outdoor weather conditions and various environments
• Ability to work in confined spaces and elevated areas
• Travel to remote and on-site locations with varying conditions - up to 70%

Accessibility: If you need accommodations as part of the employment process, please contact KE Human Resources via email at HR@KEway.com.

jobs.title: Part-Time Retail Ambassador - University Village
jobs.description:
RETAIL AMBASSADOR - PART-TIME

Seattle, WA - University Village

At Rothy’s, we believe there’s a better way to do business—one that puts the planet and its people first. That’s why we’ve transformed millions of plastic bottles into stylish, sustainable shoes and bags, creating wardrobe staples that look just as good as they feel.

In our retail stores, clienteling, and genuine connection are at the heart of everything we do. We take pride in building lasting relationships with our customers—getting to know their style, anticipating their needs, and creating personalized experiences that make them feel truly seen and supported. Whether it’s helping someone find their perfect fit or sharing the story behind our sustainable designs, every interaction is an opportunity to deepen that connection.

As we grow, we’re cultivating not just a workplace, but a community. It’s a place where careers can grow, ideas are shared, and people feel a true sense of belonging. Every day brings new opportunities to learn, lead, and make an impact—together, as part of a welcoming, inclusive team that celebrates each other’s contributions.




ABOUT THE TEAM:

Shopping at Rothy’s IRL is not your ordinary retail experience—so naturally, our Stores team is extraordinary, too. Experts in the fit, wear and sizing of our shoes, these team members provide deep knowledge of every Rothy’s style and out-of-this-world customer service—creating long-lasting brand loyalty. Customers love shopping in our stores due to these exceptional interactions.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

As a Retail Ambassador, you will be the representative of the brand on the sales floor, delivering exceptional customer experiences and living our company values in every interaction. You’ll focus on creating meaningful connections with customers, driving sales through service, and supporting a welcoming, inclusive store culture. While your primary focus is on sales, you will also assist with limited operational tasks to ensure the store is well-maintained and running smoothly.




WHAT YOU’LL DO:

Customer Experience (90%)

 - Drive personal sales and results and contribute to team goals

 - Create lasting relationships with our customers by engaging in strong clienteling practices

 - Contribute to a positive, inclusive, and service driven store culture by modeling collaborative, team focused behavior

Operational Excellence (10%)

 - Execute assigned responsibilities accurately as part of daily store operations, including stock replenishment, visual merchandising support, and store organization and cleanliness

 - Demonstrate knowledge of store operations and policies, following established procedures and SOPs to ensure operational excellence and compliance




YOU ARE:

 - Guided by Rothy’s values and committed to fostering a welcoming, service driven environment:
   
   - Embrace Possibility.  We dream BIG, really big
   
   - Obsess Over Innovation: We never accept the status quo
   
   - Make the Planet Proud.  We make the right choice, not the easy one
   
   - Collaboration is Key.  We’re laser focused on driving results

 - 18 years of age or older




YOU HAVE:

 - Previous retail or customer service experience preferred

 - Strong communication skills and the ability to build genuine customer connections

 - A passion for service and the drive to achieve personal and team sales goals

 - Willingness to support operational tasks as part of the team

 - Availability to work at least 16 hours/week, either 3 Peak Days (Friday, Saturdays, Sundays + Holidays) OR 2 Peak Days (Friday, Saturdays, Sundays + Holidays) + 2 Non-Peak Days (Mondays - Thursdays)

 - Ability to stand/walk an entire shift

 - Ability to lift, push carry or otherwise move up to 25 lbs

 - Ability to frequently bending, reaching, stretching, and safely use ladders and step stools

 - Ability to uphold Rothy’s Experience by following our dress code, including wearing Rothy’s shoes during every shift




OUR BENEFITS:

 - Wellness and Commuter Programs

 - PTO and Wellbeing Time

 - Employee Discount Program




PAY RANGE:

$21.30 per hour

Base pay is one part of the total rewards package that is provided to compensate and recognize employees for their work.  This role may be eligible for additional discretionary bonuses/incentives, as well as a comprehensive benefits package.

Base pay will vary based on factors such as qualifications, experience, skill level, competencies and work location. We will meet minimum wage or minimum of the pay range (whichever is higher) based on city, county and state requirements.

jobs.title: Sr. SCM Analyst
jobs.description:
Step into the innovative world of LG Electronics. As a global leader in technology, LG Electronics is dedicated to creating innovative solutions for a better life. Our brand promise, 'Life's Good', embodies our commitment to ensuring a happier life for all. We have a rich history spanning over six decades and a global presence in over 290 locations.  Our diverse portfolio includes Home Appliance Solutions, Media Entertainment Solutions, Vehicle Solutions, and Eco Solutions.  Our management philosophy, "Jeong-do Management," embodies our commitment to high ethical standards and transparent operations. Grounded in the principles of 'Customer-Value Creation' and 'People-Oriented Management', these values shape our corporate culture, fostering creativity, diversity, and integrity. At LG, we believe in the power of collective wisdom through an inclusive work environment.  Join us and become a part of a company that is shaping the future of technology.  At LG, we strive to make Life Good for Everyone.

The Opportunity:

Driving better future mobility

VS (Vehicle component Solutions) Company (https://www.lg.com/global/mobility) of LG Electronics focuses on commercializing environmentally responsible automotive components and core solutions based on LG’s proprietary technologies. A leading provider of core components for global car manufacturers, VS Company is supporting the emerging trend of the vehicle industry.

As a Sr. SCM Analyst, you will:

Strategic Planning & Inventory Optimization
•Manage the inbound logistics process from manufacturing site delivery through warehouse receipt to improve inventory efficiency and logistics performance.
•Monitor, analyze, and present KPIs including Lead Time (L/T), Days Inventory Outstanding (DIO), and month-end forecast status.
•Lead daily inventory reconciliation across all sub-inventories, investigate discrepancies, and implement preventive measures to maintain data integrity.

Warehouse Operations & Third-Party Logistics (3PL) Warehouse
•Own the end-to-end inbound logistics flow from manufacturing site delivery through warehouse receipt, driving continuous improvement in inventory efficiency and logistics performance metrics.
•Release daily shipping orders to 3PL warehouses based on OEM demand and perform stringent shipping controls, ensuring timely delivery in line with customer JIT requirements.
•Verify Advanced Shipping Notifications (ASN) and manage warehouse costs by reviewing 3PL KPIs, identifying performance gaps, and driving corrective actions to reduce expenses and improve service quality.
•Design and implement standard operating procedures (SOPs) across warehouse and logistics operations to enhance consistency and operational efficiency.

Customs & Tariff Management
•Monitor and interpret rapidly changing customs policies, tariffs, and trade regulations; develop and implement proactive strategic response plans to minimize supply chain disruption and cost exposure.
•Administer duty drawback claims, Post Summary Correction (PSC) processes, and customs protests.
•Oversee transportation and packaging standards to optimize cost and compliance.

Data Analytics, Reporting & Process Improvement
•Quickly diagnose and resolve logistics supply chain issues as they arise; identify root causes and propose corrective solutions within tight turnaround windows.
•Conduct market research and industry benchmarking to inform strategic planning; present findings as comprehensive reports.
•Convene cross-functional task forces for new or recurring operational requests; design and standardize processes, implement action plans, and eliminate recurring inefficiencies through measurable workflow improvements.
•Drive initiatives to streamline operations, reduce lead times, and implement scalable solutions for data integration and process standardization.

Cross-Functional Collaboration
•Proactively coordinate with HQ and manufacturing subsidiaries to align logistics strategies and resolve cross-entity operational issues; serve as the primary liaison on supply chain matters.
•Partner closely with all other teams and departments to strengthen operational management, resolve issues, and optimize service delivery.
•Create and implement long-term supply chain management strategies that drive resilience, agility, and overall business performance.

-Performs other duties as assigned.

Requirements:
• Bachelor's degree in Business, Supply Chain Management, or a related field
• 5 years of progressive work experience in Supply Chain Management
• Maintain regular on-site attendance at the designated work location (in office, at customer site, etc.).
• Conduct work activities and/or attend occasional meetings after regular business hours when necessary.
• Maintain respectful work-related interactions and communications at all times.
• Adhere to all established company policies and procedures, work rules, and code of conduct.

Preferred:
• Experience in the automotive industry, particularly with OEM and Tier-1 supply chain management
• Advanced ability to interpret complex data sets using Microsoft Office (Excel) and ERP/MRP systems, translating findings into strategic recommendations for leadership.
• Deep working knowledge of Warehouse Management Systems (WMS), Transportation Management, and international trade compliance (CBP, Duty Drawback).
• Proven track record of working as a supply chain planner to ensure inventory readiness and accurate forecasting.
• Highly organized and detail-focused, with exceptional skills in process documentation and written/verbal communications.
• Demonstrated ability to solve complex customer and supplier issues, including managing high-volume discrepancies and executing crisis mitigation plans.
• Proven experience in tracking results and reporting to management while working closely with cross-functional teams to enhance service delivery.

Other Requirements:

•Travel: Ability to travel up to 5% (International & Domestic)
•Physical Requirements: Ability to independently lift and carry boxes weighing between 10–20 lbs.

Preferred:
• Bilingual proficiency in both Korean and English

#LI-Hybrid

Benefits Offered Full-Time Employees:

• No-cost employee premiums for you and your eligible dependents for competitive medical, dental, vision and prescription benefits.

• Auto enrollment with immediate vesting of competitive company matching contributions in a 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan with several investment options.

• Generous Paid Time Off program that includes company holidays and a combined bank of paid sick and vacation time.

• Performance based Short-Term Incentives (varies by role).

• Access to confidential mental health resources to help you and your loved ones improve your quality of life. Personal fitness goal incentives.

• Family orientated benefits such as paid parental leave and support for families raising children with learning, social, behavioral challenges, or developmental disabilities.

• Group Rate Life and Disability Insurance.

Benefits Offered Temporary/Contractors:

• Eligible for the relevant benefit programs offered through our partner agencies.

Applicants who need assistance or a reasonable accommodation during the hiring process may contact our team by phone at: 973-477-7090 or support@lg4me.freshdesk.com. This email and phone number will only reply to accommodation requests and is not intended for general employment inquiries.

Industry Expertise

• Develops knowledge in all Compeer products and services.

Sales and Prospecting

• Develops relationships with Compeer team members in assigned office or territory to facilitate referrals and new business

The skills and experience we prefer you have:

• Minimum of 1 year of preparing taxes preferred.

• Knowledge, technical competency and technological effectiveness in tax planning and preparation that meets client’s needs.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills.

• High level of integrity.

• Strong computer skills, including MS Office applications and tax and accounting software.

• Skill in developing and maintaining interpersonal relationships.

• Analytical skills with attention to detail.

• Problem solving, decision making and organizational skills.

• Ability to work evenings and weekends in order to meet deadlines and client expectations.

jobs.title: Manager, Risk Management (REMS) Consultant
jobs.description:
Are you interested in working directly for a single sponsor while having the security and additional career opportunities that working for a global CRO can bring? Our team says it’s the best of both worlds….

ClinChoice is searching for a Manager, Risk Management (REMS) Consultant for 12 months Contract with possibility of extension to join one of our clients.

ClinChoice is a global full-service CRO with a strong focus on quality, professional development, and supportive culture. As a client-facing role, we are looking for confident candidates with the ability to work independently whilst establishing a high-trust environment with the client’s counterparts.

Position Summary

The Manager, Risk Management supports the development, implementation, operational execution, monitoring, and assessment of Risk Evaluation and Mitigation Strategies (REMS) and U.S. risk management strategies under the oversight of the Client.

Key Responsibilities

REMS Program Strategy and Operations

Support the development, implementation, daily operations, monitoring, and modification of assigned REMS and U.S. risk management strategies

Propose and assist with the development and implementation of REMS modifications

Support operational readiness for launches, REMS modifications, and program transitions across business, quality, PV, call center, portal, and IT functions

Provide regular REMS status reports, proposals, and materials for review and approval

Support REMS Assessment Report planning, data collection, review, approval, and submission

Triage REMS operational inquiries and ensure timely response, documentation, and escalation

Collaborate across therapeutic areas to support REMS and risk management activities

Governance and Stakeholder Management

Coordinate and support REMS Core Team governance, including meeting materials, agenda, minutes, decisions, actions, risks, and escalations per Clients directive

Partner cross-functionally and provide concise program updates and decision materials to stakeholders and leadership

Train internal and external stakeholders on REMS requirements and processes

Compliance, Quality, and Inspection Readiness

Maintain controlled workflows, records, and inspection-ready documentation

Support audits and inspections; track findings, manage corrective and preventative actions (CAPAs), commitments, and remediation through closure, as required

Assist in the development, maintenance, and updating of REMS standard operating procedures (SOPs)

Coordinate development of responses to FDA information requests and related regulatory correspondence

Contribute to electronic document review, approval, and archiving systems, including development of REMS specific workflows

Assist with monitoring program and vendor compliance metrics for trends and escalate as warranted

Vendor, Contract, and Financial Oversight

Support client regarding vendor oversight of deliverables, service levels, quality events, effectiveness surveys, audits, remediation, and performance reviews

Support budget forecasts and contract alignment for current and future scope of work; and purchase order- invoice reconciliation as needed

Metrics, Reporting, and Risk Management

Monitor for and identify program risks, dependencies, resource constraints, and operational concerns/issues, such as (e.g., potential launch delays, system defects, resource gaps, or unresolved cross-functional dependencies); propose and support mitigation planning and escalation.

Education/Experience:

• Bachelor’s degree (life sciences preferred)

• Minimum of 3 years of relevant experience, with at least 1 year in REMS, Regulatory Affairs, Pharmacovigilance, Medical Affairs, Medical Writing, or a related function

• Equivalent combination of advanced degree and reduced experience may be considered

• Knowledge of FDA regulatory requirements across the prescription drug development lifecycle, including post‑marketing activities and U.S. submissions

• Experience with risk management program operations, including call center operations, database management, and effectiveness assessments

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills (English required)

·       Experience managing third-party vendors, contracts, budgets, service levels, and performance remediation in a regulated environment

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:

• Strong cross‑functional collaboration and stakeholder management skills

• Ability to influence within function, cross‑functionally, and globally

• Excellent organizational, analytical, and problem‑solving abilities

• High attention to detail with strong documentation practices

• Ability to manage multiple priorities in a regulated environment

·       Proficiency with data reconciliation, and electronic document regulatory information management systems

Preferred Qualifications

·       Advanced degree (MA, MBA, MHA, PharmD, or similar)

·       Experience with clinical trial operations, pharmacovigilance operations, and/or NDA/BLA submissions

·       Experience coordinating interactions with regulatory agencies, including scientific, regulatory, and safety meetings

·       Experience with product launch readiness, or major REMS program transitions

·       Project management certification or demonstrated pharmaceutical project/program management experience

Additional Requirements

• Ability to travel domestically up to 10%

The Application Process

Once you have submitted your CV, you will receive an acknowledgement that we received it. If you have the requirements we need, you will be invited for phone interview as the first step.  Unfortunately, due to the number of applications we receive, we cannot reply to everyone individually if you are not successful.

Who will you be working for?

About ClinChoice

ClinChoice is a global full-service CRO specializing in clinical development and functional solutions for pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical device, and consumer health companies. We have over 28 years of proven high-quality delivery and results across all our services, with over 4,000 professionals in more than 20 countries across the Americas, Europe, and Asia-Pacific.

Our Company Ethos

Our mission drives our culture: to contribute to a healthier and safer world by accelerating the development and commercialization of innovative drugs and devices. Our employees are the most valuable company asset and they are the fulcrum around which all ClinChoice activities are built and close management and training is the core instrument to develop and maintain highly-qualified personnel. The continuous training keeps the resources qualified in terms of competence and expertise and gives all personnel the clear tools needed to manage both internal and client processes with the same methodology.   The success of these core values is evidenced by our below industry average turnover rates.

ClinChoice is an equal opportunity employer. We have based our success on attracting, developing, and promoting talent guided by diversity and inclusivity. Our employees come from very diverse backgrounds: gender, race, beliefs, and ethnicities. We recognize this is our strength and celebrate it.

jobs.title: Strategic Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
Paperless Parts is the SaaS-based intelligence layer for modern manufacturing, enabling our customers to innovate faster in the physical world. From rockets to medical devices, we power the parts that move the world forward.

This position requires activities that are subject to US Export Control Laws and require US Citizenship or Green Card Holder.

Strategic Customer Success Manager

Location: Boston, MA (Hybrid)

Reports To: Senior Director of Customer Success

Employment Type: Full-Time

Travel: Up to 50%

This position requires activities that are subject to US Export Control Laws and require US Citizenship or Green Card Holder.

The Opportunity

As a Strategic Customer Success Manager, you will operate as a trusted business partner to our enterprise customers, engaging across all phases of the customer lifecycle to drive long-term value and measurable business outcomes. You will build and maintain multi-threaded relationships across all levels of the customer organization—from executive leadership to site-level operators—ensuring alignment between corporate objectives and day-to-day execution.

In this role, you will provide data-driven insights and strategic guidance, helping customers optimize platform performance and overcome operational challenges across locations. You will partner closely with internal teams, including Sales, Implementation, Product, and Support, to advocate for your customers, influence product direction, and secure long-term account growth and retention.

What Success Looks Like (First 6–12 Months)

• Portfolio Health & Retention: Maintain net revenue retention above target across your assigned enterprise account portfolio.

• Multi-Site Adoption: Successfully execute phased rollouts across complex customer organizations to achieve target seat and workflow adoption milestones.

• Value Realization: Establish and present quantified ROI frameworks to executive stakeholders during quarterly business reviews for top-tier accounts.

Key Responsibilities

• Portfolio Management: Own a portfolio of 20–40 enterprise accounts representing up to 15% of ARR, driving retention, expansion, and long-term customer success.

• Executive Relationship Building: Build and maintain multi-threaded relationships from C-suite leadership to site-level operators to align corporate strategy with operational execution.

• Account Strategy & ROI: Develop strategic success plans tied to customer business objectives, regularly measuring performance and communicating ROI to executive stakeholders.

• Multi-Site Rollouts: Program manage enterprise-wide, multi-location rollouts to ensure consistent software adoption and operational results.

• Business Reviews & Escalations: Conduct on-site and virtual business reviews, serving as the trusted advisor and primary escalation point for critical account needs.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Sales, Product, and Implementation teams to advocate for customer requirements, inform product strategy, and drive renewals and expansion.

Relationship Expansion: Partner with Sales team to identify opportunities to expand the commercial relationship with strategic customers based on existing ROI recognition and future value creation.

Qualifications & Experience

Core Requirements

• Enterprise Customer Management: Proven track record in Customer Success or Technical Account Management supporting complex B2B enterprise accounts.

• Commercial Accountability: Demonstrated experience managing portfolio retention, identifying expansion opportunities, and driving measurable ROI.

• Stakeholder Management: Exceptional executive presence with experience managing multi-threaded relationships across leadership and operational teams.

• Program Management: Experience leading complex, multi-site software implementations or rollouts in matrixed environments.

• Location: Ability to work on-site in Boston, MA on a hybrid schedule, with up to 50% travel required.

• Domain Expertise: Background in manufacturing or manufacturing software (e.g., Sheet Metal Fabrication, CNC Machining, Additive Manufacturing).

• Technical Aptitude: Experience translating complex technical data and operational workflows into actionable business insights.

Salary range:  $107,000 - $145,000

This role is also eligible for commission based compensation

The job posting range is the lowest to highest salary we in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting. We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range, and the range may be modified in the future. jobs.title: Director of Consultant Relations
jobs.description:
ABOUT 9AMHEALTH

9amHealth is an AI-enabled virtual specialty care platform focused on managing high-cost chronic conditions at scale. The company partners with employers, health plans, and pharmacy benefit managers to deliver comprehensive, cost-effective medical care for individuals living with obesity, diabetes, hypertension, and dyslipidemia. Members receive access to specialized clinicians, including endocrinologists, obesity medicine specialists, and clinical pharmacists, at-home lab testing, prescription medications, and lifestyle support.

9amHealth was founded in 2021 and is backed by leading healthcare investors like Define Ventures, SemperVirens, 7Wire Ventures, and The Cigna Group Ventures.


DIRECTOR OF CONSULTANT RELATIONSHIPS

Location: Remote
Full-time



ABOUT THE ROLE

This role was created to strengthen 9amHealth’s presence in the benefits consulting and PBM

space. As we continue to expand, we need a dedicated Sales Executive to build and manage

high-value relationships with consultants and advisors who influence employer healthcare

decisions. This person will be the face of 9amHealth in this channel, ensuring our solution stays

top-of-mind and driving revenue through strategic partnerships.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Build and grow relationships with employee benefits consultants, pharmacy consultants, and other key influencers in the employer health ecosystem.
   
   - For this role, your targets aren’t employers directly (at least not primarily) — they’re influencers and gatekeepers in the employer healthcare decision-making chain.
   
   - So in plain English: they’re selling 9am Health by winning over the advisors who steer employer healthcare dollars. Land the consultants → consultants recommend you → employers adopt.

 - Secure commercial agreements and formal partnerships with consulting firms and their

 - client networks.

 - Attend and host social and office events to deepen relationships and increase awareness of 9amHealth.

 - Maintain an active presence in industry networks and engage with national pharmacy teams.

 - Keep vendor profiles current and optimized across consultant and broker platforms.

 - Identify mutually beneficial incentive structures and co-marketing opportunities.

 - Collaborate with internal sales and marketing teams to deliver materials, proposals, and case studies that support consultant engagement.

 - Monitor industry trends, competitive activity, and client needs to inform strategy and opportunities.




WHAT YOU’LL NEED

 - A relationship-driven B2B sales professional with 7+ years of experience, ideally in digital health, PBMs, benefits, or healthcare services.

 - Proven success selling to or through consultants, brokers, or advisors.

 - Exceptional networking skills and comfort connecting with stakeholders at all levels in both formal and social settings.

 - Self-starter mentality with the discipline to manage and grow your own pipeline.

 - Comfortable traveling to partner offices, industry events, and conferences as needed.


WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT AT 9AMHEALTH

At 9amHealth, you'll join the exciting environment of a startup with the stability of highly experienced founders that have successfully built a business from scratch. We foster a collaborative learning mindset and a passion for improvement. You'll work with a brand-new product alongside a small, flexible team of people eager to shape technology, infrastructure, and culture.

Our team members are spread across the globe, with physical sites in San Diego, California, and Vienna, Austria, but we value your culture regardless of where you work.

We offer a comprehensive benefits package, including health, dental, and vision insurance, along with flexible PTO and work from home options. We provide a professional development budget and support continuing education, empowering our team to grow alongside the company. Team members have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact on chronic disease management and patient outcomes while contributing to a collaborative, mission driven culture focused on improving healthcare accessibility and affordability.




OUR COMMITMENT TO DIVERSITY AND INCLUSION

Diabetes disproportionately impacts BIPOC (black, indigenous, and people of color) https://9am.health/en/journal/how-diabetes-affects-bipoc-communities communities. We are committed to creating a workforce that reflects our patients and creating a positive healthcare experience for them. We welcome applications from people of color, LGBTQ+ individuals, people with disabilities, members of ethnic minorities, and foreign born residents.

jobs.title: Lead Animator
jobs.description:
WHAT YOU WILL BE WORKING ON

Your main challenge

Gameloft Barcelona is looking for a Lead Animator to lead the animation team working on a new action-based, multi-platform IP featuring world-famous characters from a major licensor.

Your challenge will be to establish and maintain a high animation quality bar while leading and developing the team behind it. You will combine people leadership with strong animation expertise, working closely with Art, Game Design, Programming and external partners to ensure every animation supports the personality of our characters, gameplay readability and the overall player experience.

What it means on a daily basis

• Lead and develop the animation team, providing regular feedback, mentoring and guidance while supporting the individual growth of animators across different seniority levels.
• Own the animation quality bar, ensuring character animation delivers the expected level of movement, weight, acting, storytelling and personality while remaining consistent with the project's artistic direction and licensor expectations.
• Plan and oversee animation production, managing priorities, workload and delivery while keeping stakeholders informed and stepping into hands-on animation work when the team needs additional support.
• Collaborate closely with Game Design, Programming, Art and Technical Animation to ensure animations work effectively within gameplay, including topics related to rigging, skinning and game-engine animation states.
• Coordinate animation work with external partners, providing clear briefs, reviews and actionable feedback to ensure outsourced animation integrates consistently with the work produced internally.

What success will look like

Within your first 3 months, you will have developed a strong understanding of the project's animation direction, characters, production pipeline and team, establishing effective ways of working with the animators and key partner disciplines.

Within 6 months, you will be confidently leading animation production and team development, maintaining a consistent quality bar, identifying production or quality risks early and ensuring the team receives the direction and feedback needed to deliver.

Within 9 months, you will be a key reference for animation across the project, helping the team operate with increasing autonomy while continuously raising animation quality and strengthening collaboration between Animation, Art, Design, Programming and external partners.

Who you would be working with

You will report to the Studio Art Development Director and lead a team of 3D Animators and Technical 3D Animators.

You will work closely with the Studio Art Director, 3D Art Lead, Game Design, Programming and other production disciplines, while also collaborating with external animation partners and the project's licensor.

Your recruitment journey

Our recruitment process is designed to give you the opportunity to meet the people you would work with and explore both your animation expertise and leadership experience.

• Recruiter interview
• Hiring team interview
• Animation assessment/test, where applicable
• Final interview

Where this role can take you

This role gives you the opportunity to take ownership of animation at project level, developing both your craft and leadership expertise while contributing to a major multi-platform IP.

You will have the opportunity to grow as an animation leader, influence animation standards and workflows, develop other artists and collaborate closely with senior creative and technical stakeholders across the project.

WHAT YOU NEED TO SUCCEED

• Strong expertise in 3D character animation for games, with the ability to create and evaluate both realistic and stylized/cartoon animation.
• Excellent understanding of movement, weight, acting, timing and storytelling, with the ability to preserve the identity and personality of a character through animation.
• Ability to establish, communicate and maintain animation quality standards, translating animation principles into clear visual, written and verbal feedback.
• Strong understanding of game animation production and real-time workflows, including effective collaboration with Technical Animators on rigging, skinning and game-engine animation states.
• Ability to plan and prioritize animation work, manage production constraints and communicate clearly with stakeholders regarding scope, quality and delivery.
• Professional experience with industry-standard 3D animation tools and workflows, particularly character animation pipelines such as Maya and/or 3ds Max.
• Fluent English and the ability to communicate effectively within an international and multidisciplinary development environment.
• A portfolio or showreel demonstrating strong character animation work and relevant game animation experience.

WHO YOU ARE

• A supportive people leader who can mentor and develop animators across different levels of seniority.
• Comfortable giving clear, constructive and actionable feedback while maintaining a high creative quality bar.
• Collaborative and able to act as a central point of communication between Animation, Art, Game Design, Programming and external partners.
• Organized and able to manage changing priorities in a dynamic production environment.
• Hands-on when needed, with a lead-by-example approach and the ability to balance team leadership with direct creative contribution.

Why Join the World of Gameloft?

• Because you want to be part of an exceptional experience within a company that is constantly growing!
• Because you want to work with talented people who are industry pioneers!
• Because you want to be part of an international environment with daily contact with other countries & cultures!
• Because you want to work in an inclusive equal opportunity workplace!
• Or, just because you’re looking for a great place to work!

Benefits:

• Permanent contract and full-time position with excellent social benefits.
• 25 vacation days per year.
• Private medical health insurance.
• Flexible compensation with Ticket Restaurant Card.
• Flexible work-from-home hybrid model.
• Free language courses.
• Your birthday off!
• 1 month of remote work.
• Merit-based salary progression system and a competitive initial salary package.
• Career development opportunities.
• Excellent working conditions, with our office located in the centre of Barcelona.
• ...and Thursday after-work beers!

We can’t wait to find our next great talent!

Join our team, recently recognized in Forbes' top 100 companies to work for! We're gamers from all walks of life, united in creating a culture of inclusivity. Partnering with organizations like COGAM, we ensure a safe workplace for everyone, regardless of background or gaming preference. Whether you're a casual or hardcore gamer on any platform (we're cross-platform now!), we want you to feel like you belong. Be part of shaping the gaming industry with us!

Want to know more? Please visit our Website: www.gameloft.com

jobs.title: Network Engineer, Distributed Compute
jobs.description:
ABOUT BASE

Base is America’s next-generation power company. We’re rebuilding the foundation of modern civilization–electricity–by deploying a vast network of distributed batteries that is transforming today’s fragile, centralized grid into a resilient and abundant system. We are engineers, operators, and creatives solving some of the most complex, interdisciplinary challenges of our time.




ABOUT THE ROLE


WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Own the end-to-end network architecture for Distributed Compute networks: site connectivity, backhaul, the fleet-wide overlay, and the interconnect within each node. Standardize the per-site network stack (routing, switching, firewall, out-of-band management) so new sites come online quickly.

 - Lead fiber and carrier strategy for the fleet. Evaluate dark fiber vs. lit services, and build vs. lease decisions per site cluster. Select topologies that scale with site density, and manage carrier/ISP selection, circuit ordering, and failover across fiber, fixed wireless, and cellular. You'll build on existing work with Base's fiber consultants and take over this function as it scales.

 - Build and operate the fleet overlay and its automation. Establish secure site-to-site and site-to-cloud connectivity, BGP routing, and traffic engineering for inference workloads. Automate configuration generation, zero-touch provisioning, and monitoring so network state is managed in code.

 - Instrument, secure, and support the network in practice. Track latency, throughput, packet loss, and circuit health in Base's telemetry and Grafana stack. Define segmentation between compute, battery control, and management planes, along with certificate management and audit-ready access controls. Support the first installs and site bring-ups in the field, then reduce on-site involvement as processes mature.

 


WHAT YOU'LL BRING

 - 5+ years running production networks

 - Deep, hands-on routing and switching: BGP, OSPF, VLANs, VRFs.

 - Experience with site-to-site connectivity at scale: SD-WAN or overlay networks (WireGuard, IPsec) across tens to hundreds of locations.

 - Familiarity with fiber networks and topologies

 - Experience procuring and managing circuits with carriers

 - Comfort in the field. Some of this job happens at a site in a utility territory

 


ABOUT THE TEAM

Distributed Compute is Base’s program for deploying modular datacenters on top of our battery fleet, turning distributed energy sites into a distributed inference network. That scale is a networking problem as much as a power problem. Hundreds of small sites, each running GPU compute, spread across utility territories, and every one of them needs reliable, secure, high-throughput connectivity, with the fleet behaving like one coherent network. This is the first dedicated network engineering hire on the program, so the architecture decisions are still open and the constraints are real: residential and utility sites, power budgets, physical access. What you build will carry production inference traffic within months, not years.



Please note: Base is a startup, which means priorities shift and evolve quickly. Your role may expand or change based on the needs of the business at any given time, so the responsibilities listed may not be exhaustive.




OUR VALUES

 - First Principles Thinking: Question assumptions. Principles > rules.

 - Operate at Base Pace: Focus on what matters, act quickly, and learn by doing.

 - Give & Get Feedback: Be direct, be humble, and maintain a growth mindset.

 - Everyone’s an Owner: Follow through on commitments and own results.

 - Strong Opinions, Loosely Held: Drive clarity and make calls with imperfect information.

jobs.description:
About Us

DLH delivers improved health and national security readiness solutions for federal programs through science research and development, systems engineering and integration, and digital transformation. Our experts in public health, performance evaluation, and health operations solve the complex problems faced by civilian and military customers alike by leveraging advanced tools – including digital transformation, artificial intelligence, data analytics, cloud enablement, modeling, and simulation, and more. DLH is dedicated to the idea that “Your Mission is Our Passion” and brings a unique combination of government sector experience, proven methodology, and unwavering commitment to innovation to improve the lives of millions.

Overview

The TCAC FoS is fielded to the United States Marine Corps Radio Battalions (RadBn) and Marine Corps Forces Special Operations Command (MARSOC). The TCAC FoS is a computer-based Signals Intelligence (SIGINT)/Electronic Warfare (EW) fusion center that provides automated SIGINT processing, analysis, and reporting capabilities. The system is configured to operate in a distributed mode and can automatically accept, process, correlate, and geographically display air, surface, subsurface, and emitter and sensor reports. The Fleet Marine Force (FMF) RadBns and MARSOC use the TCAC FoS capabilities to provide timely and accurate SIGINT/EW support to Marine Air-Ground Task Force (MAGTF) combat operations.

Responsibilities

• Work with Cybersecurity personnel utilizing ACAS and SCAP to scan Windows hosts and Linux VMs for vulnerabilities and missing STIGs.

• Utilize PowerShell and Bash scripting to apply patches, update software, and make configuration changes to Windows hosts and Linux VMs.

• Resolve application and configuration issues that arise during installation of new or updated software.

• Retrieve various Microsoft patches and SIGINT tools from applicable repositories; install and update the applications, and configure each to successfully execute as expected.

• Establishes and maintains network servers within the lab environment.

• Produces new software baselines and system builds based on operational requirements.

Qualifications

• Technical Training in computer systems and hardware integration.

• Eight (8) years of hands-on experience with Signals Intelligence or Distributed Common Ground System, to include three (3) of the following five (5) areas: Systems Requirements, Operational Requirements, Data Analysis, Test & Evaluation, and Training. Experience may be achieved simultaneously.

• Recognized expert who has demonstrated industry and/or military experience with Distributed Common Ground System or Signals Intelligence systems.

• Security + CE Certification required within 60 days of employment.

• Active TS/SCI Clearance walking through the door

Preferred Qualifications

• Prior Marine Corps system experience with an emphasis on SIGINT and C4I, and Systems/Software Integration.

• Familiarity with REL 9, Cisco Switches, Linux, Active Directory, Systems Administration, Bash, PowerShell, and Podman is a plus.

Benefits

DLH Corp offers our employees an excellent benefits package, including Personal Time Off (PTO), medical, dental, vision, supplemental life with AD&D, disability coverage, flexible spending accounts, and more. We want our employees to save for their future; therefore, we offer a 401(k) Retirement Plan, which includes a matching component. DLH is dedicated to your career development, providing training to help drive success, with access to our best-in-class e-learning suite for formal and informal learning, professional and technical certification preparation, and education assistance at accredited institutions.

EEO

jobs.title: MSL / Sr MSL, Hematology
jobs.description:
The Medical Science Liaison (MSL) is a highly trained, field-based scientific expert who engages healthcare professionals (HCPs) to exchange clinical, scientific, and research knowledge. Operating within regulatory and corporate guidelines, the MSL builds and maintains scientific relationships and collaborations with the medical and scientific community at the local, regional, and national levels, including HCPs, professional societies, and healthcare organizations.

Travel & Territory

• Assigned Territory: Northern California.
• This role provides educational, scientific, and research support for Sobi's rare disease portfolio within the hematology franchise, supporting the Northern California territory.
• Frequent travel by ground and/or air is required, with an estimated 60% or more of time away from the remote home office to support coverage of the Northern California territory and product needs.

Essential Responsibilities / Scope of the Job

Including, but not limited to, the following:

• Serve as the primary field-based point of contact for Sobi Medical Affairs within the Northern California territory.
• Engage appropriately with key thought leaders and healthcare professionals to exchange scientific information accurately, fairly, and in a balanced manner.
• Report field intelligence to Sobi, including competitive insights, perspectives on compounds, disease states, and the treatment landscape.
• Support Sobi's clinical development and operations teams through site recommendations, site initiation visits, communication facilitation, and accrual support activities.
• Participate in, and at times lead, advisory board meetings at the local, regional, and national levels.
• Deliver internal and external training on preclinical science, clinical data, and outcomes.
• Represent Sobi at medical conferences and provide session summaries.
• Serve as a cross-functional scientific resource across the organization, consistent with company guidelines.
• Maintain advanced, current knowledge of relevant studies, compounds, and disease states to support collegial, scientific discussions with leading hematology/oncology thought leaders.
• Demonstrate a high standard of excellence in managing the assigned Northern California territory while contributing to the success of colleagues and the broader MSL organization.

Required

• Accredited doctorate degree in a life-science or basic-science discipline (Pharm.D., D.Sc., D.N.P., Ph.D., or M.D./D.O.). Candidates with an advanced health-related degree combined with extensive industry or clinical experience will also be considered.
• Minimum of 1 year of MSL experience in hematology/oncology and rare disease.
• Existing familiarity with the Northern California medical/scientific community and key institutions.
• Ability to understand and effectively communicate scientific information, and to respond to inquiries and address the needs of key stakeholders.
• Strong written and oral communication skills, with the ability to shape and articulate a clear strategy and narrative.
• Demonstrated success managing internal and external stakeholders, and leading or influencing cross-functional teams in a matrixed environment.
• Proven ability to prioritize and manage multiple projects concurrently.
• Proven track record of strategic thinking, problem-solving, and decision-making.
• Ability to initiate and maintain relationships throughout the medical community.
• Demonstrated ability to build positive, constructive relationships with cross-functional internal team members.
• High level of personal integrity, emotional intelligence, and flexibility.
• Understanding of the highly regulated biopharmaceutical industry environment, including basic knowledge of the legal and regulatory landscape.
• Passion for science and teaching.

Compensation and Total Rewards at Sobi

At Sobi, we are dedicated to providing our employees with a comprehensive and industry-competitive total rewards package. Our compensation philosophy is designed to recognize and reward talent, ensuring that your contributions are valued and reflected in your overall rewards.

Your total compensation at Sobi goes beyond just your base salary and annual bonus. It also includes a robust suite of benefits, such as:

• A competitive 401(k) match to support your financial future.
• Tuition and wellness reimbursements to invest in your personal and professional growth.
• A comprehensive medical, dental, and vision package to prioritize your health and well-being.
• Additional recognition awards to celebrate your achievements.

All Sobi employees need to demonstrate behaviors in line with Sobi's core values: Care, Ambition, Urgency, Ownership and Partnership. Are you ready to be on the Sobi team? Come join a culture that empowers every person to be the person that makes a difference for rare disease.

Why Join Us?

We are a global company with over 1,900 employees in more than 30 countries and are committed to the societies where we operate. With a deeply skilled management team directing our day-to-day wins, and a Board with a stellar track record, we’re ready to take on the world’s diseases, ailments and adversity. Our people believe they have the power to make a positive impact in others’ lives because that’s exactly what we do here. As a specialized biopharmaceutical company, we are dedicated to rare diseases. And we see this focus as a strength. Accomplishing this requires strong partnerships with patients, partners and stakeholders across the entire value chain.
