• In close routine collaboration with the external customer, designs, implements and executes an agreed-to service plan. Monitors and reports progress on plan completion as directed. Works with numerous internal and external stakeholders in the interest of achieving desired overall project velocity.

• Acts as an advisor to the customer on occupational safety issues. Provides input to project managers, client relationship managers, or business development staff on potential new EHS projects. Participates in business development activities as directed.

What we are looking for:

• Bachelor's degree preferred – ideally, in a science or engineering field.

• Minimum 3 years of experience required, working in the occupational safety / employee accident prevention field.

• Desirable, but not required: Associate Safety Professional (ASP) or Certified Safety Professional (CSP) professional accreditation.

• Active Secret Security clearance highly preferred (or willing to go through process with us to get one)

• Experience in manufacturing-&-assembly industries / heavy industry settings a plus.

• Experience in the aerospace and defense or automotive industry a further plus.

• Possess an extensive knowledge of occupational safety technical subject matter and how to apply it in real-life settings. Highly familiar with standard concepts, practices, and procedures within the occupational safety field. Just a few topics where strong technical knowledge is required:

jobs.title: Finance Manager
jobs.description:
Medsien is a leading provider of scalable remote care management, enabling healthcare practices to enhance patient engagement, improve outcomes, and optimize operational efficiency. Hundreds of organizations trust Medsien’s unparalleled technology solutions to implement exceptional remote care management programs, personalize every interaction, and improve the lives of those who need it most. We are committed to innovation, collaboration, and the delivery of exceptional service to our clients and their patients. Based in San Francisco and venture-backed by top-tier investors, Medsien was founded to reimagine remote care management.

More than 60% of all U.S. adults—over 150 million people—live with at least one chronic condition, which requires dedicated, ongoing medical support outside the four walls of their doctor’s office. Yet, only 20% of these patients have access to remote care from the comfort of their homes, putting their health at significant risk. Together, we can save lives and create a real impact.

We seek a dynamic, results-oriented Finance Manager to lead the financial operations and report directly to the COO.

As a Finance Manager, you will:

• Lead Medsien’s financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, and management reporting processes.

• Build and maintain financial models that support short-term execution and long-term strategic planning.

• Develop accurate revenue, expense, headcount, cash-flow, and profitability forecasts.

• Analyze company performance against budget, forecast, and prior periods, identifying key drivers, risks, and opportunities.

• Create clear financial reports, KPI dashboards, and executive-level insights for CEO, COO and other company leaders.

• Partner with Sales, Operations, Engineering, Marketing, Patient Growth, and other teams to build departmental plans and improve financial accountability.

• Evaluate pricing, customer profitability, unit economics, margins, investments, hiring plans, and resource-allocation decisions.

• Build financial models for new products, programs, partnerships, and strategic initiatives.

• Support cash management, runway planning, scenario analysis, and capital-planning decisions.

• Partner with internal and external accounting resources to ensure financial reporting is accurate, timely, and aligned with the company’s planning needs.

• Improve the reliability, consistency, and automation of financial data, reporting, and forecasting processes.

• Establish scalable financial planning processes and operating rhythms as Medsien continues to grow.

• Support board, investor, lender, financing, and due diligence materials as needed.

• Serve as a strategic finance partner to leadership by turning financial and operational data into clear recommendations and decisions.

Please apply if you have:

• 6+ years of progressive experience in strategic finance, FP&A, financial planning, or a related finance role,

• Strong experience building and maintaining financial models, budgets, forecasts, cash-flow projections, and long-range plans,

• Demonstrated ability to analyze business performance, identify meaningful trends, and translate financial data into actionable recommendations,

• Experience developing management reporting, KPI dashboards, budget-to-actual analyses, and executive-level financial presentations,

• Strong understanding of financial statements, accrual accounting, revenue, expenses, cash flow, and the relationship between operational and financial performance,

• Experience partnering with business leaders to evaluate investments, headcount, pricing, resource allocation, and other strategic decisions,

• Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills, including the ability to build reliable and scalable financial models,

• Strong analytical judgment, attention to detail, and ability to independently manage recurring planning and reporting processes,

• Strong executive communication skills and the ability to explain complex financial information clearly to non-finance leaders,

• Ability to work hands-on in a fast-growing organization while building more scalable financial processes and reporting systems.

Some nice-to-have qualifications include experience in:

• Experience at a high-growth, venture-backed, SaaS, technology-enabled services, or healthcare technology company,

• Understanding of healthcare economics, medical billing, claims, reimbursements, or revenue-cycle operations,

• Experience supporting a business with recurring, usage-based, per-member, or service-based revenue,

• Experience analyzing unit economics, customer profitability, gross margins, pricing, and contribution margins,

• Experience with workforce planning, capacity modeling, sales commissions, and departmental budgeting,

• Experience preparing reporting and financial materials for executives, boards, investors, or lenders,

• Experience supporting fundraising, financing, due diligence, or strategic transactions,

• Familiarity with accounting and finance systems such as QuickBooks, NetSuite, Ramp, Bill.com, or similar platforms,

• Experience improving financial data quality, reporting automation, and cross-functional planning processes,

• CPA, CFA, CMA, MBA, or another relevant finance credential.

For this position, we offer:

• Competitive USD salary,

• Generous vacation and PTO policies,

• Fully remote work opportunities,

• Training, mentorship, and coaching from leadership.

Our Process

We will review your application along with all the others we receive and pick the top profiles for a screening call. In many cases due to time constraints and our candidate volume, only the short-listed candidates are contacted but we do consider each application carefully. If you have been selected as a short-listed candidate, we will contact you for a short screening call to get to know you better. If you don’t get a call, please don’t be disappointed! We receive many applications for each role and must prioritize who we speak to.

Employment at Medsien is based solely on a person’s merit and qualifications. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity regardless of sex, age, race, color, national or ethnic origin, religion, marital status, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability, age, citizenship, veteran or military status, and other legally protected characteristics.

Thank you for taking the time to apply for a position at Medsien!

jobs.title: Junior CRO Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT US

Ruby Labs is a leading tech company that creates and operates innovative consumer products. We offer a diverse range of opportunities across the health, education, and entertainment industries. Our innovative teams are driving the future of consumer-led products, and we're always looking for passionate individuals to join us. Learn more about our story at: https://rubylabs.com/about-us/




ABOUT THE ROLE

RubyLabs is looking for a hands-on Junior CRO Manager to join one of our product growth teams. You'll work directly with our Senior CRO Manager, turning a fast-moving testing roadmap into live experiments, new landing pages, and new funnels.

This is an execution role first. You'll take hypotheses from idea to live test - building the designs yourself with AI tools, setting up the experiments, and keeping the pipeline moving - while bringing your own test ideas to the table. The more your judgment proves out, the more of the roadmap you own.



Responsibilities

 - Build new landing pages and funnels: create alternative landing page variants and funnel flows to test messaging, structure, and offers.

 - Prepare designs with Claude: turn hypotheses into experiment mockups and variants using AI tools, without waiting on a designer.

 - Set up experiments: configure A/B tests, define success metrics, and verify tracking before anything goes live.

 - Manage the experiment pipeline: keep tickets clear and prioritized, brief engineers, and follow each test from setup to rollout.

 - Contribute test ideas: study the funnel, competitors, and user behavior, and bring hypotheses to the roadmap alongside the senior's.

 - Support analysis and documentation: help read results, document learnings, and keep the testing roadmap current.

Qualifications

 - 1+ years of hands-on experience in CRO, growth, product, or digital marketing - you've built pages, run or supported tests, or shipped funnel changes before.

 - Design sense: you can tell a clean, convincing page from a cluttered one, and you can build one yourself with the tools at hand.

 - Bias for shipping: you'd rather get a solid variant live today than polish it for a week, and you keep the cycle moving.

 - Proactive: you don't wait for the next ticket; you spot what needs doing and do it.

 - Strong English: clear written and verbal communication. You'll write hypotheses, tickets, and summaries daily.

 - Good judgment on conversion opportunities: you can look at a landing page or funnel step and sense what's worth testing and why.

 - Comfortable with ambiguity: priorities shift, briefs are incomplete, and data is messy. You make a sensible call and keep moving.

 - AI-native habits: you already use Claude or similar tools in your work and want to push further.

 - Attention to detail: experiments live or die on setup, and you check twice.

Nice to Have

 - Experience with landing page builders, no-code tools, or basic HTML/CSS.

 - Familiarity with Mixpanel, Google Analytics, GrowthBook, or similar.

 - Exposure to subscription or SaaS funnels.

 - Bachelor's degree in a relevant field.

What We Offer

 - Direct mentorship from a Senior CRO Manager and a full view of how a high-volume experimentation process runs.

 - Ownership that grows with results: start with execution, earn your own tests.

 - Autonomy and speed: small team, fast decisions, no bureaucracy.

 - The latest AI tools as a core part of daily work, not a side experiment.

 - Room to grow into a CRO Specialist role as you deliver.


LOCATION

Ruby Labs operates within the CET (Central European Time) zone. Applicants from any country are welcome to apply for the position as long as they are located within approximately ± 4 hours of CET. This ensures optimal collaboration and communication during working hours.




BENEFITS

Discover the perks of being part of our vibrant team! We offer:

 - Remote Work Environment: Embrace the freedom to work from anywhere, anytime, promoting a healthy work-life balance. 

 - Unlimited PTO: Enjoy unlimited paid time off to recharge and prioritize your well-being, without counting days. 

 - Paid National Holidays: Celebrate and relax on national holidays with paid time off to unwind and recharge. 

 - Company-provided MacBook: Experience seamless productivity with top-notch Apple MacBooks provided to all employees who need them. 

 - Flexible Independent Contractor Agreement: Unlock the benefits of flexibility, autonomy, and entrepreneurial opportunities. Benefit from tax advantages, networking opportunities, reduced employment obligations, and the freedom to work from anywhere. Read more about it here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1nkrN76JlZkbKj9WSOhlT1_mni_CZeDkHdwfIjPXVwvk/preview?tab=t.0#heading=h.ndsdl4wapxtt

Be part of our fast-growing team and seize this excellent opportunity for personal and professional growth!




INTERVIEW PROCESS

After submitting your application, we conduct a thorough review which typically takes 3 to 5 days, but may occasionally take longer due to the volume of applications received. If we see a potential fit, we proceed with the following steps:

 - Recruiter Screening (40 minutes)

 - Technical Interview (60 minutes)

 - Final Interview (30 minutes)




LIFE AT RUBY LABS

At Ruby Labs, we move fast, aim high, and expect the same from our team. We’re not here to play small—we’re here to build, grow, and win. That means we look for people who are ambitious, driven, and ready to give their best every single day.

This is a place for individuals who thrive under pressure, embrace challenges, and see opportunity in every obstacle. If you’re hungry to achieve, motivated by impact, and want to grow at the speed of your own ambition, Ruby Labs offers the platform to make it happen.

Here, effort is matched with reward. We recognize those who go all in and deliver results, and we create space for people who want more—more responsibility, more growth, and more success.

jobs.title: Participant Recruitment Operations Manager
jobs.description:
At Headlands Research, we are dedicated to enhancing clinical trial delivery within our communities. As a leading network of advanced clinical trial sites, we leverage cutting-edge technology and exceptional support services to broaden outreach and participation. Founded in 2018, our rapidly growing company currently operates 20+ sites across the US and Canada, with plans for further expansion.

📍 Location: Remote | 🏥 Site Name: Headlands Research Inc | 🕒 Full-Time |

The Company

At Headlands Research, we are working to improve lives by advancing innovative medical therapies. We are a family of next-generation clinical trial sites integrating technology and high-quality support services to make clinical research accessible to participants. Headlands operates clinical research sites across the U.S. and Canada and continues to grow its network and centralized capabilities.

The Role

The Participant Recruitment Operations Manager is responsible for the day-to-day operational performance of the centralized patient recruitment function and recruitment call center. This role translates study-level enrollment requirements into actionable recruitment workload, staffing, productivity, and funnel goals; monitors performance against those expectations; and takes timely corrective action when enrollment is at risk.

The Manager leads a remote team of patient recruiters and is accountable for call center execution, lead management, pre-screening productivity, call quality, participant experience, recruiter coaching, funnel forecasting, capacity planning, performance reporting, and consistent operational processes across studies and sites. Success requires a strong command of recruitment data, the ability to identify funnel leakage and operational barriers, and disciplined follow-through to ensure recruitment resources align with current and forecasted enrollment needs while maintaining a professional, empathetic, and participant-centered recruitment experience.

Key Responsibilities

• Lead and supervise remote participant recruitment call center members and manage the daily operations, workload, and performance of the centralized recruitment call center.

• Translate site and study enrollment targets into weekly and daily recruitment goals, including required lead volume, contact activity, prequalification, scheduling, screening, and enrollment expectations.

• Build and maintain study-level recruitment funnel forecasts to determine the volume of leads, recruiter activity, and call center capacity required to support enrollment goals and timelines.

• Monitor actual funnel performance against forecast and identify gaps, trends, and risks early; recommend and implement corrective actions based on where performance is breaking down.

• Own call center productivity and performance management, including lead response time, contact attempts, contact rate, prequalification rate, scheduling rate, appointment conversion, recruiter throughput, backlog, aging leads, and other operational KPIs.

• Establish productivity expectations by recruiter and study based on enrollment priority, lead volume, complexity, and available capacity; rebalance workload as enrollment needs change.

• Conduct routine performance reviews of recruiter productivity and call quality; provide actionable coaching, establish improvement expectations, and escalate sustained performance gaps when necessary.

• Regularly monitor and evaluate recruiter calls for communication quality, professionalism, rapport building, active listening, study explanation, prescreening effectiveness, objection handling, and overall participant experience.

• Provide ongoing individual and team-based call coaching to strengthen recruiter communication skills, confidence, consistency, participant rapport, and effectiveness in moving qualified participants through the recruitment funnel.

• Establish and maintain call quality standards and scorecards that incorporate participant experience, communication effectiveness, protocol-appropriate study discussion, and adherence to recruitment workflows; use call monitoring trends to inform targeted training and performance improvement.

• Ensure recruiters create a professional, empathetic, and participant-centered experience throughout recruitment interactions, including for individuals who do not ultimately qualify, schedule, or enroll.

• Partner with site leaders and Recruitment leadership to establish enrollment priorities, understand screening capacity and site constraints, and align centralized recruitment activity to the studies with the greatest enrollment need.

• Evaluate study performance at the site and funnel level to distinguish lead-volume challenges from contact-center, pre-screening, scheduling, site-capacity, or downstream conversion issues.

• Maintain visibility into recruiter capacity and staffing requirements; forecast resource needs based on active study volume, anticipated lead flow, enrollment timelines, and upcoming study launches.

• Ensure leads are worked according to defined service levels and that high-priority studies receive appropriate coverage, including proactive management of lead queues, aging, follow-up cadence, and unworked leads.

• Produce and communicate recurring operational reports and dashboards that summarize enrollment progress, funnel conversion, productivity, capacity, forecast versus actual performance, risks, and corrective actions.

• Use recruitment systems, CRM/call center technology, automation, and AI-enabled tools to improve recruiter efficiency, lead prioritization, workflow management, reporting, and operational scalability.

• Partner with Recruitment Systems/Technology resources to ensure accurate data capture, standardized metric definitions, appropriate system utilization, and reliable reporting.

• Identify and implement process improvements that reduce time to contact, improve conversion, increase recruiter productivity, and create consistent recruitment workflows across the network.

• Support study launches by confirming call center readiness, recruiter coverage, lead routing, pre-screening workflows, study training, and operational handoffs before recruitment activity begins.

• Escalate enrollment and operational risks promptly with a clear assessment of impact, root cause, recommended action, owner, and expected resolution timeline.

• Ensure recruitment activities and pre-screening processes are performed consistently and in accordance with applicable GCP, regulatory, privacy, and ethical requirements.

Core Performance Accountabilities

• Enrollment attainment and pacing against study/site goals

• Recruitment funnel forecast accuracy and forecast-to-actual performance

• Lead response time, contact rate, and lead aging/backlog

• Contact-to-prequalification and prequalification-to-scheduled conversion

• Scheduled-to-screened and screened-to-enrolled/randomized conversion, where available

• Recruiter productivity, throughput, utilization, and adherence to assigned workload

• Recruiter call quality, coaching completion, and improvement against established quality standards

• Participant experience and consistency of recruiter communication across calls and studies

• Call center capacity versus forecasted enrollment demand

• Timely identification, escalation, and resolution of recruitment performance risks

Required Skills and Abilities

• Proven experience managing patient recruitment, call center, contact center, or centralized recruitment operations; clinical research experience strongly preferred.

• Strong analytical ability with demonstrated experience interpreting operational and funnel data and converting findings into clear actions.

• Experience forecasting workload, staffing, capacity, or funnel requirements against defined performance targets.

• Demonstrated ability to manage team productivity, establish measurable expectations, coach performance, and hold team members accountable for results.

• Demonstrated experience monitoring calls and coaching recruiters or call center staff on communication quality, rapport building, active listening, objection handling, and participant/customer experience.

• Ability to balance productivity and conversion expectations with a professional, empathetic, participant-centered approach to recruitment interactions.

• Strong understanding of call center metrics, lead management workflows, service levels, conversion metrics, and operational performance management.

• Proficiency with CRM, call center, reporting, and workforce/productivity technologies; experience using automation or AI-enabled tools to improve efficiency is a plus.

• Ability to prioritize across multiple studies and rapidly adjust resources based on changing enrollment needs and performance.

• Strong problem-solving and root-cause analysis skills, including the ability to distinguish marketing/lead-volume issues from operational funnel or site-capacity constraints.

• Clear, concise communication skills with the ability to present performance, risks, forecasts, and recommended actions to operational and site leadership.

Education and Experience

• Bachelor's degree in a relevant field preferred, or equivalent combination of education and experience.

• Three or more years of leadership experience in patient recruitment, call center/contact center, clinical research operations, or a related performance-driven environment preferred.

• Experience leading remote teams across multiple time zones preferred.

• General understanding of GCP, CFR, privacy requirements, and applicable state/provincial regulations.

• Demonstrated track record of using metrics, forecasting, and operational management to achieve defined performance outcomes.

Remote Pay Range

$95,000—$120,000 USD

Headlands Research will never ask a candidate for personal identifiable information (date of birth, social security number, driver’s license information, etc) via email or messenger tools, or for a financial deposit of any kind.

Headlands Research is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetic information, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

Need Assistance?

Headlands Research is committed to providing access and reasonable accommodation in its employment for individuals with disabilities. To request disability accommodation in the application process, contact recruiting@headlandsresearch.com for further assistance. Please note this is for individuals to request an accommodation as part of the application process and any other correspondence will not receive a response.

jobs.title: Marketing Strategy Coordinator
jobs.description:
As a Marketing Strategy Coordinator, you will support the planning, coordination, and execution of marketing strategies across multiple initiatives.

You will work closely with internal teams to research market opportunities, organize campaigns, analyze performance, coordinate marketing projects, and help ensure that strategies remain aligned with company goals.

The ideal candidate is analytical, organized, creative, and comfortable managing multiple priorities in a collaborative and fast-moving environment.

Responsibilities

• Assist in developing and coordinating marketing strategies and campaigns.
• Conduct market, competitor, customer, and industry research.
• Support the development of campaign plans, messaging, and marketing materials.
• Coordinate marketing projects, timelines, priorities, and deliverables.
• Analyze campaign performance and identify opportunities for improvement.
• Prepare reports, presentations, and marketing insights for internal teams.
• Collaborate with different departments to maintain consistent brand positioning and messaging.
• Help identify new opportunities to strengthen customer engagement and brand awareness.
• Track marketing initiatives and ensure projects remain aligned with established goals.
• Contribute ideas for new campaigns, promotions, partnerships, and business growth initiative

• Strong communication and organizational skills.
• Ability to think strategically while maintaining attention to detail.
• Strong research and analytical abilities.
• Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities effectively.
• Comfortable working independently and as part of a collaborative team.
• Problem-solving mindset with the ability to adapt to changing priorities.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills.
• Familiarity with marketing principles, campaign planning, branding, or market research.
• Ability to interpret information and translate insights into actionable recommendations.
• Professional, dependable, and proactive approach to work.

• Competitive salary of $50,000–$59,000 per year
• Full-time employment
• Professional growth opportunities
• Opportunities to develop strategic marketing and leadership skills
• Collaborative and professional work environment
• Exposure to a variety of marketing projects and business initiatives
• Opportunities to take on increased responsibilities as the company grows
• Supportive environment focused on learning, development, and career advancement

jobs.title: Account Development Manager - EMEA
jobs.description:
Wrike is the most powerful work management platform. Built for teams and organizations looking to collaborate, create, and exceed every day, Wrike brings everyone and all work into a single place to remove complexity, increase productivity, and free people up to focus on their most purposeful work.

Wrike is our people, not a place. As a distributed team, we own our growth, stay globally connected, and rely on the product we build to deliver impactful work alongside brilliant minds. You'll have real ownership over meaningful work, a global team that has your back, and the flexibility to do your best work your way. If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you.

Our vision:  A world where everyone is free to focus on their most purposeful work, together.

About the Role:

Wrike is looking for an energetic, passionate, tech-savvy, and customer-oriented Account Development Manager to help teams across the world be more successful with our product. You will establish relationships and engage with clients to find new opportunities to expand the Wrike product. You’ll be working with our customer base of knowledge workers to get them onboarded, help them be more productive with Wrike, and answer their questions. It’ll be your job to understand your customers' goals, offer tailored advice on best practices, and deliver Wrike value. You will be proactively reaching out to the customers and sharing the expertise on how to use the product in the most efficient way. Our days at Wrike are fun and intense. We have a dynamic and diverse international customer base who want to be more productive and need your help taking the steps to make it happen.

Your Team:

You will be part of the incredible Wrike Account Development Team and will work alongside other talented and passionate ADMs in an environment that prizes a growth mindset, mutual support, and creative problem-solving. You will be collaborating with Professional Services consultants, Sales Engineers, Renewal Team and the Marketing team in order to provide the best service to our customers, understand their needs, and provide/sell the best solution possible.

Your Impact:

• Actively prospecting into existing accounts via Outbound calls.

• Managing assigned accounts, inbound requests, trials, leads

• Managing the full sales-cycle, including contract generation and other deliverables for closing

• Learning proven SaaS sales process and methodology from decorated Sales Leaders

• Working with your territory team and leaders to strategise big deals

• Leveraging Salesforce.com to execute your lead processing and opportunity management

• Prioritising opportunities and applying appropriate resources

• Proactively reaching out to customers to help them use Wrike in the most efficient way and share best practices via email and phone calls (team members spend about 80% of their work time on calls with customers)

• Maximizing customer lifetime by helping them unlock the most product value

Your Qualifications:

• Fluency in English

• 1+ years of work experience in a customer facing role (Sales, Customer success, Customer Support, etc)

• Strong verbal and written communication skills: able to present complex ideas in an accessible and engaging way

• A keen business sense to discover and understand customer business objectives and pain points

Standout Qualities:

• Having a problem solver mentality, being a critical thinker and generally curious

• A passion for learning and improving every day, motivated to excel

• Openness to receiving feedback, being coachable

Benefits & Perks:

• 25 calendar days of paid vacation

• Sick Leave Compensation (5 Paid Uncertified Sick Days)

• Parental Leave: 18 Weeks Maternity / 4 Week Paternity

• 2 Volunteer Days

• Medical Insurance (Employees + Dependents)

• Hybrid Working Model

• School Allowance (Up to €600/month for school aged kids)

• Simcard w/ Unlimited Internet Access for active employees

• Office Lunch Allowance (via Wolt) on Wednesdays / Thursday

What’s next?

• Interview with a Recruiter

• Interview with Hiring Manager

• Interview with a Peer ADM Manager

• Presentation

Your recruitment buddy will be Arjola Stejskal, Talent Acquisition Specialist

#LI-AS1

Who Is Wrike and Our Culture

We’re a team of innovators and creators who solve the complex work problems of today and tomorrow.

Hybrid work mode

Wrike is our people, not a place. With 1,000+ employees collaborating across nearly every time zone, we support talent through 10 global hubs — Australia, Costa Rica, Cyprus, Czechia, Estonia, France, India, Ireland, Japan, and the United States — offering flexible ways of working that include remote work, hybrid environments, and co-working spaces across many locations.

While flexibility looks different across teams and regions, employees located near certain hubs — particularly in Prague (CZ), Nicosia (CY), Bangalore (IN), and Rennes (FR) — are generally expected to collaborate in person around 2–3 days per week, balancing the flexibility of distributed work with opportunities for in-person collaboration and connection.

Our persona

💡  Smart: We love what we do, and we’re great at it because this is our domain. Our combined knowledge in this space is unmatched.

💚  Dedicated: We get up every day focused on helping our customers win. We’re committed to helping our teammates win, too!

🤗  Approachable: We're friendly, easy to get along with, considerate, and helpful.

Our culture and Values

🤩 Customer-Focused

We care about our customers. We understand the customer journey, experience, and value derived from Wrike. Decision-making and action-taking are done with the customer in mind.

🤝 Collaborative

We work as one and win together, each bringing unique strengths that contribute to diversity of thought for better outcomes. Leveraging our own work management platform, we foster an environment of creative collaboration and shared achievement.

🎨 Creative

We strive to succeed through continuous innovation. It’s our pursuit of novel concepts that helped us create a market category. We continue to cultivate a workplace that fosters creative thinking as a means of transcending conventional boundaries and empowers us to break new ground to deliver extraordinary work management solutions.

💪 Committed

We believe in ownership at all levels of the organization, by owning workflows from start to finish. Each member of our team is an integral part of this commitment, establishing work as a platform for personal growth and transformation, as well as collective success and growth.

Check out our LinkedIn Life Page, Company culture page, Instagram, Wrike Engineering Team, Medium, Meetup.com, Youtube for a feel for what life is like at Wrike.

jobs.title: Cloud Network Engineer
jobs.description:
M3 (www.m3as.com) is a leading provider of hospitality-specific software solutions, delivering cloud-based tools for hotel accounting, financial reporting, labor management, payroll, and business intelligence. Built by hoteliers for hoteliers, M3 empowers hotel owners, operators, and management companies to streamline back-office operations, reduce costs, gain real-time insights, and drive portfolio performance across thousands of properties in North America and beyond.

Description Summary:     The Cloud Network Engineer will be responsible for managing both on-premise environments and cloud-based networks. Management will encapsulate design, organization, installation, modification and documentation. This role involves securing communication across networks, facilitating network scalability, ensuring proper disaster recovery capabilities, and maintaining the overall health and performance of the network infrastructure.

Essential Duties:

The duties listed below are the essential functions of this position, and they may change as the needs of the company demand. All associates are expected to do what is necessary to get the work done and to cooperate fully with their supervisor’s requests for additional or altered duties.

• Design, implement, and manage network infrastructure for both on-premise and cloud environments.

• Ensure secure communication across networks by implementing and maintaining security protocols and measures.

• Develop and maintain disaster recovery plans and procedures to ensure business continuity.

• Automate configuration management to streamline network operations and improve efficiency.

• Monitor network performance and troubleshoot issues to ensure optimal operation.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to design and implement network solutions that meet business requirements.

• Install, configure, and remove various equipment from our data center.

• Work closely with the users of each network to proactively identify potential issues and fix existing problems as well as perform root cause analysis

• Stay up to date with the latest industry trends and technologies to continuously improve network infrastructure.

• Provide technical support and guidance to team members and stakeholders.

• Other duties as assigned

Education/Training/Experience:

• A minimum of ​5-10​ years of experience in a directly related position required.

• Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information technology, or a related field preferred.

• 5+ years of experience managing cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud required.

• 5+ years in network design and hands-on support of enterprise IP Networks required.

• Proven experience as a Network Engineer, with a focus on hybrid cloud and on-premise environments required.

• Strong knowledge of network protocols (IPsec, DNS, VoIP, QoS, and MPLS), security measures, and disaster recovery planning required.

• Experience with automation tools and scripting languages (e.g., Ansible, Terraform, Python, PowerShell) required.

• Experience working in a hybrid networking/software development environment required.

• Experience configuring and maintaining server/virtualization clustering (VMWare, XenServer) required.

• Experience with network security tools such as NGFWs and IPS required.

• Extensive knowledge of both Windows and Linux OS environments required.

• Deep knowledge of application transport and network infrastructure protocols required.

• Data center operations, procedures, and best practices preferred.

• Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail required.

• Strong communication and collaboration skills required.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Relevant certifications such as CCNA, CCNP, AWS Certified Solutions Architect, or similar preferred.

• Familiarity with DevOps practices and tools required.

jobs.title: Senior Procurement Officer - Re-advertised - Idleb & Aleppo (Hybrid)
jobs.description:
Established in 1977, GOAL is an international humanitarian and development agency, committed to working with communities to achieve sustainable and innovative early response in crises, and lasting solutions to poverty and vulnerability. GOAL has worked in over 60 countries and has responded to almost every major humanitarian disaster. We are currently operational in 18 countries.

GOAL began operations in Syria in 2013 responding to the acute needs of conflict-affected communities. GOAL's areas of operations include but not limited to Aleppo, Idleb and Lattakia Governorates, and is expanding to new governorates in Syria. Programmes focus on Food and Nutrition Security, WASH, Shelter, Livelihoods/ERMS and Emergency Response with an emphasis on cash and voucher modalities. GOAL Syria implements its programmes directly, with over 500 staff based in Syria, and through Syrian NGO partners. GOAL's programme works at the household and community levels to improve community resilience and household coping strategies.

Job purpose:

The purpose of this position is to ensure the efficient and compliant operation of GOAL Syria’s Procurement Department by conducting high-value tenders, actively monitoring all framework agreements, long-term contracts, and pre-qualified supplier lists, and producing accurate, timely procurement and contract-management reports, while guaranteeing that all procurement is conducted in accordance with GOAL’s Procurement policies and procedures, relevant donor regulations, and the overarching principle of achieving the best possible Value for Money (VFM).

Duties, objectives and competencies

• Process procurements assigned to you by the PM ensuring that all procurement procedures in the GOAL offices inside Syria are effectively followed in compliance with the GOAL Logistics/Procurement Manual and relevant donor requirements.

• High-value tenders: Manage end-to-end tender processes that assigned to her/him—ITT/EOI preparation, evaluation, award and contracting—in full compliance with the GOAL Procurement Manual and donor rules.

• Framework agreements & Pre-qualified Suppliers: Keep the FWA tracker, pre-qualified supplier tracker and SharePoint folders current; coordinate six-monthly supplier performance reviews

• Prepare electronic and hardcopy procurement files for each PR (Request Form) and ensure that all relevant paperwork is filed, original and scanned copies, as per GOAL Procurement Manual and internal audit requirements. Update the FWA Trackers on SP and ensure all relevant information is included.

• Process the assigned PR’s according to the GOAL Procurement Manual/Procurement Chart procedures.

• Analyse the specification of the supplies, works or services required and source potential, reliable suppliers who can meet these specifications.

• Assist the PM in preparing and Conduct field visits and market surveys with the PM and Supply Chain Advisor Coach the procurement officers/assistants on GOAL procurement processes, monitoring progress of their work and providing ongoing training in roles and responsibilities on advice from the Procurement Manager.

• Ensure that all suppliers have (ATSC) completed, according to the procurement process and up to date.

• Prepare Request for Offers (RFO) or Invitation to restricted Competition (IRC) to obtain quotations/bids as per required process;

• Complete Bid analysis (BA) and Tender/Procurement report for review and obtain the necessary signatures for approval from budget-holders and finance department; as well as arrange PCOMs/TCOMs in time.

• Framework agreements & Pre-qualified Suppliers: Keep the FWA tracker, pre-qualified supplier tracker and SharePoint folders current; coordinate six-monthly supplier performance reviews.

• Raise Purchase Orders/Contracts to place the order with the chosen supplier and follow up the status of the goods, to delivery to the required location, as per the PR;

• Ensure that Goods received Note and Service / works Receive Report are prepared for all deliveries and attached to the procurement file;

• Review all PO’s\Contracts for procurement staff before sending it for signing.

• Review and ensure that all documents of the procurement process and payment documents completed by the officer/ assistant are correct and in compliance with GOAL procurement manual

• Ensure that all selected suppliers are registered on the GOAL Syria Registered Supplier List, and maintain it by updating it where necessary with regular reviews of suppliers together with PM and Supply Chain Advisor on suppliers based on criteria of reliability, quality and prices of goods offered, terms & conditions, after sales services offered, and warranty guaranteed.

• Assist Procurement Manager to manage the procurement E-mail and closely monitoring it.

• In case any problem with payments to supplier get in contact with finance and try to solve the problem.

• Complete all financial paperwork, obtain the necessary signatures for approval and ensure payment to the supplier is affected.

• Raise PRF, prepare reconciliation list and checklist.

• Track the status of all PRs in an Order Tracking System (OTS) in Digital OTS and ensure all Procurement officers are updating the same in a timely manner.

• Assist other departments to find out all the information about the materials to be purchased and the available specifications and conduct a market assessment.

• Follow up on the status of pre-qualified supplier lists and update supplier information as needed.

Reporting

• Contribute procurement updates to the biweekly procurement Report.

Other Duties:

• Contribute to yearly, grant-based procurement plans if required by Procurement Manager and Supply Chain Advisor

• General work in assisting in the overall process and day-to-day duties of the procurement Department.

Requirements (essential)

• Holds a university degree (engineering, economy, business administration, management and human sciences or relevant).

• At least 3 years of relevant work experience in areas such as procurement, logistics in INGO /NGO, private or government sectors;as officer and above.

• At least 1 year experience proven in procurement field with INGOs/NGOs in complex tender and contract management.

• Ability to understand and implement organisational and donor policies.

• Strong computer skills in Microsoft packages, including Excel, Word, and Outlook (particular emphasis on Excel).

• Ability to manage and prioritise a varied workload in a in a dynamic work environment.

• A flexible approach to work and willingness to take on extra duties, work additional hours or on weekends as required.

• Excellent attention to detail.

• Ability to write, speak and work in English and Arabic.

Requirements (desired)

• Proven experiences in procurement field with INGOs/NGOs in high Value tenders.

• Proven staff management experience

• Ability to manage and prioritise a varied workload in a in a dynamic work environment.

• Diplomacy and negotiation skills.

• Basic technical knowledge in an area of Humanitarian Logistics; (e.g. ICT; mechanics; construction; electricity; Water, Sanitation and Hygiene; or other).

Note:
Transportation is provided from Aleppo to Idlib. Therefore, candidates based in Aleppo are encouraged to apply.

Interested? Then apply for this position via clicking on the "apply now" button and fill out the application form. All applicants must send a Cover letter and an updated CV (no longer than four pages). Both must be in English.

Please note that only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

GOAL has the right to select one or more candidates from this vacancy announcement. We may also retain applications and consider candidates applying to this post for other similar positions with GOAL at the same grade level and with similar job descriptions, experience, and educational requirements.

Qualified female candidates are strongly encouraged to apply.

The application deadline is 29 Sep 2026 however, you are encouraged to apply immediately as we will be reviewing applications on a rolling basis, therefore we may withdraw the position before the advertisement’s closing date if a suitable candidate/s is identified.

Please note that GOAL does not charge a fee of any kind or any other financial obligation at any stage of its recruitment process (application, interview, processing, training, induction) or other fees, or request information on applicants’ bank accounts. GOAL does not work with intermediary institutions and individuals or employment agencies during the recruitment process. If any fee or payment is requested from you at the application or any stage of the recruitment process, please do not respond.

GOAL does not accept any responsibility for the accuracy, errors or omissions of any of the information contained in translated advertisements by an independent party on other sites or through other channels.

General terms and conditions

Safeguarding

Children and vulnerable adults a must be safeguarded to the maximum possible extent from deliberate or inadvertent actions and failings that place them at risk of abuse, sexual exploitation, injury and any other harm. One of the ways that GOAL shows this on-going commitment to safeguarding is to include rigorous background and reference checks in the selection process for all candidates.

Safeguarding Statement
GOAL has zero tolerance for safeguarding violations. All staff are expected to adhere to GOAL’s Code of Conduct and Safeguarding policies, including the prevention of sexual exploitation, abuse, and harassment (PSEAH). Recruitment is subject to safeguarding checks, including reference verification

Accountability within GOAL

Alongside our safeguarding policy, GOAL is an equal opportunities employer and has a set of integrity policies. Any candidate offered a job with GOAL will be expected to adhere to the following key areas of accountability:

• Comply with GOAL’s policies and procedures with respect to safeguarding, Code of Conduct, health and safety, data protection and confidentiality, do no harm principles and unacceptable behavior protocols.

• Report any concerns about the welfare of a child or vulnerable adult or any wrongdoings within our programming area.

• Report any concerns about inappropriate behavior of a GOAL staff or partner.

This Job Description only serves as a guide for the position available. GOAL reserves the right to change this document. Any published closing dates are estimated.  Due to the nature of GOAL’s work we aim to fill vacancies as quickly as possible.  This means that we will close adverts as soon as we have found the right candidate and this may be before the published closing date.  We would therefore advise interested applicants to submit an application as early as possible.

Thank you.

Lead Installer

The home improvement industry is broken. Renuity is here to fix it.

Whether it’s a new bath, a custom closet, or exterior upgrades, we help people create homes they love – without the hassle. jobs.title: Tunnel Design Engineer
jobs.description:
AECOM is seeking a highly skilled and innovative Tunnel Engineer to join our growing Americas tunneling practice In Chelmsford, MA. This role is ideal for a technically strong, collaborative professional with hands-on experience in analysis and design of tunnel and underground infrastructure.

At AECOM, you will join a global team of 50,000+ professionals driven by a shared purpose: delivering a better world. Our work improves mobility, resilience, clean water access, and community connectivity.

The responsibilities of this position include, but are not limited to:

Key Responsibilities

• Design tunnels and underground structures using TBM (Tunnel Boring Machine) and SEM (Sequential Excavation Methods).
• Design SOE (Support of Excavation) systems for shafts, portals, cut-and-cover structures, and deep excavations.
• Develop, verify, and validate analytical, spreadsheet and manual design calculations.
• Apply commercial numerical modelling software to perform advanced analyses.
• Independently organize work plans, design tasks, and deliverables for underground infrastructure projects.
• Prepare design reports, technical specifications, and drawing packages, and assemble contract documents.
• Collaborate closely with colleagues from other disciplines, external partners, and clients to support successful project delivery.
• Provide expert guidance in soil mechanics, rock mechanics, and ground–structure interaction to multidisciplinary project teams on major transportation and water conveyance projects.
• Contribute to the development and continuous improvement of AECOM’s tunneling standards, tools, and best practices.

Minimum Requirements:

• Bachelor’s degree in geotechnical, structural, or tunnel engineering and 6+ years of related experience or demonstrated equivalency of experience and/or education
• Professional Engineer (PE) license

Preferred Qualifications:

• Master’s degree in structural, geotechnical or tunnel engineering
• Experience with both large diameter (18 ft +) tunneling and trenchless technologies
• Multidisciplinary coordination experience on large underground infrastructure projects ($200+ million construction value)
• Client-facing skills and experience
• Experience with planning and implementing geotechnical investigation programs for tunnel and underground projects
• Proficiency in analytical and numerical analysis methods for tunnels and underground works
• Demonstrated experience in analysis and design of tunnels and underground structures
• Excellent oral and written communication skills
• Strong collaboration and coordination skills
• Ability to work independently and make informed technical decisions with minimal supervision

• All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
• Relocation not offered with this opportunity
• AECOM does not offer U.S. work sponsorship or sponsorship transfer with this opportunity

At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.

About AECOM

AECOM is proud to offer comprehensive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees. Depending on your employment status, AECOM benefits may include medical, dental, vision, life, AD&D, disability benefits, paid time off, leaves of absences, voluntary benefits, perks, flexible work options, well-being resources, employee assistance program, business travel insurance, service recognition awards, retirement savings plan, and employee stock purchase plan.

AECOM is the global infrastructure leader, committed to delivering a better world. As a trusted professional services firm powered by deep technical abilities, we solve our clients’ complex challenges in water, environment, energy, transportation and buildings. Our teams partner with public- and private-sector clients to create innovative, sustainable and resilient solutions throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm that had revenue of $16.1 billion in fiscal year 2025. Learn more at aecom.com.

What makes AECOM a great place to work

You will be part of a global team that champions your growth and career ambitions. Work on groundbreaking projects - both in your local community and on a global scale - that are transforming our industry and shaping the future. With cutting-edge technology and a network of experts, you’ll have the resources to make a real impact. Our award-winning training and development programs are designed to expand your technical expertise and leadership skills, helping you build the career you’ve always envisioned. Here, you’ll find a welcoming workplace built on respect, collaboration and community—where you have the freedom to grow in a world of opportunity.

As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we believe in your potential and are here to help you achieve it. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

jobs.title: Direct Support Professional (DSP) / Caregiver -2nd shift
jobs.description:
What You Get to Do:

A Direct Support Professional (DSP) caregiver provides direct support, positive direction, instruction, and assistance to individuals with mental, intellectual & developmental, and physical disabilities.  The ultimate goal is to empower individuals with disabilities to live as independently and comfortably as possible while maintaining their dignity and respect.

• Provide hands-on assistance, encouragement, mentoring, and guidance.
• Ensure the comfort, safety, and personal growth of the individuals we serve.
• Perform housekeeping and laundry duties.
• Assist with daily living tasks such as moving around, getting in and out of bed, dressing, bathing, toileting, personal hygiene and more.

Why This Role:

• Personal fulfillment, a meaningful career, and the chance to make a difference.
• Positively impact someone’s life.
• Gain health care experience to further your career.
• Reliable work schedule.
• Varied day-to-day experiences; no two days are the same

What Makes You A Great Fit:

• Valid driver's license required (due to transporting persons served)
• Candidates must be comfortable driving to transport persons served as required Some positions/locations may require your own personal vehicle and auto liability insurance based on the role
• Person-centered, patient, and kind
• Dependable, adaptable, flexible
• Observant and detail oriented
• Positive role-model for others and able to work on a team
• Committed to creating a respectful and collaborative environment
• Computer skills for documentation

About the Team

Since 2017, Avride has been building expertise in autonomous technologies to create solutions that address current needs and anticipate future demands.  We are a U.S.-based autonomous vehicle startup headquartered in Austin, Texas with additional R&D hubs around the world. Our company develops and operates both autonomous cars and delivery robots that share technologies and mutually benefit from each other’s advancements — a unique approach in the industry.

About the Role

Avride is preparing to launch a fleet of autonomous delivery robots at multiple campuses across the U.S. and we are hiring a motivated, entry-level Robot Service Technician Assistant to support this exciting deployment. In this role, you will support the daily operations, maintenance, and preparations of our delivery robots. This part-time and weekend-based role is the perfect starting point for individuals looking to build a career in robotics and electro-mechanical assembly. You will ensure our fleet is ready for deployment while learning foundational skills needed to advance in our rapidly growing industry.

This position is employed through our staffing partner and offers weekly pay.

Schedule:

We are seeking candidates that can work 2-3 evenings per week,7:30pm-11:30pm to help with evening coverage. Some of the evenings may include weekends (Fri, Sat and/or Sun.)

What You’ll Do

• Prepare robots for the shift: Ensure all hardware and software are ready for daily deployment.

• Put robots/batteries on chargers for the night: Manage power cycles to ensure maximum fleet readiness.

• Clean robots: Maintain physical appearance and protect sensitive external hardware.

• Perform mechanical repairs: Assist with and execute basic repairs on the robot fleet.

• Perform service campaigns: Help implement widespread hardware or software updates across the fleet.

• Assist remote support coordinators: Act as the hands-on field contact for the remote tracking team.

• Perform calibrations and wheel alignment: Ensure sensors and chassis components are properly tuned for safe navigation.

• Keep workshop clean and tidy: Maintain a safe, organized, and efficient workspace for the entire technical team.

• Ability to lift and move items over 50 pounds safely.

• Team-oriented mindset with strong communication and collaboration skills.

Nice to Have

• General computer literacy.

• Introductory background or interest in electric vehicle (EV) service, automotive repair, or electronics.

jobs.title: Senior Product Marketing Manager (QuickBooks Migration)
jobs.description:
Acumatica's Product Marketing team is looking for a strategic Product Marketer to own the product marketing for our QuickBooks Graduates program — the positioning, messaging, and content strategy that helps growing small businesses "graduate" from QuickBooks to a modern, cloud ERP platform. You have proven experience in ERP or SMB accounting/finance software, and a strong point of view on why and when small businesses outgrow QuickBooks. You'll craft compelling, differentiated messaging that speaks to QuickBooks users at the exact moment they're hitting the ceiling of their current system, and you'll tailor that story to the industries where those breaking points show up most: construction, manufacturing, distribution, professional services, and their related micro-verticals. This role is a full-time opportunity reporting directly to the VP of Product Marketing.

Primary Responsibilities:

QuickBooks Graduates Positioning & Storytelling

Own the positioning and messaging that fuels the QuickBooks Graduates program, working alongside marketing teams, sales, and partner teams who drive its broader execution. Shape clear, compelling narratives that translate product functionality into meaningful business value for small businesses that have outgrown QuickBooks — helping prospects understand not just what Acumatica does differently, but why it matters at their stage of growth, while clearly differentiating our cloud ERP platform from QuickBooks and other SMB accounting and.ERP tools.

Industry & Micro-Vertical Messaging

Go beyond a one-size-fits-all QuickBooks-replacement narrative. Build and maintain positioning and content that applies the QuickBooks Graduates story to our targeted industries — construction, manufacturing, distribution, and professional services — and their related micro-verticals, so messaging speaks directly to the specific triggers, workflows, and pain points that push each industry beyond QuickBooks.

Thought Leadership & Market Insight

Create differentiated thought leadership assets, messaging, and positioning that establish Acumatica as the trusted destination for growing QuickBooks customers. Ground our storytelling in an ideal customer profile — the QuickBooks user hitting the limits of their system — along with industry and market insights, to ensure our communications deeply resonate with real-world growing pains: multi-entity complexity, inventory and job costing limitations, lack of automation, and reporting gaps.

Go-to-Market Leadership

Work collaboratively with the broader marketing organization to support end-to-end go-to-market strategies for QuickBooks Graduates campaigns.

Customer-Centered Narratives

Partner with our customer advocacy team to review and elevate customer stories and videos from businesses that made the switch from QuickBooks, weaving authentic, real-world outcomes — by industry — into marketing assets. Use customer evidence to build trust, credibility, and emotional connection across the buyer journey.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Data-Informed Strategy

Leverage performance data and analytics to guide QuickBooks Graduates marketing strategies, evolve content, and evaluate campaign effectiveness by industry segment, and continuously refine our approach — balancing insight with creativity to drive stronger outcomes.

Maintain and evolve core QuickBooks Graduates assets — including website messaging, comparison guides, datasheets, infographics, brochures etc. — for both the overarching program and its industry-specific variants, to ensure clarity, consistency, and accuracy. Support release planning and help keep internal and external teams aligned on positioning as offerings grow and change.

Events, Speaking & Community Engagement

Support industry trade shows and events with strong messaging and content targeted at QuickBooks users evaluating a move to ERP. Messaging and Positioning

Translate functionality and benefits into real value that resonate with small business buyers, tailoring that value story to both the overarching QuickBooks Graduates program and its industry-specific extensions.

Experience: A minimum of three to five years of product marketing experience is required. You must possess a deep knowledge of small business accounting software (QuickBooks or comparable), ERP business management systems, accounting processes, business technology, and B2B marketing strategies. Experience marketing to or supporting one or more of the following industries is a plus: construction, manufacturing, distribution, or professional services.

Education: An educational background in marketing, English, public relations, journalism, business, philosophy, computer science, or a related field.

Skills: You must be an exceptionally strong writer, able to explain complex features using clear, direct language and to translate technical ERP capability into plain-spoken benefits for small business owners. You must approach every project with an analytical mind and a creative approach to messaging. Excellent organization, multitasking ability, and strong communication are essential.

Technology Proficiency: Experience working with marketing technologies is preferred. This includes WordPress, Jasper or comparable AI tools, Camtasia, Asana, CRM applications, SharePoint, and Wistia. Direct experience with QuickBooks (Online or Desktop) is a strong plus.

Team Fit: We're looking for someone who fits with our friendly, ethical team, embodies our core values, brings a smile to work, and is ready to form lasting professional relationships in a fun, fast-paced environment. jobs.title: Customer Success Engineer
jobs.description:
Introduction

Are you searching for an opportunity to play a key role in contributing to the dramatic growth of a highly successful software company?

At Poppulo, we’re working on what’s next in communications and workplace technology. As a recognised organisation in this industry, we understand that meaningfully reaching every employee is hard. And so is managing office space in a hybrid world. And so is improving the customer and guest experience. We exist to make each of these things easier. We exist to bring harmony to our customers.

And we do that at enterprise scale. Our omnichannel employee communications, customer communications, and workplace experience platform is trusted by over 6,000 organisations today, reaching more than 35M employees and delivering content to 500,000+ digital signs.

We know there’s no such thing as a “perfect" candidate - we’re all a work in progress and are growing new skills and capabilities all the time. We encourage you to apply for a position with Poppulo even if you don’t meet 100% of the requirements. We believe in fostering an environment where there is a diversity of perspectives, in hopes that we can all succeed.

Job Summary

Poppulo is expanding its global Customer Success Engineering team, and this role adds capacity in US to support our US and global customer base. Customer Success Engineers are the technical owners of the customer relationship after the sale, working alongside Customer Success Managers to turn a signed contract into launched, adopted, measurable outcomes, and then to keep those outcomes compounding through every renewal that follows.

The work is hands-on and outcome led. You will get customers to real adoption of what they have bought and then look for the pattern behind it: the playbook, the reusable asset, the piece of enablement that lets the next twenty customers reach the same outcome without twenty separate engagements. Some accounts will fund dedicated coverage and expect an embedded engineer; most you will cover across a wider portfolio, deciding where your time matters most based on retention risk and expansion opportunity. Where a customer buys a scoped implementation or a significant build, our Professional Services team delivers it and you pick up the ongoing technical ownership from there, so the customer keeps a consistent technical partner long after the project closes.

Success is measured by adoption and gross revenue retention across the accounts you cover, not by hours logged, tickets closed, or billable delivery. You will be central when an escalation or a critical implementation demands deep technical help, but much of your impact should come from customers succeeding before anyone has to escalate, and from the scaled approaches that make that repeatable.

Key Responsibilities

• Own the technical relationship for an assigned set of accounts, partnering with the Customer Success Manager who owns the commercial relationship, so the customer experiences one team rather than a series of handoffs.

• Drive measurable adoption across your accounts: define what a successful technical outcome looks like, track whether the customer is reaching it, and intervene early when the signals turn.

• Work directly in customer environments to configure and optimize Poppulo experiences, accelerating time to value new adoption and deepening usage of what is already live.

• Deliver enablement and training that makes customer admins and content owners more self-sufficient as needed to protect revenue

• Prioritize across a portfolio, making judgement calls on where technical attention will most reduce churn risk or unlock expansion, and time boxing engagements against a clear reason for being there.

• Step in as the technical lead during escalations and critical situations, coordinating support to a resolution the customer can see, while working to reduce how often those situations arise.

• Surface expansion opportunities uncovered through technical work, qualifying new use cases and handing them to the commercial team with the technical case already made.

• Partner closely with Professional Services on scoped implementations and build projects: contribute to the account context going in and take on continuous technical ownership once the project is delivered.

• Work as part of a globally distributed Customer Success Engineering team, sharing coverage, context, and escalation support across regions and time zones.

• Represent the customer's technical reality internally, feeding defects, gaps, and roadmap needs into Product and Engineering with the evidence to make them actionable.

• Build the scaled approaches that extend your reach: reusable playbooks, reference configurations, enablement of assets, and repeatable interventions that lift outcomes across many accounts rather than one at a time.

Technical Skills / Competencies

• 4+ years in a customer-facing technical role such as success engineering, solutions engineering, technical account management, or enterprise implementation.

• Demonstrable track record of driving adoption and technical outcomes for enterprise customers beyond initial launch, rather than project delivery and handover.

• Experience working across multiple accounts simultaneously and prioritising independently.

• Working knowledge of enterprise technical infrastructure: SSO and identity management, APIs and integrations, web technologies, security and industry compliance.

• Experience contributing to retention or expansion outcomes, whether formally measured or through influence on renewals.

• Proven ability to learn new technologies independently and become productive quickly.

• Third-level qualification in a technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

Technical Skills / Competencies

• Driving adoption and technical outcomes. Able to define what success looks like inside an account, get the customer there, and evidence it. Judged on whether the customer is genuinely using and valuing the platform, not on activity delivered.

• Building for scale. Instinctively turns a solved problem into a playbook, reference configuration, or enablement asset, so the next customer benefits without a repeat engagement.

• Hands-on technical capability in enterprise SaaS. Comfortable configuring within a platform, working with APIs and integrations, and troubleshooting across enterprise infrastructure including SSO and access management, web technologies, security, and compliance.

• Portfolio judgement. Can hold many accounts at once and decide independently where technical attention creates the most value, without waiting to be assigned.

• Credible communication at every level. Can train an admin in the morning and hold a candid technical conversation with an enterprise executive in the afternoon, adjusting depth without losing authority.

Compensation

Annual base salary gross: 70,000-100,000 plus variable USD Annual. The base salary range represents the low and high end of the Company's contemplated salary range for this position. Actual salaries will vary and will be based on various factors, such as the candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies, and geographic location. The salary is one component of Company's total compensation package for employees. Other rewards and benefits include variable compensation, short-term incentives, health insurance, accident and life insurance, access to the best in class learning and development platforms, flexible work arrangement, to name just a few!

Who We Are

We are a values-driven organisation that encourages our employees to bring their authentic selves to work every day and empowers everyone to make a tangible impact on our products, clients, and culture. We offer a dynamic environment with driven, fun, and flexible individuals who thrive on challenge and responsibility. This is an opportunity to contribute to our culture and join a company that’s on the move.

We live the Poppulo values each day, as they are key to everything we do.

• Bring Your Best Self We show up authentically, are self-aware and always strive to be better.

• See it. Own it. Solve it. We proactively innovate and solve for our customers and each other. We set an example with high standards for our work. We foster a culture of learning, acknowledging our successes and our failures.

• Together We’re Better We value and celebrate our diversity. We learn from others, respecting their expertise, and focus on building trust. That's what makes us a team.

Named a Great Place to Work in 2015, 2016, 2017, 2018, 2019, 2020, and 2021, we are a fast-growing global technology company, with offices in Ireland, the US, the UK. and India.

Poppulo is an equal opportunity employer.

We are committed to protecting your privacy. For details on how we collect, use, and protect your personal information, please refer to our Job Applicant Privacy Policy. Please also review AI in Our Hiring Process for information on our approach to AI in hiring and guidance for candidates.
