• Monitoring and supervising Tower’s automated trading systems during Asian market hours across multiple markets and trading teams.

• Analyzing live trading activity for risk and compliance issues and responding promptly to unusual trading behavior or changing market conditions.

• Collaborating with risk managers and trading teams to identify intraday trading issues, escalate them to key stakeholders, and coordinate with Tower’s core engineering team, brokers, and exchanges to resolve issues in real time.

• Developing and maintaining monitoring procedures and documenting production issues as they occur to ensure accurate operational records.

• Working knowledge of risk controls across equities, futures, options, and FX markets, along with an understanding of exchange-specific rules and procedures.

jobs.title: Nurse Case Manager Care Coordination Part Time Days
jobs.description:
Days Part time, 0.7 FTE, hours are 8-4:40. One weekend every 7 weeks and one holiday per year.

The Nurse Case Manager reflects the mission, vision, and values of NM, adheres to the organization’s Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines and all other regulatory and accreditation standards.

• Assists in coordinating the patient's stay from admission through discharge. Assists to expedite medically appropriate, cost-effective care. Helps to ensure patient is at the right level and site of care, and the patient moves along the continuum of care in a safe and timely manner.

Responsibilities:

• In collaboration with the patient/family, and members of the health care team, assesses, plans, implements, and evaluates the plan of care and the patient's response to treatment.
• Continually proactive in collaborating and educating physicians and multidisciplinary team in appropriateness of admission, continued stay, utilization of resources and expected LOS.
• Refers appropriate cases to patient financial services, peer review, patient relations, risk management.
• Collaborates with physicians and other health care team members to clarify admission status and plan of care.
• Utilizes all available tools and resources to gain better and complete picture of clinical assessment of the patient: notifies physicians and staff of concerns/variations.
• Relays pertinent information to appropriate care team members relative to admission, continuum of care and concerns related to discharge.
• Ensures that the interdisciplinary care plan and the discharge plan are comprehensive and consistent with the patient's clinical course, continuing care needs, and coordinated with covered services as available.
• Assesses and reassesses the patient for on-going care needs with knowledge of high-risk criteria and initiates referrals to the appropriate resources in a timely manner to progress toward the discharge plan.
• Participates in rounds and complex patient care conferences as indicated, identifying needs, barriers, and action plans.
• Performs utilization management activities of all inpatients and observation patients by applying approved criteria. Notify physician advisor of any outlier cases.
• Provides timely and thorough reviews to third party payers as requested or required. Experiences minimal denials based on lack of medical necessity.
• Has a good working knowledge base of available and diverse extended care providers for general population served. Asks co-workers for references for unfamiliar cases.
• Researches patient insurance plan in order to offer in-network providers of care and allow patient to make informed decisions.
• Partners with the nursing staff and physicians to convey accurate and timely information to post-acute care providers to encourage a smooth hand-off and create a seamless and safe discharge to the next continuum of care.
• Partners with the care delivery team to identify proactively and coordinate any educational needs for the patient and family.
• Ensures the patient is at the most appropriate level of care for the expressed severity of illness and level of services required. Applies National Guidelines and clear communication with physicians.
• Collaborates with physicians and other health care team members to clarify admission status and plan of care.
• Coordinates appropriate bed placement for patients with Patient care services, collaborating on location, staffing etc.
• Queries the admitting physician for additional information as needed to meet medical necessity for admission or appropriate level of care. Refers cases to physician advisor for any outlier cases.
• Coordinates patient activity and flow or movement between levels of care. Identifies potential throughput barriers and acts proactively to inform and alert upper management of anticipated delays.
• Reviews clinical against Milliman criteria to help determine patient class and level of care needed. Confers with MD to discuss clinical and appropriate level of care when needed.

Required:

• Bachelors of Science in Nursing (required for hires after 01/01/2011)
• Registered Nurse in the state of Illinois
• One year of case management experience in an acute hospital setting

Preferred:

• Two years’ experience in utilization review
• Case management certification
• Prior experience in case management or insurance setting.
• Bilingual

Northwestern Medicine is an equal opportunity employer (disability, VETS) and does not discriminate in hiring or employment on the basis of age, sex, race, color, religion, national origin, gender identity, veteran status, disability, sexual orientation or any other protected status.

Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools may be used in some portions of the candidate review process for this position, however, all employment decisions will be made by a person.

jobs.title: Corporate Strategist
jobs.description:
The Weave Corporate Strategy team is integral in helping Weave’s C-Team & executive leadership craft our corporate strategy and then execute it. The Strategy team focuses on 5 key areas:

 - (1) Run “BizOps” (internal consulting) efforts focused on improving internal operations + special projects for executive leadership

 - (2) Develop Weave’s Strategy Plan

 - (3) Identify & Launch into New Markets

 - (4) M&A

 - (5) Own Weave’s competitive intelligence initiatives

Approximately 75% of bandwidth for this role will be dedicated to supporting Weave’s payments + partnerships organizations. 25% will be supporting other strategy team responsibilities (strategy planning, market intelligence, new markets, etc.)

 - Reports to: Sr. Director of Strategy

 - This position will be hybrid (remote + in-office), based out of our Lehi, UT HQ
   


WHAT YOU WILL OWN

 - (1) Run “BizOps” / Internal Consulting Efforts (with a focus on Weave’s Payments/RCM business unit)
   
   - Lead strategy & execution projects supporting our Head of Product (Payments & RCM solutions), GM of Payments, VP of Partnerships, Chief Revenue Officer (CRO) and other departments (as needed).  Focus would be heavily on executing payments/RCM + partnership initiatives.
   
   - Develop effective revenue growth strategies (ex: how to grow Weave’s payments business, how to test new pricing models/partnerships, etc.)
   
   - Analyze internal business practices with the goal of determining bottlenecks to providing effective operations.  Provide executive-level recommendations on how we can improve & optimize

 - (2) Define Weave’s Strategy Plan
   
   - Develop Weave’s 3-year Strategy Model (Vision, Values, Focus Areas, Objectives, KPIs, Major Initiatives)
   
   - Build response plans for specific competitors and market trends
   
   - Analysis of Weave’s strategic position (ex: using SWOT or other strategy frameworks)
   
   - Assist the CEO & C-Team in running key leadership meetings & workshops (ex: C-team offsites, Board meetings, etc..)

 - (3) Identify & Launch into New Markets
   
   - Identify new markets, conduct initial research and help align resources across Weave to launch into new industries and/or international expansions
   
   - Help identify new markets + strategic partnerships for Weave’s payments and RCM product lines

 - (4) M&A
   
   - Identify acquisition targets
   
   - Perform due diligence on potential merger & acquisition targets
   
   - Help lead post-merger integration (PMI) efforts

 - (5) Competitive Intelligence
   
   - Produce robust analysis/insights into Weave’s competitive landscape (particularly for payments and RCM competitors + industry leaders/startups)

jobs.title: Talent Acquisition Partner
jobs.description:
At Unispace, we create spaces that empower people and businesses to thrive. We are a global design-build partner delivering workplace and life sciences projects for some of the world’s most innovative brands.

With over 500 people across four continents, we bring together strategy, design, project management, and delivery into one seamless experience. Our integrated approach enables us to move with agility, solve complex challenges, and deliver meaningful outcomes for our clients.

Our people are at the centre of everything we do. We foster a collaborative, inclusive culture that values curiosity, accountability, creativity, and continuous improvement. We believe diverse perspectives strengthen our teams and help us create better experiences for our clients and each other.

At Unispace, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute to impactful projects, work alongside talented global teams, and grow your career in an environment that encourages innovation and new ideas.

Role Profile

As a Regional Talent Acquisition Partner, you will be the engine of talent acquisition activity in Unispace, our RPO client. You'll be providing hiring support across the USA as required. Based full-time at Unispace's Boston studio, you will be embedded within the business and partner closely with the HR team and hiring managers across Design, Project Management, Pre-construction, Construction, Commercial, and Corporate functions to attract and secure exceptional talent into a dynamic, design-led environment.

This is a hands-on, delivery-focused role for a skilled recruiter equally comfortable managing high volumes of live roles and building long-term talent pipelines. You will act as a true brand ambassador for Unispace, ensuring every candidate has a compelling, professional experience from first contact to offer.

Key responsibilities

• Have visibility of the full recruitment lifecycle for all USA vacancies, from briefing and job posting through to offer management and onboarding handover.

• Partner with hiring managers to define role requirements, create compelling job descriptions, and align on candidate profiles and timescales.

• Source candidates through a variety of channels including direct search, LinkedIn Recruiter, job boards, referrals, and specialist networks.

• Conduct initial screening calls and structured competency interviews to assess suitability and cultural fit before presenting shortlists to the business.

• Manage offer processes including salary benchmarking, negotiations, and pre-employment checks.

• Build and maintain proactive talent pipelines for business-critical and hard-to-fill disciplines across the Unispace portfolio.

• Champion the clients employer brand externally, ensuring a consistent and positive candidate experience at every touchpoint.

• Build trusted relationships with hiring managers and senior leadership, providing expert recruitment advice and market insight.

• Maintain accurate vacancy and candidate data within the ATS, producing regular recruitment MI and pipeline reports.

About you

• Demonstrable in-house or agency recruitment experience, ideally within the built environment, workplace design, construction, or professional services sectors.

• Proven track record of managing multiple concurrent vacancies across varied disciplines and seniority levels.

• Strong direct sourcing capability with hands-on experience using LinkedIn Recruiter and other candidate attraction tools.

• Confident, credible communicator with the ability to influence and advise senior stakeholders.

• Highly organised with excellent attention to detail and the ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.

• Experience using an ATS and maintaining accurate recruitment data and reporting.

• Prior experience recruiting within Commercial Real Estate, Workplace Design, Interior fit-out, architecture, or construction sectors (desirable).

• Familiarity with specialist roles such as interior designers, project managers, pre-construction, or site-based professionals (desirable).

• Exposure to diversity and inclusion recruitment initiatives (desirable)

About us

You will be employed by our RPO partner, Tandem Talent. Tandem Talent is our embedded recruitment partner working onsite within Unispace.

• Exact compensation may vary based on skills, experience and location

Base Pay Range

$100,000—$120,000 USD

jobs.title: GTM Systems Specialist
jobs.description:
Founded in 2018 with co-headquarters in Dublin and Boston, Tines powers some of the world's most important workflows. Our intelligent workflow platform applies AI, automation, and integration with human ingenuity to drive real business results.

Tines serves a diverse range of customers, from startups to public companies, including Canva, Databricks, Elastic, Kayak, Intercom, and McKesson. As an integrator across the entire tech stack, Tines is vendor-agnostic integrating with any API-enabled service. This flexibility enables our customers to achieve their highest-priority goals faster. And because Tines is secure and private by design, it’s popular with security, IT, engineering, finance, and other security-focused teams.

At Tines, we're driven by our values of Simplicity, Speed, and Soundness. We're committed to delivering exceptional customer experiences while fostering a company culture that nurtures individual curiosity, growth, and integrity. We’re excited about what’s next, and we’re looking for others to join us on our journey.

Tines is investing in its quote-to-cash platform and process. This role contributes to how that platform is built and administered. You will be the systems owner for our quote-to-cash configuration in DealHub and Salesforce, inputting to the design direction, and technical build and administration.

What you'll do

• Own DealHub build-out, configuration and day-to-day admin. Be the accountable owner of the platform: product catalog and SKU architecture, pricing and discounting rules, playbooks and quote flows, approval workflows, document and template management, and the Salesforce integration.

• Contribute to the platform roadmap. Working with Senior team members, translate where the business is going into a sequenced buildout plan as our products and commercial models evolve, and make the design calls that keep the configuration extensible rather than accumulating rework with every pricing change.

• Support our implementation partners. Scope and prioritise third-party services work, translate their the specifications and execute the builds, review and test what comes back, and hold quality and timeline.

• Set standards and governance. Define how change gets made: intake and prioritisation, sandbox and release practice, testing expectations, documentation standards, and the data-quality rules that stop bad data being created at the point of entry.

• Own the wider GTM stack in your scope. Maintain Salesforce configuration (objects, fields, flows, validation rules, permission sets, reporting) and the adjacent GTM tools that integrate with quote-to-cash.

• Be the systems partner to the business. Run requirements discovery with Sales, Deal Desk, Finance, and Legal, push back when an ask will not scale, and turn ambiguous business problems into specs people can build from.

• Maintain standards. Create the documentation and delivery standards for GTM Systems, mentor more junior analysts as the team grows

What you'll bring

• 3+ years in GTM systems, business systems analysis, revenue systems, or sales operations in a B2B SaaS environment, including ownership of a revenue-critical platform.

• Hands-on DealHub administration experience. You have configured, not just used, DealHub: product catalog, pricing and discount rules, playbooks, approval workflows, templates, and the CRM integration. This is a requirement for this role.

• Strong Salesforce administration fluency: objects, fields, flows, validation rules, permission sets, reports and dashboards.

• Extensive knowledge of quote-to-cash: quoting, approvals, order forms, amendments, renewals, and the downstream handoffs into billing and compensation.

• Demonstrated solution design, not just configuration: you can take an ambiguous business problem, choose an approach, and defend the trade-offs behind it.

• Experience scoping and managing external implementation partners or contractors, and holding them to a standard.

• Confidence advising and influencing senior stakeholders, including saying no to a request that will not scale, and settling disagreements across Sales, Finance, and Legal.

• Clear communication with both technical and non-technical audiences, and a service mindset toward the reps who depend on the platform.

Bonus points

• Exposure to a second enterprise CPQ platform alongside DealHub.

• Experience configuring CPQ through a pricing or packaging change

• Experience working alongside external implementation partners or systems integrators.

• Exposure to CaptivateIQ, NetSuite, or comparable ICM and ERP integrations.

• Salesforce Administrator or Platform App Builder certification.

• Experience working in an agile or sprint-based delivery model.

jobs.description:
Weave is building a more connected financial experience for healthcare practices and their patients, bringing payments and revenue-cycle workflows directly into the communications and interactions practices use every day. As a Product Manager on the Payments & RCM team, you will own products and workflows that help practices collect more efficiently, understand what has been paid, and reconcile payments back to the systems they use to run their businesses.

You will work across payments, practice-management software, patient financial experiences, and healthcare revenue cycle management, partnering closely with Engineering, Design, Data, Operations, Finance, Risk, and go-to-market teams. This role reports to the Head of Product, Payments & RCM and will have meaningful ownership over an area that is strategically important to Weave’s growth.

 - Location: Preferably hybrid/in-office in Lehi, Utah

 - Reports to: Head of Product, Payments & RCM
   


WHAT YOU WILL OWN

 - Own product strategy, discovery, prioritization, and execution for a set of payments and RCM workflows, from identifying the problem through launch, adoption, measurement, and iteration.

 - Improve how healthcare practices request, collect, record, and reconcile patient payments across digital and in-office experiences.

 - Build workflows that connect payment activity with practice-management systems, patient ledgers, claims and RCM data, and other systems of record.

 - Develop a deep understanding of how practices reconcile transactions, settlements, refunds, adjustments, fees, chargebacks, and other payment activity with patient balances and accounting records.

 - Identify opportunities to reduce manual work and eliminate fragmented workflows between Weave, practice-management software, payment systems, and financial operations.

 - Partner with customers and internal teams to understand front-office and back-office workflows, identify high-value problems, and validate solutions before significant development investment.

 - Define clear product requirements, success metrics, and acceptance criteria while giving Engineering and Design appropriate latitude to determine the best solution.

 - Use customer research, product analytics, payment data, operational data, and financial metrics to prioritize opportunities and evaluate product performance.

 - Partner closely with Engineering to balance new capabilities with reliability, scalability, platform improvements, and technical debt in financial workflows where accuracy matters.

 - Work with payment, technology, and healthcare partners to define and deliver integrations that expand Weave’s capabilities.

 - Collaborate with Sales, Customer Success, Support, Marketing, Finance, Risk, and Operations to ensure successful launches and ongoing product adoption.

 - Develop a strong understanding of the economics of the products you own, including payment volume, adoption, monetization, cost, and operational impact.

 - Help shape the longer-term Payments & RCM roadmap as Weave expands its role in the patient financial journey.
   


WHAT YOU WILL NEED TO ACCOMPLISH THE JOB

 - 4+ years of product management experience building and shipping software products.

 - Meaningful product experience in at least one of the following areas:
   
   - Healthcare payments or payment technology
   
   - Practice Management Software, EHR, or healthcare RCM
   
   - Financial reconciliation, patient ledgers, billing, or accounting workflows

 - Strong understanding of how complex operational workflows translate into product requirements and user experiences.

 - Experience working closely with Engineering and Design to deliver technically complex products or integrations.

 - Ability to understand APIs, data flows, system integrations, and dependencies well enough to make informed product decisions without needing to be the engineer.

 - Strong analytical skills and experience using data to evaluate problems, prioritize investments, establish KPIs, and measure results.

 - Ability to communicate clearly with both technical and nontechnical audiences and translate between customer, business, operational, and engineering needs.

 - Experience conducting customer discovery and turning qualitative and quantitative insights into product decisions.

 - Demonstrated ability to operate effectively when the problem is not fully defined and to create structure from ambiguity.
   


WHAT WILL MAKE US LOVE YOU

 - You have worked on payment reconciliation between a processor/payment platform and a PMS, EHR, ERP, accounting system, or other system of record.

 - You understand healthcare payment workflows such as patient responsibility, statements, payment plans, card-on-file, post-insurance balances, collections, and payment posting.

 - You have worked for a PMS/EHR company, healthcare payments company, RCM technology company, payment processor, PayFac, or vertically integrated SaaS platform.

 - You understand the payment lifecycle beyond checkout, including authorization, capture, settlement, funding, refunds, disputes, transaction matching, and reconciliation.

 - You have experience with platforms serving SMB healthcare practices, particularly dental, optometry, veterinary, medical, or other ambulatory healthcare markets.

 - You understand enough of the healthcare revenue cycle to reason about claims, eligibility, insurance adjudication, patient responsibility, and collections.

 - You naturally look for opportunities to replace manual financial workflows with automation while maintaining appropriate accuracy, controls, and user trust.

 - You can move comfortably between customer workflow details and broader product/business strategy.

jobs.title: Graduate Credit Analyst
jobs.description:
About Wayflyer

Today's small businesses need a capital provider that keeps pace with their growth ambitions. Traditional financing options are slow, cumbersome and often out of reach. That's why we built Wayflyer.

Our technology allows us to assess businesses in minutes, generate financing offers that reflect their growth potential, and send funds in as little as 24 hours. To date, we've deployed over $6bn to thousands of businesses worldwide, backed by Tier 1 banks like J.P. Morgan.

You'll be collaborating with ambitious colleagues from around the world. We have offices in Dublin, London, New York, Charlotte, Berlin and Sydney.

The challenge

Wayflyer's growth depends on knowing exactly who we can fund and how much risk that carries. This role exists to dig into the data behind every customer, business and financial, and turn it into decisions that let us fund eCommerce growth responsibly.

What you'll actually do

 - Discover the story behind the data - analyse financial and non-financial data on new and existing customers to understand how their business really works

 - Assess and quantify risk - learn to evaluate the challenges of running an eCommerce business and how Wayflyer can fund that growth responsibly

 - Connect with customers directly - join regular calls to deepen our understanding of their business models, funding needs, and future plans

 - Collaborate with management to build and implement new processes and products

 - Support sales and operations by understanding how they win and manage customer relationships

 - Learn our existing loan portfolio and portfolio management tools, including when to exit risky relationships

 - Collaborate across Wayflyer - partner with teams across the business to connect dots, share insights, and drive impact

What this role could turn into

This is a launchpad, not a lane. Past analysts in this seat have moved into Senior Credit Risk Analyst roles, crossed into Portfolio Management, and built careers in Commercial or Strategic Finance as Wayflyer's risk function has scaled.

Who thrives here

Someone insatiably curious about how businesses actually work, not just their numbers. You ask questions because you need the real answer, not because you're expected to. You think founder-first, you're comfortable presenting your own conclusions in a room, and you're ambitious enough to want to prove it fast.

We hire for range

You don't need years of experience, you need trajectory. A strong academic record in Business, Finance, Economics, Engineering, Law or Computer Science (completed or near completion) is your starting point. From there, what matters is how quickly you pick things up: comfort with financial reporting, an instinct for data (Excel or SQL is a plus), and momentum toward a professional finance or accounting qualification if that's your path.

Location and working policy

Based in our Charlotte HQ. Hybrid, 3-4 days onsite to start, transitioning to a more flexible remote role over time.

The good stuff

25 days annual leave plus public holidays, private healthcare, life insurance and critical illness cover, a pension plan, generous parental leave, equity, and the option to work from abroad for up to 60 days a year.

 

By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Wayflyer Limited will process your personal data for the purpose of evaluating your suitability for the role. Such processing is based on the need to take steps prior to entering into a potential employment agreement. To learn more about how we handle your personal data, you can contact our privacy team at privacy@wayflyer.com or review our privacy notice at https://wayflyer.com/privacy-notice. https://wayflyer.com/privacy-notice.*

jobs.title: (Senior) Program Manager
jobs.description:
Orcrist is building a next generation data intelligence platform using cutting-edge technologies. We're handling petabyte-scale data with sub-second queries. Our product is a Kubernetes‑based platform delivered as B2B SaaS or as a self‑hosted on‑prem solution, including air‑gapped deployments. We enable customers across defense, law enforcement, and enterprise to turn mission-critical data into actionable intelligence.

Role

We're looking for a (Senior) Program Manager to join our Business/Government Development team. In this role, you'll own the entire path from a prioritized opportunity to a successfully delivered and scalable customer program. You will translate customer needs into concrete project concepts and prototypes, leading delivery across defense, security, and public-sector environments while bridging the gap between capture, product, and operational users.

What you'll do

• Convert prioritized leads and customer needs into concrete, funded project opportunities together with Government Development, Business Development, and Product.

• Work directly with public-sector customers and operational users to understand complex operational problems, user needs, and procurement logic.

• Structure and coordinate prototypes, demonstrators, minimum viable products (MVPs), and pilot projects with clear test scenarios and decision milestones.

• Take end-to-end responsibility for program delivery post-award, managing scope, timeline, budget, technical implementation, dependencies, and risks.

• Build and maintain trusted relationships with users, decision-makers, procurement bodies, and external technology or consortium partners.

• Document customer feedback and operational insights systematically, translating them into product decisions and reusable platform capabilities.

• Establish binding governance, reporting, and decision-making structures to ensure contractual obligations and customer expectations are consistently met.

About you

• 6+ years of relevant professional experience in program management, project management, innovation management, solution delivery, or technical business development.

• Proven track record of converting early leads or customer needs into funded projects and delivering complex, cross-functional customer programs.

• Demonstrable experience in defense, security, government, or comparably regulated public-sector environments.

• Experience structuring pilot projects or prototypes with technical teams and operational users, especially where requirements are not fully defined upfront.

• Entrepreneurial mindset with strong ownership, structured execution, and the ability to connect strategic objectives with operational delivery.

• Business fluent German and English (C1+).

• Willingness to travel regularly (approx. 30–40% within Germany and Europe).

• Work authorization in Germany and willingness to undergo a security clearance.

What We Offer

• Remote-first, Germany-wide: Work from wherever you do your best work, with regular team gatherings in Berlin and other off-site locations.

• Flexibility by default: Flexible working hours help you make work fit your life.

• Your setup, your way: Get a personal home-office equipment budget to create a workspace that works for you.

• 30 days of vacation: Take the time you need to recharge and come back with fresh energy.

• Keep growing: We invest in your personal and professional development.

• Get rewarded for impact: Performance bonuses are tied to agreed objectives and key results.

• A warm welcome: Every new team member gets a welcome goodie bag.

• Good people, good times: From summer and Christmas parties to regular team gatherings, we make time to celebrate together.

• A mission that matters: Work on challenges with tangible impact on public safety and national security.

• Salaris tussen de € 17,37 en € 20,70 bruto per uur (afhankelijk van je ervaring)
• Direct een arbeidsovereenkomst voor onbepaalde tijd
• Gemiddeld 120 uur per 4 weken op contract
• Onregelmatigheidstoeslagen afhankelijk van jouw type dienst (conform CAO PB: avond 10%, nacht 20%, weekend 35%, feestdagen 50%)
• Pensioenregeling, reiskostenvergoeding eindejaarsuitkering

jobs.title: CRO Manager
jobs.description:
About Eucalyptus

We're on a mission to make good health last a lifetime. More than 1 billion people live with obesity worldwide, driving preventable chronic conditions. We're here to build better long-term care.

Eucalyptus is now part of Hims & Hers, the global leader in personalised health and wellness.

Euc is the company behind Juniper, one of the world's largest weight-management programs combining GLP-1 medication with personalised nutrition, movement support, and clinician-led care from prescribers, nurses, health coaches, pharmacists, and dietitians. Our published clinical research shows that our combined clinical and behavioural approach helps patients lose significantly more weight during their treatment with Juniper by four times.

Our Growth Story:

• Supporting patients living with obesity across our 5 markets

• Received selective NICE endorsement to provide services to the NHS

• Tailored our offering to thousands of patients in Australia, the UK, Germany, Japan and Canada.

About the role

We're looking for a CRO Manager to own and improve one of the most important journeys at Juniper: how prospective patients move from their first visit to our website through to starting treatment. Juniper has a complex, considered customer journey. Prospective patients need to understand our program, decide whether it's right for them, complete a health assessment and ultimately make a meaningful healthcare decision. You'll combine data, experimentation and a deep understanding of customer behaviour to make that journey simpler, clearer and more effective.

This is a senior, hands-on individual contributor role within our Product Growth team. You'll own conversion across our digital funnel, identify where and why prospective patients drop out, and turn those insights into experiments that materially improve performance. You'll work closely with Design, Copy, Engineering, and Analytics to turn opportunities into shipped experiments. As Juniper expands into new products and patient needs, you'll also help build and optimise the new conversion journeys that support that growth.

What you'll be doing

• Own conversion across the funnel. Take accountability for performance from landing page through to quiz, assessment and order, identifying the biggest conversion leaks and opportunities for improvement.

• Build and run our experimentation roadmap. Translate customer behaviour and funnel data into clear hypotheses, prioritise opportunities based on expected impact, and run a structured experimentation cadence.

• Get close to the data. Diagnose where customers are dropping out, quantify opportunities, and work with Analytics to ensure the right tracking, measurement, and attribution are in place.

• Design rigorous experiments. Own A/B and multivariate testing from hypothesis through to execution, analysis and decision-making.

• Turn experiments into decisions. Clearly articulate what worked, what didn't and why, using results to determine what we ship, iterate or stop.

• Understand the customer behind the numbers. Combine quantitative data with customer insight to understand intent, friction, trust and the reasons people hesitate or abandon their journey.

• Lead conversion-focused creative execution. Partner closely with Copy and Design to turn hypotheses into messaging, UX and customer experiences that improve conversion.

• Partner with Engineering and Product. Take opportunities from diagnosis through to implementation rather than stopping at recommendations.

• Connect acquisition and conversion. Work closely with Growth to ensure the experience customers land on reflects the intent and messaging that brought them there.

• Build new conversion journeys. As Juniper expands its product ecosystem, help create and optimise funnels for new products and patient needs.

• Raise our CRO capability. Establish strong practices around prioritisation, experiment design, measurement and learning so we continuously get better at understanding what drives growth.

About you

We're looking for someone who has genuinely owned conversion problems, not simply supported a CRO program.

You'll need to have:

• 5+ years of experience across CRO, experimentation, digital optimisation, product growth, or a similarly quantitative digital role.

• A track record of owning and improving digital conversion funnels, with clear examples of measurable commercial impact.

• Strong hands-on experience designing and running A/B and multivariate experiments.

• Strong analytical instincts. You can interrogate funnel performance, identify drop-offs, size opportunities, and translate data into hypotheses.

• Experience working with Analytics or Data teams to build robust measurement and attribution frameworks.

• Strong customer judgement and an understanding of how UX, messaging, friction and behavioural psychology influence conversion.

• Experience working closely with Design, Copy, Engineering and Product to turn hypotheses into shipped experiences.

• Strong commercial judgement and an ability to connect individual funnel metrics to broader business outcomes.

Experience in healthcare, subscription businesses or considered-purchase journeys is useful, but not essential. We're much more interested in how you approach customers, experimentation and growth.

Why this role matters

• Conversion is one of Juniper's biggest growth opportunities.

• Our patient journey is fundamentally different from a simple ecommerce checkout. People are making a personal healthcare decision, often after spending significant time thinking about their health and weight. Building trust, communicating clearly and removing unnecessary friction all matter.

• At the same time, Juniper is evolving beyond a single offering into a broader ecosystem of products and care. That means building new journeys, understanding new customer behaviours, and continuously improving how people discover and access the right care.

• You'll have meaningful ownership of that problem, with the data to understand it, the creative and technical partners to execute against it, and the opportunity to directly influence how quickly Juniper grows.

Why join Eucalyptus?

Euc is also behind a growing family of digital healthcare clinics (Pilot, Kin, Software, Compound) across men’s health and well-being, fertility, skincare, and preventative health.

Here’s what makes joining Euc unique:

• What’s next - Our goal for the next three years is to support 1 million patients globally to live better for longer. We’re launching into new conditions, demographics, and geographies as we build a truly preventive healthcare ecosystem.

• Build something world-changing - We’re on the path to becoming the world’s largest international digital healthcare company. It will be challenging, fast-paced, and deeply rewarding.

• Make real impact - You will deliver work that directly shapes patient outcomes and scales evidence-based care across markets.

• Accelerate your growth - You will have high ownership, continuous feedback, and dedicated development support.

• Join a motivated team - You will collaborate with talented peers to solve complex clinical and operational problems at scale.

What’s ahead in Australia?

• Grow with us globally - Get mentorship from leaders across Australia, the UK, Germany, and Japan, collaborate with teams in the Philippines and South Africa, and explore new markets or travel internationally. ****Recognised on Hatch’s Hotlist as one of Australia’s top employers, we support early-career professionals to become future global leaders.

• Shape your career - Access learning budgets, conferences, certifications, peer shadowing, and a global knowledge-sharing culture.

• Work where well-being matters - Experience catered wellness talks, exercise classes, free barista coffees, funded social clubs, and quarterly rooftop parties.

• Innovate with purpose - Use state-of-the-art tools and contribute to bold, impactful solutions in healthcare.

• Support at every stage - Benefit from parental and miscarriage leave, health, professional development, and personal days, and our Employee Assistance Program.

At Eucalyptus, we value individuals from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives, and we embrace the unique qualities each person brings. When you apply, please let us know of any reasonable adjustments you may need during the interview process. We use AI-assisted tools across our business to help our teams work more efficiently, including within our recruitment process. These tools support our team — all hiring decisions are made by real people, and every application is reviewed by a member of our recruitment team.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, End User Experience
jobs.description:
We're looking for a Senior End User Experience Manager to lead our global EUE team and redefine what internal IT support looks like at Nexthink. This is not a traditional help-desk management role; it's a mandate to build a modern, largely self-service, AI-augmented support model, anchored by two flagship internal deployments: Spark, our AI-powered personal IT agent delivering autonomous support to every employee, and our new AI-powered ITSM platform replacing legacy ticketing infrastructure.

You'll manage a 9-person team spread across five countries, own the full IT Workplace experience end-to-end (devices, peripherals, remote office infrastructure, and beyond), and personally drive the adoption curve for Spark and our new AI-powered ITSM platform - working directly with the Engineering and Product teams building them, since both platforms are still in active development. You'll also carry security and compliance into everything you do: Nexthink is ISO 27001 and SOC 2 Type II certified, and your team's processes are part of that certification boundary.

Nexthink sells Digital Employee Experience (DEX) management; which means this role is also our own best reference customer. We're looking for someone who wants to actively use, stress-test, and enhance our own DEX platform internally, feeding real operational insight back into the product and acting as an internal champion for what great DEX looks like in practice.

This role reports directly to the Senior IT Director and owns a budget covering tooling, vendor contracts, and team resourcing decisions.

Required

• 5+ years of hands-on people management experience, ideally leading distributed/global teams.

• Demonstrated experience managing IT end-user support or workplace technology functions at scale.

• Genuine interest and hands-on experience in automation and AI-driven support tooling - this role requires someone who wants to eliminate manual work, not preserve it.

• Genuine enthusiasm for Digital Employee Experience (DEX) as a discipline, with willingness to be a hands-on internal user and advocate of Nexthink's own DEX platform.

• Comfortable operating with in-development products: ability to work directly with Engineering/Product teams, tolerate ambiguity, and provide structured operational feedback.

• Strong analytical mindset: comfortable working with data, SLAs, and KPIs to drive decisions rather than intuition alone.

• Working exposure to ISO 27001 and/or SOC 2 Type II frameworks, with an understanding of how end-user computing controls fit into a certified environment.

• ITIL certification.

• University degree.

• Native Spanish speaker with professional-level English (written and verbal).

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders at all levels, including Engineering, Product, and executive leadership.

We are the pioneers and trailblazers of a global IT Market Category (DEX) that is shaping the future of how the world works, giving our customers’ IT Teams total digital visibility across their enterprise. Our innovative solutions integrate real-time analytics, automation, and employee feedback across all endpoints. This enables our IT teams to solve complex technical challenges, create ever more productive workplaces, and deliver happy, satisfied employees in the digital workplace.

With over 1000 employees across 5 continents, Nexthink operates as One Team, connecting, collaborating and innovating to continuously grow. We call our employees ‘Nexthinkers’ and our commitment to diversity, inclusion, and equity is second to none. We currently have over 75 nationalities working with us, from all cultures and backgrounds, speaking many different languages.

If you are looking for a change and like a nice atmosphere, lots of challenges, and having fun while working, this is a great opportunity for you! Check what we offer:

• 📍 Amazing centrally located offices near the Bernabeu Stadium. 🩺 Private Health Insurance (Sanitas) and daily meal vouchers of 11 EUR will be entirely covered by us. 🏡 Hybrid work model balancing office and remote work, with a structured approach for new hires to foster connections and onboarding. 🏖️ Flexible Hours and unlimited vacation (employees have unlimited paid time off on top of the 23 days of holidays we offer) plus 3 company-paid volunteer days. 🤸 Up to 25 EUR per month for a gym subscription. 🛴 Flexible retribution plan for kindergarten & transport tickets. 🧑‍🏫 Reimbursement of up to 50% of the cost of English & Spanish classes. 🍉 Fresh fruit, cookies, and occasionally some soft drinks as well. 🍕 Regular company and team events like Pizza talks, Team Building activities, Christmas parties, hosting Meetups at the office and more! 📣 Bonuses for referring successful hires after three months of continuous employment. 💼 Permanent Contract and a competitive compensation package (Stock Options also included). 🚚 We offer a relocation package to people who are coming from another country.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Supplier Relations (K4B)
jobs.description:
KAYAK, part of Booking Holdings (NASDAQ: BKNG), is a leading travel search engine. With billions of queries across our platforms, we help people find their perfect flight, stay, rental car and vacation package. We're also transforming business travel with a new corporate travel solution, KAYAK for Business.

As an employee of KAYAK, you will be part of a travel company that operates a portfolio of global metasearch brands including momondo, Cheapflights and HotelsCombined, among others. From start-up to industry leader, innovation is in our DNA and every employee has an opportunity to make their mark. Our focus is on building the best travel search engine to make it easier for everyone to experience the world.

KAYAK for Business (K4B) is KAYAK's corporate travel platform — built to help companies manage business travel through a modern online booking experience, AI-powered features, and a connected network of travel management partners.

KAYAK is seeking a highly motivated Senior Manager to lead Supplier Relations for KAYAK for Business. This person will report to the Senior Director KAYAK for Business and oversee the portfolio of all global preferred supplier partners (TMC, airline, rail, lodging, car rental, ground, expense, payment, etc).

This position is based in our Cambridge, MA office at least 3 times per week.




IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL:

 - Drive global growth, engaging new partnerships as well as optimizing and retaining our existing partnerships, while expanding the value proposition and aligning the K4B strategy for suppliers and other partnerships

 - Design and lead travel partner evaluations, communications, and contracting for the organization

 - Collaborate with partners & internal teams on commercial opportunities, developing and strengthening strategic and mutually beneficial relationships for K4B and its partners

 - Working closely with customers and internal collaborators to ensure current and future content & functionality needs are exceeded

 - Collaborate with key internal teams like Business Development, Account Management, Product & Marketing to achieve target goals

 - Contribute to determining and prioritizing new technology improvements to help drive additional sales to key partners

 - Work closely with the Finance department for budgeting and forecasting and revenue reconciliation from suppliers




PLEASE APPLY IF YOU HAVE:

 - 7+ years in travel agency, distribution, payment, air/lodging/car/rail supplier or related fields

 - Proven history of building and maintaining strong relationships both internally and externally

 - Savvy and clear communicator, story teller and presenter to both technical and non-technical audiences

 - Outstanding analytic skills to drive positive partnership results based on analysis

 - Expert negotiator, developing creative solutions to problems or barriers

 - Comfortable working in a fast-paced tech environment

 - Recognized as a thought leader within the Travel Industry

 - Experience in tech a major plus

 - Strong business development and problem-solving skills coupled with a willingness to “roll up your sleeves”

 - Experience working with global teams in multiple locations




BENEFITS AND PERKS

 - Work from (almost) anywhere for up to 20 days per year

 - Focus on mental health and well-being:
   
   - Company-paid therapy sessions through SpringHealth
   
   - Company-paid subscription to HeadSpace
   
   - Company-wide week off a year - the whole team fully recharges (and returns without a pile-up of work!)

 - No meeting Fridays

 - Paid parental leave

 - Generous paid vacation + time off for your birthday

 - Paid volunteer time

 - Focus on your career growth:
   
   - Development Dollars
   
   - Leadership development
   
   - Access to thousands of on-demand e-learnings

 - Travel Discounts

 - Employee Resource Groups

 - Competitive retirement and health plans

 - Free lunch 2 days per week

 - Fun quarterly events such as boat trips, arcades, ski trips, Thursday happy hours, and more

There are a variety of factors that go into determining a salary range, including but not limited to external market benchmark data, geographic location, and years of experience sought/required. The range for this Massachusetts-based role is $135,000-$155,000.

We offer a competitive base salary and benefits including: health benefits; flexible spending account; retirement benefits; life insurance; paid time off (including PTO, paid sick leave, medical leave, bereavement leave, floating holidays and paid holidays); and parental leave benefits. This role is eligible to be considered for an annual bonus.




INCLUSION

At KAYAK, we want everyone to have the space to grow, share ideas and do great work. That's why we're focused on hiring the best talent from all walks of life and experiences, supporting them well and making sure no one feels like they have to fit a mold to belong here.

Need any adjustments for the interview, application or on the job? No problem - just give us a heads-up. We've got you.

jobs.title: Night Manager
jobs.description:
• Represent the General Manager overnight, with delegated authority over guest, operational and staffing decisions whenever no senior manager is on site.
• Run the front desk overnight: check-ins, check-outs, walk-ins, room changes and guest requests.
• Approve service recovery, room moves, complimentary gestures and refunds.
• Act as the hotel's first point of contact for emergency services and notify the General Manager according to the escalation matrix.
• Hold all night-time departments (Front Office, Housekeeping, Food & Beverage, Engineering and Security) to hotel policies, brand standards and safety procedures.
• Act as the duty manager and the visible face of the resort at night, welcoming late arrivals and assisting guests with requests, concerns and complaints.
• Resolve guest issues on the spot, applying service recovery within the authority granted by the General Manager, and log every case for follow-up.
• Ensure the lobby, public areas, spa and pool zones, restaurants and bars are safe, clean and presentable throughout the night.
• Oversee late check-ins, early departures, room moves, in-house requests and the preparation of early-morning arrivals and departures.
• Coordinate with Housekeeping, Engineering, F&B, Security and Reservations on urgent night-time issues, and escalate what cannot wait for the morning.
• Supervise closing of outlets and event spaces, cash handling by outlet staff and the opening routines for breakfast and early departures.
• Monitor room status accuracy in the property management system so that inventory and rates are correct for the day ahead.
• Ensure billing, fiscalisation and tourist tax requirements are met for all night transactions.
• Conduct scheduled night patrols of public areas, back-of-house, car parks, pool and spa areas, and check that alarms, exits and access points are secure.
• Ensure guest registration is completed correctly and on time for all arrivals, including eVisitor entries, and that guest data is handled in line with GDPR.
• Record all accidents, incidents, lost property and security events in the incident log, and report them to the Front Office Manager, Rooms Division Manager and General Manager.
• Ensure grooming, uniform and service standards are upheld, and that brand standards are followed in every guest interaction.
• Croatian and English language

In this role, you will design, develop, and maintain high‑quality software components using TypeScript, React, and modern cloud‑native technologies. You will work closely with senior engineers, product managers, and cross‑functional teams to deliver scalable and secure solutions that power Nexthink’s next generation of DEX capabilities.

This is a hands‑on engineering role in a collaborative, agile environment where you’ll be empowered to influence design decisions, improve architecture, and drive engineering excellence.

jobs.title: Sr. Territory Account Manager, Tri-Cities
jobs.description:
Carbon Robotics is the leader in physical AI for agriculture, helping farmers become more profitable and sustainable. Its flagship product, the LaserWeeder™, is the world’s leading commercial laser weeding system with hundreds of units operated by farmers in 15 countries worldwide.

LaserWeeder combines computer vision, AI, robotics, and high-powered lasers to identify weeds and destroy them with sub-millimeter precision—no herbicides, hand labor, or soil disturbance required. Growers achieve weed control cost reductions of up to 80% and crop yield increases of 5–50%, with payback in one to three years. The system is powered by Carbon AI’s Large Plant Model (LPM), trained on 150 million labeled plants, and can start weeding any crop or field in minutes.

The company's second product is Carbon Autonomy, the most dependable tractor autonomy solution. Carbon Autonomy includes a retrofit tractor autonomy kit for John Deere tractors, autonomy software, and remote supervision for real-time interventions if required.

Carbon Robotics is based in Seattle, Washington State, USA and has raised $185 million in capital since 2018 from leading investors including NVIDIA’s NVentures and BOND.

YouTube | X | Instagram | LinkedIn | News

Location: Tri-Cities, Washington
Department: Sales
Travel: Extensive travel throughout the territory

About Carbon Robotics

Carbon Robotics is building the future of agriculture through AI-powered robotics and autonomous systems. Our Carbon Autonomy platform enables farmers to automate existing tractors, helping address labor shortages, increase equipment utilization, and improve farm productivity.

The Role

As a Territory Account Manager, you will own sales of Carbon Autonomy across the Tri-Cities and surrounding agricultural regions of Eastern Washington.

You will build relationships with growers and farm operators, identify opportunities for automation, demonstrate our technology, and manage the sales process from initial prospecting through close.

This is a highly field-based role for someone who understands agriculture and is excited about bringing new technology to farmers.

What You'll Do

• Own and grow the Carbon Autonomy sales pipeline within your territory

• Prospect and develop relationships with growers, farm owners, and agricultural operations

• Understand customers' equipment, labor, and operational challenges and identify opportunities for automation

• Conduct customer meetings, product demonstrations, and field visits

• Manage the full sales cycle, including proposals, negotiations, and closing

• Build and maintain strong relationships with customers and agricultural partners

• Represent Carbon Robotics at industry events, field days, and grower meetings

• Collaborate with Sales Engineering, Operations, Customer Success, and Product teams

• Maintain accurate pipeline, forecasts, and territory plans

• Provide customer and market feedback to the wider organization

What We're Looking For

• 4+ years of experience in agricultural equipment, AgTech, precision agriculture, or B2B sales

• Proven track record of achieving sales targets

• Strong understanding of commercial farming and agricultural operations

• Existing relationships with growers or agricultural businesses in Eastern Washington is highly desirable

• Experience selling high-value capital equipment, technology, or complex solutions

• Strong consultative selling, communication, and negotiation skills

• Comfortable working independently in a field-based territory

• Excited by AI, robotics, autonomy, and emerging agricultural technology

• Valid driver's license and willingness to travel extensively

Preferred

• Experience selling agricultural machinery or technology directly to growers

• Knowledge of John Deere equipment, precision agriculture, GPS/autosteer, or telematics

• Existing network within the Tri-Cities / Columbia Basin farming community

• Bachelor's degree in Agriculture, Business, Engineering, or related field

Carbon Robotics follows equitable hiring practices. Flexibility in our hiring process allows hiring of talent at levels different from what are posted.  The compensation range outlined is based on a target budgeted base salary. Individual base pay depends on various factors such as relevant experience and skill, Interview assessments and responsibility of role, job duties/requirements. Offers are determined using our equitable hiring practices. Carbon Robotics offers additional compensation in the form of benefits premiums, pre-IPO stock options and On Target Earning commissions for appropriate positions. Base pay ranges are reviewed each year. We are committed to the principle of pay equity – paying employees equitably for similar work.

Carbon Robotics' base salary pay range:

$100,000—$125,000 USD

Why would you join Carbon Robotics?

Passion for building teams capable of solving uniquely interesting problems. Innovation while disrupting the market is what we do.  Profiled in WSJ and Forbes, Carbon Robotics is poised to become the next billion dollar company in the rapidly growing worldwide Ag-Tech industry.

We offer competitive compensation and benefits to our full time US based* employees, including:

• Competitive salaries

• Pre-IPO Stock Options

• Generous Benefits: Fully-paid medical, dental, and vision insurance premiums for you and all dependents Choice of PPO or HDHP/HSA Virtual Care - Doctor on Demand Employee Assistance Program Mental Health HRA Restricted Healthcare Travel support Menopause Support Life Insurance Long Term Disability Flexible PTO 401(k) plan Pet Insurance Commuter Benefits

• Work Culture: Be a part of an inclusive and tight-knit company culture that values innovation and mission-driven success.

*Internationally based employees benefits varies & Contractors are not eligible for Carbon Robotics Benefits or Stock

Carbon Robotics is building a culture of diversity and inclusion for all.  We welcome everyone’s voice and believe in open and transparent communication. We believe the best products, services, and companies are built by strong teams that include a diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, ideas, and experiences. We are committed to supporting and enabling growth and opportunity for every employee at every level. This is the foundation to which we will build a truly unique environment.

We are equally committed to equal employment opportunity, and it is foundational to how we recruit and hire our talented team. jobs.title: Account Executive
jobs.description:
At Just Appraised, we’re replacing outdated, manual local government workflows with modern software used by hundreds of government agencies across the United States. Our cutting-edge, AI-powered software, which leverages Natural Language Processing (NLP), replaces manual data entry to eliminate delays, backlogs, and errors. This work directly impacts how communities fund schools, infrastructure, and public services.

About the Role

We are seeking an Account Executive to join our expanding Sales team and bring our solutions to market across the country. You’ll be joining a critical, early-stage team where you won't just be an "executor" but a key contributor to our growth strategy, with the opportunity to directly shape strategy as we scale.

This is a unique chance to gain true ownership by owning the full sales cycle—from engaging in outbound prospecting to creating persuasive proposals and successfully closing business. This role offers a front-row seat to the rapid growth of a SaaS company, selling an innovative, AI-first product that genuinely modernizes a historically underserved sector. If you are looking for high autonomy, direct impact on community services, and the chance to accelerate your career in sales, come join our team!

What You Will Work On

• Own the Sales Cycle: Engage in outbound prospecting, primarily through cold calls from leads generated through our BDR team, targeting local government entities.
• Solve Real Problems: Conduct discovery calls to deeply understand prospect challenges and demonstrate how our customized software provides effective solutions.
• Close Business: Create persuasive proposals that clearly demonstrate our product's impact, driving deals to a successful conclusion.
• Collaborate: Coordinate effectively with both internal and external stakeholders throughout the sales process.
• Drive Engagement: Support and drive attendance to various marketing events, including conferences, trade shows, and webinars.
• Achieve Goals: Meet or exceed established sales targets and activity metrics.
• Manage Pipeline: Accurately track and update the sales funnel using a CRM.
• Shape Strategy: Contribute to and execute the company's overall sales strategy as we scale.

What We’re Looking For

• Experience:
• 5+ years of overall Software Sales experience.4+ years of quota-carrying SaaS sales experience in a new business/closing role, with a preference for experience in the public sector.Prior experience selling solutions in the EdTech or GovTech industries
• Skills & Mindset:
• Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to actively listen and communicate with empathy (EQ > IQ).Work Ethic: Adaptable, professional, highly motivated, and possesses a strong work ethic.Autonomy & Teamwork: A self-starter who can work independently while also collaborating seamlessly within a small team environment.Execution: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with an efficient approach to time management and a focus on clear goals.
• Travel: Willingness to travel up to twice a month (approximately 40% travel annually) for events and client meetings.

Benefits

• Competitive compensation and stock equity plan
• Comprehensive benefits package that includes medical, dental, vision, and life insurance
• Company sponsored pre-tax retirement savings program (401k)
• A flexible work environment that supports working from home
• Flexible PTO
• Parental Leave
• Home office stipend

jobs.title: Customer Support Associate
jobs.description:
Padlet https://padlet.com is building software for a good education. A good education is one that inspires curiosity, creativity, and community. Our software enables that through visual content creation and collaboration in millions of classrooms worldwide.

At Padlet, we know that great customer support is provided by both people and products. As a group, we've set high standards for how we treat people: whether it's our users, or Larry, our UPS deliveryman. We'll be relying on you to help us meet the standards we've set for ourselves in our interactions with our community.

We are seeking a highly motivated and resourceful individual who is dedicated to providing world-class support by exceeding expectations through each interaction with the Padlet community. The ideal candidate is a fiercely loyal advocate for our customers, a creative problem-solver, and a collaborative team member. This person is energized by working with people, while still being a strong independent worker.

This is a full time, salaried position that will be based in our San Francisco office.




RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Effectively solve customer inquiries via phone, email

 - Hold a high bar for Support when owning customer interactions

 - Identify, document and follow up with engineers on product bugs and features

 - Advocate for customers by identifying trends in issues and suggesting improvements to processes, policies and products

 - Recognize errors and draft improvements to content in the external Support Center and internal documentation

 - Collaborate with members of other teams to root out answers and be a resource to teammates

 


QUALIFICATIONS

 - The ability to provide support fluently in English. Proficiency in another language is a bonus

 - Genuine curiosity about people and business, while possessing the ability to inspire passion in others

 - Experience in direct customer or client-facing roles

 - Interest in implementing feedback and dedicated to the improvement of your skills and work

 - Strong organizational, analytical, written and verbal communication skills

 - Superb attention to detail

 - Excellent time-management skills





ABOUT PADLET

 - Vision: Every child in the world will grow up with Mickey Mouse and Padlet.

 - Product: We are making the default way of collecting and sharing thoughts on the Internet. People love the product.

 - Impact: We have 40 million users, making Padlet one of the most used apps on the planet.

 - Money: We are venture backed AND fiscally responsible. We are built to last one hundred years.

 - Badassery: We are only 70 odd people. That's over half a million active users per person.




SOME PEOPLE YOU‘D BE WORKING WITH

 - Collin Palmer: Exclusively listens to movie soundtracks when working, especially the Darth Vader theme. One man product machine from speccing to shipping.

 - Brian Koh: Only human we know who has impulsive urges to exercise. When he does, he doesn't care about outfits. We've seen him running in boots, tight jeans, and leather jackets. Exceptional engineer and even better mentor.




THE OFFICE

 - Our office https://padlet.link/sf-office-gmap is in the middle of Presidio, a beautiful national park. We’re a 5 minute walk from the beach. The WiFi works outdoors. You can work sitting in a lawn overlooking the Golden Gate Bridge.

 - The office itself is designed to be a space for all your interests and hobbies. We have a meditation room, game room, library, art studio, kids room, and full makerspace with 3d printers, presses, laser cutters, sewing machines, and more.




BENEFITS

 - Top tier medical, dental, and vision insurance for you and your family, including One Medical memberships.

 - 401(k) with matching.

 - Commuter benefits.

 - FSA.

 - Stock options.

 - Catered lunches and dinners. Military grade snacking.

 - 20 vacation days. Plus sickness and bereavement days for when life happens.

 - Parental leave

 - All the gadgetry you need, including a new phone every year.




SPECIAL TIME TO JOIN

Because we're small, we move fast. And because we have tremendous traction, your work will impact millions. This combination of speed and impact is rare and quite satisfying.

jobs.title: Home Health LVN
jobs.description:
WelbeHealth PACE helps seniors stay in their homes and communities by providing comprehensive medical care and community-based services. It’s our mission to serve the most vulnerable seniors with better quality and compassion in a value-based model. The Home Health LVN plays a vital role in achieving our mission by performing skilled duties at home under CMS approval, bringing convenient and necessary care to our participants’ homes.

Under the supervision of WelbeHealth RNs, NP or MDs, the Home Health LVN is responsible for carrying out tasks in the participants’ residences as assigned such as home safety assessments, data gathering and supervisory visits. The Home Health LVN will perform skilled duties only after site licensure or in the event of pandemic/stay at home order with CMS approval to provide necessary care in the home.

Essential Job Duties:

• Provide and document in-person supervision and instruction to home care assistants and home health aides assigned to participants’ homes at least as frequently as specified in the Home Health Agency regulations and more often if necessary

• Instruct the participant, family and caregivers regarding the disease process, self-care techniques, and prevention strategies, as assigned

• Conduct and Perform home safety assessments as assigned

• Deliver and document nursing interventions as assigned, accurately responding to physician orders, and correctly administering medications and performing ordered tests and treatments

• Support to the clinic staff and home health staff work to manage smooth care transitions between settings (hospitals, skilled nursing facilities, home, etc.).

• Must be willing and could work a varied schedule that may include evening nights, weekends and overtime

Job Requirements:

• Graduate of an Accredited School of Nursing required

• Unencumbered LVN License in state practicing

• Reliable means of transportation

• Nursing knowledge and skills necessary to treat frail, elderly participants and manage complex clinical situations

• Must obtain CPR and First Aid certification within 180 days of hire and maintain certification thereafter; CPR and First Aid certification upon hire preferred

Benefits of Working at WelbeHealth: Apply your clinical expertise in new ways as we rapidly expand. You will have the opportunity to design the way we work in the context of a supportive and loving environment where every individual feels uniquely cared for.

• Medical insurance coverage (Medical, Dental, Vision)

• Work/Life Balance – we mean it! 17 days of personal time off (PTO), 12 holidays observed annually, and 6 sick days

• Advancement opportunities – we’ve got a track record of hiring and promoting from within, meaning you can create your own path!

• Bonus eligibility – your hard work translates to more money in your pockets

• And additional benefits

Compensation consists of base salary plus bonus. WelbeHealth offers a competitive total rewards package that includes a 401(k) match, comprehensive healthcare coverage, and a broad range of additional benefits. Actual compensation will be determined based on experience and relevant qualifications.

Compensation Offering

$32.61—$41.33 USD

In this spirit, please note that we have a vaccination policy for all our employees and proof of vaccination, or a vaccine declination form will be required prior to employment. Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity and Inclusion
