jobs.title: Field Sales Specialist
jobs.description:
Ciao. Noi siamo Teya. 

Teya è nata da una semplice convinzione: le attività locali meritano di meglio. Sono i caffè, i ristoranti, i saloni, i negozi e gli imprenditori che danno carattere alle nostre strade principali, creano posti di lavoro e mantengono vive le comunità. Eppure, per troppo tempo, i servizi finanziari hanno reso loro la vita più difficile, con strumenti macchinosi, un supporto scadente e una complessità che ostacola la gestione di un'azienda. 

Teya esiste per cambiare tutto questo. Stiamo costruendo una piattaforma finanziaria per le attività locali in tutta Europa, incentrata su strumenti semplici, un design curato e un supporto umano reale. I nostri Membri contano su di noi per gestire la loro attività con sicurezza, e questa responsabilità modella il nostro modo di lavorare. Ci muoviamo velocemente. Ci importa della qualità. Curiamo i dettagli. E crediamo che grandi prestazioni e autentica ospitalità debbano andare di pari passo. Se vuoi creare prodotti significativi, risolvere problemi reali e fare la differenza per le attività locali, ci farebbe molto piacere conoscerti.

Teya è una delle Fintech in più rapida crescita in Europa, che ogni giorno supporta migliaia di attività locali. Siamo un'azienda di pagamenti e software che aiuta le piccole imprese a crescere. Crediamo che il commercio locale sia il cuore pulsante delle nostre comunità e siamo qui per offrire ai commercianti gli strumenti e il supporto che meritano per competere con i grandi player.

Mentre continuiamo a crescere, stiamo espandendo il nostro team di field sales e siamo alla ricerca di candidati motivati, orientati alle persone e focalizzati sui risultati che vogliano unirsi alla nostra operatività. Se ti piace entrare in contatto con le persone, prosperi in un ambiente dinamico e frenetico e vuoi crescere in un'azienda che sta rivoluzionando i pagamenti locali, questo è il posto che fa per te!

 

La nostra Cultura:

Questi cinque valori definiscono il nostro modo di lavorare ogni giorno:

 - Orgogliosi di servire: Siamo al fianco delle piccole e locali imprese.

 - Costruire dal futuro: Creiamo oggi ciò che verrà domani.

 - Semplicità: Diamo valore alla chiarezza, all'efficienza e alla tecnologia intelligente.

 - Mentalità vincente: Puntiamo in alto e offriamo l'eccellenza.

 - Un Sogno. Una Squadra. Una Voce: La collaborazione ci rende più forti.

 


LA TUA MISSIONE:

 - Identificazione dei clienti: Individua in modo proattivo potenziali clienti nella tua zona attraverso attività di prospecting, lead generation, networking e referral.

 - Creazione di relazioni: Incontra di persona i clienti attuali e potenziali per comprenderne le sfide, sviluppare empatia e stabilire un rapporto di fiducia offrendo un'esperienza positiva.

 - Chiusura: Utilizza strategie di vendita efficaci per acquisire nuovi clienti e raggiungere costantemente i tuoi obiettivi.

 - Conoscenza del prodotto: Diventa un esperto di tutto ciò che riguarda Teya e la nostra suite di prodotti (non preoccuparti, riceverai una formazione approfondita!).

 - Feedback di mercato: Collabora con il resto dell'azienda fornendo preziosi approfondimenti sul campo ("boots-on-the-ground") per contribuire a migliorare i nostri prodotti.

 - Fedeltà del cliente: Mantieni relazioni durature con i clienti, individuando opportunità di up-selling e cross-selling delle soluzioni Teya per massimizzare il valore e la retention.

 - Rappresentanza del brand: Agisci come il volto di Teya nel tuo territorio, incarnando i nostri valori e la nostra visione.

 


LE TUE RESPONSABILITÀ:

 - Attività sul campo per l'acquisizione di nuovi clienti all'interno del tuo territorio assegnato;

 - Partecipazione alle riunioni mattutine del team per definire i piani, stabilire gli obiettivi e condividere le esperienze;

 - Gestione di un portafoglio clienti attivo e delle attività post-vendita;

 - Offrire un servizio clienti eccellente e personalizzato.

La tua missione non è solo chiudere contratti, ma creare partnership durature e contribuire alla soddisfazione e al successo dei nostri clienti comprendendone realmente le esigenze.

 


IL TUO PROFILO:

 - Esperienza minima di 2 anni in un ruolo commerciale con cicli di vendita brevi (l'esperienza in ambiti quali pagamenti, banche, B2B o SaaS costituisce un plus);

 - Comprovato raggiungimento degli obiettivi commerciali;

 - Passione per il supporto alle piccole imprese e alle aziende in crescita;

 - Propensione a lavorare in ambienti dinamici e frenetici;

 - Eccellenti capacità comunicative e di presentazione;

 - Ottime capacità di gestione del tempo e organizzative;

 - Forti capacità di negoziazione e mentalità commerciale;

 - Spirito proattivo e ambizione di superare le aspettative;

 - Forte mentalità di squadra;

 - Resilienza e capacità di superare le obiezioni;

 - Voglia di imparare e sviluppare nuove competenze, con una passione per la tecnologia e i prodotti digitali.

 


COSA TI OFFRIAMO:

 - Stipendio base lordo competitivo di 25.000€ - 30.000 € + 20.000 € di commissioni all'anno.

 - Auto aziendale / rimborso chilometrico per le trasferte.

 - Inquadramento CCNL Terziario.

 - Welfare aziendale (142 € netti al mese).

 - Buoni pasto da 8 € netti al giorno con Coverflex.

 - Copertura assicurativa sanitaria.

 - 25 giorni di ferie annuali (oltre alle festività locali).

 - Lavora con alcune delle migliori menti del settore che stanno cambiando il volto del Fintech in Italia!

Pronto a essere il volto della rivoluzione Fintech in Italia? Se hai la grinta per vendere e la passione per il servizio, vogliamo costruire il futuro insieme a te. Facciamo la differenza, insieme!

 

Teya è orgogliosa di essere un datore di lavoro che offre pari opportunità.

Ci impegniamo a creare un ambiente inclusivo in cui chiunque, indipendentemente da razza, etnia, identità o espressione di genere, orientamento sessuale, età, disabilità, religione o background, possa prosperare e dare il meglio di sé. Crediamo che un team diversificato porti a idee migliori, risultati più solidi e un ambiente di lavoro più accogliente per tutti.

Se hai bisogno di qualsiasi adattamento ragionevole in qualsiasi fase del processo di selezione – che si tratti di colloqui, valutazioni o altre parti della candidatura – ti invitiamo a comunicarcelo. Ci impegniamo a garantire che ogni candidato viva un'esperienza equa e accessibile con noi.

jobs.title: Senior Account Executive, Strategic Pursuits, Aviation APAC (Based in Singapore)
jobs.description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Location: Singapore

About the Role

We are seeking an exceptionally accomplished and visionary Account Executive to join our Strategic Pursuits team. This is a role for a true sales master, who will not only drive Cloudflare’s most strategic and complex platform sales but also innovate new business models within focused accounts. The ideal candidate possesses unparalleled strategic influence, a profound understanding of customer enterprise architecture across all four pillars (business, data, applications, technology), and the ability to proactively shape how Cloudflare integrates into and advances modern cloud operating models.

As an Account Executive (Strategic Pursuits), you will consistently demonstrate the highest level of sales mastery, ensuring highly accurate forecasting, strategic pipeline management, and consistently exceeding attainment targets. You will be a recognized industry authority, capable of contextualizing Cloudflare’s entire product suite within the broader security and business strategies of the largest enterprises. This role demands the ability to influence and engage at the highest executive levels, including CEOs, CFOs, and Board Members, while leading highly specialized virtual teams (VPs, SVPs, and cross-functional leaders) to proactively propose transformative new solutions and forge digital innovation partnerships that redefine industries.

What You'll Do

• Visionary Revenue & Business Model Creation: Architect and execute strategies to consistently exceed the most ambitious multi-million dollar sales targets and annual quotas, specializing in closing complex platform sales and pioneering new business models within highly strategic accounts.

• Precision Forecasting & Strategic Pipeline Leadership: Operate with unmatched accuracy in forecasting, proactively shaping and managing the strategic pipeline. Provide insights that set the stage for Cloudflare's future sales direction, influencing company-wide impact.

• Shape Enterprise Architecture & Business Models: Apply mastery in understanding and influencing customer Enterprise Architecture across all four pillars (business, data, applications, technology). Critically analyze and map these to business models, strategically positioning Cloudflare within and actively shaping modern cloud operating models.

• Ultimate Executive Engagement & Influence: Lead and orchestrate multiple, simultaneous, highly complex customer engagements across numerous business units. Expertly connect disparate needs to solidify platform sales and drive new business models. Proactively apply executive sponsorship programs, ensuring direct engagement and influence with CEOs, CFOs, and Board Members.

• Advanced Virtual Team Leadership & Solution Incubation: Lead highly specialized virtual teams, including VPs, SVPs, and cross-functional leaders, to proactively propose and incubate groundbreaking new solutions for customers. Guide these teams to learn from past experiences, shaping the future strategy for Cloudflare’s offerings.

• Digital Transformation & Industry Partnership Architect: Exhibit mastery in understanding the intricate nuances of digital transformation across diverse industries. Fully grasp the strategic challenges and opportunities companies face. Expertly identify market shifts, emerging technologies, and industry-specific needs to construct pioneering digital innovation partnerships between Cloudflare and its customers, providing mutual benefit and advancing entire industries.

• Organizational Communication & Inspiration: Take highly complex information and distill it into clear, easy-to-understand language for broad audiences, both internal and external. Inspire others to learn from mistakes, foster continuous improvement, and take decisive action through ongoing coaching and feedback.

• Long-Term Strategic Stewardship: Consistently articulate how decisions will impact Cloudflare many years into the future, demonstrating a willingness to trade short-term gains for significant, long-term organizational benefit. Build unwavering trust by sharing learnings and exemplifying a "Cloudflare first" mentality, inspiring followership across the company.

• Operational Excellence & Business Model Innovation: Debunk the myth that choosing speed, quality, and price is limited to only two. Define Cloudflare's long-term strategy and quarterly objectives with clear, measurable results. Demonstrate a profound understanding of Cloudflare's business model and identify innovative ways to improve efficiency that impact the entire business, acting as a model for servant leadership.

• Continuous Learning & Industry Impact: Amass expert-level knowledge through continuous learning and an innovative mindset, serving as a model of humility and lifelong learning. Your insights and actions will directly influence broad or significant changes at Cloudflare and within the industry.

• Champion of Diversity & Inclusion: Actively improve the diversity of the company, demonstrating unparalleled leadership in inclusive practices and programs. Sponsor efforts that drive meaningful, systemic change in the way the company operates, truly being a source for good.

Examples of Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience

• 12+ years of unparalleled experience selling complex, transformative technology solutions in a B2B enterprise model, with an irrefutable track record of consistently exceeding multi-million dollar quotas and originating new business models.

• Experience in the aviation industry

• Mastery-level knowledge of Cloudflare's entire product suite and the broader security, networking, and cloud landscape, coupled with the ability to contextualize and integrate these solutions into highly complex, multi-vertical enterprise strategies.

• Expert capability in influencing and shaping customer Enterprise Architecture (Business, Data, Applications, Technology) and seamlessly mapping these to advanced business models and modern cloud operating environments.

• Proven success in engaging and influencing at the highest executive levels, including CEOs, CFOs, and Board Members, leveraging executive sponsorship programs to drive strategic outcomes.

• Demonstrated ability to lead and inspire highly specialized virtual teams (VPs, SVPs, cross-functional leaders) to proactively propose, design, and close groundbreaking new solutions.

• Recognized authority on digital transformation across industries, with a profound understanding of market shifts, emerging technologies, and the ability to construct mutually beneficial digital innovation partnerships.

• Exceptional strategic communication, negotiation, and presentation skills, capable of distilling highly complex information into clear, actionable insights for the most senior executives, both internal and external.

• A visionary leader who consistently prioritizes the long-term benefit of Cloudflare, influencing company-wide strategy and fostering a culture of innovation and continuous improvement.

• Unrivaled proficiency in advanced sales and business intelligence platforms, coupled with the ability to define long-term strategy, set quarterly objectives, and improve overall business efficiency.

• Servant leadership model with a deep affinity for identifying customer needs and driving impactful strategies that also benefit the broader community.

• An exemplary lifelong learner whose expert-level knowledge and innovative mindset have driven significant change at the company and/or within the industry.

• Demonstrated leadership in fostering diversity and inclusion, actively sponsoring efforts that drive meaningful systemic change within the organization.

• Bachelor's degree required, with an MBA or advanced technical degree highly preferred.

• Willingness and ability to travel extensively and globally as required for strategic engagements and industry influence.

What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

1.1.1.1: We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.

Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!

Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.

This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.

Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.

Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at hr@cloudflare.com or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Computer Graphics
jobs.description:
Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.

At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device. We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.

A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.

We are seeking an experienced Senior Software Engineer with a deep background in 3D computer graphics and engine development to join the ML Data Pod within the Foundation AI team. In this role, you will build the foundational infrastructure that powers our next-generation AI capabilities.

As the AI landscape rapidly shifts toward spatial and 3D generation, high-quality data has become the ultimate bottleneck. You will be instrumental in solving this challenge by unlocking the Roblox engine as a massive, scalable platform for synthetic data generation.

This is a unique opportunity to bridge the gap between cutting-edge AI research and low-level engine architecture. You will be navigating unmapped territory—shaping how we represent and structure complex 3D data (such as meshes, materials, lighting, and scene graphs) to effectively train state-of-the-art 3DGen models. Ultimately, the synthetic pipelines you architect will directly fuel the frontier AI models that will define the future of immersive 3D content creation for millions of creators worldwide.

Responsibilities

• Synthetic Data Generation: Spearhead initiatives to leverage the Roblox engine to procedurally generate the massive, high-fidelity 3D datasets required for training frontier 3DGen models.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with AI research scientists to translate complex model training requirements into actionable engine features, while collaborating with core engine teams to implement them safely and efficiently.

• Pipeline Architecture: Design, build, and optimize scalable graphics and engine-level systems capable of generating diverse spatial, geometric, and visual data at scale.

• Technical Integration: Drive the technical direction for embedding synthetic data generation workflows into the existing engine architecture without compromising core performance.

Minimum Qualifications

• 5+ years of experience building and shipping complex, production-grade software systems

• Deep expertise in 3D computer graphics, rendering pipelines, and game engine architecture.

• Strong proficiency in systems programming (e.g., C++) with a proven track record of writing highly optimized, scalable code.

• Experience extracting, modifying, or manipulating programmatic data from within a complex engine environment.

• Strong communication skills with a demonstrated ability to bridge the gap between machine learning researchers and low-level systems engineers.

• Bonus: Familiarity with machine learning data pipelines, automated synthetic data generation, or 3D generative AI architectures.

Preferred Qualifications

• Background in geometry, linear algebra, or related mathematical domains

• Experience with graphics APIs or frameworks a plus but not required

The actual base pay is dependent upon a variety of job-related factors such as professional background, training, work experience, location, business needs and market demand. All full-time employees are also eligible for equity compensation and for benefits as described on this page.

$227,370—$295,250 USD

Roles that are based in an office are onsite Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday, with optional presence on Monday and Friday (unless otherwise noted).

Lalamove is disrupting the logistics industry by connecting customers and drivers directly through our technology. We offer customers a lightning fast and convenient way to book delivery and moving services whether they are at their home, at work or on the go. People talk about O2O, we live it!

jobs.title: Business Development & Operations Supervisor

A Growth & Operations Lead to own the freelancer side of the Servi marketplace — from strategy and outreach to vetting, activation, and retention. Build relationships with universities, public and private institutions, and community organizations to grow the freelancer network.

Lead freelancer acquisition through job fairs, partnerships, cold outreach, referrals, and on-ground initiatives.

Support ambassador and referral programs to accelerate supply growth, in addition to other initiatives.

3. Pipeline Management & Conversion

Own and manage the freelancer pipeline from initial reach and contact through to activation.

Maintain structured tracking systems and dashboards, to monitor conversion rates across all onboarding stages.

Identify drop-off points in the funnel and improve outreach messaging, scripts, and onboarding flows accordingly.

Convert non-freelancers into service providers.

4. Freelancer Vetting & Quality Control

Own the vetting pipeline end-to-end: document collection, identity verification (KYC), interview scheduling, and onboarding.

Define and enforce quality standards and acceptance criteria per vertical.

Support Trust & Safety processes by ensuring proper verification, maintaining quality standards, and resolving issues when they arise.

5.  Marketplace Operations & Freelancer Management

Ensure balanced supply across verticals and areas, monitor freelancer availability, readiness, and utilization.

Build and maintain relationships with freelancers post-onboarding, supporting them through their engagements and growth.

Monitor performance, engagement, and retention. Handle freelancer issues, feedback, and escalations.

Support engagement initiatives to keep the supply base active and motivated.

6. Reporting & Performance Tracking

Maintain structured dashboards tracking acquisition, conversion, activation, and retention metrics.

Provide regular reporting on supply growth, quality levels, and operational gaps. Track key KPIs and flag risks or bottlenecks.

Research and act on insights around freelancer behavior, pricing, and vertical dynamics.

7. Research & Process Benchmarking

Research regional and global platforms to benchmark best practices in supply operations and freelancer management.

Translate findings into internal playbooks, processes, and guidelines; contribute to building a structured knowledge base for scaling.

PROFILE & COMPETENCIES

Education: Bachelor’s degree in business management, operations, project management, HR or a related field.

Experience: 6 to 10 years in operations, business development, or marketplace environments. Startup experience is a strong advantage.

Languages: Fluent in English and Arabic. French is a plus.

Technical Skills: Advanced Excel / Google Sheets for data analysis, dashboards, and funnel tracking. Proficiency in Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace. Hands-on experience with CRM and field outreach tools. Comfortable with project management platforms. Strong digital organization habits.

Soft Skills: Persistent and persuasive in the field. Data-driven and self-accountable. Adapts fast, works well with ambiguity, and thrives without a playbook. Tech-savvy — uses tools to move faster, not just to report.

WHO THRIVES HERE

This role is built for someone who is equally comfortable in the field building relationships and at a desk, managing pipelines and data. It is for serious owners who move fast without losing structure and want to build something that has never existed in this market.

jobs.description:
🧠 ABOUT LEGION HEALTH

At Legion Health, we believe everyone deserves fast, affordable, and world-class health care, and we’re developing the AI infrastructure to deliver it at scale.

Legion is building autonomous medical care, starting with psychiatry. Our AI-native care-delivery platform automates much of the administrative work required to deliver direct patient care, allowing clinicians and operations teams to focus on the moments where human judgment and attention matter most.

Our technical moat is hard to copy—we combine rich data, production AI, doctors in the loop, and end-to-end care operations to deliver measurably better care to a clinically complex patient population. This has helped us complete tens of thousands of visits in just two years while holding operations costs flat and achieving industry-leading patient NPS and retention.

While the last generation of healthcare startups made the existing system incrementally more efficient, Legion is rebuilding full-stack care delivery from first principles. Our vision is a 10X better patient experience that is higher quality, less expensive, and more scalable—and a 10X better clinician experience that frees providers to focus on what matters most: caring for patients.

Legion Health is backed by Y Combinator, leading venture capital firms, and founders from Function Health, Modern Health, Everly Health, Trusted Health, Clipboard Health, PatientPing, Sesame Care, Faire, EasyPost, and fuboTV.

Join us as we build the future of health care: faster, higher-quality, and more affordable, powered by clinicians, operators, and AI working together.




📍 ROLE LOGISTICS

 - Job Type: Full-time contract

 - Role Type: Provider Operations / Recruiting Coordination / Onboarding / Payroll Support

 - Ideal Experience Level: 2+ years

 - Location: Fully remote

 - Work Hours: 9:00 AM–6:00 PM US Central Time

 - Hourly Compensation: $5–$15 per hour, based on experience




🚀 THE OPPORTUNITY

Legion is hiring an exceptionally organized and detail-oriented Medical Virtual Assistant to help operate the systems that support our growing network of healthcare providers.

You will support providers throughout their relationship with Legion—from recruiting and onboarding through active operations, payroll preparation, and offboarding. Your work will help ensure candidates receive timely follow-up, new providers are ready to begin, operating records remain accurate, and payroll inputs are complete before they are finalized.

This is not a generic assistant role. You will own recurring, detail-heavy workflows that directly affect providers, internal teams, and Legion’s ability to deliver patient care. A missed document can delay a provider’s start date. An inaccurate status field can create confusion across teams. An overlooked payroll discrepancy can affect a provider’s pay. Precision and follow-through matter.

The right person enjoys bringing order to complex workflows. You should be comfortable maintaining spreadsheets and trackers, coordinating across multiple teams, following up persistently, documenting decisions, and identifying missing information before it becomes a larger problem.

This role is a strong fit for someone who enjoys checklists, healthcare operations, provider communication, reconciliation work, and continuously improving how recurring processes are run.




✅ RESPONSIBILITIES AND DELIVERABLES

 - Coordinate provider recruiting operations, including:
   
   - Maintaining accurate candidate records and statuses.
   
   - Scheduling and confirming interviews.
   
   - Following up with candidates about outstanding steps.
   
   - Updating hiring records and internal trackers.
   
   - Coordinating handoffs between recruiting and onboarding.

 - Support provider onboarding from accepted offer through start readiness, including:
   
   - Collecting required documents and information.
   
   - Maintaining onboarding checklists and status trackers.
   
   - Following up promptly on missing or incomplete items.
   
   - Coordinating internal handoffs across relevant teams.
   
   - Confirming that required operational steps are complete before a provider begins.
   
   - Escalating blockers that could delay a provider’s start date.

 - Maintain accurate provider-operations records, including:
   
   - Provider rosters.
   
   - Recruiting and onboarding status.
   
   - Active, inactive, and offboarding providers.
   
   - State coverage and provider availability.
   
   - Collaborating-physician relationships.
   
   - Credentialing and payer-enrollment status.
   
   - Outstanding documents, approvals, and follow-up items.

 - Communicate clearly and professionally with providers through Slack, email, and approved internal systems.

 - Support weekly payroll preparation, including:
   
   - Gathering provider compensation inputs from approved systems.
   
   - Reviewing visit counts, no-shows, and late cancellations.
   
   - Updating payroll and payment trackers.
   
   - Reconciling discrepancies across source systems.
   
   - Confirming that supporting information is complete.
   
   - Escalating unresolved discrepancies before payroll is finalized.
   
   - Maintaining a clear record of changes, questions, and resolutions.

 - Coordinate across recruiting, credentialing, clinical operations, billing, finance, and payroll to keep provider workflows moving.

 - Maintain clear task queues and follow-up systems so that outstanding items do not fall through the cracks.

 - Document recurring workflows and update SOPs, checklists, and templates as processes evolve.

 - Identify opportunities to simplify, standardize, or automate repetitive administrative work.

 - Handle sensitive provider, company, hiring, and compensation information with discretion and care.

 - Raise unclear ownership, conflicting information, or potential errors promptly rather than making unsupported assumptions.




🏆 YOU’LL BE SUCCESSFUL IF YOU…

 - Keep provider trackers accurate, current, and easy for other teams to understand.

 - Ensure candidates and providers receive timely, professional follow-up.

 - Help new providers complete onboarding requirements and become ready to start without preventable delays.

 - Catch missing information and payroll discrepancies before they create downstream problems.

 - Produce documentation that clearly explains what happened, what remains outstanding, and who owns the next step.

 - Manage recurring deadlines without needing repeated reminders.

 - Follow established procedures while noticing when a process is unclear, inefficient, or incomplete.

 - Move quickly without sacrificing accuracy.

 - Communicate professionally and confidently with clinicians, candidates, contractors, and internal teammates.

 - Remain calm and organized when priorities change or multiple deadlines overlap.

 - Build reusable checklists, trackers, and workflows that make provider operations easier to scale.

 - Earn the trust of providers and teammates through reliability, discretion, accuracy, and consistent follow-through.




🧰 IDEAL BACKGROUND AND SKILLS

 - 2+ years of experience in one or more of the following:
   
   - Healthcare operations.
   
   - Provider operations.
   
   - Recruiting coordination.
   
   - Provider or employee onboarding.
   
   - Payroll or invoice support.
   
   - Human-resources administration.
   
   - Executive-assistant or virtual-operations support.

 - Strong preference for experience supporting:
   
   - Clinicians or other healthcare professionals.
   
   - Independent contractors.
   
   - Distributed or fully remote teams.
   
   - Recurring payroll, payment, or reconciliation workflows.

 - Excellent organizational skills and close attention to detail.

 - Strong spreadsheet skills, including maintaining structured trackers, reviewing data, reconciling differences, and identifying missing information.

 - Careful with names, dates, pay periods, visit counts, status fields, and supporting documentation.

 - Clear, concise, and professional written English.

 - Comfortable following up persistently and respectfully with providers and internal teammates.

 - Able to manage several recurring workflows and deadlines simultaneously.

 - Proactive about identifying blockers, discrepancies, unclear ownership, and overdue action items.

 - Comfortable working in a fast-moving startup where processes may evolve as the company grows.

 - Able to handle confidential provider, recruiting, company, and compensation information appropriately.

 - Familiarity with HIPAA-sensitive healthcare environments and appropriate information-handling practices.

 - Experience with any of the following is a plus:
   
   - Google Sheets.
   
   - Slack.
   
   - Ashby or another applicant-tracking system.
   
   - Healthie or another EHR or practice-management platform.
   
   - Looker Studio or similar reporting tools.
   
   - Stripe or contractor-payment platforms.
   
   - Payroll, invoicing, or payment-reconciliation workflows.
   
   - Telehealth or behavioral-health operations.
   
   - Credentialing and payer enrollment.
   
   - Healthcare billing.
   
   - Provider scheduling or workforce operations.




⚠️ THIS ROLE IS NOT A FIT IF YOU…

 - Prefer exclusively patient-facing work and do not enjoy internal operations.

 - Dislike spreadsheets, trackers, checklists, or reconciliation work.

 - Need every day to follow exactly the same workflow.

 - Wait for repeated instructions instead of proactively following up on outstanding work.

 - Are uncomfortable asking questions or escalating conflicting information.

 - Are casual about deadlines, documentation, confidentiality, or payroll accuracy.

 - Frequently lose track of details when managing several workflows at once.

 - Prefer completing individual tasks without taking ownership of the full outcome.




💰 COMPENSATION & ROLE BENEFITS

 - Hourly Compensation: $5–$15 per hour, based on experience.

 - Job Type: Full-time contract.

 - Schedule: 9:00 AM–6:00 PM US Central Time.

 - Work Setup: Fully remote.

 - Impact: Build the provider-operations foundation that enables clinicians to spend more time caring for patients.

 - Autonomy and Learning: Develop experience across recruiting coordination, provider onboarding, healthcare operations, payroll preparation, and process improvement.

 - Growth Opportunities: Take on broader ownership across provider operations, onboarding, recruiting coordination, payroll operations, quality assurance, or team leadership as Legion grows.




🤝 EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY

Legion Health is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees, contractors, and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law. We encourage applicants from all backgrounds to apply.

jobs.title: Workday Integrations Architect
jobs.description:
The Company You’ll Join

Carta is the connected platform and AI-native ecosystem for private capital. Built to replace fragmented tools with a single system of record, Carta brings together the software, services, and legal infrastructure that founders use to manage equity, fund managers use to run administration and reporting, and legal teams use to close transactions. Trusted by 55,000 companies and 1.8M+ equity holders in 160+ countries, and 10,000 funds and SPVs representing $250B+ in assets under management, Carta is transforming how private capital operates. Recognized by Fortune, Forbes, Fast Company, Inc. and Great Places to Work.

For more information about our offices and culture, check out our Carta careers page.

The Problems You'll Solve

At Carta, our employees set out on a mission to unlock the power of equity ownership for more people in more places. We believe that the problems we solve today unlock the opportunities of tomorrow. As a Workday Integrations Architect, you’ll work to:

• Own the end-to-end integration pipeline — from design and configuration to deployment and production support — ensuring Workday connects seamlessly with internal and external platforms via Studio, Orchestrations, Core Connectors, EIB, RaaS, and REST/SOAP APIs

• Ensure data integrity across all inbound and outbound integrations by building rigorous mapping, transformation, and validation processes that keep Carta's people data accurate and compliant at scale

• Govern the integration lifecycle — managing code migrations, production hyper care, and Workday release cycles including impact analysis, regression testing, and adoption of new features

• Serve as the subject matter expert for Workday integrations, advising HR, IT, and business stakeholders on design patterns and best practices that drive scalable, maintainable solutions

• Extend Workday's capabilities through Extend applications, calculated fields, and business process automation that reduce manual work and unlock operational efficiency

• Maintain key external platform connections — including Greenhouse, HireVue, and others — keeping Carta's HR tech ecosystem reliable and well-integrated

The Team You'll Work With

You'll be joining Carta's People Platform team. This team owns the systems that power how nearly 2,000 Carta employees globally experience their work from hire to retire. The People Tech team sits at the intersection of HR, IT, and engineering, building the integrations and automation that keep Carta's people data accurate, compliant, and actionable across the business. As Carta scales internationally, this team's work becomes increasingly consequential  ensuring that every system, every data flow, and every workflow keeps pace with the company's growth.

About You

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT BLOCKIT

Blockit is a Sequoia-backed AI time agent.

It learns your preferences and can autonomously coordinate meetings to any degree of complexity (timezones, group scheduling, IRL, etc) similar to an executive assistant – but never goes to sleep and responds instantly. 

Blockit is the foundation of a massive platform of AI agents that will have access to the world's time. The more people who continue to link their calendars to the agent, the more powerful our network becomes.




ROLE

Blockit is seeking a Customer Success Manager to lead activation, adoption, and retention across our customer base. We're looking for someone with 3+ years in customer success, account management, or solutions at a software company. Experience standing up a function rather than inheriting one is a plus.

You will personally work with every contracted account we have — today that's hundreds of accounts, heavily concentrated in venture capital, private equity, financial services, and professional services firms, alongside a fast-growing base of AI and technology startups. You'll partner with our onboarding specialist to run pilots, fix problems, drive adoption, surface expansion signals for the rest of the GTM team, and be the voice that carries what they tell us back into the product.

Ideally, you are technical enough to figure out SSO or a broken calendar sync before you escalate it, commercially aware enough to recognize when an account is ready to grow, and analytical enough to write an SOP when a customer asks a usage question our dashboard can't answer yet. You are comfortable and excited by the speed of zero-to-one building in a startup environment and bonus points if you have a passion for productivity tools.

Our agent spreads virally, which means accounts land on you already curious and already using the product. Your job is to turn that curiosity into activated, deeply adopted teams — and to ensure the motion that lets the next ten people do it after you.




WHAT YOU'LL DO:

 - Lead Enterprise onboarding, pilots, and rollouts end to end — setup, admin training, then adoption team by team: usage reviews with admins and chasing the pockets that haven’t linked calendars.

 - Serve as the primary contact for inbound support and agent-behavior feedback via email and Slack.

 - Handle churn with a real save motion: understand why, offer the right landing spot, and harvest the reason.

 - Build the machine: usage and retention reporting, templates, runbooks, and the QA loop behind our AI support agent.


WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE:

 - Accounts activate. Within 90 days of close, most of an account’s users clear the value bar — five or more meetings scheduled. Account activation rate is the number you own.

 - Activation sticks. Users hold that bar on a trailing 90-day basis. First-time activation is the start; sustained usage is the proof a team has actually changed how it schedules.

 - The product gets better. A third of what customers write to us is a bug, a sixth a feature request. You turn that stream into prioritized input for product and engineering.


WHO YOU ARE:

 - 3+ years in customer success, account management, or solutions. Founding or first-CS-hire experience is a strong plus.

 - Technically curious and unafraid of the stack — you can hold your own with engineers.

 - Comfortable with data and quick to learn. You know the difference between a number and a story.

 - Commercially aware: you’ve read an account, known when it was ready to grow, and made the case with evidence rather than instinct.

 - Exceptional writer — most of this job happens in email and Slack, in front of managing partners and heads of platform at some of the best firms in the world.

 - Organized to a fault, with high agency and no ego about scope. Fifteen external calls, forty email threads, a bug queue, and a pilot scorecard only coexist if you have a system — and some weeks the job is a training session, some weeks a supplier registration portal at 9pm.

 - Bonus: experience with horizontal productivity tools, or a network in venture capital, private equity, or professional services.

jobs.title: Head of Compliance - Malta

FalconX is a pioneering team of operators, investors, and builders committed to revolutionizing institutional access to the crypto markets. Operating at the intersection of traditional finance and  cutting-edge technology, FalconX addresses the industry's foremost challenges: Navigating the digital asset market can be complex and fragmented, with limited products and services that support trading strategies, structures, and liquidity found in conventional financial markets. As a comprehensive solution for all digital asset strategies from start to scale, FalconX operates as the connective tissue empowering clients with seamless navigation through the ever- evolving cryptocurrency landscape.

Role Overview

We are seeking a high-credibility Head of Compliance to lead and oversee our Compliance function for a Malta-based crypto trading business. This is a hands-on leadership role requiring direct engagement experience with the Malta Financial Services Authority (MFSA), prior MFSA PQ/approved-role status, and the expertise to navigate the EU regulatory landscape under MiCA. Operating in an agile environment, you will balance strategic advisory with direct execution mentoring a lean team while taking full ownership of regulatory governance and risk remediation.

Key Responsibilities:

• Regulatory Engagement: Lead and oversee all regulatory matters, including audits, exams, onsite inspection, regulatory reporting, ongoing regulatory dialogue with regulatory agencies, including the MFSA, FIAU, and broadly EU agencies where applicable.

• MiCA & Crypto Oversight: Lead the firm through MiCA licensing and transition processes, ensuring CASP/VFA policies, product features, and operational controls align with EU regulatory standards.

• Governance & Monitoring: Own and execute the compliance program, board reporting, and internal policy registers.

• Remediation & Advisory: Pragmatically resolve legacy compliance issues while delivering commercially minded advice to enable business growth.

• Lean Team Leadership: Guide, mentor, and set standards for a team of 3–4 compliance professionals without reliance on heavy administrative infrastructure.

Mandatory Requirements

jobs.title: Principal Solutions Architect - SAARC
jobs.description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Locations: Bengaluru/Mumbai/New Delhi

About the Role

As a Principal Solutions Architect, you'll be a trusted advisor to Cloudflare's most strategic enterprise customers across the Asia Pacific region. You will work at the intersection of technology, business strategy, and executive influence, helping organisations in industries such as financial services, government, and telecommunications navigate complex digital transformation journeys using Cloudflare's platform.

You'll speak the "customer language", understand the CxO mindset, and influence technology decisions at the intersection of risk, resilience, and innovation. Whether it's advising a CISO on a Zero Trust security strategy, helping a CIO rationalise their network architecture, or working with engineering leadership on edge-native application modernisation, you'll help our most important customers reimagine how the Internet works for them and position Cloudflare as the foundational platform for that future.

You'll be embedded in account planning with our sales and solutions engineering teams, operating proactively across the full customer lifecycle; from early strategic discovery through to long-term platform adoption and expansion. As a Principal Solutions Architect, you'll also play a significant role in raising the architectural capability of the broader Solutions Engineering organisation across APAC.

What You’ll Do

• Own long-term executive relationships across Cloudflare's most strategic APAC accounts; engaging CIOs, CTOs, and CISOs on their multi-year technology agendas and positioning Cloudflare as a foundational platform, not a point solution.

• Design and facilitate executive vision-setting and architecture workshops that produce tangible outcomes: multi-year roadmaps, reference architectures, and business cases co-developed with customers' enterprise architects and engineering leadership.

• Translate industry trends like Zero Trust, Digital Sovereignty, AI workload security, cloud-to-edge migration into actionable architectural strategies tailored to each customer's business context and regulatory environment.

• Guide clients across the full engagement lifecycle; from strategic discovery and architecture design through proof of concept, value realisation, and expansion planning while proactively partnering with the Sales and Solutions Engineering team to surface architectural opportunities before deals are formally scoped.

• Elevate the architectural capability of the broader APAC Solutions Engineering team by developing reusable workshop frameworks, reference architectures, and best practices that others can apply independently; and by mentoring Solutions Engineers in senior stakeholder engagement.

• Represent Cloudflare externally at industry events, executive roundtables, and sector forums as a credible peer to enterprise architects and technology leaders; produce content: white papers, architectural guidance that establishes Cloudflare's voice on key transformation themes across the region.

What Success Looks Like

• In your first 6 months: You've established trusted advisor relationships with senior technical and business stakeholders across 3-5 of Cloudflare's most strategic APAC accounts. You've designed and facilitated 2-3 executive vision-setting or architecture workshops that have resulted in documented multi-year roadmap alignment with Cloudflare embedded as a core platform component. You've shaped at least one strategic engagement where you've connected Cloudflare's developer and edge compute capabilities to a customer's application modernisation or AI strategy; demonstrating platform breadth beyond security alone. You've contributed at least one reusable asset to the APAC SE team; a workshop framework, reference architecture, or architectural playbook that others can apply independently.

What We’re Looking For

• 12+ years of experience in technical presales, enterprise architecture, or IT leadership (e.g., Chief Architect, CTO, CISO).

• A genuine ability to operate at two levels simultaneously: credible in a boardroom conversation about digital strategy, and capable of going deep on architecture design with engineering teams.

• Demonstrated experience leading executive-level workshops, technology strategy sessions, or architectural visioning engagements with tangible business outcomes.

• Strong understanding of transformation priorities relevant to APAC enterprises: Zero Trust architecture, cloud and network modernisation, digital sovereignty and data residency, AI infrastructure, and application performance at scale.

• Experience with modern application architecture patterns (microservices, APIs, event-driven systems, CI/CD, serverless and edge compute).

• A track record of proactively contributing to pipeline and account expansion through architectural influence — not just responding to requests.

• Proven ability to enable and elevate peers: you've built frameworks, run internal enablement, or mentored others at scale.

• Confident, compelling communicator in both executive business settings and technical deep dives and comfortable representing Cloudflare publicly at industry events.

• Bonus: Familiarity with enterprise architecture frameworks (TOGAF), security standards (NIST SP 800-207, ISO 27001), and IT risk management principles relevant to regulated industries.

Preferred Qualifications

• Bachelor's or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Security, or related field.

• Experience in regulated industries (FSI, Government, Telco) or complex multi-cloud/hybrid environments.

• Hands-on technical curiosity: you stay current across networking, cloud infrastructure, application security, and developer platforms; not because the job requires it, but because you find it genuinely interesting.

• Prior experience in a role that required navigating cultural and linguistic diversity across multiple APAC markets.

What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

1.1.1.1: We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.

Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!

Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.

This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.

Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.

Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at hr@cloudflare.com or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.

jobs.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer - Agentic AI
jobs.description:

Organizational Leadership & Mentorship

•    Foster knowledge sharing through documentation, technical talks, open-source contributions, and community engagement

•    Create and refine career paths and professional development opportunities for engineering team members

Architecture & Systems Design

•    Design and architect large, complex systems involving multiple teams, cloud infrastructure, and sophisticated AI/ML components

•    Lead the design of evaluation frameworks, observability systems, and production monitoring for AI-driven features at scale

•    Establish security architecture and responsible AI guardrails that scale across the platform

•    Conduct research and prototyping on novel technical approaches; lead exploration of emerging AI/ML techniques

•    Lead root cause analysis and architectural reviews for critical incidents; drive improvements to prevent recurrence

Cross-Organizational Influence & Communication

•    Communicate technical vision and strategy to executives, product leadership, and engineering teams; influence organizational priorities

•    Partner with product, design, and domain specialists to define ambitious technical roadmaps aligned with business strategy

•    Represent the engineering organization in high-stakes customer and partnership discussions; build credibility and trust

•    Lead or contribute to technical due diligence for acquisitions, partnerships, and strategic technology evaluations

•    Translate complex AI/ML concepts, trade-offs, and limitations for audiences ranging from technical engineers to executive leadership

•    Advocate for technical health, engineering culture, and long-term sustainability over short-term pressures

•    Participate in industry forums, conferences, and communities; enhance the organization's external reputation

•    Lead technical interviews and design discussions; mentor interviewing skills across the engineering organization

Software Development Excellence & Innovation

•    Develop innovative solutions to the organization's most complex technical challenges, particularly around AI/ML integration and distributed systems

•    Prototype and validate new approaches; share learnings and best practices across the organization

•    Contribute to critical code paths and architectures; model best practices in code quality, testing, and maintainability

•    Build evaluation frameworks, monitoring systems, and testing infrastructure that scale across the organization

•    Implement security best practices, responsible AI guardrails, and compliance mechanisms that serve as templates for the organization

•    Work with cloud services, managed AI services, Kubernetes, and infrastructure-as-code at an architectural level

•    Troubleshoot and resolve the most complex production issues; establish practices to prevent future incidents

•    Contribute to open-source projects, research initiatives, or industry collaboration where aligned with business strategy

ServiceNow Platform Strategy & Excellence

•    Define platform architecture and integration patterns for AI-native ServiceNow applications

•    Establish best practices and architectural standards for ServiceNow development across the organization

•    Lead technical decisions on ServiceNow platform capabilities vs. custom development trade-offs

•    Drive adoption of ServiceNow platform features and managed services; evaluate and recommend platform upgrades

•    Partner with ServiceNow product teams and technical account managers on advanced integrations and customizations

•    Mentor senior engineers on ServiceNow platform architecture and advanced development patterns

•    Ensure applications remain compatible with ServiceNow platform updates and evolution

Customer Strategy & Support Leadership

•    Shape organizational approach to customer support and issue resolution; establish standards for response and resolution

•    Lead customer-critical incident response and complex troubleshooting; provide technical escalation path

•    Engage with strategic customers on technical topics, roadmap alignment, and complex integration challenges

•    Gather and synthesize customer feedback to inform product and platform strategy

•    Establish programs and practices that improve customer experience and reduce support burden

•    Work with customer success leadership to align technical capabilities with customer success metrics

•    Lead technical due diligence and support in customer selection and onboarding processes

To Be Successful in this role you have:

• 4+ years in cloud-native and AI-native systems or equivalent senior-level roles

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager
jobs.description:
About Backblaze

Backblaze is the object storage leader in the open cloud movement, fueling customer success with cloud storage built purposefully to unlock budgets, unburden administrators, and unleash innovators. Together with our partners, we’re helping customers break free from the restrictive, overpriced legacy solutions that hold them back, and blaze forward with the full power of the open cloud in their hands.

Founded in 2007, we scaled the business with less than $3 million in outside funding until 2021, when we did a traditional IPO on the Nasdaq stock exchange. Today, Backblaze generates over $100m in revenue and is the leading specialized storage cloud, managing over three billion gigabytes of data storage for 500K+ customers in 175+ countries, including businesses, developers, IT professionals, and individuals.

But while there is a lot to celebrate in our past, there is almost as much opportunity ahead of us. We’re seeking a B2 Principal Product Manager to join our team!

About the Role

We are seeking an ambitious and accomplished Principal Product Manager to join our Product team. Backblaze’s B2 cloud object storage offers multi-exabyte, S3-compatible, globally available object storage that unlocks app builder innovation across AI neoclouds and traditional hyperscalers at a fraction of the cost of traditional cloud infrastructure hyperscalers.

The Principal Product Manager for B2 will work closely with key stakeholders to understand the evolution of cloud storage and the customer problems in the space, and determine product strategies and roadmap to address those problems. This person will work independently to lead efforts for new feature discovery and delivery, as well as improvements to execute on those strategies. Understanding customer problems through interviews and market research, and translating them into requirements, is critical.

What You'll Do

• Drive B2 product strategy and roadmap development through delivery execution.

• Lead the end-to-end product development lifecycle from discovery through delivery in feature development.

• Gather and synthesize inputs for discovery and prioritization from internal functions, customers, and partners across the full spectrum of R&D development, including feature capabilities, user experience challenges, cost optimization, and technical debt.

• Translate complex customer challenges into clear, concise, and actionable product requirements in collaboration with Design, Engineering, and GTM teams.

• Collaborate with Product Marketing to launch and drive adoption of new products and features.

• Act as a subject matter expert and evangelist for Backblaze's solutions, presenting to customers, prospects, partners, and internal teams.

• Establish and track key product metrics (KPIs), using data to guide iteration and growth decisions.

• Maintain a deep understanding of the latest advancements in the object storage market, including customer use cases and competitive offerings, to identify new opportunities and ensure Backblaze’s market leadership position.

The Right Fit

• 8+ years of Product Management experience in tech businesses, preferably on IaaS and/or SaaS offerings.

• A proven track record of successfully launching and scaling technical products or platforms in high-growth businesses involving in-depth cross-functional collaboration and leadership across R&D and go-to-market functions.

• Strong grasp of cloud architecture, APIs, and security and compliance.

• Proven success in owning product roadmaps, defining MVPs, and driving the complete product life cycle.

• Strategic thinker who can translate market trends, customer needs, and technical innovations into a clear product vision and actionable roadmap.

• Deep empathy for customers and users in gathering and synthesizing input, and a passion for solving their most pressing security challenges.

• Outstanding communication and leadership skills with a collaborative and team-oriented approach to identifying problems, determining potential solutions, and building consensus around your vision with internal and external stakeholders.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

• Experience applying data and metrics to inform product decisions and measure success.

Bonus Points For

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

• MBA degree.

• Expertise in applying GenAI in solution prototyping and agentic workflow development.
