jobs.title: Remote Response Associate, Roadside Assistance (CSR)
jobs.description:
About Agero:

Wherever drivers go, we’re leading the way. Agero’s mission is to rethink the vehicle ownership experience through a powerful combination of passionate people and data-driven technology, strengthening our clients’ relationships with their customers. As the #1 B2B, white-label provider of digital driver assistance services, we’re pushing the industry in a new direction, taking manual processes, and redefining them as digital, transparent, and connected. This includes: an industry-leading dispatch management platform powered by Swoop; comprehensive accident management services; knowledgeable consumer affairs and connected vehicle capabilities; and a growing marketplace of services, discounts and support enabled by a robust partner ecosystem. The company has over 150 million vehicle coverage points in partnership with leading automobile manufacturers, insurance carriers and many others. Managing one of the largest national networks of service providers, Agero responds to approximately 12 million service events annually. Agero, a member company of The Cross Country Group, is headquartered in Medford, Mass., with operations throughout North America. To learn more, visit https://www.agero.com/.

Note: For our technical positions, we love to get you started in person! You may be required to travel to Medford for your initial onboarding. Don't worry about the logistics - once you're hired, we handle all travel arrangements and expenses for you.

Role Description and Mission: The Job & Why It Matters

Are you a quick-thinking problem solver who thrives on helping others in their time of need? Do you want to make a real difference and have a lasting impact on customers?

Agero is actively seeking Remote Response Associates to join our Roadside Assistance department, where you will help rescue stranded customers off the side of the road. When a vehicle breaks down, you are the driver's first point of contact. Taking real-time inbound calls from motorists across the U.S., you will be the calming voice that turns an unpredictable, highly stressful situation into a solved problem. You will provide a clear roadmap of what they can expect next, guiding them through an urgent and unplanned event. Just like an everyday superhero, you are stepping in to save their day and get their plans back on track!

As a Remote Response Associate, you serve as a lifeline for customers facing roadside emergencies such as flat tires, lockouts, dead batteries, fuel deliveries, and towing due to mechanical failures. Because customers often reach out feeling overwhelmed or unsafe on the side of the road, in dark parking lots, or while traveling in unfamiliar areas, you will manage these high-stress situations with calm, empathetic guidance and consistent reassurance.

Leading with a customer-first mindset, you will coordinate directly with external service providers to ensure the accurate and rapid dispatch of tow trucks and service vehicles. Your ability to stay calm and make quick decisions under pressure directly impacts customer safety, satisfaction, and our reputation for service excellence as a trusted, industry-leading roadside provider.

Key Outcomes: What you'll do

• Handle High-Volume Calls: Gather essential details regarding location and vehicle issues to dispatch assistance quickly for stranded motorists in real-time.

• Dispatch with Accuracy: Coordinate efficiently with external service providers to ensure the right help arrives at the right time.

• De-escalate & Support: Use active listening and empathy to calm frustrated or anxious customers, navigating heightened emotions during uncertain situations.

• Navigate Digital Tools: Utilize multiple web-based systems and dispatch tools simultaneously to track service progress accurately.

• Excel in a Virtual Team: Thrive in a performance-driven remote environment, collaborating with peers and managers via Zoom and Google Chat.

Skills, Education, & Experience: What We’re Looking For

This isn’t your typical, script-reading customer service role. We have a high bar for talent because our drivers need real help in real-time. Every single call involves a stressful situation - some customers will be panicking, others might be crying, and many won't even know exactly where they are stranded. To succeed here, you need to bring your A-game every shift, every call.

Here are the skills you'll bring to the team:

• Empathy in Action: You have a natural ability to genuinely understand what a stranded driver is going through. You can authentically connect with people, stay patient, validate their fears, and give them the real reassurance they need when they are stuck in a dark parking lot or on a busy highway.

• Effective Communication & Listening: True communication starts with listening. You need to actively listen to absorb the critical details from a worried caller, ask the right questions, and probe for missing information. From there, you'll use a steady, confident voice to give clear directions to our roadside partners and explain the next steps to the customer so they feel completely guided.

• Sound Judgment Under Pressure: You don’t fold when things get chaotic. You can keep a cool head, think clearly, and make smart, fast decisions during unpredictable events. You are comfortable thinking outside the box to solve problems safely, but you also have the awareness to know exactly when a situation needs to be escalated for extra help.

• Problem-Solving & De-escalation: You bring a calm, professional attitude to every interaction. You have a knack for turning a stressful, negative situation into a smooth, positive experience by focused problem-solving.

• Multitasking Mastery: You thrive in a fast-paced environment where no two calls are identical. You can comfortably talk to a stranded driver or a tow provider while simultaneously typing detailed notes, navigating multiple screens, and pulling resources from our system without breaking your focus.

• Service Excellence: We leave no one stranded. You take total ownership of every single call and call-back. You don't just check a box or process a dispatch; you focus on the person behind the problem, ensuring both our customers and our roadside partners get high-quality, accurate, and timely support.

• Tech Proficiency: You are comfortable working with digital tools and fast-paced systems. You can confidently navigate online databases, CRMs, and complex dispatch software all at once. You are familiar with and comfortable using AI tools, a pro at using Google Maps to pinpoint exact locations, fluent in Google Workspace (Gmail, Docs, Sheets, Chat), and can type at least 30 WPM accurately without breaking the flow of a live conversation.

• Accountability & Reliability: Even in a remote environment, we hold our team to a high standard and operate a structured contact center with top-tier client expectations. select a dedicated production schedule with set days off. We require your consistent commitment to this schedule because a stranded driver is counting on you when you are on the clock. At the same time, due to the nature of our business, things move fast. Call volumes spike, schedules adjust, teams shift, and supervisors change - meaning you must be highly adaptable and ready to pivot.

Position Requirements:

• Location: You must currently physically reside in Alabama, Arizona, Florida, Georgia, Mississippi, Tennessee, or Virginia.

• Customer-Facing Experience: You bring 1+ years of continuous customer service experience, ideally in a fast-paced contact center environment. A steady work history, proven career growth, and previous remote experience are highly valued. We also love and look for transferable skills from retail, fast-food, hospitality, administrative, or warehouse/production environments!

• Background Check: You must successfully pass a comprehensive criminal background screening (covering 10 years for misdemeanors and a lifetime check for felonies) to protect customer security and client integrity.

• Workspace Needs: You must have a dedicated, quiet home office setup completely free from family, pet, or background noise. Associates are responsible for providing their own work equipment.

Remote Technology Requirements (BYOD):

To ensure you can support stranded drivers without technical lag, your home office setup must meet these exact specifications. We will verify your system using the Harver System Checker during the application process.

Your PC & Equipment Setup:

• Computer: A personal desktop or laptop manufactured in 2021 or later. Chromebooks, Macs, and tablets are not allowed.

• Operating System: A current, supported version of Windows 11 (specifically version 24H2, 25H2, or newer). Important Note: Microsoft has discontinued support for older Windows 11 versions, so you must be updated to be eligible.

• Processor: Intel or AMD with 2+ cores, minimum 3.5 GHz (boosted/turbo speed).

• Memory & Storage: Minimum 8 GB RAM and at least 20 GB of free hard drive space.

• Peripherals: A working webcam (used for training & company meetings) and a high-quality USB-wired headset. Dual monitors are not required, but may be used if preferred.

• Browser: Google Chrome (version 23+) or Mozilla Firefox (version 3+).

• Hardwired Internet: A secure, hard-wired high-speed connection hooked directly into your router (modem) via an Ethernet cable. Wi-Fi is absolutely not allowed while working.

• Required Internet Speeds: Minimum 25 Mbps download / 10 Mbps upload. Maximum latency up to 80ms–100ms.

• Mobile Device: An active cell phone capable of receiving SMS text messages and downloading security apps for our mandatory two-step authentication process.

What Will NOT Work (Incompatible Setups):

• Work-Issued PCs: You must have full Administrator privileges to install our tools. Devices owned by previous employers and schools have strict security locks and cannot be used.

• Incompatible Devices: MacBooks, iPads, iMacs, Chromebooks, Surface Pro/Go, Samsung Notebooks, or any machines built before 2020.

• Incompatible Connections: Mobile hotspots, Wi-Fi, satellite internet, or USB phone tethering.

• Banned Software: Active VPNs, privacy/proxy services, or hosted/virtual PC platforms.

• Unsupported OS: All versions of Windows 10 and older, expired versions of Windows 11.

Pay, Benefits, & Career Growth:

• Solid Starting Pay: Earn a dependable base rate of $16.25 per hour.

• Premium Shift Differentials & Incentives: Boost your earnings with an extra $1.50 to $2.75 per hour in shift differentials for working evenings, nights, and weekends. You also have direct access to monthly performance and attendance bonuses, plus regular overtime opportunities based on business needs, and scheduled raises through merit increases.

• Comprehensive Benefits Package: We have you covered. Enjoy a full suite of medical, dental, and vision insurance options, a 401(k) program with a company match, Paid Time Off (PTO), tuition reimbursement, Employee Assistance Program (EAP), referral bonus program, complimentary roadside assistance, and more!

• A Clear Path Upward: We invest heavily in your future. You will have direct access to online skill-building courses, professional mentorship, and cross-training programs designed to give you the exact expertise you need to climb the ladder and fast-track your career at Agero.

Start Dates, Training, & Production Schedules:

• Up-Coming Start Date(s): October 26th, 2026 & November 9th, 2026

• Mandatory Paid Training: To set you up for absolute success, 100% attendance is required during your first two weeks of mandatory classroom training (Monday–Friday). Because this foundational period is packed with essential learning, schedules cannot be modified. We assess performance throughout this time and look for opportunities to cross-train you to expand your skill set early on.

• Selecting Your Shift: You will choose your full-time production schedule during the job offer process on a first-come, first-served basis. Training dates & schedules are set by Agero and based on business needs. The Roadside Assistance department is open 24 hours a day, 7 days a week to support stranded motorists when they need us most. Available production schedules will vary by start date and are subject to change.

• Schedule Commitment: Your production schedule is static for your first 90 days after training. After this 90-day milestone, you become eligible to request schedule changes. Our team also participates in semi-annual shift bids to keep things fair and flexible.

• 24/7 Roadside Reality: Because breakdowns don't take days off, we provide 24/7/365 coverage. This means most full-time production schedules include working at least one weekend day and holiday coverage. Full Time only. Weekend availability/flexibility is required.

Upcoming Training Classes:

• Class A: Monday, October 26th, 2026 Training: 09:00 am to 05:30 pm EST, Monday - Friday for seven weeks. (100% attendance required). Production Schedules: All shifts are listed in Eastern Standard Time (EST). Early Mornings: 04:00 am -12:30 pm (Thu/Sun off), 04:30 am - 01:00 pm (Tue/Wed off), 05:00 am - 1:30 pm (Thu/Fri off), 05:30 am - 02:00 pm (Mon/Sat off), 06:00 am - 02:30 pm (Tue/Sun off), 06:30 am - 03:00 pm (Wed/Thu off), 07:00 am - 03:30 pm (Mon/Fri off), 07:30 am - 04:00 pm (Tue/Sat off) Days: 08:00 am - 04:30 pm (Thu/Sun off), 08:30 am - 05:00 pm (Wed/Fri off), 09:00 am - 05:30 pm (Mon/Tue off), 09:30 am - 06:00 pm (Thur/Sat off), 10:00 am - 06:30 pm (Wed/Sun off), 10:30 am - 07:00 pm (Mon/Tue off) Mids/Afternoons: 11:00 am - 07:30 pm (Wed/Thu off), 12:00 pm 08:30 pm (Tue/Wed off), 01:00 pm - 09:30 pm (Mon/Sat off), 02:00 pm - 10:30 pm (Thu/Fri off) Overnights: 08:00 pm - 04:30 am (Tue/Wed off), 09:00 pm - 05:30 am (Thu/Sat off), 10:00 pm - 06:30 am (Fri/Sun off) * * * limted number of overnight shifts available 4x10's: 04:00 am - 02:30 pm (Tue/Fri/Sun off), 05:00 am - 03:30 pm (Wed/Thu/Sat off), 06:00 am - 04:30 pm (Mon/Tue/Sat off), 07:00 am - 05:30 pm (Tue/Fri/Sun off), 08:00 am - 06:30 pm (Wed/Thu/Fri off), 01:30 pm - 12:00 am (Tue/Wed/Sun off), 02:30 pm - 01:00 am (Mon/Fri/Sat off), 08:30 pm - 07:00 am (Mon/Tue/Sat off), 09:30 pm - 08:00 am (Wed/Thu/Sun off)

• Class B: Monday, November 9th, 2026

• Training: TBD. Monday - Friday for two weeks. (100% attendance required). Production Schedules: All shifts are listed in Eastern Standard Time (EST). The actual shift times for this start date are still To Be Determined and will be updated as soon as they become available Full time only

What to Expect After You Apply:

• Immediately after you apply, check your inbox for a "Magic Link" from our vendor partner, Harver.

• Complete your Harver Computer Skills Assessment and Remote Technology Diagnostic right away. It only takes about 10 mins total to do this step.

• Keep an eye on your text messages and email for an update. Qualified candidates will be sent a calendar link to schedule an interview on Zoom with a Recruiter.

Hiring In:

• United States: Alabama, Arizona, Florida, Georgia, Mississippi, Tennessee, and Virginia

The anticipated closing date to submit applications for this role is October 14th, 2026 by 5:00 pm EST. Join our Greenhouse Candidate Portal to track your application status and receive instant alerts for future openings.

The base salary range presented represents the anticipated low and high end salary range for new hires in this position. Your final base salary will be determined based on factors such as work location, experience, job related skills, and relevant training and education. The range listed is just one component of the total compensation package provided by Agero to employees.

National Pay Range

$16.25 per hour USD

Life at Agero:

At Agero, you'll find a workplace where your unique perspective is not just welcomed, it's celebrated. We believe that our differences make us stronger, and we're committed to creating an environment where every employee feels a sense of belonging. If you're looking for a company that values your individuality, provides opportunities for growth, and champions open communication, Agero is the place for you. Join our team and help us drive the future of driver assistance, while experiencing a workplace where you can truly thrive.

Benefits Built for Well-being:

Agero’s innovation is driven by a workforce where all associates feel like they can truly thrive. Agero offers a wide range of benefits to promote well-being, encourage personal development, and ensure financial stability. Our benefits include:

• Health and Wellness: Healthcare, dental, vision, disability, life insurance, and mental health benefits for associates and their families.

Join Agero and experience a workplace that invests in your success both personally and professionally.

jobs.title: Member Care Advocate Supervisor
jobs.description:
ABOUT WELLTH

Wellth is a fast-growing, growth-stage digital health company headquartered in Los Angeles. Our mission is to motivate people living with chronic conditions to make healthier choices, every single day.

We use behavioral economics, habit science and technology to motivate lasting behavior change in some of the highest need and most underserved populations in the US (Medicare and Medicaid), drastically changing their quality of life and health outcomes. We have demonstrated results with several large insurers and health systems (e.g. reducing hospitalizations by over 40%), and are now rapidly scaling. Our goal is to be the category leader in improving health outcomes for hard-to-engage populations. A key difference at Wellth compared to other digital health companies is that our users (Members) actually use Wellth every single day - think TikTok tier daily engagement (and data generation!).

But most importantly, our work quite literally saves lives by stabilizing chronic disease patients and preventing disease progression, hospitalization, and other bad outcomes. We are a mission-driven company where you work with incredible talent and see tangible differences directly from your impact and influence.

The Member Care Advocate (MCA) team is where that mission becomes a daily phone call, a completed screening, a closed care gap. As Supervisor, you'll lead the advocates who make those calls happen, keeping the team's day-to-day execution sharp, consistent, and member-centered as Wellth continues to grow.


ABOUT THE ROLE

The Member Care Advocate Supervisor runs the day-to-day floor operations of the MCA team, reporting to the Member Care Advocate Manager. Where the Manager owns the strategy behind risk stratification and measure prioritization, you own making sure that strategy actually happens on the ground every day — advocates working the right queues, calls meeting quality standards, and issues getting caught and coached in real time.

This is a hands-on, floor-facing leadership role. You'll spend your day split between live coaching, call reviews, queue monitoring, and being the first line of support when an advocate hits something they haven't seen before. You'll also carry a small caseload of your own, so you stay close to the work you're managing.


WHAT YOU’LL DO

Daily Team Leadership & Queue Execution

 - Supervise the MCA team's daily work in the Member Care Queue, making sure advocates reach the right member, through the right channel, within each measure's action window.

 - Provide real-time floor support — answering advocate questions, unblocking issues, and stepping into complex or sensitive calls as needed.

 - Enforce the one-outreach-per-7-day consolidation rule and apply exception protocols for members in acute transitions (post-discharge, recent diagnosis, medication change).

 - Monitor daily queue throughput and advocate capacity, flagging bottlenecks or staffing gaps to the Manager before they become backlogs.

 - Personally carry a small caseload of members, keeping your own coaching grounded in current, first-hand call experience.

Quality Assurance & Coaching

 - Conduct call reviews, live monitoring, and calibration sessions to ensure advocates are following approved scripts, decision trees, and escalation guides.

 - Deliver real-time feedback and coaching, and keep clear documentation to support one-on-ones and performance conversations.

 - Partner with the Manager on team scorecards, and own the weekly reporting of advocate activity (contacts, completions) and outcomes (measure closures, re-engagement).

 - Surface recurring script gaps, process friction, or training needs to the Manager, with concrete examples pulled from call reviews.

Team Leadership & Development

 - Support the Manager in hiring, onboarding, and training new Member Care Advocates.

 - Lead daily huddles and team check-ins, communicating priority shifts, cohort changes, and escalation updates.

 - Build a team culture of accountability, clinical curiosity, and member-centered communication.

 - Serve as the first point of escalation for advocate questions, resolving what you can and routing the rest to the Manager.

Cross-Functional Coordination

 - Communicate emerging trends from the floor — member barriers, script issues, recurring objections — to the Manager and Quality team.

 - Support the Manager with scheduling and day-to-day capacity planning across the team.

 - Help maintain accurate outreach history and case documentation across the MCA team.


WHO YOU ARE

We're looking for someone who has:

 - 2+ years in case management, care coordination, digital health coaching, or similar, including some experience mentoring, training, or informally leading peers.

 - Working knowledge of HEDIS measures and comfort following and enforcing measure-related protocols.

 - Experience coaching or monitoring front-line staff in a metrics-driven environment.

 - Strong organizational skills — able to keep a daily queue moving and juggle multiple priorities without dropping the ball.

 - Excellent written and verbal communication — can coach an advocate through a tough call and also document it clearly afterward.

Preferred Experience

 - Experience in a digital health or health tech company, working at the intersection of technology product and human care delivery.

 - Experience with care management platforms, CRM tools, or health plan quality reporting systems.

Schedule Availability:

This role requires availability for designated shifts to ensure coverage between 8:00 AM PST and 4:00 PM EST.

Shift assignments depend on team coverage needs, employee location, and time zone.




PHYSICAL DEMANDS & WORKING CONDITIONS

Prolonged periods of sitting and/or standing at a desk and working on a computer.



You will enjoy working with us at Wellth.

The benefits of working with us include:

 - Working remotely.

 - Robust Paid Time Off and generous parental leave program.

 - Health, dental, and vision insurance, in addition to FSA/HSA plans.

 - Ability to have a positive impact on people who need it most.

 - Support of a highly dedicated team focused on building the future of healthcare.



Hourly Compensation: $31-$34/hour

 

Wellth is an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, ethnicity, national origin, citizenship, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other protected characteristics.

jobs.title: Head of Change Management
jobs.description:
Step into a career with ASM, where cutting edge technology meets collaborative culture. ​

For over 55 years ASM has been ahead of what’s next, at the forefront of innovation and what’s technologically possible. With more than 4,500 ASMers representing 70 nationalities, our people and our advanced semiconductor devices are playing a crucial role in trends such as 5G, cloud computing, AI, and autonomous driving.  But we’re more than just a tech company. We value diversity, inclusion and sustainability as we strive to make a positive impact on the world.  Our development programs help support your growth, shaping your future and pushing the boundaries of innovation to unleash potential.

Job's mission

The Head of Change Management will establish and lead the enterprise change, adoption and capability agenda for ASM’s Global Digital Transformation (GDT) organization. This role will ensure that investments in data, end-to-end processes, AI, digital platforms and other technologies translate into sustained changes in how people work and into measurable business outcomes.

As the senior leader for change management and adoption within GDT, you will set the approach, standards and roadmap for enterprise change. You will partner with business functions, the People Team, Corporate Communications, Digital Transformation Business Partners, Business Process and Data Owners, senior management and others to build ownership, readiness and adoption from strategy through deployment and value realization.

Success will be measured not by communications delivered or training completed, but by the extent to which new ways of working are adopted, embedded and sustained, and by the business outcomes they enable. This role will also lead ASM’s AI Literacy agenda, building the confidence and practical capability needed to use AI responsibly and effectively at scale.

What you will be working on

Set the Change and Adoption Direction

• Define and lead ASM’s enterprise change management and adoption direction for the digital transformation.

• Establish a practical, scalable change framework, standards, tools and playbooks that can be reused across portfolios, domains and initiatives.

• Integrate change, communications, learning, leadership alignment and adoption into the transformation life cycle from value case through realization.

• Create a clear portfolio view of change impact, organizational readiness, dependencies and change saturation to guide sequencing and investment decisions.

• Set governance and accountabilities so that business leaders own adoption and GDT provides the expertise, methods and enablement required to succeed.

Drive Adoption and Measurable Business Outcomes

• Lead change for enterprise initiatives spanning data, processes, AI, automation, digital platforms and other technologies.

• Translate target business outcomes into specific behavior changes, stakeholder commitments, adoption measures and reinforcement plans.

• Define and track outcome-oriented measures such as adoption, proficiency, and process compliance, linking these to business outcomes and investment decisions.

• Use data, feedback from people and operational insights to identify barriers, adapt interventions and accelerate value realization.

• Ensure changes are sustained after go-live through communities, coaching, and others.

Build Business Ownership

• Advise (senior) leaders on transformation leadership, sponsorship, decision-making and visible role-modeling.

• Partner business functions, the People Team, Business Process Data Owners, GDT teams, and others to create integrated plans.

• Build strong change networks and communities across functions, regions and locations, and constructively challenge leaders and teams when ownership, readiness or value assumptions put outcomes at risk

Lead AI Literacy, Learning and Digital Culture

• Own the rollout of the Data & AI Literacy program, and other digital learning programs across ASM.

• Embed a learn-apply-lead approach that connects capability building to real use cases, responsible AI practices and day-to-day work.

• Build a data-driven, AI-enabled and change-ready culture through leadership engagement, role-based learning, communities of practice, storytelling and recognition.

Build GDT Capabilities for the Future

• Establish a structured approach to assess current and future capability needs across GDT, identify role- and team-level gaps, and translate the findings into clear development priorities and workforce plans.

• Design and lead a role-based GDT learning and development program that builds the capabilities needed to deliver the GDT strategy, including AI literacy, data fluency, agile ways of working, product and platform thinking, change leadership and business-value realization.

What we are looking for

Education

• A degree in organizational change management, business administration, organizational psychology, human resources, or a related field. Equivalent experience will also be considered.

• Relevant certifications or training in change management, organizational development, learning, are preferred, but not required.

Experience and skills

Must have (required)

• 7+ Years of experience in Enterprise Change Management, transformation, or organizational development.

• Proven success driving adoption and measurable business outcomes for large-scale transformations involving processes, data, AI, automation, or technologies.

• Demonstrated ability to create enterprise change strategies, governance, methods and reusable playbooks.

• Proven experience assessing organizational capability gaps and translating them into learning pathways, development plans and measurable capability outcomes.

• Strong experience in stakeholder engagement, coaching, change impact and readiness assessment, communications, learning, and resistance management.

• Experience defining and using adoption, proficiency, behavior, value and benefit measures to steer interventions and demonstrate impact.

• End-to-end enterprise mindset and good business acumen, with the ability to connect transformation choices to strategic and operational outcomes.

• Credibility to advise, influence and challenge senior leaders across functions, cultures and geographies.

• Ability to build trusted partnerships and mobilize teams without relying on formal authority.

• Excellent communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to make complex change clear, relevant and actionable for different audiences.

• Strong leadership, coaching and facilitation skills, with a track record of developing change capability in others.

• Outcome-driven, pragmatic and resilient, able to balance pace, empathy, discipline and long-term sustainment.

Desired (not required)

• Leading change in a semiconductor, high-tech, or manufacturing environment

Apply today to be part of what’s next.

We make the tech that enables the chips in devices which improve lives around the world. We do this with an eye to the future, pushing the boundaries of what’s possible through cutting-edge innovation, and driving the next wave of technological breakthroughs that shape how we live, work, and connect.

To learn more about ASM, find us at asm.com and on LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, X and YouTube.

Type: Full-time





ABOUT COPERNIQ

Coperniq is an AI-native operating platform for project-based contractors.

We bring sales, project management, field service, communication, payments, and AI agents into one platform so contractors can run their business without stitching together multiple disconnected tools.

We’re backed by Y Combinator and Initialized Capital and work with contractors across the U.S.

We’re a small, high-ownership team where strong performers can take on significantly more responsibility very quickly.




THE ROLE

We’re looking for a Founding Business Development Representative to help build Coperniq’s outbound sales motion.

Your primary responsibility will be creating qualified sales pipeline through outbound prospecting. You’ll work directly with the founders and sales team to identify the right accounts, reach decision-makers, understand their business problems, and create opportunities for Coperniq.

This role is also designed as a path into an Account Executive position.

We expect strong performers to spend approximately 2–6 months developing deep knowledge of our customers, market, product, and sales process before beginning to own deals themselves.

The transition to Account Executive will be based on performance and readiness, not tenure alone.



WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Prospect target accounts through phone, email, LinkedIn, and other channels.

 - Identify owners, executives, and other key decision-makers.

 - Create and qualify new sales opportunities.

 - Book and attend qualified sales meetings.

 - Understand customer pain, priorities, timing, and buying intent.

 - Maintain accurate CRM records, opportunity data, and next steps.

 - Follow up consistently with prospects throughout the sales process.

 - Work with the founders and sales team to improve targeting, messaging, sequences, and outbound strategy.

 - Test new approaches and help build the outbound playbook for future BDRs.

At full ramp, the target for this role is approximately $350,000 in Sales Accepted Pipeline per month.




PATH TO ACCOUNT EXECUTIVE

Our goal is not for you to remain a BDR indefinitely.

As you demonstrate consistent pipeline performance and develop strong product and sales knowledge, you’ll begin taking on more responsibility in the sales cycle.

This can include:

 - Running discovery calls.

 - Delivering product demos.

 - Building proposals and business cases.

 - Managing multiple stakeholders.

 - Handling objections.

 - Negotiating commercial terms.

 - Owning opportunities from first conversation through close.

Once you’re ready to consistently own the full sales process, the expectation is that you’ll transition into an Account Executive role with a new closing quota and compensation plan.




WHO YOU ARE

You’ll likely be a strong fit if you:

 - Want to build a career in B2B software sales.

 - Are comfortable making cold calls and doing high-volume outbound.

 - Communicate confidently with business owners and executives.

 - Are competitive, persistent, and comfortable hearing “no.”

 - Take feedback well and improve quickly.

 - Are highly organized and disciplined about follow-up.

 - Take ownership without needing constant direction.

 - Are motivated by performance and compensation.

 - Want to earn increasing responsibility quickly.

 - Thrive in an early-stage startup where the playbook is still being built.

Previous experience in BDR/SDR roles, SaaS, roofing, construction, or field services is helpful but not required.




WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

A successful BDR at Coperniq consistently creates qualified opportunities and develops a strong understanding of:

 - Our customers and target market

 - Coperniq’s product and value proposition

 - Discovery and qualification

 - Customer pain and buying intent

 - Strong sales process and CRM discipline

The best performers will show that they can do more than book meetings — they can understand customers, run strong conversations, and ultimately earn the opportunity to close business themselves.



COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

 - $60,000 base salary

 - $60,000 target variable compensation

 - $120,000 OTE

 - Uncapped variable compensation after ramp

 - Equity in Coperniq

 - 15 days PTO

 - 5 paid sick days

 - 70% of employee medical insurance premiums covered by Coperniq

 - 401(k)

 - Company events and offsites
   
   
   


WHY COPERNIQ


This is an opportunity to join the sales organization early and grow with it.

You’ll work directly with the founders, help shape how Coperniq goes to market, and have a clear opportunity to move into a closing role based on performance.

If you want to learn quickly, create pipeline, earn responsibility, and build toward becoming an Account Executive, we’d love to talk.

We’re growing, not slowing, here at Macquarie Technology Group because we’re passionate about doing things differently. We want to challenge the industry and look for better ways of doing things. As a team, Macquarie Government are hardworking, results and success focused. We also take the time to celebrate our success and make sure our people are doing work that makes a difference.

We require security clearance for this role you must be an Australian citizen to be eligible to obtain a security clearance or ideally already hold NV1 security clearance.
 


The Opportunity
We're looking for a Security Engineer to join our growing cyber security team in Canberra. This opportunity is ideal for someone with around 18 months to 4 years' experience in a SOC or cyber security environment who has hands-on experience with Splunk log onboarding, use case development, detection engineering and security monitoring.
You'll play a key role in onboarding and normalising log sources, building and tuning detections, investigating alerts, and supporting incident triage and response activities across customer environments. We're looking for someone who understands how security data flows into a SIEM, can work through detection logic, and enjoys improving visibility and security outcomes through well-designed use cases and analytics.
Working alongside experienced cyber professionals, you'll continue to develop your skills across Splunk, detection engineering, threat monitoring and incident response while supporting environments that genuinely matter. If you're curious, proactive, and eager to grow your technical capability in a high-performing team, this could be a great next step in your cyber security career.

jobs.title: Maintenance Mechanic - Washingtonville
jobs.description:
Maintenance Description:

Ensure operation of machinery and mechanical equipment by completing preventive maintenance requirements on: motors, pneumatic tools, hydraulic systems, conveyor systems, and production machines; following diagrams, sketches, operations manuals, manufacturer's instructions, and engineering specifications; troubleshooting malfunctions.

Locate sources of problems by observing mechanical devices in operation; listening for problems; using precision measuring and testing instruments such as laser alignment tools, stethoscope, tachometer, infrared camera, ultra sound and vibration analysis tools.

Remove defective parts by dismantling devices; using hoists, cranes, and hand /power tools.

Determine changes in dimensional requirements of parts by inspecting used parts; using tape measures, calipers, micrometers, and other measuring instruments.

Adjust functional parts of devices and control instruments by using hand tools, levels, plumb bobs, and straightedges.

Maintain equipment, parts, and supplies inventories by checking stock to determine inventory level; anticipating needed equipment, parts, and supplies; placing and expediting orders; verifying receipt.

Conserve maintenance resources by using equipment and supplies as needed to accomplish job results.

Provide mechanical maintenance information by answering questions, requests and completing feedback documentation.

Maintain technical knowledge by attending educational workshops and reviewing technical publications.

Maintain continuity among work teams by documenting and communicating actions, irregularities, and continuing needs.

Maintain safe and clean working environment by complying with procedures, rules, and regulations.

Contribute to team effort by accomplishing related results as needed.

Mechanical / Technical Understanding - Mechanical Fundamentals: mechanics, lubrication, understanding maintenance documents, pumps, piping systems, welding/cutting (stick, mig, tig and torch). Mechanical power transmission: basic mechanics, bearings. Hydraulic power transmission: basic hydraulics, hydraulic troubleshooting. Basic pneumatic: Pneumatic Principles, Reciprocating Compressors, Rotary Compressors, Primary Air Treatment, Secondary Air Treatment, Piping, Hoses, and Fittings, Directional Control Valves, Pressure-Control Valves, Pneumatic Cylinders, Pneumatic Motors.

Qualifications:

Have ability to work off of blueprints

Welding experience

Experience with cutting torch and plasma cutter

Experience with motor/pump alignment

Experience with the installation of welded, threaded and PVC piping

Industrial fabrication experience

Experience with the use of basic shop equipment (i.e. drill press, stationary band saw, pedestal grinder, etc.)

Basic knowledge of rotary valves and dust collector systems

Understanding of basic rigging principles and equipment

Must have basic mechanical troubleshooting skills

2+ years’ experience as a mechanic in an industrial manufacturing setting

jobs.title: Product Marketing Manager - Card Not Present (eCommerce) Processing & Value Added Solutions
jobs.description:
We are looking for a strategic and execution-focused Product Marketing Manager to lead go-to-market strategy for NMI's card-not-present (CNP) processing and Value Added Solutions (VAS) portfolio, the tools and services that power secure, high-converting online and card-not-present transactions for merchants, software platforms and partners across the United States.

NMI has evolved from a payment gateway into a full-service payment platform. Our CNP processing stack and VAS suite, including Customer Vault, Automatic Card Updater, Invoicing, ACH and fraud prevention tools, give merchants and partners a single, trusted path from sign up to pay out. This role supports that evolution, helping translate processing and VAS capabilities into messaging that speaks to the outcomes online merchants, marketplaces, subscription businesses and software platforms actually care about: conversion, fraud loss reduction, recurring revenue retention and total cost of acceptance.

You will lead market positioning, messaging, launches and enablement for NMI's CNP processing and VAS offerings, working closely with product, sales and channel teams to help make sure NMI is the preferred processing and VAS partner for every merchant and partner selling online.

This role calls for a solid understanding of how ecommerce merchants, subscription businesses and software platforms evaluate and adopt payment processing and value added services, and the ability to help translate technical capability (tokenization, network tokenization, recurring billing, customer vaulting, PCI scope reduction, fraud and chargeback tools) into outcome-led messaging that supports pipeline and adoption.

This role is also NMI's evangelist for CNP processing and VAS. You will present to sales teams and internal stakeholders, and help represent NMI at ecommerce and payments industry events. You will build AI tools into your everyday workflow as a core habit rather than an occasional add-on, and bring enough technical fluency across payment gateways, tokenization, APIs and PCI compliance to work credibly alongside engineers and technical buyers.

This is a remote, US-based role, with a strong preference for candidates in the Eastern or Central time zone.

About NMI

NMI, a global leader in payment technologies, allows software and sales professionals to deliver payment innovations to their clients without having to build payment expertise in house. NMI enables our partners with choice, and challenges the one-size-fits-all approach to payments. You've probably used NMI in the last 24 hours without even realizing it. We're the platform that powers success for innovative tech created by SMBs, entrepreneurs and fintech startups. We're creative problem solvers who help visionaries smash through boundaries and think beyond what's possible so they can think about what's next. But we're not just built for the tech savvy. We democratize the latest payments technology so that everyone can realize the benefits of easy payments across the full spectrum of commerce. Our mission is to use our expertise to enable more payments, in more ways and more places. We provide ISOs, Fintech Innovators and Technologists the freedom to focus on what they do best, liberating them from restricted payment solutions and giving them access to the latest payment technology now and in the future.

How We Work - Our Core Values

• Be a Good Person, It's Simple. We treat everyone fairly and with respect. We lead with kindness, humility and integrity. We take the time to understand each other and our customers. And we serve with care, because customers are never a transaction, and always our focus

• Align, Trust & Go. We debate openly, listen carefully and challenge thoughtfully. Once we decide, we move forward together - holding ourselves accountable to our commitments, and focusing on what matters most to our customers. That alignment creates momentum.

• Raise the Bar. Good enough isn't enough. We stay curious, measure everything, stay honest about progress and keep pushing ourselves to think creatively. We drive change, again and again. And leave things better than we found them. When we raise the bar, our customers feel it too.

Key Responsibilities:

• Own CNP Processing & VAS Go-to-Market Strategy — Lead positioning and messaging for NMI's card-not-present processing stack and Value Added Solutions, including tokenization and vaulting, recurring billing support, ACH, invoicing and fraud prevention tools.

• Define clear, outcome-led value propositions for ecommerce merchants, subscription businesses, marketplaces and software platforms, grounded in conversion, revenue retention and fraud reduction rather than processing specifications alone.

• Develop differentiated narratives that articulate why NMI is the processing and VAS partner of choice for online and card-not-present businesses, moving away from feature-and-spec language in favor of stories about merchant and partner success.

• Partner with Product Management to influence roadmap decisions using merchant insight and competitive intelligence, driving adoption of NMI's CNP processing and VAS suite.

• Drive Product Launches & Market Adoption — Support go-to-market execution for new processing capabilities, VAS features and integrations.

• Collaborate cross-functionally across product, sales, corporate marketing and channel marketing on launch execution.

• Create launch plans, enablement materials, customer-facing messaging and internal readiness programs for online merchants, subscription businesses and software platforms.

• Support adoption and revenue generation by aligning messaging with onboarding, documentation and the merchant experience.

• Build Understanding of the eCommerce & VAS Ecosystem — Develop working knowledge of buyer and operator personas within ecommerce, subscription/recurring billing and software platform segments.

• Conduct market research on trends in online fraud, chargebacks, PCI compliance, checkout conversion and payment orchestration.

• Monitor competitors and market dynamics to support NMI's differentiation strategy for CNP processing and VAS.

• Translate research into actionable, solution-focused messaging and strategic recommendations.

• Build Sales & Channel Enablement — Develop high-impact sales enablement tools, including pitch decks, battlecards, case studies, messaging frameworks, ROI narratives and use cases specific to CNP processing and VAS.

• Help sales articulate the business value of NMI's processing and VAS suite in terms merchants and partners care about, not just technical capability.

• Support lifecycle messaging that drives adoption, expansion and retention among merchants and partners.

• Partner with channel marketing to equip ISOs, software providers and reseller partners with compelling, VAS-focused messaging they can use with confidence.

• Support NMI's Evangelism — Present NMI's CNP processing and VAS solutions to sales teams and internal stakeholders, and support prospect and partner conversations.

• Help represent NMI at ecommerce and payments industry events and conferences as opportunities arise.

• Support analyst relationships and help build a credible, technical voice for NMI's CNP processing and VAS story.

• Bring working technical fluency across payment gateways, tokenization, APIs and PCI compliance to work credibly with engineers, integrators and technical buyers.

• Influence & Support Product & Business Strategy — Bring competitive insight and merchant research into product packaging, pricing and positioning discussions.

• Help build business cases for new VAS opportunities and processing enhancements.

• Drive alignment across product, engineering and commercial teams on processing and VAS priorities.

• Contribute to Thought Leadership & Drive Solution Storytelling — Turn merchant and market insights into repeatable narratives and frameworks for internal and external use.

• Partner with content and communications on thought leadership (whitepapers, points of view, benchmark reports, webinars) about how NMI's processing and VAS solutions help merchants succeed.

• Contribute to company and industry initiatives (webinars, events, analysts, partners) relevant to ecommerce and CNP processing.

Minimum Requirements:

• Five plus years of B2B product marketing experience in payments, fintech or a closely related ecommerce technology space. Payments or fintech experience is required.

• Experience marketing, or supporting the marketing of, card-not-present payment processing, online payment gateways, tokenization/vaulting, recurring billing, fraud prevention or related payments or fintech value added services.

• Ability to help translate technical processing and fraud/compliance capabilities into solution-forward, outcome-based messaging for non-technical merchants and buyers.

• Experience supporting cross-functional product and feature launches.

• Comfortable and effective presenting live to sales teams, prospects and internal/external stakeholders.

• Ability to move a product's narrative from feature-and-spec-led to solution- and outcome-led, and to bring sales and channel teams along with that shift.

• Uses AI tools as part of daily product marketing work (research, content, competitive analysis, enablement production).

• Strong storytelling, messaging, speaking and content development skills.

• Bachelor's degree in Marketing or another related field.

Essential Skills and Experience:

• Strategist - You combine classic strategic marketing skills with experience in multi-channel marketing/distribution, have perspective, and can see and discuss multiple aspects and impacts of issues and project them into the future.

• Strong External and Internal Collaborator - You collaborate well cross-functionally with key internal partners, work effectively with external partners to identify potential joint marketing opportunities, and have a willingness to learn and grow.

• Business Savvy - You possess a technical understanding of payment processing, tokenization, and fraud/compliance tools, have a solid degree of business acumen, and provide consistent, accurate information.

• Master Communicator - You have the ability to distill complex and difficult information into easy-to-understand communications. In other words, you can easily "de-geek the speak" with your exceptional creative and communication skills.

• Influencer - You build strong working relationships with peers, internal partners and external partners.

• Flexible - You not only cope with change, you thrive on it and can shift gears comfortably.

• Driven - You are results-oriented with a positive outlook and a clear focus on quality and business performance.

• Solution Oriented - You have the ability to identify and creatively solve complex problems.

• Personable - You are positive, energetic, and exude a strong sense of teamwork by working effectively, respectfully, and efficiently with all team members.

• Courageous and Ethical - You possess professional courage, steadfastly persevere through challenges, are ambitious while humble, have high standards for ethics and integrity, and do the right things the right way.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Experience marketing into ecommerce, subscription/recurring billing, marketplace or software platform segments.

• Familiarity with payment gateways, tokenization, PCI DSS compliance or fraud/chargeback management tools.

• Experience working on cross-functional projects with multiple stakeholders.

• Experience contributing to a product's shift from a technical, spec-driven story to a solution- and outcome-driven story.

• Exposure to ISOs, resellers or channel partners.

Do you feel like you have a slightly out of the ordinary career path or history? We are open to all walks of life and very willing to hear your story. Please don't feel like this should be a barrier to securing a great career at NMI! We appreciate success can come in all shapes and sizes. Fill in the 'Additional Info' box on our application to tell us more about your path.

As well as being a part of something exciting everyday, you will also receive the following benefits:

• A remote first culture!

• Competitive compensation and benefits

• Personal growth and advancement opportunities

• Flex PTO & dedicated sick time

• Health, Dental and Vision Insurance

• Life, ADD, Short-term and Long-term Disability insurance

• 401k matching up to 4% after two months of service

We believe that having a diverse group of employees strengthens both our work and our workplace. We're focused on making NMI more diverse and welcoming with initiatives like having a dedicated Diversity, Equity & Inclusion action group, diversity goals for hiring, anonymized resume screening, affinity groups such as our Women's network and LGBTQ+ Network, open forums for discussions on diversity and social justice, and measuring inclusion and belonging as part of our regular employee engagement surveys.

jobs.title: CLINICAL TRIAL MANAGER
jobs.description:
JOIN US!

Adicet Bio, Inc. is a clinical stage biotechnology company discovering and developing allogeneic gamma delta T cell therapies for autoimmune diseases and cancer. Adicet is advancing a pipeline of “off-the-shelf” gamma delta T cells, engineered with chimeric antigen receptors (CARs), to facilitate durable activity in patients. For more information, please visit our website at https://www.adicetbio.com.

CLINICAL TRIAL MANAGER

As a Clinical Trial Manager you will be responsible for the operational planning, execution, oversight, and delivery for assigned clinical trials. The Clinical Trial Manager will ensure studies are conducted in compliance GCP/ICH, company Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), study timelines and budget. You will work cross functionally within the Adicet Bio team as well as with study sites, CROs and other vendors.

Key responsibilities:

• Work closely with the Clinical Operations team to support all aspects of global clinical studies

• Take a leadership role in certain site and study management activities including: ICFs, site activations, monitoring reports and study plan review and creation

• Leading and presenting at Study Execution Team meetings

• Collaborate with cross functional team members to independently address routine study issues

• Assist with CRO and/or vendor oversight and management to ensure milestones are achieved

• Identify issues for escalation, participate in problem solving and implementation of risk mitigation

• Participate in departmental and corporate initiatives

• Perform co-monitoring visits as needed to provide oversight during site qualification, site initiation, routine monitoring, and close-out visits

• Generate and maintain reports, listings, and trackers as needed

• Ensure close tracking of site enrollment and related metrics

• Establish and manage clinical trial master files (TMF).

Qualifications:

• BS or higher degree in science, nursing (RN or BSN), or equivalent discipline

• A minimum of 4 years of clinical research experience in biotechnology, pharmaceutical, or CRO industry

• Experience supporting studies in a fast-paced environment

• Success in working with CROs and vendors

• Excellent communication skills and ability to achieve milestones in a team environment

• Strong working knowledge of FDA, ICH Guidelines, and GCPs governing the conduct of clinical trials

• Experience with managing studies in electronic data capture systems

• Experience with project, vendor, contract, and clinical research staff management

• Experience with Institutional Review Board (IRB) preparations and submission

• Ability to work independently, collaboratively and manage deadlines

• Knowledge in molecular diagnostics or laboratory skills is a plus

jobs.title: Senior Accountant
jobs.description:
Why Rogo

Our mission is to transform global finance by empowering professionals at the world's top investment banks, private equity funds, and investment firms with AI that delivers unparalleled speed, accuracy, and insight. We're not just improving financial workflows; we're redefining them.

This is a unique opportunity to join a generational company driving transformation in one of the most important industries in the world. With a rapidly growing, global client base, proven product-market fit, and backing from world-class investors, we are scaling quickly and defining a new category of enterprise AI.

Our team is sharp, motivated, and deeply committed to Rogo’s mission. We take ownership of complex problems and stay relentlessly focused on our users. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment, demand excellence, and want to help build the future of finance, we invite you to join us.


THE ROLE:

You will be the internal owner of Rogo's month-end close cycle for the US and international entities. In this role you are aimed to take ownership and establish a documented runbook, coordinate the local providers, and give every current and future non-US entity a day-to-day owner. The job is controls, review and ownership, not data entry. This role will report to the Accounting Manager.




WHAT YOU WILL DO: 

 - Support entity-level books for US and no-US entities: month-end close to US GAAP on corporate deadlines, working with local accounting providers

 - Prepare local-to-US GAAP bridge support and assist local statutory accounts and filings

 - Support balance sheet reconciliations, accruals, prepaids and the fixed asset register

 - Run intercompany billing and settlement, and support transfer pricing entries

 - Oversee the outsourced AP specialist: vendor onboarding and W-9/W-8 compliance, coding review, approval routing, payment run controls, AP accruals and aging

 - Assist with payroll accounting and reconciliation for US and no-US entities

 - Support external audit: reconciliations, PBC items, and walkthrough support for entity-level and AP processes




WHAT YOU BRING (REQUIRED):

 - CPA (preferred)

 - 3+ years progressive accounting experience

 - Solid US GAAP; working familiarity with local statutory frameworks

 - Strong reconciliation discipline and documentation habits; audit support experience

 - Modern ERP experience and strong Excel




NICE TO HAVE: 

 - Audit foundation (Big 4 or national firm) plus industry close experience

 - Multi-entity, multi-currency close in a high-growth or multinational environment

 - Experience coordinating outsourced providers or shared-services teams

 - Intercompany and transfer pricing exposure

 - Interest in automation and AI-assisted close work


WHO YOU ARE

 - You thrive in fast-paced environments. You are high-intensity and care a lot about what you do, and you're ecstatic to work at a startup. 

 - You are ambitious. You have fun solving problems that others think are impossible. 

 - You are curious.  You find joy in learning about AI, technology, and finance.

 - You are an owner. You are autonomous, self-directed, and comfortable working with ambiguity.

 - You are collaborative, organized, thoughtful, and kind.


WHY JOIN ROGO?

 - Up and to the right: Rogo has strong product adoption with the world's leading financial institutions, and we are still early. The upside is enormous.

 - Extraordinary team: we take talent density seriously. You'll do the best work of your career alongside some of the sharpest people in AI and finance.

 - A one-of-one problem: bringing AI to the core of how Wall Street works is one of the most ambitious, technically demanding, and consequential problems today. There is nowhere else you can work on it at this scale.

 - Real ownership: You'll own real surface area and watch the world's most sophisticated users rely on your work.

 - Always at the frontier: we work at the edge of what the best models can do and turn it into products people trust. If you're obsessed with AI, this is where it's happening.

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
Location: Remote
Compensation: $90,000–$120,000 base salary
Company: Coperniq — YC W23, backed by Initialized Capital



ABOUT COPERNIQ

Coperniq is building an AI-native operating platform for project-based contractors.

We help contractors run their business across sales, project management, field operations, service, payments, and customer communication — while deploying AI agents alongside their teams to automate repetitive work.

We’re a fast-moving startup with a small team, real customers, and a lot left to build.



THE ROLE

We’re looking for a Customer Success Manager to own relationships with Coperniq customers and help them get as much value as possible from the platform.

This is a hands-on role. You’ll work directly with contractors to understand how their businesses operate, configure Coperniq around their workflows, drive adoption, solve problems, and make sure customers are successful long after implementation.

You’ll also work closely with Product, Engineering, Sales, and Solutions Engineering. Customer feedback should not just live in a CRM — you’ll help turn it into product decisions.



WHAT YOU’LL DO


 - Own customer onboarding and go-live from handoff through successful implementation.

 - Drive product adoption through workflow coaching, health checks, QBRs, and proactive customer engagement.

 - Learn each customer's business and help them configure Coperniq around their real-world workflows.

 - Monitor account health and churn risk and intervene before problems become cancellations.

 - Handle customer escalations and coordinate with Product, Engineering, and Solutions Engineering when needed.

 - Own renewals and de-escalations for your accounts.

 - Turn customer feedback into clear, actionable inputs for the product team.

 - Identify opportunities for expansion when customers are getting strong value from Coperniq.

 - Help us build the processes, playbooks, and systems that will scale the Customer Success organization.
   


WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR


 - Strong communicator who can build trust quickly with customers.

 - Extremely organized and able to manage several customer relationships at once.

 - Comfortable learning complex software and understanding operational workflows.

 - Proactive — you don't wait for a customer to complain before investigating a problem.

 - Able to operate with ambiguity and take ownership without needing a detailed playbook.

 - Strong problem-solving instincts and willingness to dig into product issues yourself.

 - Comfortable working closely with founders, engineers, and customers in a fast-moving startup environment.

 - Prior experience in Customer Success, implementation, account management, or a similar customer-facing role is preferred.
   


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

 - $90,000–$120,000 base salary, depending on experience and fit.

 - Equity in Coperniq.

 - 70% medical coverage.

 - 15 days of PTO per year.

 - 5 paid sick days per year.

 - Remote work.
   


YOU'LL BE A GREAT FIT IF

You like being close to customers, enjoy understanding how businesses actually operate, and want more ownership than you'd typically get at a larger company.

This isn't a role where you simply run scheduled check-ins. We want someone who can become a trusted partner to our customers while helping us build a world-class Customer Success organization from the ground up.

jobs.title: Inbound 1st Shift Lead Fulfillment Associate
jobs.description:
As a member of the ShipBob Team, you will...

• Grow with an Ownership Mindset: We champion continuous learning and innovation. You'll take on real problems, create tangible solutions, and drive results that move the needle for ShipBob, our merchants, and for your own professional growth. If you're ready to do the most meaningful work of your career, this is the place.

• Collaborate with Peers and Leaders Alike: At ShipBob, leaders are accessible; feedback flows in both directions, and everyone, regardless of their seniority or role, steps up to help when needed. We hold each other to high standards because we trust each other to meet them. That combination of transparency and mutual respect is what makes the work here feel worth doing.

• Experience a High-Performance Culture and Clear Purpose: We are results-driven and clear about what that means: our goals are specific, accountability is shared, and every team member can see how their work connects to our mission. When we hit milestones, we celebrate them together. When we fall short, we learn and move forward.

Compensation: $21.00 - Starting compensation is reflective of 1st shift Lead.

Location: 400 Smoketree Plaza, North Aurora, IL 60542

Shift: 1st Shift: 6:30am - 3pm (Hiring for Sunday - Thursday and Tuesday - Saturday).

Role Description:

Our Associates work together as a team to deliver an incredible experience for our customers every day. Dedication and commitment to excellence will set you apart as a candidate and set you up for success within our fast-growing company. At ShipBob there is a huge opportunity for career growth as we are invested in each and every employee’s success in their career. This role reports to the Area Manager. The backup for this role is the Area Manager, Fulfillment Operations.

What you’ll do:

As an associate you will be working within one of several teams:

• Receiving: This team accepts our customers’ new inventory and owns the entire process of getting that inventory put away and accepted into our system. The responsibility of communicating the arrivals and any exceptions are received as well.

• Picking: Spread across two different processes our picking team is responsible for delivering products to the next stage of the process quickly and accurately. An integral team in the warehouse, pickers and their peers keep the flow of customers products moving and keep the warehouse humming.

• Packing: The final touches before a customer receives their products, the packing team is responsible for ensuring the quality of each and every shipment as well as packing the items correctly. The packing team works together with picking to guarantee that shipments are fulfilled perfectly and owns all responsibility around those shipments.

• Other Duties as Required: We are a team which means you will be asked to help out in other areas out of your normal day to day responsibilities to ensure the operations are running efficiently.

• This role includes responsibility for ensuring products are handled, stored, and distributed in a manner that maintains their safety, quality, and legality. Team members are expected to follow all standard operating procedures, report any concerns related to product condition or integrity, support traceability through accurate record-keeping, and contribute to a culture of continuous improvement and product safety awareness.

What you’ll bring to the table:

• Able to work scheduled shifts including overtime, and/or weekends based on business needs and consistently arrive for work on time.

• Ability to lift up to 50 lbs without restriction.

• Able to stand and walk continuously during and up to a 8-10 hr shift.

• Able to bend, stoop, reach above, and push/pull frequently.

• May be required to help out in other departments as needed.

• You’re willing to get your hands dirty to get a task completed.

• You have the ability to adapt to change quickly.

• You are extremely detail oriented.

• Ability to quickly understand new processes and identify operational opportunities.

• You’re looking to get your foot in the door with a rapidly growing start-up company.

• Previous warehouse experience is not required.

• Must be 18 or older.

Perks & Benefits:

• Medical, Dental, Vision & Basic Life Insurance

• 401K Match

• Weekly paycheck with paid overtime eligibility

• Pay Progression Program

• Paid Time Off & Sick Time Off

• Comprehensive Benefits Package >>> https://www.shipbob.com/careers/

• See Our High-Performing Culture >>> Check us out on Instagram (@lifeatshipbob)

#LI-DNI

We recognize that people come with a wealth of experience and talent beyond just the technical requirements of a job. If your experience is close to what you see listed here, please still consider applying. Diversity of experience and skills combined with passion is a key to innovation and excellence; therefore, we encourage people from all backgrounds to apply to our positions.

About You:

Building the world’s leading full-stack fulfillment platform is challenging work. The problems we solve are complex, the pace is fast, and the bar is high. That means ShipBob’s environment isn’t the right fit for everyone, and that’s okay. If you are ready to take ownership, push boundaries, and grow alongside a team that genuinely supports each other, we would love to hear from you.

Learn more about our core values and how we perform at a high level in our day-to-day work on our Culture page (https://www.shipbob.com/careers/culture/).

About Us:

ShipBob is a leading global supply chain and fulfillment technology platform designed for SMB and Mid-Market ecommerce merchants to provide them access to best-in-class capabilities and to deliver a delightful shopper experience. Merchants can outsource their entire fulfillment operations, utilize ShipBob’s proprietary warehouse management system for in-house fulfillment, or take advantage of a hybrid solution across ShipBob’s dozens of fulfillment center network in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, Europe, and Australia. ShipBob is backed by leading investors like Menlo Ventures, Bain Capital Ventures, Hyde Park Venture Partners, and SoftBank Vision Fund 2, and is one of the fastest-growing tech companies headquartered in Chicago.

At ShipBob, every full-time employee gets access to our best-in-class AI and productivity tools from Day 1 at no cost. This isn't a pilot or a perk for select teams. It's standard for everyone. We believe innovation isn't owned by one department. Whether you're in Talent, Operations, Finance, Engineering, or Customer Success, we expect you to ask: how can this be done better, faster, or smarter? These tools are our investment in your ability to find those answers.

Use of AI-Assisted Tools During Recruitment

We may use AI-assisted tools during the recruitment process to support administrative functions such as transcribing interviews, generating summaries or notes, organizing interview feedback, facilitating candidate communications, and helping recruiters identify candidates whose qualifications may align with job requirements. These tools are designed to assist our recruiting team and are not used to make final hiring decisions. Hiring decisions are made by trained human reviewers who consider the candidate's application, interview performance, qualifications, experience, and other relevant factors. AI-assisted tools do not independently determine whether a candidate advances in the hiring process or receives an offer of employment. Where required by applicable law, candidates will be provided with notice regarding our use of AI-assisted technologies and, where available, information about any applicable rights relating to such processing, including the ability to request additional information or opt out of certain AI-assisted processing activities. Candidates who exercise available opt-out rights may be reviewed through alternative processes consistent with applicable law.

ShipBob provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.

There is no deadline to apply for this position, as ShipBob accepts applications on an ongoing basis.

jobs.title: Senior Associate, Fund Administration (Accounting)
jobs.description:
ABOUT JUNIPER SQUARE

Private markets are one of the largest, most complex, and most underserved corners of global finance. Our mission at Juniper Square is to unlock their full potential. We’re the Operations Partner trusted by 2,300+ GPs, unifying technology, data, and fund administration services into a single platform that helps GPs move faster, make better decisions, and scale with precision. With $300B+ under administration and 700,000+ LPs on platform, we’ve built the scale to match our ambition. And with JunieAI, our purpose-built AI platform, we’re reimagining how private markets operate, embedding intelligence across every workflow. Founder-led since 2014, backed by $350M+ in funding, and now 1,000+ employees strong, we’re building a company designed to shape the future of private markets for decades to come.

Our culture is built for people who want to do ambitious, meaningful work alongside exceptionally talented teammates. We think like owners, move with urgency, and take pride in solving hard problems that truly matter to our customers and the future of private markets. We believe the best ideas come from open debate, deep collaboration, and diverse perspectives, which is why we believe transparency is the default and feedback makes us stronger. If you’re energized by high standards, rapid growth, and the opportunity to help define a category at a pivotal moment, come join us!

Juniper Square offers employees a variety of ways to work, ranging from a fully remote experience to working full-time in one of our physical offices. We invest heavily in digital-first https://blog.junipersquare.com/juniper-square-ponders-future-of-office-with-digital-first-hybrid-workplace-strategy/ operations, allowing our teams to collaborate effectively across 27 U.S. states, 2 Canadian Provinces, India, Luxembourg, and England. We also have physical offices in San Francisco, New York City, Mumbai and Bangalore for employees who prefer to work in an office some or all of the time.




ABOUT YOUR ROLE

We are hiring a few Senior Associates to join our team. This is an exciting opportunity to join a fast paced start-up environment to help build out Juniper Square’s Fund Administration service offering. Juniper Square is on a mission to transform the Fund Administration offering to Private Markets. We are more than a Fund Administrator, we are a Modern Fund Administrator.  As a Senior Fund Accountant you will partner with the customer, other members of the fund accounting team, and Investor Services and Fund Administration Onboarding teams to deliver  fund accounting and reporting services to Juniper Square’s Private Market customers in the Real Estate, Private Equity, and Venture Capital space. You will have a significant opportunity to shape the trajectory of our service offering and in so doing help to deliver a best-in-class experience to our customers. We are a team of values based self-starters with a curious mindset and the motivation to use technology to our advantage so that we are continually iterating and improving on the status quo. This is an opportunity to couple prior education and experience and to learn from some of the best talent in Private Markets.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Support  major decisions regarding team buildout and operational policies and procedures

 - Define and support the implementation of fund administration workflows, applying best practices and process efficiencies

 - Interface directly with clients to deliver an outstanding client experience

 - Serve as a technical accounting expert and key advisor on significant business/accounting decisions for the team

 - Perform accounting, analytical, & financial reporting duties; ensure client and investor reporting is prepared and completed timely and accurately

 - Review waterfall calculations and capital calls and distributions in accordance with clients’ Limited Partnership Agreements

 - Prepare and review asset- and fund-level performance metrics (IRRs, TVPI, etc.)

 - Assist in preparing, compiling, and verifying external client and regulatory reporting

 - Prepare financial information for stockholders/investor reports

 - Assist with annual audits, including preparation of the initial draft of the annual audit report and related schedules and disclosures; assist with PBC list (Prepared By Client) and tax returns

 - Research and assist in interpreting the impact of recent accounting developments




QUALIFICATIONS

 - 3+ years of fund accounting or audit experience with exposure to Private Equity, Venture Capital, Private Credit and/or Real Estate funds

 - Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or related field required. 

 - Investran experience preferred.

 - Exposure to complex fund structures, waterfall calculations, performance metrics (IRRs), distributions and capital calls calculations

 - Experience with annual reporting (audited financial statements) 

 - Passion for technology and a desire to use technology to improve business operations

 - Experience scoping out system requirements and implementing new systems

 - Strategic thinker with the ability to master both the details and the big picture

 - Ability to handle many projects at once without losing track of the details

 - Comfortable with ambiguity, excellent work ethic and likes to take ownership of your work


At Juniper Square, we believe building a diverse workforce and an inclusive culture makes us a better company. If you think this job sounds like a fit, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all the qualifications.




COMPENSATION 

Compensation for this position includes a base salary, equity, and a variety of benefits. The U.S. base salary range for this role is $85,000 - $98,000. The Canadian base salary range for this role is $80,000 - $100,000. Actual base salaries will be based on candidate-specific factors, including experience, skillset, and location, and local minimum pay requirements as applicable. We are actively hiring for this role in Canada, and offer competitive local pay and benefits. Your recruiter can provide further details.



Benefits include:

 - Health, dental, and vision care for you and your family

 - Life insurance and disability coverage

 - Mental wellness coverage

 - Fertility and growing family support

 - Flex Time Off in addition to company-paid holidays

 - Paid family leave, medical leave, and bereavement leave policies

 - 401k retirement savings plan

 - Healthcare FSA and commuter benefits programs

 - Allowance to customize your work and technology setup at home

 - Annual professional development stipend
