jobs.title: Manager, GTM - UCANZ (Contract)
jobs.description:
About Crunchyroll

Founded by fans, Crunchyroll delivers the art and culture of anime to a passionate community. We super-serve over 100 million anime and manga fans across 200+ countries and territories, and help them connect with the stories and characters they crave. Whether that experience is online or in-person, streaming video, theatrical, games, merchandise, events and more, it’s powered by the anime content we all love.

Join our team, and help us shape the future of anime!

About the role

Crunchyroll is seeking an execution-focused Manager, (GTM) to support the UCANZ region (United States, Canada, Australia, and New Zealand). This individual will play a critical role in driving the planning, execution, and operational excellence of regional GTM initiatives, partnering closely with cross-functional teams to deliver subscriber growth and business objectives.

You will help drive GTM execution for Crunchyroll's owned-and-operated platform and key distribution partners, including Amazon, Apple, Google, YouTube, Roku, Comcast, PlayStation, Samsung, and others.

What You'll Do

Drive Go-To-Market Execution

• Lead the day-to-day execution and coordination of GTM initiatives across the UCANZ region, ensuring workstreams are aligned with strategic priorities and have clear owners, timelines, dependencies, and next steps.

• Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to coordinate campaigns, partner initiatives, and regional priorities across Marketing, Content, Lifecycle, Analytics, Operations, Product and Business Development.

• Establish clear project plans, trackers, timelines, dependencies, risks, and mitigation strategies for multiple concurrent initiatives so stakeholders have current visibility into progress, dependencies, decisions, and areas requiring attention.

• Drive accountability across stakeholders, proactively removing blockers and ensuring successful execution.

Performance Analysis & Business Insights

• Track regional business performance against subscriber, engagement, revenue, and campaign targets.

• Analyze performance versus plan, identify trends, risks, and opportunities, and provide actionable recommendations to improve business outcomes.

• Partner with Analytics, Finance, Lifecycle, and User Acquisition teams to develop reporting frameworks and performance dashboards.

• Monitor key GTM KPIs and prepare regular executive-ready reporting on regional performance, market trends, and operational health, and key risks.

• Leverage data to inform prioritization, resource allocation, and future GTM strategies.

Operational Excellence

• Serve as a key operational partner to the GTM UCANZ leadership team, ensuring initiatives move forward efficiently and consistently.

• Identify process gaps and proactively recommend workflow improvements that increase speed, visibility, and cross-functional collaboration.

• Keep trackers, dashboards, business reviews, and project documentation accurate and up to date, helping establish clear sources of truth for the region.

• Develop executive-ready presentations, dashboards, trackers, business reviews, and project documentation with exceptional attention to detail.

• Synthesize complex information into concise insights, recommendations, and next steps for leadership.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Build strong relationships across Product, Content, Marketing, Lifecycle, Analytics, Finance, Business Development, Regional teams, and external partners.

• Coordinate initiatives across global and regional stakeholders, ensuring alignment on priorities, milestones, and deliverables.

• Thrive in a highly matrixed organization, influencing without direct authority and effectively navigating changing priorities and ambiguity.

We are considering US-Remote applicants.

About You

• 5+ years of experience in strategy, consulting, business operations, program management, go-to-market, or project management within entertainment, media, technology, gaming, or a fast-paced consumer business.

• Demonstrated success managing complex cross-functional projects from concept through execution.

• Experience interpreting business performance, measuring results against targets, and developing data-driven recommendations.

• Experience building executive dashboards, reports, business reviews, and presentations using data to tell compelling business stories.

• Experience with project management, including planning, prioritization, dependency management, and stakeholder coordination.

• Experience with senior leadership.

• Experience with Excel/Google Sheets and PowerPoint/Google Slides skills; experience with BI and reporting tools (e.g., Tableau, Looker, Power BI).

About the Team

Crunchyroll's continued global expansion is driven by strong regional execution and integrated growth strategies. The GTM & Planning team partners closely with U.S.-based leadership and regional teams to develop and execute go-to-market strategies that grow Crunchyroll's subscriber base, deepen fan engagement, and maximize the impact of its owned-and-operated platform and strategic distribution partners.

As part of the broader Growth & Planning organization, the team sits at the center of regional strategy, operational planning, and cross-functional execution, bringing together Product, Marketing, Content, Analytics, Lifecycle, Business Development, and Operations to deliver measurable business impact.

The Pay Range for this position is listed. Actual pay will vary based on factors including, but not limited to location, experience, and performance.

Pay Range

$72—$80 USD

About our Values

We want to be everything for someone rather than something for everyone and we do this by living and modeling our values in all that we do. We value

• Courage. We believe that when we overcome fear, we enable our best selves.

• Curiosity. We are curious, which is the gateway to empathy, inclusion, and understanding.

• Kaizen. We have a growth mindset committed to constant forward progress.

• Service. We serve our community with humility, enabling joy and belonging for others.

Our commitment to diversity and inclusion

Our mission of helping people belong reflects our commitment to diversity & inclusion. It's just the way we do business.

jobs.title: Principal Visual Design Artist - Unpublished R&D Product
jobs.description:
Riot Visual Designers craft the best player experiences through their knowledge of systemic design, graphic design, interactivity, layout, typography, color theory, and illustration. Designers collaborate with cross disciplinary teams and act as both artistic and design problem solvers. They understand players and ask questions about the what, who, and how when solving for an interface or communication challenge.

As a Principal Visual Design Artist on an unpublished R&D title, you will be responsible for all aspects of Visual Design in an early-stage R&D game. We need your help to produce assets of the highest quality so our players can immerse themselves in our world. You'll report to the Visual Design Lead and collaborate with other artists to establish the style of the game's user interface. You'll also work collaboratively with engineers, designers, and producers, and together will give new, delightful experiences to our players.

Responsibilities:

• Work with the team to create a visual style that satisfies the creative goals - establishing a unique visual identity for the game’s UI

• Create visually balanced and intuitive interfaces that show an excellent grasp of readability, hierarchy, platform and player behavior patterns

• Guide the planning of UI work, working with artists and designers to build on the creative vision

• Create assets through each stage of development, taking ideas from concept to in-game implementation

• Use deep knowledge of systemic design, graphic design, interactivity, layout, typography, color theory, and illustration to create seamless player experience

• Extend themes throughout the project, establishing style guides and conventions

• Establish the quality bar for visual design for the game

Required Qualifications:

• Hands-on experience contributing to a major feature, game, product launch, or entertainment property through the craft of visual communication design.

• 8+ years of professional experience as a Visual Designer, UI Designer, or UI Artist

• Expert knowledge in Figma & Adobe CC

• Knowledge of the game development pipeline including optimization, localization and implementation

• Experience shipping games in Unreal, Unity, or any relevant game engine.

• Portfolio that demonstrates visual taste of contemporary graphic design and strong artistic style

Desired Qualifications:

• Experience developing brand identities, logos, brand kits, etc.

• Experience in a secondary area such as motion graphics, illustration, animation, or modeling

For this role, you'll find success through craft expertise, a collaborative spirit, and decision-making that prioritizes the delight of players. We will be looking at your past studies, experience, and your personal relationship with games. If you embody player empathy and care about players' experiences, this could be your role!

Our Perks:

Riot focuses on work/life balance, shown by our open paid time off policy and other perks such as flexible work schedules. We offer medical, dental, and life insurance, parental leave for you, your spouse/domestic partner, and children, and a 401k with company match. Check out our benefits pages for more information.

At Riot Games, we put players first. That mission drives every decision in our quest to create games and experiences that make it better to be a player. Whether you’re working directly on a new player-facing experience or you’re supporting the company as a whole, everyone at Riot is part of our mission. And just like in our games, we’re better when we work together. Our goal is to create collaborative teams where you are empowered to bring your unique perspective everyday. If that sounds like the kind of place you want to work, we’re looking forward to your application.

It’s our policy to provide equal employment opportunity for all applicants and members of Riot Games, Inc. Riot Games makes reasonable accommodations for handicapped and disabled Rioters and does not unlawfully discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, handicap, veteran status, marital status, criminal history, or any other category protected by applicable federal and state law. We consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with criminal histories, in a manner consistent with applicable federal, state and local law, including the California Fair Chance Act, the City of Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, and the Washington Fair Chance Act.

• Communication with others, including Rioters and third parties such as vendors, and/or players, including minors

Operational Excellence & Efficiency

• Ensure seamless operations across both front and back-of-house, managing processes with precision and attention to detail to optimize store efficiency.

• Oversee and participate in daily operational tasks, ensuring compliance with company standards and fostering a smooth, organized workflow.

Business Strategy & Corporate Collaboration

• Leverage resources provided by corporate partners, serving as a key liaison between headquarters and your boutique to align strategies and maximize business success.

• Implement corporate initiatives effectively, adapting them to meet the specific needs of your team and store while driving overall performance.

Who You Are:

• 2-3+ years of prior supervisory experience, preferably in luxury retail management.

• Prior experience managing in a commission environment is a plus

• Prior merchandising experience

• A natural leader with strong coaching, communication, and people development skills.

• Passionate about client relationships and creating a high-touch, personalized shopping experience.

• Results-driven and strategic in decision-making, with a focus on achieving KPIs.

• A strong recruiter who attracts top talent to build a high-performing team.

• Achieve talent acquisition targets including open to hire percentage and hiring speed

• Achieves staff turnover goals

• Highly organized, adaptable, and solutions-oriented in managing store operations.

• A brand ambassador who embodies SMCP’s core values and vision for modern luxury.

• Flexible availability, including evenings, weekends, and holidays, is required.

• Fully versed in front and back of house.

Join a Career That Fits Your Life:

At SMCP, we provide more than just a job—we provide a path to grow, thrive, and be part of something exceptional.

Your talent and dedication are rewarded with a 50% shopping discount, a seasonal wardrobe offering and a seasonal clothing allowance, so you always feel confident in the latest collections—because style starts with you. We also provide a cell phone contribution, keeping you connected and equipped for success.

We know that security and well-being matter. That’s why we provide comprehensive health, dental, life, and disability coverage, an employer-matched 401(k) with immediate 100% vesting, and paid time off—including vacation, holidays, sick time, and personal days—plus paid parental leave and pet benefits. You’ll also have access to resources like our Employee Assistance Program (EAP), which includes personalized guidance, expert care, and mental health support through every stage of life, along with MAVEN Family Planning, providing additional support for family planning and wellness.

Through extensive product knowledge training, industry insights, and the opportunity to earn more through our Monthly and Seasonal Bonus Incentive Plan, you’ll refine your expertise, elevate your skills, and make a lasting impact on the client experience. With mentorship and professional development support, plus a dynamic, engaging workplace where your contributions truly matter, you’ll discover a career that’s as fulfilling as it is inspiring.

At SMCP, you’re not just an employee, you’re a valued part of a team that celebrates passion, creativity, and excellence. With a dynamic, engaging workplace and a people-first culture, you’ll find a career that’s as rewarding as it is inspiring.

Ready to lead with confidence and style? Apply today and become part of the SMCP Dream Team!

$95,000—$105,000 USD

jobs.title: Senior Mission Operations Engineer, Connected Warfare
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Connected Warfare division builds systems to support and execute global command and control missions. We create joint, time sensitive, multi domain, ubiquitous, connected mesh ecosystems. Our ecosystem enables connected warfare with disproportional impact by connecting every robot, human, and sensor in every domain, aggregating together hundreds of thousands of end points across the globe for battlefield dominance. We are the substrate that provides the source of truth for critical commander decision-making, effectively transforming the way that militaries close kills chains and enable mission autonomy.

The Mission Operations (MOPs) team is responsible for managing the execution, delivery, growth, and success of our customer accounts. Working across product, engineering, business development and logistics teams, our Mission Operations Engineers own and shape the customer relationships by embedding themselves with their units to develop, plan, and deploy Anduril products in support of their missions. They work side-by-side with customers to understand their specific problem sets and then shape Anduril’s offerings alongside our engineering teams to fit the mission needs. Because the problems we solve are uniquely challenging, our Mission Operations Engineers naturally gravitate toward finding solutions and are adept at identifying and navigating organizational hurdles. They are ultimately responsible for customer and mission success and therefore play a critical role in the shaping and future of Anduril Industries and the Warfighter.

ABOUT THE JOB

Orchestrate the deployment of Anduril products. Lead the planning and deployment of Anduril’s flagship hardware and software products in support of customer missions. Through collaboration with our engineering, logistics, and technical operations teams, Mission Operators are in charge of deploying our products to the field, training end users, and ensuring the high performance of our products. We are obsessed about engagement and keeping our finger on the pulse of how customers interact with our products. This helps us improve the user experience and evolve their operational tactics and techniques. And if something isn’t quite right, we work with product teams to quickly address the issue on behalf of our customer.

Grow your business through customer success. In addition to the operational and executive relationships you own, you will be responsible for meeting commercial targets that drive top line growth. This requires establishing committed and trust-based partnerships with our customers to not only help them solve their immediate problems, but also to foresee future opportunities where Anduril’s technology can make them more effective. Understanding Anduril’s value proposition and articulating how we can have an impact on a customer’s problem set, from the executive level to the end user, is critical to positioning Anduril for the future.

Shape our products to meet mission needs. Work side-by-side with our customers to understand their specific mission challenges and represent the customer as you work with Anduril engineers to shape products that solve critical national and international security challenges. Anduril engineers rely on Mission Operators to understand the lay of the land and bring a perspective that informs the product development process.

Collaborate across nearly every Anduril team. Successfully deploying our complex hardware and software products requires collaborating with nearly every internal Anduril team - business development, engineering, product, logistics, finance, legal, contracting, technical operations, and many more. You’ll be responsible for ensuring each party is engaged and informed, and will therefore become well-versed in what it takes to really bring the best of Anduril to our customers.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Mission First Mindset. We put the needs of the mission and our customers first and understand that the US and its allies have no preordained right to victory in any future conflict. We actively seek out opportunities to better understand our customers’ mission needs, with a goal to build the best possible products for the warfighter and radically evolve our national and international defense capabilities. We push ourselves and the limits of our capabilities in the pursuit of this goal.

Ownership Mentality. We’re looking for owners; those who have a natural bias to assume responsibility, a healthy dose of skepticism, and contribute to a culture of performance. We empower our Mission Operators to quickly assume high levels of responsibility and entrust them to actively own their account and shape its success. Our Mission Operators are just as comfortable helping to shape a proposal or pitch a new customer as they are working with engineers on new features or deploying products in the field.

Technical Aptitude and Intellectual Curiosity. We are first and foremost a technology company, working at the leading edge of capabilities like machine learning, autonomy, distributed networking, and multi-modal sensor fusion. Do you have a natural desire to see beyond simple cause and effect relationships to really understand how complex systems operate? Do you actively seek out opportunities to educate yourself? These capabilities form the foundation of our product offerings, so we are looking for those who are comfortable communicating technical concepts and can articulate them in the context of the customer’s mission.

Structured Thinker and Problem Solver. Leading technical programs requires clear communication and well thought-out plans. We are looking for assertive communicators who bring a thoughtful perspective and honest dialogue. A solution-driven approach, the ability to distill complexity into its essential, digestible components, and the ability to supervise execution are critical to ensure mission success.

High Value Team Member. Do you enjoy working as part of a team? At Anduril, the path to success weaves through the organization - account teams, engineering, logistics, technical operations, and more. It requires humility, an eagerness to learn, and empathy toward your fellow team member. We assume best intentions and empathize with customers just as we do with our colleagues. Can you develop rapport at both the user and executive levels? Do you enjoy sharing successes? We are a low ego group that promotes teamwork and collaboration to bring about success.

360 Degree Leader. We are a flat, non-hierarchical organization with a matrix structure that is dynamic and evolving. We expect you to be self-aware enough to recognize your position of unstated leadership within the company. You should have a demonstrated ability to lead and influence people through both formal and informal constructs and in situations where there is lack of clarity across teams. Finally, we need people who identify gaps and breakdowns and solve them immediately, rather than point them out and step back. You should also seek 360 feedback to help inform your growth trajectory as a leader.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

• Serve in a customer-facing Account Manager capacity, working directly with the United States Army to develop and deploy Anduril integrated hardware-software C2 products to meet customer and operational needs

• Own the delivery of contract deliverables to include developing, and implementing, measures of performance and effectiveness, writing technical reports, and creating user development roadmaps

• Design & implement user feedback loops to gather, triage, and prioritize requirements, feedback, issues, and challenges found through the employment of Anduril C2 products during training, exercises, and normal use within unit schedules

• Serve as a conduit between program and engineering teams to drive the development of product features and configurations that enhance or greatly improve efficiency of user workflows and employment of Anduril C2 products

• Support engagement with other service components, Task Forces, Geographic Combatant Commands, and other Government organizations as required to integrate Anduril products laterally across United States Armed Forces customers for increased adoption

• Develop and contribute to a streamlined user feedback and engagement system, which include issue tracking, training sessions, qualification tracking, and focused preparation for large scale exercises and events

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

• Experience in program management, product deployment, or field engineering roles

• Exceptional interpersonal and stakeholder management skills with senior military leaders and officials

• Understanding of U.S. and allied military operations, doctrines, and multi-domain environments

• Experience translating and decomposing highly technical concepts into operational requirements and performance specifications

• Strong aptitude for problem solving in unstructured situations at the intersection of hardware, software, and networking. Ability to drive challenging and vague technical problems to clarity and resolution

• Willing to travel as necessary (25-50%)

• Ability to work remotely across customer sites in Tacoma, WA

• Must possess an active U.S. Secret clearance

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

• Experience in Defense Technology, Product or Program Management, Solutions Architect, or Technical Delivery-type roles

• Experience and familiarity with United States Army and/or Joint-Force intelligence, operational planning, targeting, and fires systems and workflows

• Experience and familiarity in mobile compute challenges and tradeoffs for dismounted soldiers in varying form factors

• Familiarity with operational constraints of military workflows in Disconnected, Denied, Intermittent, and Low-Bandwidth (DDIL) environments

• Familiarity with mesh networking and data federation across disparate systems

• Familiarity with doctrinal, functional, and technical command and control concepts, processes, and principles

US Salary Range

$129,000—$208,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

• No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

• Please always verify communications: Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address. Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

• Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

• What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

jobs.title: Business Development Representative
jobs.description:
About Dutchie

Founded in 2017, Dutchie is a comprehensive technology platform powering dispensary operations, while providing consumers with safe and easy access to cannabis. Dutchie aims to further support the positive societal change the cannabis industry brings to the world through wellness benefits, social justice, and empowering local communities through tax revenue. Powering thousands of dispensaries across 40+ markets throughout the United States and Canada, Dutchie is the leading technology company in the cannabis space and was named in Fast Company’s 10 Most Innovative Companies in North America and listed two years in a row on LinkedIn’s Top 50 Startups.

Dutchie has raised over $600M in funding to date, backed by D1 Capital Partners, Tiger Global, Dragoneer, DFJ Growth, Thrive Capital, Howard Schultz, Snoop Dogg’s Casa Verde Capital, Gron Ventures, members of the founding team at DoorDash, Kevin Durant’s Thirty Five Ventures, and other notable angel investors.

About This Job

As a Business Development Representative on our outbound team, you'll find and open doors with dispensaries that haven't discovered Dutchie yet. You'll build target lists, run sequences, and start conversations that turn into qualified meetings for our Account Executives and Account Managers. To succeed here, you'll need to be curious about the businesses you're prospecting into, resourceful when a first attempt doesn't land, and genuinely energized by the grind of top-of-funnel outbound — the volume, the research, the follow-up.

This role sits on a strong, growing sales team and comes with real coaching and mentorship as you ramp. You'll need to move comfortably across systems and adapt quickly as our outbound motion takes shape — prioritizing the accounts and activities that create the most pipeline. Your success will be rooted in consistent activity, sharp messaging, and a coachable mindset that keeps improving week over week.

What You'll Do…

• Outbound Prospecting: Build and work target account lists across U.S. dispensaries, using state, license status, and market maturity to prioritize who you reach out to and when.

• Multi-Channel Outreach: Run cold and warm outreach across call, email, and social, using the Dutchie Revenue Playbook to deliver consistent, proof-point-driven messaging that resonates with dispensary owners and operators.

• Meeting Generation: Book qualified meetings for Account Executives and Account Managers, and manage a clean handoff so context and momentum aren't lost.

• Pipeline Hygiene: Log activity, disposition, and source data accurately in HubSpot and Salesforce (Legacy and Greenpath), giving leadership reliable visibility into pipeline health.

• Performance & Coaching: Hit weekly and monthly activity and meetings-booked targets, and show up for regular 1:1 coaching and Gong call reviews to keep sharpening your messaging and objection handling.

• Market Intelligence: Share what you're hearing in the field — competitive signals, regional trends, buying triggers — so the team can keep refining how we target and message.

What You Bring

• 1+ years of experience in a sales, BDR/SDR, or outbound prospecting role, preferably within B2B SaaS or tech.

• A track record of hitting activity and pipeline-generation targets in a metrics-driven environment.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the confidence to cold call and the ability to write outreach that doesn't sound templated.

• Comfort working in a CRM (Salesforce, HubSpot, or similar) and following a defined process for logging activity and disposition.

• A coachable, growth-oriented mindset — you want mentorship from a strong team and a path toward Account Executive or Account Management.

• Genuine curiosity about the cannabis retail industry and a willingness to learn the regulatory nuances that shape how dispensaries buy.

• Organizational skills to manage a high volume of accounts and outreach without losing attention to detail.

It’s a Bonus if You…

• Have prior outbound (not just inbound) sales experience and can speak to how you build and prioritize a target account list.

• Have experience with sales engagement/sequencing tools and call intelligence platforms (e.g., Gong).

• Have sold into retail, POS, fintech, or another regulated or vertical SaaS market.

• Have exposure to or interest in the cannabis industry specifically.

You’ll Get…

We are targeting a starting salary of $50,000 - $65,000 based on the intended level for this role.

In addition to cash compensation, our total rewards package includes:

• Full medical benefits including dental and vision plans to ensure you always have the best care.

• Equity packages in the form of stock options to all employees.

• Technology (hardware, software, reading materials, etc..) allowance

• Flexible vacation and sick days

At Dutchie, we’re committed to providing an environment of mutual respect where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants and teammates without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, age, national origin, disability status, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Dutchie believes that diversity and inclusion among our teammates is critical to our success, and we seek to recruit, develop and retain the most talented people from a diverse candidate pool.

jobs.title: Industrial Security Specialist
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Quindar is standing up an Industrial Security Program to support mission partners across the U.S. Government. We are seeking an Industrial Security Specialist I/II/III who thrives in a hands-on environment and is excited to help build, scale, and mature a compliant, high-impact security program supporting DoD and Intelligence Community (IC) customers.

In this role, you will work closely with the Facility Security Officer (FSO) and play a critical role in day-to-day security operations, compliance, and process development. You will be a key contributor to developing Quindar’s Industrial Security Program and implementing industrial security standards across new and existing secure spaces, directly enabling classified mission execution.




WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

 - Support the development and delivery of security training, education, and awareness programs

 - Manage the full personnel clearance lifecycle, including initial submissions, upgrades, and reinvestigations

 - Support classified onboarding and offboarding briefings for employees

 - Provide local visitor control and classified meeting support

 - Review SF-86s for adequacy and completeness

 - Process incoming and outgoing Visit Access Requests (VARs)

 - Assist with DCSA self-inspections, assessments, and audits

 - Support the maintenance and continued build out of security compliance software

 - Help develop, revise, and maintain security policies, SPPs, and internal processes

 - Support physical security operations, including badging, visitor access, and secure storage

 - Assist with security briefings and presentations

 - Support ad hoc projects as the security program continues to grow and evolve

 - Creating and implementing new security processes for newly established secure facilities and environments

 - Direct support to government programs implementing industrial security requirements from SCI Nominations to building and reviewing DD-254s.




THIS ROLE IS A GREAT FIT IF YOU

 - Enjoy building structure where minimal processes currently exist

 - Are comfortable wearing multiple hats in a fast-paced environment

 - Take pride in precision, compliance, and enabling mission success

 - Are confident in your industrial security knowledge and when you don’t know something, your response is, “I’ll find out.”




QUALIFICATIONS

Required:

 - U.S. Citizen

 - Active Top Secret clearance

 - High school diploma or higher

 - 2–4 years of DoD/DCSA security experience supporting an FSO or CSSO

 - Hands-on experience with DISS, NISS, SWFT, and NBIS

 - Working knowledge of the NISPOM 32 CFR Part 117 and DoD 5200 series manuals

 - Experience managing the full clearance lifecycle (initials, upgrades, reinvestigations)

 - Experience with the life cycle of employee security reporting

 - Experience with document control and the secure handling and transmittal of classified materials and data, including inventory management, secure shipping, and couriering of classified documents and physical media

 - Experience in DCSA incident reporting process

 - Experience working directly and professionally with program managers, customers, government partners, and vendors.

 - Strong attention to detail with excellent written and verbal communication skills

 - Ability to work independently and collaboratively

 - Experience building or scaling security processes in a growing organization

 - Experience completing a DCSA self-inspection

 - Experience in reviewing DD-254s to establish program security requirements

 - Complete the CDSE DCSA FSO Possessing Facilities Certification within six months of hire



Preferred:

 - CDSE DCSA FSO Possessing Facilities Certification

 - Active Top Secret clearance with CI Poly

 - Experience supporting DCSA Open Storage accreditations and annual inspections

 - Prior involvement in day-to-day SCIF operations

 - Experience working in a startup or small company environment during periods of rapid growth or major contract wins

 - Experience with SCI nominations and associated reporting requirements

 - Experience building sub-contractor DD-254s and flowing to customer

 - Experience implementing or scaling security software systems to support an Industrial       Security Program

 - Experience transitioning security requirements to a new facility.





WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

 - Successfully transition Industrial Security processes and day-to-day security operations to Quindar’s new facility.

 - Support the stand-up and operational readiness of new classified spaces

 - Take ownership of assigned Industrial Security functions while maintaining the ability to provide cross-functional support across the team.

 - Help build, document, and improve scalable security processes as Quindar’s classified programs and workforce grow.

 - Become a trusted security resource for employees, program teams, and internal stakeholders.

 - Proactively identify gaps, track actions through completion, and help keep security requirements from becoming program or operational blockers.

 - Develop strong working relationships with DCSA, government customers, and other external security stakeholders as applicable.

 - Successfully operate in a growing environment, balancing new program/facility development with day-to-day Industrial Security operations

jobs.title: VP, Marketing
jobs.description:
About the Company

Why We Built Lyric: Supply chains are more critical and complex than ever. Every day, large enterprises navigate trillions of possible decisions that could impact the bottom line. Powerful algorithms and AI can address these problems, yet most organizations struggle to leverage supply chain AI at scale. The current SCM technologies are either rigid, limited-scope point solutions or custom solutions built in-house, which demand immense expertise and investment.



That is…until now.



Enter Lyric: Lyric is an enterprise AI platform built specifically for supply chains, offering the best of both worlds:

 - Out-of-the-box AI solutions for optimizing networks, allocating inventory, scheduling routes, planning fulfillment capacity, promising orders, propagating demand, building predictions, analyzing scenarios, and more, plus

 - A platform-first approach that empowers both business and technical users with end-to-end product composability, leveraging no-code tools, their own code, or even forking our code to build and refine supply chain decision intelligence

With Lyric, enterprises no longer have to choose between flexibility and speed, they get both.



The Mission: We’re building a new era in supply chain with the team best equipped to lead it. With over 20 years at the intersection of supply chain and algorithms, we developed a deep conviction that global supply chains needed something like Lyric. Since our inception in December 2021, that conviction has been validated time and time again.



Today, a growing number of Fortune 500 companies, including Smurfit WestRock, Estée Lauder, Coca-Cola, and more, are innovating on their own terms with Lyric. We can’t wait to see what our customers, both current and future, are empowered to build with us next. Come build with us!

About the Role

Lyric is hiring a VP of Marketing to scale our marketing function as a core member of the GTM leadership team. This is a senior, high-ownership role for a strong generalist who can set strategy, build teams, and execute across the full marketing mix.

The right candidate has a proven track record at high-growth B2B SaaS or enterprise AI companies and knows how to market complex technical solutions to Fortune 500/1000 buyers, connect storytelling to revenue, and build the systems and teams needed to grow.



What You'll Do

 - Own Lyric's marketing execution across demand generation, field marketing, and content/brand, with a clear mandate to drive qualified pipeline and revenue growth

 - Build and lead a modern, always-on demand generation engine leveraging AI, automation, and data to optimize channel mix, targeting, and campaign performance across the funnel, with a sharp focus on enterprise buyers

 - Establish and evolve the marketing tech stack and data infrastructure, ensuring the right mix of tools for automation, lead scoring, content management, and reporting

 - Define the operating cadence for Marketing, including dashboards, forecasting, and business reviews,  and partner with Sales using pipeline math to align on goals, diagnose gaps, and drive accountability

 - Build, develop, and coach a high-performing marketing team; evaluate talent honestly, place people in positions to succeed, and hold the organization to a high bar

 - Manage external partners across PR, brand/creative, and digital to maximize quality and efficiency



About You

 - 10–15+ years of progressive marketing experience in B2B SaaS or enterprise AI/ML, with at least 5+ years building and leading marketing teams at high-growth companies

 - Strong generalist background spanning demand generation, product marketing, field marketing, and content/brand, with a proven ability to connect storytelling to revenue

 - Proven track record of marketing complex technical solutions to Fortune 500/1000 enterprises across the full buyer journey

 - Deep knowledge of B2B buyer journeys, marketing automation, and CRM systems (e.g., HubSpot); a modern marketer who embraces experimentation and stays ahead of emerging tools and tactics

 - Metrics-driven operator with a strong track record of hitting pipeline and revenue targets, and the budgeting and forecasting discipline to back it up

 - Demonstrated success managing and consolidating external partners across PR, creative, and digital

 - Excellent communicator and team builder who thrives in early-stage, high-visibility environments



Even if you don't meet 100% of the qualifications, we recommend applying to the role!

Location: Remote - US. Some travel is required.



Compensation: The annual on-target earnings for this role is $300K. Base cash will be determined based on years of experience, with an additional variable compensation that is earned based on individual & business performance. You will also receive equity in Lyric.

jobs.title: Department Manager-Oxmoor Center
jobs.description:
About the Role

As a Department Manager, you’ll be the leader supporting and encouraging your whole team. By bringing everyone together, you’ll be able to create an inclusive culture that promotes collaboration and an entrepreneurial spirit, helping you, your team, and H&M succeed. Ensuring an excellent operational & visual experience for your store, customers & colleagues. You’ll be aware of your store’s strengths, opportunities, and competitors. Analyze and follow up on sales, and create plans to optimize results and profits.

A Day in the Life

Working at H&M means no two days are ever the same, but a typical day will include the following responsibilities*

Customer Sales & Profit

• You are responsible for the total OMNI customer experience in your store, ensuring visual and commercial curation according to global guidelines
• Representing yourself and the H&M brand positively during customer interactions
• Be aware of and take responsibility of your department's strengths and identifying commercial opportunities and acting on them
• Establish & analyze sales and budget goals, creating plans to optimize results
• Ensure customer service is provided in all areas of the store and that your team has the ability to work towards actively promoting and selling products to customers
• Following up that your team is actively promoting our Customer Loyalty App (Hello Member) & in-store sustainability initiatives
• Manage your department in a cost-efficient way
• Ensure correct routines in fitting room and checkout, including transaction, returns and exchanges
• Ensure all admin routines for both people and operations are handled in a correct way

Fashion & Trend Awareness

• Keep up-to-date with fashion scene, trends, tendencies, styles, brands, products, competitors and relevant influencers, etc
• Ensure your team provides product and fashion knowledge as well as other relevant information during customer interactions

Team & Development

• Responsible for recruitment, onboarding, performance management, upskilling & developing your team in-store
• Complete performance evaluations and succession planning to support business & team needs
• Retain and share your knowledge and skills with your team
• Collaboration, planning & teamwork with in-store Visual Merchandiser team
• Give & receive feedback with your colleagues to learn, develop & support each other
• Responsible for the teams planning & scheduling
• Regular communication to store colleagues to inform, motivate and inspire – daily, weekly meetings, etc
• Ensure all procedures, routines, and legal requirements in all areas of the store are followed
• Participate in relevant available Onboarding & introduction processes, trainings and courses relevant for your role & future development

Retail Operations/ Visual & Commercial Execution

• Secure a clean and tidy sales floor and back of house including stockroom areas
• Ensure high fashion quality, visual and commercial product presentation, with good garment care
• Secure good stock levels and provide input on allocation to Area team
• Ensure the full garment cycle – from delivery to garment presentation – and fitting room routines are according to our standards and routines set internally, utilizing all tools and technology provided
• Upkeep & follow best practice for any in-store OMNI Services & in-store tech services/tools, etc (Instore Care App, Click & Collect, Smart Store etc)
• Secure a strong balance and the maintenance of price signs in-store and throughout the sales floor/store following guidelines according to global and local strategies & sales market/regional requirements to ensure a strong and consistent price perception throughout store
• Updating & upkeep of BOH Areas for all colleagues (key information, health & safety, tidiness etc)
• Responsible for opening & closing of store daily

Who You Are

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Full Stack
jobs.description:
ABOUT TESSERA LABS

Tessera Labs is redefining how enterprises adopt and operationalize Artificial Intelligence. Backed by Foundation Capital and led by a world-class founding team, we build multi-agent AI systems that automate complex business workflows across platforms such as SAP, Salesforce, Workday, Snowflake, MuleSoft, and more.

Our mission is to bring real AI automation to the enterprise—delivering speed, precision, and measurable impact. We operate with extreme ownership, move quickly, and build at the frontier of applied AI.

We're backed by Andreessen Horowitz and Foundation Capital, and built by leaders from Meta AI, Google Research, Microsoft AI, SAP, Oracle, and Salesforce. We move fast, operate with extreme ownership, and build at the frontier of applied AI. Our ethos in one line: enterprise serious, AI forward.




About the role

We're hiring a Full Stack Software Engineer to help build Tessera Mosaic, where AI agents work alongside people to transform how enterprises operate. You'll own meaningful product problems end to end, from intuitive interfaces for understanding and controlling agents to the data and backend systems that power them.

You'll work across product, design, data, and infrastructure, with significant ownership over both what we build and how we build it. If you enjoy turning ambiguous problems into polished products, working with complex enterprise data, and shaping an AI-native platform from an early stage, this role offers the opportunity to have an outsized impact.



What you'll do

 - Own ambiguous product and technical problems end to end: clarify the problem, investigate the underlying data and systems, propose an approach, align on tradeoffs, and ship.

 - Build data-intensive product features across the stack, from polished React experiences to APIs, data models, and backend services.

 - Build AI-native workflows that make agent behavior legible and controllable, including how users understand what an agent is doing, review its work, and intervene when needed.

 - Integrate with enterprise systems of record such as SAP, Salesforce, and Workday, navigating complex data models, APIs, and real-world edge cases.

 - Partner closely with product, design, and engineering to challenge assumptions, shape solutions, seek early feedback, and iteratively deliver real business value.

 - Help shape the technical foundations of the platform through thoughtful architecture, reusable abstractions, shared components, engineering conventions, code review, and technical discussions.

What we're looking for

 - Strong experience building production applications with React and TypeScript, paired with backend experience designing APIs and services in Node.js, Python, Java, or a comparable stack.

 - Strong data fundamentals and comfort working with relational data models, SQL, schemas, transformations, and the performance and reliability considerations of data-intensive applications.

 - The ability to take a feature from database to UI. You don't need to be equally deep everywhere, but you're comfortable moving across the stack and learning what you need along the way.

 - A track record of turning ambiguity into action: you define problems before solutions, ask good questions, make pragmatic tradeoffs, and iteratively ship rather than waiting for a perfect spec.

 - Strong product judgment. You seek to understand and challenge the "why," contribute ideas rather than simply implementing requirements, and balance speed with quality, security, and maintainability.

 - A collaborative, high-ownership approach. You communicate technical decisions clearly, contribute constructively to how the team designs and builds, and help other engineers do their best work.

Nice to have

 - Experience building AI-native or agentic products, including areas such as agent execution, tool use, observability, evaluations, or human-in-the-loop workflows.

 - Experience with ERP, CRM, HCM, or other complex systems of record, particularly SAP.

 - Experience working in fast-moving, early-stage environments and using modern AI-assisted development tools.


WHY TESSERA LABS

 - Build AI products that solve complex, real-world enterprise problems

 - Work at the intersection of AI, ERP systems, and automation

 - High ownership, high impact, and direct influence on product direction

 - Collaborate with a deeply technical and customer-focused team

No third party may recruit, solicit candidates, publish job opportunities, use Tessera Labs’ name or branding, or represent that they are acting on behalf of Tessera Labs without prior written authorization. Any such activity conducted without explicit written consent is strictly prohibited.

jobs.title: Staff Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
We're building a new system of record for finance, one that understands not just the numbers, but the business context behind them. At its core is our Operational Ledger: a financial data layer that preserves every event, calculation, policy, source, and decision behind the financials, rather than reducing them to contextless entries.



Questions that once took weeks to answer become as routine as a Google search: Why did margins change? Which customers are actually profitable? How are we tracking against budget? We're not bolting AI onto legacy software. Quanta was built from the ground up around granular financial data, flexible primitives, and systems that agents can safely understand and act on.



We've spent years closing the books for real, fast-growing companies and turning what we learn into product. We've already replaced much of what QuickBooks and NetSuite can do and the manual work surrounding them. Customers are now turning off legacy accounting systems and moving to Quanta.



We're still early. The problems are hard, the ambition is enormous, and there's no playbook for what we're building.




THE TEAM

We're a small, tight-knit team working together in person in downtown San Francisco. Our team brings together deep expertise in engineering and finance. We've built accounting systems at Affirm, ledgers at Stripe and Robinhood, launched products from 0→1, scaled infrastructure processing billions of dollars, built finance functions, and closed the books under real operating pressure.



We understand our customers because we have been in their shoes. Quanta's earliest product was built around a few principles we still value: get to learning as quickly as possible, find the simplest solution that works, and build alongside real users and real-world edge cases.



Quanta is for people who want ownership, prioritize learning and outcomes over conventional playbooks, and are comfortable figuring things out as they go. We move quickly, but we are building systems where correctness and trust matter deeply. That tension—moving fast while building durable foundations—is at the heart of the engineering problems we work on.



As a Staff Engineer on the Platform team, you'll work on the foundational systems that Quanta's product and engineering teams build on top of. You'll own problems where architecture, correctness, reliability, and developer leverage matter—and where the right abstraction can unlock an entire category of product capabilities.



You'll operate across team boundaries, identifying the technical investments that matter most and driving them from ambiguous problem to production.




WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 - 10+ years of software engineering experience, with significant experience building and owning complex backend, platform, or distributed systems in production.

 - Deep backend and distributed systems experience, particularly with systems where correctness, reliability, and data integrity matter.

 - Strong systems thinking, including API design, data modeling, system boundaries, failure modes, and operational tradeoffs.

 - Excellent technical judgment and the ability to distinguish between problems that require durable infrastructure and those where the simplest solution is the right one.

 - Strong debugging instincts and comfort working through difficult problems across application, data, and infrastructure layers.

 - Ability to create clarity from ambiguity and independently identify the highest-leverage technical problems to solve.

 - Strong communication and collaboration skills, particularly when translating complex technical tradeoffs for engineers and non-engineers.

 - A hands-on mindset. You want to design systems and build them.
   
   

Bonus points for experience with financial systems, ledgers, accounting infrastructure, data platforms, developer platforms, or other systems where correctness and auditability are critical. You are excited about working in person with a collaborative team in San Francisco.




THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR YOU IF…

 - You want a Staff role primarily focused on architecture, planning, or technical strategy rather than writing and operating production code.

 - You prefer clearly defined problems and established technical roadmaps rather than identifying what needs to be built.

 - You reach for sophisticated abstractions before understanding the underlying problem. We value durable systems, but we also value simplicity.

 - You optimize for speed by accepting known gaps in correctness or reliability. Trust matters deeply in the systems we build.

 - You are uncomfortable working in a complex, judgment-heavy domain where the right technical model requires understanding the underlying business context.

 - You think of platform engineering primarily as infrastructure or developer tooling. Our platform sits directly underneath the product and the financial systems our customers rely on.

 - You are primarily interested in AI as a standalone feature rather than building the systems, constraints, and primitives that make AI useful and trustworthy.

 - You prefer working independently or remotely from product engineers and domain experts. This team works closely and in person by design.


WHY QUANTA

Build a category, not just features. We're not selling a slightly better version of an established tool. We're changing what companies should expect from their financial systems.

Join early enough to matter. We're a small team. The things you discover, build, and prove can become part of how Quanta sells for years.

Learn directly from exceptional people. You'll work alongside founders, engineers, and finance leaders who have built financial infrastructure and operated finance functions firsthand.

Grow with the company. We're looking for someone who wants to master outbound, take on increasing ownership, and help us build the sales organization that comes next.





BENEFITS

 - Competitive early-stage salary

 - Competitive early-stage equity

 - Health, dental, and vision insurance

 - 401(k)

 - Take-what-you-need paid vacation

 - Commuter benefits

 - Wellness stipend

 - Paid lunches and dinners in the office

 - All the equipment and tools you need to do your best work

jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist
jobs.description:
Senior Data Scientist

Greater Boston Area

Company Description

Newton Research is a fast-growing software start-up founded by repeat entrepreneurs and well-funded by blue chip venture capital firms. We are building the next generation of the closed loop media lifecycle, developing AI agents that leverage the latest in LLMs and generative AI with specialized knowledge. Our products generate actionable business insights for our customers and partners, assisting in each step of the media planning, buying and measurement lifecycle. Can we talk about success to date?

Role Description

This is a full-time Senior Data Scientist role with Newton Research, Inc., working from our offices in Needham, MA (hybrid, in office 2-3 days per week). You will develop production-level models and algorithms, analyze data, design experiments, and interpret results. More importantly, you will work with engineering to encode those abilities into software and train Newton to think like a data scientist. The data science team is small, so your work reaches customers quickly and your judgment shapes the product. We value self-motivated individuals who collaborate well across teams and can present and defend findings to stakeholders. At this level you take ownership of ambiguous, open-ended problems, scoping them yourself and deciding how they should be answered.

Responsibilities

• Build production-level models and algorithms for media planning, audience, measurement and yield problems

• Design and interpret experiments, including deciding what a result does and does not support

• Own problems end to end, from scoping the question to defending the answer to customers

• Work with engineering to encode your judgment into Newton's agents

• Build the evals and benchmarks that tell us whether an agent's analysis is correct, not just plausible, and set the methods the team uses as it grows

Qualifications

Master's or PhD in a quantitative field such as Mathematics, Physics, Statistics, Computer Science, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience

• 5+ years of experience in data science or applied statistics

• Deep working knowledge of statistical modeling, causal inference and machine learning, and the judgment to know which one a problem calls for

• Ability to evaluate a model, a causal experiment, or an AI-generated analysis and identify what it measures, where it fails, and how to verify it

• Proficiency in Python, including data science libraries like pandas and scikit-learn, and writing code that ships to production

• Strong SQL and experience with cloud data platforms such as Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks, or Redshift

• Ability to clearly explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences

• Experience in media, marketing, advertising, or related industries

Base Salary Range: $175,000-$195,000 + Equity

jobs.title: Director, Expansion & Powered Admin Services
jobs.description:
ABOUT JUNIPER SQUARE

Private markets are one of the largest, most complex, and most underserved corners of global finance. Our mission at Juniper Square is to unlock their full potential. We’re the Operations Partner trusted by 2,300+ GPs, unifying technology, data, and fund administration services into a single platform that helps GPs move faster, make better decisions, and scale with precision. With $300B+ under administration and 700,000+ LPs on platform, we’ve built the scale to match our ambition. And with JunieAI, our purpose-built AI platform, we’re reimagining how private markets operate, embedding intelligence across every workflow. Founder-led since 2014, backed by $350M+ in funding, and now 1,000+ employees strong, we’re building a company designed to shape the future of private markets for decades to come.

Our culture is built for people who want to do ambitious, meaningful work alongside exceptionally talented teammates. We think like owners, move with urgency, and take pride in solving hard problems that truly matter to our customers and the future of private markets. We believe the best ideas come from open debate, deep collaboration, and diverse perspectives, which is why we believe transparency is the default and feedback makes us stronger. If you’re energized by high standards, rapid growth, and the opportunity to help define a category at a pivotal moment, come join us!

Juniper Square offers employees a variety of ways to work, ranging from a fully remote experience to working full-time in one of our physical offices. We invest heavily in digital-first https://blog.junipersquare.com/juniper-square-ponders-future-of-office-with-digital-first-hybrid-workplace-strategy/ operations, allowing our teams to collaborate effectively across 27 U.S. states, 2 Canadian Provinces, India, Luxembourg, and England. We also have physical offices in San Francisco, New York City, Mumbai and Bangalore for employees who prefer to work in an office some or all of the time.




ABOUT YOUR ROLE

Juniper Square serves more than 2,200 GP customers, and most of them use a fraction of what we offer. We are standing up a dedicated expansion organization to change that, and we are looking for a Director of Expansion & Powered Admin Services to lead it.

The role carries two connected mandates. The first is the expansion motion across our installed base: cross-selling GPX products into GPX customers, into our Fund Administration client base, and Fund Administration into self-administered accounts. The second is Powered Admin Services, an emerging channel in which third-party fund administrators license or white-label Juniper Square technology, creating distribution to their GP clients at near-zero acquisition cost. Early partner conversations are underway; you will turn them into structured pilots and then into a repeatable channel.

Reporting to the Head of Sales, you will lead a team of dedicated expansion sellers, the first of whom is already in seat, and you will partner daily with our Fund Administration organization, Customer Success, Revenue Operations, Partnerships, and the asset-class sales leaders whose sellers hold commercial ownership of accounts in their first year.

This is a build role. The lead flow, the qualification bar, the whitespace and wallet-share analysis, the account-handoff enforcement, and the channel playbook do not yet exist in systematic form. Our working thesis is that a majority of expansion quota is attainable from strategic accounts we already serve. Nobody has tested that claim against data. You will.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

Carry the number

 - Own and deliver an expansion ARR quota as a working seller, not solely through a team. Run your own deals, in your own accounts, from day one.

 - Build and own the pipeline from the installed base rather than waiting for it to be routed to you.

Define the expansion motion

 - Come in and assess: what's actually there, what's sellable now, and where the real ceiling is. Turn the whitespace analysis into graded, prioritized account plans.

 - Build the wallet-share and whitespace program — categorize penetration targets, trust-building accounts, and structurally blocked accounts, and keep that intelligence current in Salesforce.

 - Set the qualification bar and build the plays per product, so the motion is repeatable rather than dependent on individual heroics.

 - Operationalize lead flow from the installed base: client signals surfaced by Fund Administration and Customer Success (fund launch plans, DDQ cycles, product usage) logged where sellers can act on them.

 - Define the adoption-first play: drive usage and training on technology clients already own as the door-opener, with paid expansion as the follow-on.

Scope Powered Admin Services

 - Size the market. How many fund administrators are realistic targets, what do they run today, and what would make them move.

 - Identify the buyer and the entry point. Run the first conversations and the first deals yourself.

 - Define what we're actually selling, in partnership with Product and Fund Administration leadership: the packaging, the boundaries, and what we will and won't support in a white-label arrangement.

 - Bring back an honest recommendation on whether this warrants a dedicated seller, and when.

Build the team

 - Partner with the seller already in seat to define the motion together, then hire and ramp behind it as volume justifies.

 - Own ramp plans, pipeline reviews, and MEDDPICC-based deal coaching. Define the book or territory split between sellers.

 - Run the volume analysis that justifies the next seat rather than assuming it.

Work the seams

 - Build a real operating cadence with Customer Success (Enterprise, Mid-Market & Growth), Fund Administration relationship managers, and the asset-class sales leaders whose sellers hold commercial ownership of accounts in their first year.

 - Enforce clean account-ownership rules: ownership windows, AE-to-expansion handoffs at the end of the window, the competitive-account exception path, and no passive compensation anywhere.

 - Feed Marketing the segments and signals that expansion campaigns need: DDQ plays, K-1 season plays, fund-launch triggers.

Report and refine

 - Own the expansion dashboard: pipeline created from the installed base, expansion ARR closed, attach rates by product, time-to-first-expansion, and adoption-to-paid conversion.

 - Bring model corrections to sales leadership quarterly — which routing rules are wrong, where the rules of engagement need amending, and whether the expansion and Powered Admin Services theses are holding.

Use AI as core infrastructure

 - Treat AI as central to how this function runs, not a side project. Build whitespace scoring, account-plan generation, and signal detection with our internal tooling rather than staffing them manually.

 - Redesign the work rather than adopt tools. The measure is workload that no longer requires a person, not software we've licensed.
   
   


QUALIFICATIONS

 - 8+ years in SaaS or fintech revenue roles with meaningful time in expansion or installed-base selling, and a track record of carrying and hitting a quota. We're open to candidates who've done this from inside Customer Success or from inside Sales — what matters is that you've owned a number.

 - Experience building a land-and-expand or installed-base motion, ideally more than once: usage-based lead scoring, adoption-first selling, and cross-functional selling through Customer Success and services teams.

 - People-leadership experience, including building a small team from zero, with the willingness to stay hands-on in deals while you do it.

 - Player-coach operating style. Roughly 10% strategy, 90% execution. You will be in accounts, not above them.

 - Comfortable in ambiguity. One of your two motions does not exist yet, and the other inherits rules that are still being reconciled. You'll need to run both while policy catches up.

 - Fluent in Salesforce as the operating system for the motion, and able to define requirements for RevOps and data tooling.

 - Demonstrated use of AI to create real efficiency in a revenue organization — workflow redesign, not tool adoption alone.

Strong plus

 - Experience selling technology to fund administrators, or from inside a company that does. A Customer Success or expansion background at a SaaS business serving fund administrators is close to the ideal profile here. We are not requiring it, and we will happily teach the Powered Admin Services side to a strong expansion leader.

 - Private markets experience, or experience selling financial technology at scale into institutional buyers. Credibility with a GP's CFO or controller goes a long way here.

 - Exposure to selling alongside a services organization, where margin, capacity, and delivery constraints shape the deal.

 - Experience standing up a white-label, OEM, or powered-by partnership motion.
   
   


COMPENSATION

Compensation for this position includes a base salary, commission, equity, and a variety of benefits. The U.S. base salary range for this role is $160,000 - $200,000. Actual base salaries will be based on candidate-specific factors, including experience, skillset, and location, and local minimum pay requirements as applicable.



Benefits include:

 - Health, dental, and vision care for you and your family

jobs.title: Senior Recruiter
jobs.description:
THE ROLE

Vox Media is looking for a Senior Recruiter to own full-cycle hiring for editorial (New York Magazine & Vox), podcast (Vox Media Podcast Network), revenue, and operations roles across the company.

This is a role for someone who has run full-cycle recruiting before, is comfortable being a trusted advisor to hiring managers (including senior ones), and genuinely enjoys the craft of matching talented people to the right opportunity, especially in a media environment where roles and needs can shift quickly.

Candidates should be fans of New York Magazine, Vox, and our podcast network.

This is a permanent, full-time position. This job is benefits-eligible. We pride ourselves in providing comprehensive benefits to support all of our employees wherever they are in life.

This job is located in our New York City office.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Manage full-cycle recruiting — intake, sourcing, screening, interview coordination, offer, and close — for a portfolio of roles spanning editorial, podcast/audio, revenue, and operations functions.

• Partner with hiring managers and senior leaders to scope open roles, build hiring plans, and act as a strategic advisor throughout the search.

• Build and maintain proactive, representative talent pipelines through sourcing, referrals, and passive-candidate outreach, rather than relying solely on inbound applications.

• Deliver a high-touch candidate experience that reflects well on Vox Media — timely communication, clear expectations, and thoughtful follow-through.

• Structure and run consistent, bias-aware interview processes, including writing job scorecards and coaching interviewers on effective, legally sound interviewing.

• Manage multiple concurrent searches with competing timelines, keeping hiring managers and candidates aligned without dropping the details.

• Own offer strategy and negotiation in partnership with People leadership, balancing candidate expectations with internal equity and approved compensation bands.

• Track and report on pipeline health, time-to-fill, and other recruiting metrics, and use that data to flag risks and recommend adjustments.

• Stay current on the media, journalism, and podcasting talent landscape, and bring market insight back to hiring teams.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

• A passion for the art of talent acquisition — aka you love what you do.

• You're a genuine fan of our brands and shows — and you actually consume them.

• 6+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience (strong preference for in-house) — you have a strong track record for closing candidates. Specifically, experience recruiting editorial, creative, and audio/podcast talent.

• You strive for a positive candidate experience — each open role builds on your ability to grow the talent network.

• Strong sourcing skills — you don't wait for the perfect candidate to apply; you go find them.

• Stakeholder management is second nature for you — you feel confident advising and pushing back constructively on hiring managers, including senior leaders.

• You know that diverse slates alone don't move the needle — you build hiring processes that are equitable by design, from first outreach to final offer.

• Excellent organizational skills — you can run a busy, varied req load without letting candidates or hiring managers fall through the cracks.

• Systems expertise — you feel comfortable managing an ATS and partnering with the Head of People to build recruiting process.

• Clear, warm, and timely communication — you represent Vox Media to every candidate you talk to, whether they're hired or not.

PAY TRANSPARENCY

The salary range listed below represents the minimum and maximum base pay for this position at the time of this posting. Final salary offered to the candidate selected for the position will be based on factors including but not limited to the candidate's skills and experience.

Pay Range

$100,000—$125,000 USD

OUR DEI COMMITMENT

Vox Media is committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone can show up as their authentic selves and create their best work. We recognize that great stories, platforms, products and services come from people with all manner of backgrounds and experiences. We recognize that our commitments require ongoing work and sustained attention, as well as adaptation to new insights and best practices.

Vox Media is an Equal Opportunity Employer and qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, religion, disability, national origin, protected veteran status, age, or any other status protected by applicable national, federal, state, or local law. Vox Media will also consider all qualified applicants with criminal histories in accordance with applicable Fair Chance laws. We are also committed to providing reasonable accommodations as part of the application process to candidates with disabilities. If you require a reasonable accommodation as part of the application process, please contact our recruiting team (recruitment@voxmedia.com).

WHAT COMES NEXT

Our recruiting team will go through applications in a timely manner. Please note that our recruiting team will only contact you from @voxmedia.com email addresses, never via text message. Read more about how our recruiting team operates, and how to protect yourself from recruitment fraud, here.
