jobs.title: Junior QA Automation
jobs.description:
Are you curious, motivated, and forward-thinking? At FIS, you’ll have the opportunity to support the coordination and delivery of meaningful projects that connect financial services with modern technology. Our talented people empower us, and we believe in being part of a team that is open, collaborative, entrepreneurial, passionate, and above all, fun.

About the team

You will be part of our QA and Test Services (QATS) team, supporting quality engineering initiatives for critical client applications. In this role, you will contribute to Manual, Functional, and Automation testing practices across delivery teams, working closely with QA leads, SDETs, engineering, and business stakeholders. You will help execute test strategy, improve product quality, and support reliable releases through well-planned testing and CI/CD-aligned automation.

What you will be doing

• Analyze business and functional requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria to identify test conditions, scenarios, and edge cases.

• Perform Manual and Functional testing across application components, services, and end-to-end business flows, including smoke, sanity, regression, integration, and UAT support.

• Prepare, review, and maintain high-quality test cases, test scenarios, and test data with clear steps, expected results, and coverage mapping.

• Execute test cases (manual and automated), log defects with clear reproduction steps, track them to closure, and share concise test execution and status reports.

• Manage test artifacts in Jira and Zephyr — create and run test cycles, link test cases to stories and defects, and maintain traceability from requirement → test case → execution → defect.

• Participate in requirement walkthroughs, sprint planning, daily stand-ups, defect triage, and release readiness reviews.

• Perform API testing across REST, SOAP, and RPC interfaces using tools such as Postman or Bruno, and validate request/response payloads, status codes, and business rules.

• Contribute to Automation testing by building and maintaining automated tests for Web Applications and Web Services using Playwright, Selenium, and related tools in Java/C#.

• Support Unit Test practices with clear code coverage and meaningful assertions where applicable.

• Help integrate automated tests into DevOps pipelines and CI tools (for example Jenkins/Bamboo) under guidance of senior team members.

• Identify candidates for automation from the existing manual regression suite and convert them progressively.

• Apply object-oriented programming principles using Java/C# when writing or maintaining automation code.

• Follow coding standards, SDLC best practices, and quality engineering guidelines consistently.

• Analyze system behavior and troubleshoot issues across UI, API, and data layers with strong problem-solving skills.

• Document test strategy inputs, reusable test patterns, and lessons learned for wider team adoption.

• Collaborate with QA and engineering teams to establish test cases, test data, and environment readiness across environments.

• Support quality-focused infrastructure and operational documentation.

• Assist in building and integrating GenAI, LLM, and Agentic AI solutions to accelerate QA activities such as test case generation, test data creation, and defect analysis.

• Explore emerging technologies such as MCP, multi-agent systems, and AI-assisted testing to improve delivery outcomes.

• Identify recurring issues and process gaps, and apply AI-assisted solutions where appropriate.

What you bring

• 2+ years of relevant work experience in software quality engineering, covering Manual, Functional, and Automation testing.

• Strong hands-on experience in Manual and Functional testing — requirement analysis, test case design, test data preparation, execution, and defect lifecycle management.

• Practical working experience with Jira and Zephyr (or equivalent test management tools) for test case preparation, test cycle execution, defect tracking, and requirement traceability.

• 2+ years of hands-on experience in API testing (REST, SOAP, RPC) using Postman, Bruno, or similar tools.

• 2+ years of hands-on Automation Testing experience with frameworks such as Selenium, Playwright, XUnit, or NUnit.

• Working programming skills in Java/C#/Python with understanding of object-oriented programming fundamentals.

• Working knowledge of DevOps and Continuous Integration tooling.

• Good knowledge of XML and HTML.

• Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and communication skills (verbal and written English).

• Ability to learn new technologies quickly and work effectively across functional teams.

• Basic understanding of architecture design concepts and software development lifecycle processes.

• Exposure to GenAI, LLMs, Prompt Engineering, RAG, or Agentic AI concepts.

• Practical use of GitHub Copilot for faster and higher-quality delivery across test cases, test data, and automation.

• Curiosity and willingness to learn, evaluate, and apply emerging AI technologies responsibly.

Added Bonus if you have

• Experience in financial services or payment domain.

• Familiarity with ISO 8583 message format.

• Exposure to BDD/TSS frameworks such as Cucumber or SpecFlow.

• Awareness of code coverage/quality tools such as SonarQube.

• Exposure to C#, Java, Python, Oracle PL/SQL, Postman, or Bruno.

• Hands-on experience with JavaScript, PowerShell, CSS, or related test automation ecosystem tools.

What We Offer You :

• An exciting opportunity to be part of the world’s leading FinTech product organization.

• A vibrant team environment and the opportunity to build a career in the core banking/payments domain.

• Competitive salary and attractive benefits including GHMI/Hospitalization coverage for employees and dependents.

• A multifaceted role with a high degree of responsibility and a wide range of opportunities.

• A broad range of professional education and personal development possibilities – FIS is your final career step

Privacy Statement

FIS is committed to protecting the privacy and security of all personal information that we process in order to provide services to our clients. For specific information on how FIS protects personal information online, please see the Online Privacy Notice.

Sourcing Model

Recruitment at FIS works primarily on a direct sourcing model; a relatively small portion of our hiring is through recruitment agencies. FIS does not accept resumes from recruitment agencies which are not on the preferred supplier list and is not responsible for any related fees for resumes submitted to job postings, our employees, or any other part of our company.

jobs.title: Analista de Segurança Operacional Jr | Junior Operational Safety Analyst
jobs.description:
Job Description:

English Version:

Airbus is a leader in designing, manufacturing and delivering aerospace products, services and solutions to customers on a worldwide scale, pioneering sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world.

With over 45 years of presence, Airbus is expanding its footprint in Latin America through 1,500 employees and different strategic sites. As a key sourcing partner with a 500-aircraft backlog, the company maintains a deep-rooted commitment to the region's long-term growth.

Helibras, the only helicopter manufacturer in Latin America and an Airbus subsidiary, is the rotary-wing market leader across civil, executive, and defense segments. Its operations span from assembly and customization to high-complexity maintenance. As a benchmark in aerospace engineering and a strategic regional asset, its infrastructure ensures rapid operational response for demanding missions.

Will you join us in redefining the limits of what is possible?

✈️🚁🚀

Key responsibilities:

• Assist in monitoring and managing the operational routines of the Safety Management System (SMS).
• Consolidate and analyze operational safety performance indicators (KPIs/SPIs) to prepare management reports.
• Support the conduct of internal and external operational safety audits.
• Assist in controlling, reviewing, and maintaining up-to-date manuals and regulatory documentation in compliance with relevant authorities (ANAC/RBACs).
• Lead the receipt, screening, logging, and investigation support for Operational Safety Reports (RSO/RELPREV).
• Monitor the development and effectiveness of Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) plans.
• Support the organization and execution of training initiatives, campaigns, and events aimed at strengthening the organization's safety culture.
• Ensure continuous communication with the operations team, reporting occurrences relevant to technical and operational routines.
• Manage, correct, and report data on productive activities, ensuring the consistency and integrity of operational information.
• Consolidate and maintain up-to-date records of technical qualifications and training for personnel involved in operational/technical routines.
• Identify opportunities for continuous improvement in processes under their responsibility, contributing to innovation and safety initiatives.
• Assist the manager in preparing and monitoring the department's annual budget (OPEX, CAPEX, and PAT), ensuring control over approved investments.
• Consolidate and analyze financial data for the area's cost center (budget, actuals, and forecast), monitoring any variances.
• Manage costs associated with the department's activities and assist in analyzing variances by business line.
• Process and track general purchase and service requests to meet the needs of the SMS department.

Requirements:

• Bachelor's degree in Engineering (Aeronautical, Production, Mechanical, or related fields), Aeronautical Sciences, or Civil Aviation.
• Mastery of the concepts and pillars of the Safety Management System (SMS).
• Knowledge of Civil Aviation standards and regulations (ANAC / applicable RBACs).
• Intermediate/advanced proficiency in the Microsoft Office Suite (Excel for analyzing safety indicators and statistics).
• Internal candidates, please pay attention to the golden rule.

Preferred qualifications:

• Previous experience or internship in the aviation sector (helicopter/aircraft manufacturing, RBAC 135/121 operators, or RBAC 145 maintenance facilities).
• Practical knowledge of risk analysis and root cause analysis tools (CAPA, 5 Whys, Ishikawa diagram).
• Intermediate to advanced English proficiency for reading aviation and regulatory documentation.

What are we offering?

• Permanent contract.
• Working hours from Monday to Friday from 7 a.m. to 5:07 p.m.
• On-site in Itajubá (Minas Gerais)
• Health & Wellbeing: Comprehensive Medical and Dental Insurance, Enhanced Life Policy, and Wellhub (Gympass).
• Daily Conveniences: Food Vouchers, and chartered company transportation.
• Financial & Long-Term Rewards: Annual Profit-Sharing Plan (PPR) and Airbus Employee Share Ownership Plan (ESOP).

---------------

Versão em português:

A Airbus é líder no projeto, na fabricação e na entrega de produtos, serviços e soluções aeroespaciais para clientes em todo o mundo, sendo pioneira em uma aviação sustentável para um mundo seguro e unido.

Com mais de 45 anos de presença, a Airbus vem ampliando sua atuação na América Latina, contando com cerca de 1.500 colaboradores e diversas unidades estratégicas. Como parceira fundamental do setor e com uma carteira de pedidos de 500 aeronaves, a empresa mantém um compromisso sólido com o crescimento da região a longo prazo.

A Helibras, única fabricante de helicópteros da América Latina e subsidiária da Airbus, é líder no mercado de asas rotativas nos segmentos civil, executivo e de defesa. Suas operações abrangem desde a montagem e personalização até a manutenção de alta complexidade. Como referência em engenharia aeroespacial e um ativo regional estratégico, sua infraestrutura garante uma resposta operacional rápida para missões de alta exigência.

Você quer se juntar a nós para redefinir os limites do que é possível?

✈️🚁🚀

Principais responsabilidades:

• Auxiliar no acompanhamento e nas rotinas operacionais do Sistema de Gerenciamento da Segurança Operacional (SGSO/SMS).
• Consolidar e analisar indicadores de desempenho de segurança operacional (KPIs/SPIs) para elaboração de reportes e relatórios gerenciais.
• Dar suporte à realização de auditorias internas e externas de segurança operacional.
• Apoiar o controle, a revisão e a manutenção atualizada dos manuais e documentações regulatórias junto aos órgãos competentes (ANAC/RBACs).
• Liderar o recebimento, triagem, registro e suporte na investigação de Relatos de Segurança Operacional (RSO) / RELPREV (Relatório de Prevenção) .
• Acompanhar a elaboração e a eficácia dos Planos de Ação Corretiva e Preventiva (CAPA).
• Apoiar a organização e execução de iniciativas de treinamento, campanhas e eventos focados no fortalecimento da Cultura de Segurança da organização.
• Garantir a comunicação contínua com a equipe de operações, reportando ocorrências relevantes para a rotina técnica e operacional.
• Realizar o controle, correção e reporte dos apontamentos das atividades produtivas, assegurando a consistência e integridade das informações operacionais.
• Consolidar e manter atualizadas as informações de qualificação técnica e capacitação dos colaboradores envolvidos nas rotinas operacionais/técnicas.
• Identificar oportunidades de melhoria contínua nos processos sob sua responsabilidade, contribuindo com iniciativas de inovação e segurança.
• Apoiar o gestor na elaboração e no acompanhamento do orçamento anual do departamento (OPEX, CAPEX e PAT), garantindo o controle dos investimentos aprovados.
• Consolidar e analisar as informações financeiras do centro de custo da área (budget, realizado e forecast), monitorando eventuais desvios.
• Realizar o controle dos custos associados às atividades da assessoria e apoiar a apuração de variações por linha de negócio.
• Lançar e acompanhar solicitações de compras gerais e de serviços para atendimento das demandas do setor de SGSO.

Requisitos:

• Ensino Superior completo em Engenharia (Aeronáutica, Produção, Mecânica ou áreas correlatas), Ciências Aeronáuticas ou Aviação Civil.
• Domínio dos conceitos e pilares do Sistema de Gerenciamento da Segurança Operacional (SGSO / SMS).
• Conhecimento das normas e regulamentações da Aviação Civil (ANAC / RBACs aplicáveis).
• Pacote Office intermediário/avançado (Excel para análise de indicadores e estatísticas de segurança).
• Candidatos internos, por favor, atentem-se à "regra de ouro".

Diferenciais:

• Vivência ou estágio prévio no segmento aeronáutico (indústria de helicópteros/aeronaves, empresas operadoras RBAC 135/121 ou oficinas de manutenção RBAC 145).
• Conhecimento prático em ferramentas de análise de risco e causa-raiz (CAPA, 5 Porquês, Diagrama de Ishikawa).
• Inglês Intermediário/Avançado para leitura de documentação aeronáutica e regulatória.

O que nós oferecemos?

• Contrato: CLT (Prazo Indeterminado).
• Jornada de Trabalho: Segunda a sexta-feira, das 07h às 17h07.
• Modelo de Atuação: Presencial em Itajubá (Minas Gerais).

• Conveniências do Dia a Dia: Vale Alimentação e Transporte Fretado pela empresa.
• Incentivos Financeiros e de Longo Prazo: Programa de Participação nos Lucros e Resultados (PPR) e Plano de Ações para Colaboradores Airbus (ESOP).

jobs.title: Enterprise Insight Lead
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections,  where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

Enterprise Insight lead

Drive an integrated, enterprise-wide insight engine by unifying patient, customer, and commercial data (Roche Performance)  into one coherent strategic narrative. Enable high-quality, data-driven decision making that accelerates patient access, business performance, and organisational impact.

This role blends:

• Breakthrough Patient Impact (Patient Funnel & OOP Access Barriers)
• Breakthrough Access Business Case
• Enterprise & Advanced Insight Integration to shape key decisions for growth, performance, and strategic prioritisation.

Understand patient value and investment requirements for each breakthrough opportunity. Analyse across portfolio to guide the DA on optimisation patient opportunity

Build integrated insight across all business units and patient-support initiatives. Customer Insight

• Integrate all CX signals across touchpoints to create a unified customer storyline. Turn Customer insights to proposed actionable item to DA team
• Serve as the point of contact for APAC & Global insight-related initiatives and frameworks.

Roche Performance

• Working closely with FEP on bringing Roche performance (Planned & Actual) to integrate with overall insight

Organisational Insight & Enterprise Analytics,  In partnership with the Head of BE to..

-   Build and continuously refine the organisation’s strategic planning process and shift focus to accelerate commercialisation.

-   Understand organisational priorities and key indicators of success, breakthrough areas, and convert them into forward-looking insights

-  Integrate organisational insights with sales metrics (volume/value), performance drivers, portfolio trends, and channel mix implications to form a full enterprise performance picture.

What Success Looks Like

• Insights become the unified source of truth for enterprise decisions.
• Catch Up breakthrough areas to drive business impact
• Leadership relies on this role for clarity, prioritisation, and strategic foresight.
• Patient, customer, and organisational insights merge into a single, powerful narrative.
• Recommendations lead to measurable improvements in channel performance, programme impact, and patient access.
• Business teams shift from reactive to data-driven and proactive.

Experience & Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree, an advanced degree in MBA is a plus

Skills & Competencies

Who we are

A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Engineering Advisor - Reliability

Do you have a passion for delivering all types of reliability solutions?

Do you enjoy overseeing projects and managing multiple priorities?

Partner with the best

Baker Hughes stands as a leading global energy technology company, delivering innovative solutions that make energy safer, cleaner, and more efficient across the entire value chain. Operating in more than 120 countries, the company blends deep industrial expertise with advanced engineering and digital technologies to support energy production, transformation, and decarbonization. With over a century of heritage, Baker Hughes partners with customers in oil and gas, industrial sectors, and emerging energy markets to accelerate progress toward a more sustainable energy future

Fuel your passion

Engineering Advisor – Reliability applies deep expertise in reliability practices to independently deliver client solutions and advise on Baker Hughes reliability methodologies. This role drives innovation, continuous capability improvement, and the adoption of emerging technologies. As a recognized subject matter expert, you will lead by example, support others’ growth, and proactively strengthen Baker Hughes’ strategic position as a global leader in reliability solutions.

As an Engineering Advisor - Reliability, you will be responsible for:

• Lead and facilitate structured problem solving sessions using Root Cause Analysis (RCA) methodologies.

• Conduct and ensure the effective application of Reliability Studies utilizing various reliability tools, including but not limited to FMECA, Life Cycle Cost (LCC) analysis, and RCA.

• Manage, analyze, and interpret reliability data with strong data handling and IT capabilities to support decision making.

• Provide project management and administrative oversight, ensuring initiatives are delivered according to scope and objectives.

• Effectively manage time, budgets, and deliverables to meet project and business requirements.

• Actively support and contribute to business development activities, including client engagements and solution development.

• Coach and mentor team members to strengthen capability and knowledge in reliability engineering practices.

• Deliver training programs on Reliability Methods for client inhouse sessions and public seminars focused on Asset Strategy Management.

To be successful in this role you will:

• Have Master’s Degree in Engineering Discipline or 15 years of Maintenance and/or Reliability experience.

• Have experience in the application of reliability methods and techniques gained within relevant industry.

• Have experience in data analysis including extraction from various data sources the ability to summarize data into conclusions.

• Have experience in leading multi-disciplined groups in the facilitation of problem solving and/or process / maintenance improvement studies.

• Have strong commercial acumen and experience in project leadership and execution.

Work in a way that works for you

We recognize that everyone is different and that the way in which people want to work and deliver at their best is different for everyone too. In this role, we can offer the following flexible working patterns:

• Working remotely from home or any other work location

• Working flexible hours - flexing the times when you work in the day to help you fit everything in and work when you are the most productive

Working with us

Our people are at the heart of what we do at Baker Hughes. We know we are better when all of our people are developed, engaged and able to bring their whole authentic selves to work. We invest in the health and well-being of our workforce, train and reward talent and develop leaders at all levels to bring out the best in each other.

Working for you

Our inventions have revolutionized energy for over a century. But to keep going forward tomorrow, we know we must push the boundaries today. We prioritize rewarding those who embrace change with a package that reflects how much we value their input. Join us, and you can expect:

• Contemporary work-life balance policies and wellbeing activities

• Comprehensive private medical care options

• Safety net of life insurance and disability programs

• Tailored financial programs

• Additional elected or voluntary benefits

The Baker Hughes internal title for this role is: Engineering Senior Specialist  - Reliability

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections,  where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Roche in 50 Worten

Eine gesündere Zukunft. Das treibt uns an, innovativ zu sein.  Wir bringen die Wissenschaft voran, damit alle die Gesundheitsversorgung erhalten, die benötigt wird.

Wir schaffen eine Welt, in der wir alle mehr Zeit mit den Menschen verbringen können, die wir lieben.

Das macht uns zu Roche.

Die Abteilung - Wir in EFG

Im Standort Management Mannheim/Penzberg, sind wir gut 1'300 Spezialisten für verschiedenste Infrastruktur- und Professional-Services, die diese für die Standorte Mannheim und Penzberg zur Verfügung stellen. In einem dynamischen Umfeld fördern wir die nahtlose Zusammenarbeit über Geschäftsbereiche und Funktionen hinweg, bieten innovative Lösungen
und verbessern die Arbeitsumgebung der Mitarbeitenden an den Standorten Mannheim und Penzberg - wo wir die Zukunft aktiv gestalten.
In dieser Funktion bist Du Teil von Site Operations und gehörst dem Team Media & Piping PZ Penzberg an. Die neue Organisationsstruktur findest Du auch auf der GSite.

Verantwortlichkeiten | Das erwartet Dich

Unser Mandat im Team „Media & Piping Penzberg “ zielt auf die Wiederherstellung der Funktionalität und Betriebsbereitschaft unserer Produktionsanlagen ab, um eine höchstmögliche Anlagenverfügbarkeit zu gewährleisten. In unserem Aufgabengebiet arbeiten wir im engen Schulterschluss mit internen technischen Gewerken sowie Fremdfirmen zusammen, um gemeinsam die ununterbrochene Versorgung der Patientinnen und Patienten mit Medikamenten und Diagnostika sicherzustellen.

Hierbei liegt unser Fokus auf der mechanischen Instandhaltung sowie auf Umbau- und Reparaturmaßnahmen an produktions- und prozesstechnischen Anlagen. Um diese Mission bestmöglich zu erfüllen, suchen wir einen motivierten Schweißfachmann (m/w/d), der es versteht, durch Teamgeist, Respekt und Vertrauen unseren Leistungen ein Gesicht zu geben.
Du verstärkst unser Team bei den folgenden Aufgaben:

• Konzeption & Planung: Du erstellst Konzepte, planst und bereitest technische Leistungen unter Berücksichtigung des anerkannten Stands der Technik sowie aller relevanten DIN/ISO- und GMP-Richtlinien vor.
• Instandhaltung & Abwicklung: Du übernimmst die Verantwortung für die Planung, Vorbereitung und Abwicklung von Wartungs-, Reparatur- und Umbauaufträgen.
• Störungsbehebung: Im Rahmen der 24/7-Rufbereitschaft analysierst und behebst du mechanische Betriebsstörungen eigenständig und zuverlässig.
• Inbetriebnahme & Validierung: Du unterstützt bei Inbetriebnahmen, Abnahmen, Funktionsprüfungen sowie Qualifizierungs- und Validierungsaufgaben – inklusive der Erstellung, Prüfung und Pflege der Anlagendokumentation
• Fachkundige Prüfungen: Darüber hinaus bist Du zuständig für die fachkundige Prüfung und Abnahme der ausgeführten Schweißverbindungen innerhalb der „Technical BU Services“ am Standort Penzberg, insbesondere bei Anlagen, die der Druckbehälterverordnung und anderweitigen Prüfpflichten unterliegen
• Fremdfirmensteuerung: Du setzt externe Dienstleister in deinem Bereich gemäß allen gesetzlichen Vorgaben (insbesondere AÜG und ASiG) ein und übernimmst die fachliche sowie kaufmännische Abnahme ihrer Leistungen.
• Dokumentation als Schweißfachmann: In deiner Rolle als Schweißfachmann erstellst du Protokolle und Dokumentationsunterlagen nach gesetzlichen Vorgaben und Werksstandards – in enger Zusammenarbeit mit Betreibern, Projektleitern und der Qualitätssicherung.
• Schulung & Ausbildung: Du betreust Facharbeiter: innen selbstständig in Theorie und Praxis zu geprüften Schweißer: innen gemäß DIN EN ISO 9606-1 aus und weiter.

Wer bist Du

• Du hast eine erfolgreich abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Anlagenmechaniker:in, Industriemechaniker:in (Betriebstechnik oder Maschinen- und Anlagenbau) oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation sowie mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im industriell-technischen Umfeld.
• Idealerweise bringst du eine Weiterbildung zum Schweißfachmann (IWS) sowie Erfahrung im zerstörungsfreien Prüfwesen (VT / PT) mit.
• Du verfügst über fundierte Fachkenntnisse und Fertigkeiten im Neubau sowie in der Instandhaltung von Anlagen und Rohrleitungssystemen.
• Du bringst Erfahrung in der Analyse, Konzeptionierung und Planung technischer Anlagen und Systeme mit – sowohl im laufenden Betrieb als auch im Störungsfall.
• Du besitzt praktische Erfahrung im WIG-Schweißen von korrosionsbeständigen Stählen und greifst auf ein solides Wissen in der Werkstoffkunde zurück.
• Der Umgang mit gängigen MS-Office-Programmen und fachspezifischer Software (z. B. SAP P1U/P1S) fällt dir leicht und hast mindestens grundlegende Englischkenntnisse
• Eine selbstständige Arbeitsweise, aber auch engagiert und kooperativ im Team und Flexibilität sowie die Bereitschaft, Verantwortung zu übernehmen, zeichnen dich aus.

Deine Bewerbung

Ganz pragmatisch: Bitte lade online nur Deinen Lebenslauf hoch.

Zum aktuellen Zeitpunkt benötigen wir kein Motivationsschreiben, Zeugnisse oder Ähnliches.

Wir freuen uns auf Deine Bewerbung!

Your contact to us! With people. For people.

Do you need further support?

Please have a look at our FAQs, you will find them via https://careers.roche.com/global/en/faq.

Who we are

A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

A career within General Consulting services, will provide you with the opportunity to help clients seize essential advantages by working alongside business leaders to solve their toughest problems and capture their greatest opportunities. We work with some of the world’s largest and most complex companies to understand their unique business issues and opportunities in an ever changing environment. We help create sustainable change by stimulating innovation, unlocking data possibilities, navigating risk and regulatory complexity, optimising deals, and aligning costs with business strategy to create a competitive advantage.

Drive Transformation. Deliver Impact. Build Your Career.

Are you passionate about solving complex business challenges and helping organizations transform the way they operate?

We’re looking for talented German-speaking Business Analysts and Consultants at Associate level to join our Product Management & Business Analysis practice. In this role, you’ll work alongside experienced consultants and industry experts to support end-to-end Financial Services transformation across banking, insurance, and asset & wealth management, helping clients deliver innovative solutions that create measurable business value.

If you enjoy collaborating with stakeholders, analyzing business needs, and turning ideas into clear, practical solutions, we’d love to hear from you.

What You’ll Do

As part of our team, you will:

• Support clients and project teams in understanding business challenges and identifying opportunities for improvement.

• Gather, analyze, and document business and functional requirements.

• Assist in preparing user stories, acceptance criteria, process maps, user journeys, and business documentation.

• Participate in workshops and meetings with business and technical stakeholders.

• Support backlog refinement, requirement traceability, and User Acceptance Testing activities.

• Prepare meeting notes, presentations, status updates, and project documentation.

• Collaborate with cross-functional and international teams to deliver high-quality outcomes.

• Build your consulting, business analysis, agile delivery, and Financial Services knowledge through hands-on project work.

What We’re Looking For

We’re looking for professionals who bring curiosity, analytical thinking, attention to detail, and a collaborative mindset.

Required Qualifications

• 5+ years of experience as a Business Analyst, Consultant, Product Analyst, or in a similar client-facing or delivery role.

• Professional proficiency in German and strong English communication skills.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.

• Good communication skills and ability to work with business and technical stakeholders.

• Experience gathering and documenting business requirements.

• Good Microsoft Office skills, especially Excel and PowerPoint.

• Ability to manage tasks and priorities in a dynamic project environment.

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience.

Preferred

• Exposure to Financial Services, including banking, insurance, capital markets, payments, leasing, or automotive finance.

• Basic knowledge of Agile methodologies.

• Experience with Jira, Confluence, or similar documentation and process mapping tools.

• Understanding of user stories, acceptance criteria, UAT, APIs, or system integrations.

• Interest in digital transformation, process improvement, and business change initiatives.

Why Join Us?

At ETIC, you’ll work on meaningful projects while building a rewarding career in consulting. You’ll benefit from:

• Exposure to leading financial institutions and high-impact transformation programs.

• Opportunities to work with diverse, international teams.

• Continuous learning, professional development, and mentorship.

• Clear career progression and growth opportunities.

• A collaborative, inclusive, and supportive work environment.

• Challenging work that allows you to make a real business impact from day one.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

Do I need previous consulting experience?
Consulting experience is an advantage, but we also welcome candidates with strong Business Analysis experience and a passion for solving business challenges.

What kind of work will I be involved in?
You’ll support requirements gathering, documentation, workshops, process mapping, user stories, presentations, and delivery activities across client projects.

Will I work directly with clients?
Depending on the project, you may participate in client meetings, support workshops, gather inputs, and help document business needs under the guidance of more senior team members.

Will I receive training and development opportunities?
Yes. You’ll benefit from continuous learning, mentoring, certifications, and hands-on project experience to build your consulting and Financial Services knowledge.

What makes someone successful in this role?
Curiosity, attention to detail, strong communication skills, willingness to learn, and the ability to organize information clearly are key to success.

I don’t meet every requirement. Should I still apply?
Yes. We recognize that great candidates don’t always match every qualification. If you’re excited about the opportunity and believe you can make an impact, we encourage you to apply.

Ready to Make an Impact?

If you’re looking for a career where your ideas matter, your expertise is valued, and your work helps shape the future of Financial Services, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply today and become part of a team that’s transforming businesses, delivering innovation, and creating lasting impact.

Job Description:

Job Title:  Regional Sales Manager, Canada

Operating Company: Environmental Solutions Group - Heil Environmental

Location: Remote

Reports to: Regional Sales & Support Manager, Canada

Department: Sales and Marketing

POSITION SUMMARY:

Responsible for the growth of sales and market share of Refuse Collection Vehicle (RCV) units, OEM, and aftermarket parts in assigned AOR. Accountable for all activities in the assigned AOR related to the proper management of distributors and direct sales personnel, insuring both effectively represent Heil in their respective market areas. Responsible for making the appropriate distributor and personnel adjustments to insure continued profitable growth within the AOR.

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS INCLUDE:

• Responsible for distributor and direct sales performance.
• Responsible for growing sales and market share year over year for RCV units, and identifying back-office software and 3rd Eye Digital Gateway unit opportunities.
• Responsible for growing sales and market share year over year for OEM and aftermarket parts sales.
• Assist other Heil business units with sales and market share growth.
• Improve penetration of Ready Truck sales in assigned AOR.
• Effectively managing Heil owned and distributor owned demo programs.
• Participate in the product development process including VOC activities and managing/monitoring pre-production prototype and production trial run units.
• Utilizing current CRM package, maintain detailed accurate listing of RCV and Gateway units operating in assigned AOR.
• Effectively manage margins through the current discount management system. Ensure that distributors and direct sales personnel are utilizing the system as prescribed. Manage bid submittals from distributors and direct sales personnel.
• Actively participate in the credit and collections process when required.
• Perform annual performance reviews with direct employees.
• Perform semi-annual performance reviews with distributors and parts and service centers utilizing the distributor evaluation process.
• Execute distributor agreements on an annual basis.
• Promote and support Heil policies and procedures in the areas of warranty, discounting, parts procurement, parts returns, SOARs, order processing, etc.
• Ensure distributors and direct sales personnel are actively writing our bid specifications at municipalities.
• Ensure that distributors and direct sales personnel are leveraging available marketing material and campaigns.
• Ensure that distributors and direct sales personnel are sufficiently trained utilizing Heil training resources.
• Manage annual expense budget to ensure the territory does not exceed budgeted expenses or % of sales in the event that the AOR is not on pace to make the assigned sales goal.
• Execute the Dealer Excellence Program with the dealers in the AOR.
• Ensure dealer accuracy and timeliness of sales funnel activities.
• Coordinate dealer sales training.
• Lead annual business planning with dealership leadership teams.

JOB SPECIFICATIONS:

• Bachelor’s Degree in Business Management or Marketing required or equivalent experience. Engineering degree (ME, IE, EE) and MBA preferred.
• 5+ years of sales management experience (regional manager or above) in the heavy equipment business (equipment and/or parts sales management).
• Heavy Truck and Refuse industry experience a plus.
• Up to 50% travel is required for this position.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES:

Ethics and Work Standards: Maintain the highest ethical and work standards, while promoting the same attributes in co-workers and others.  Ensure that all business activities – with both internal and external customers – to be performed with a professional demeanor and that all participants be held accountable to this high standard.

Communication:  Expresses thoughts clearly, both orally and in writing, using good grammar. Presents concise, well-organized reports in Microsoft Word, PowerPoint, and Excel.  Listens to understand input, feedback, and concerns.  Provides complete information in an open, honest, and straightforward manner.  Responds promptly and positively to questions and requests.

Teamwork and Relationships:  Works with other employees willingly and in a spirit of cooperation and teamwork.  Supports cooperation.  Demonstrates a commitment to the entire business and is supportive of all initiatives (company and departmental) to help grow Environmental Solutions Group business in the United States and abroad.  Cooperates fully with others to achieve organizational goals. Is tactful, courteous, and considerate.  Embraces a positive outlook.  Is respected and trusted by others.

Continual Improvement and Problem Resolution: Identifies and communicates suggestions for work improvements.  Uses technical and analytical abilities to assure existing work practices are the most efficient and cost effective possible. Performs root-cause analysis and implements viable, permanent solutions to problems.  Works with both internal and external customers to develop solutions which meet company-wide needs and objectives.  Applies a sense of urgency to resolve problems or creates opportunities that will increase productivity and create value.  Shares best practices with other employees across the business.

Accountability:  Accepts responsibility and accessibility for both the strategic planning and the successful implementation of all projects, programs, and duties as outlined in this job description. Advises supervisor of concerns, problems, and progress of work in a timely manner.

ABOUT ESG:

Environmental Solutions Group stands at the forefront of sustainable innovation, dedicated to transforming the waste industry with eco-friendly equipment and technology solutions, all designed to improve the lives of our customers, and their communities.

This Connected Collections® ecosystem integrates advanced technology across our brands, including Heil® refuse collection vehicles, Marathon® Equipment compaction and recycling equipment, 3rd Eye® technology solutions, Soft-Pak® waste hauler software, Curotto-Can® automated carry cans, Bayne® lifting products, and Parts Central® OEM parts.

Driven by a mission of “Improving Lives,” our best-in-class teams, innovative products, and advanced technology work tirelessly to leave a lasting legacy of excellence and environmental stewardship, ensuring a greener, healthier planet for generations to come.

For more information, visit www.terexesg.com.

The Company offers competitive salaries, advancement opportunities, and a full range of benefits, including paid vacation, 401(k), medical, dental, and vision.

If you are interested in an open position but feel you may not meet all the listed qualifications, we still encourage you to apply.

Terex Corporation is a global leader in specialized equipment solutions, serving essential sectors such as emergency services, waste and recycling, utilities, and construction. Our diversified portfolio positions us in resilient, high-demand markets with strong long-term growth potential.

We design and manufacture advanced specialty vehicles—including fire, ambulance, and recreational vehicles—alongside waste collection vehicles, materials processing machinery, mobile elevating work platforms, and equipment for the electric utility industry. Through our global dealer, parts and service network and true value-creating digital solutions, we deliver best-in-class lifecycle support, helping customers maximize return on investment.

With a strong manufacturing footprint in the United States and operations across Europe, India, and Asia Pacific, Terex combines global reach with local expertise to capture opportunities worldwide. Our strategy is clear: exceed customer expectations, invest in innovation, leverage our diversified portfolio, and deliver consistent, profitable growth for our shareholders.

We are passionate about producing equipment that helps improve the lives of people around the world and providing our team members with a rewarding career and the opportunity to make an impact.  We are committed to recruiting, engaging, developing, and retaining team members at all levels of our global workforce.  Our culture is defined by our Terex Way Values – Integrity, Respect, Improvement, Servant Leadership, Courage, and Citizenship.  Our values are the driving force behind our commitment to maintain an inclusive, supportive, non-discriminatory, and safe workplace for all team members.  To that end, we are committed to actively foster a culture where every team member feels valued, listened to, and appreciated. If you are a qualified individual with a disability, including disabled veterans, you may request a reasonable accommodation if you are unable or limited in your ability to access job openings or apply for a job on this site as a result of your disability.  You can request reasonable accommodations by contacting the recruiting department (person or department) at Globaltalentacquisitions@terex.com.

jobs.title: Design Ops Associate
jobs.description:
Who We Are

At Kyndryl, we design, build, manage and modernize the mission-critical technology systems that the world depends on every day. So why work at Kyndryl? We are always moving forward – always pushing ourselves to go further in our efforts to build a more equitable, inclusive world for our employees, our customers and our communities.

The Role

Your role

As a Design Ops Associate, you’ll help create the structure, tools, and processes that enable design teams to do their best work. Rather than creating design deliverables yourself, you’ll focus on improving how design work is planned, coordinated, tracked, and delivered across projects and teams. This role balances operational planning with day-to-day execution, helping designers spend more time solving customer problems and less time navigating process challenges.

You’ll work closely with designers, product teams, engineers, and delivery partners to support the successful execution of design initiatives. Your work will help create visibility into priorities, timelines, dependencies, and outcomes, enabling teams to collaborate more effectively and make informed decisions.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone interested in design operations, programme coordination, process improvement, and the ways design teams operate within large organisations. You’ll gain exposure to design systems, digital product development, experience design practices, and portfolio management while building valuable operational and consulting skills that can support multiple career paths.

What you will do

Enable effective design delivery

• Support planning activities for design projects, including intake, prioritisation, scheduling, and resource coordination
• Help maintain processes that enable consistent and high-quality delivery across design initiatives
• Track milestones, dependencies, and deliverables to help teams stay aligned and informed
• Prepare reports and updates that provide visibility into project status, priorities, and risks

Coordinate across teams

• Facilitate collaboration between design, product, engineering, and delivery teams
• Support briefing, planning, and review activities for design work
• Ensure stakeholders have access to accurate and timely information about design initiatives
• Help manage communication flows related to project timelines, dependencies, and key decisions

Improve operational effectiveness

• Identify gaps, bottlenecks, or inefficiencies in the design workflow
• Document and maintain processes, templates, tools, and operational guidelines
• Support continuous improvement initiatives that simplify how design work is managed and delivered
• Contribute ideas that improve team effectiveness, consistency, and visibility

Support portfolio oversight

• Track work across multiple projects, programmes, or design initiatives
• Maintain information that helps teams understand workload, capacity, and priorities
• Assist with forecasting, planning, and operational reporting activities
• Monitor progress against agreed objectives and highlight potential risks or constraints

Learn and grow

• Build knowledge of DesignOps, experience design, and digital product development practices
• Learn how design teams collaborate within large-scale customer environments
• Develop skills in programme coordination, process improvement, stakeholder management, and operational planning
• Gain hands-on experience using planning, collaboration, and workflow management tools

Kyndryl currently does not require employees to be fully vaccinated against COVID-19, however, if you are hired to work at a client, customer, or partner location, you may be required to show proof of vaccination to align with their respective COVID-19 vaccination policies.  Those who believe they are eligible may apply for a medical or religious accommodation prior to the start of employment.

Who You Are

Why Kyndryl:

We’re a purpose-driven company committed to innovation and empowering our people. Here, your work contributes to meaningful outcomes for clients and communities.

Your Future at Kyndryl

Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career. We have opportunities that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to provide it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in your work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

Kyndryl is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. Kyndryl is also committed to compliance with all fair employment practices regarding citizenship and immigration status.

Required skills and experience

• Demonstrated experience coordinating projects, programs, workflows, or operational activities in a design, product, project management, or business operations environment
• Understanding of how design work moves from planning through delivery within a multidisciplinary team
• Experience managing multiple workstreams, priorities, or initiatives simultaneously
• Ability to create, document, and maintain processes, templates, or operational frameworks
• Experience collaborating with teams that have different priorities, responsibilities, and areas of expertise
• Ability to identify operational challenges and recommend practical improvements
• Experience using project management, planning, tracking, or collaboration tools
• Strong organizational skills with the ability to maintain accuracy across multiple activities and deadlines

Preferred skills and experience

• Experience supporting design, UX, service design, customer experience, or digital product teams
• Familiarity with portfolio management, resource planning, or capacity tracking practices
• Experience contributing to process improvement or operational transformation initiatives
• Exposure to design systems, design governance, or quality review processes
• Familiarity with AI-enabled productivity, workflow, or collaboration tools

The compensation range for the position in the U.S. is :

$63,360 to $114,120 based on a full-time schedule.

Your actual compensation may vary depending on your geography, job-related skills and experience.  For part time roles, the compensation will be adjusted appropriately. The pay or salary range will not be below any applicable state, city or local minimum wage requirement.

This position will be eligible for Kyndryl’s discretionary annual bonus program, based on performance and subject to the terms of Kyndryl’s applicable plans. You may also receive a comprehensive benefits package which includes medical and dental coverage, disability, retirement benefits, paid leave, and paid time off.  Note: If this is a sales commission eligible role, you will be eligible to participate in a sales commission plan in lieu of the annual discretionary bonus program.
Applications will be accepted on a rolling basis.

Being You

Diversity is a whole lot more than what we look like or where we come from, it’s how we think and who we are. We welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. But we’re not doing it single-handily: Our Kyndryl Inclusion Networks are only one of many ways we create a workplace where all Kyndryls can find and provide support and advice. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you – and everyone next to you – the ability to bring your whole self to work, individually and collectively, and support the activation of our equitable culture. That’s the Kyndryl Way.

What You Can Expect

With state-of-the-art resources and Fortune 100 clients, every day is an opportunity to innovate, build new capabilities, new relationships, new processes, and new value. Kyndryl cares about your well-being and prides itself on offering benefits that give you choice, reflect the diversity of our employees and support you and your family through the moments that matter – wherever you are in your life journey. Our employee learning programs give you access to the best learning in the industry to receive certifications, including Microsoft, Google, Amazon, Skillsoft, and many more. Through our company-wide volunteering and giving platform, you can donate, start fundraisers, volunteer, and search over 2 million non-profit organizations.  At Kyndryl, we invest heavily in you, we want you to succeed so that together, we will all succeed.

jobs.description:
---This is a hands-on, laboratory-focused position.---

Typical Accountabilities
- Conduct hands-on in vivo research and contribute independently to the planning and design of in vivo studies. Proficient in animal handling, dosing, sample collection, monitoring, and assessment of study endpoints, in line with approved protocols and relevant training.

- Develop routine drug discovery research experiments and analytical studies to identify and validate potential novel drug targets, applying diverse methodologies, with minimal supervision.
- Conduct experiments and interpret results by using established scientific methodologies and tools.
- Modify or improve existing research processes and systems to better align with experimental objectives.

- Provide technical mentorship to team members on experimental procedures and allocate administrative tasks when necessary.
- Collaborate with project teams to facilitate seamless communication and data sharing within the team.
- Search for information which may improve research methodology and procedures.
- Ensure work is performed in compliance with Safety, Health & Environment (SHE), quality, and regulatory requirements, including laboratory standards (GLS).

Minimum Qualifications:
Essential:

• Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent 3-4 years of experience) experience in a relevant field with demonstrated experience in Cellular Therapy, Immunology, and/ or Immuno-Oncology.
• 2+ years of industry experience.

• Extensive in vivo skills including animal handling, syngeneic murine, xenograft and PDX tumour models, standard routes of dosing and engraftment, tissue processing, PK/PD and efficacy studies;
• Proficiency in tail vein dosing; Well-developed understanding of molecular and cellular biology, immunological assays;
• Effective interpersonal skills; Ability to develop, implement, and troubleshoot experiments independently.

Desirable:

• Experience with a range of in vitro assays, including but not limited to ELISA, multicolor flow cytometry;
• In vitro and in vivo experience with murine T cells;
• Basic experience developing cellular therapies including CAR-T/ CAR-NK, TCR-T, and/ or TIL therapies;
• Background in drug discovery and development in the pharmaceutical industry;
• Experience with complex in vivo systems, including but not limited to orthotopic xenograft models, humanized mice, in vivo imaging of luciferase labelled tumor models.

Internal: Colleagues, senior staff and management; AZ project teams.
External: External scientific community.

jobs.description:
Since 1869, we've connected people through food they love. We’re proud to be stewards of amazing brands that people trust. Our portfolio includes the iconic Campbell’s brand, as well as Cape Cod, Chunky, Goldfish, Kettle Brand, Lance, Late July, Pacific Foods, Pepperidge Farm, Prego, Pace, Rao’s Homemade, Snack Factory, Snyder’s of Hanover. Swanson, and V8.

Here, you will make a difference every day. You will be supported to build a rewarding career with opportunities to grow, innovate and inspire. Make history with us.

Why Campbell’s…

• Benefits begin on day one and include medical, dental, short and long-term disability, AD&D, and life insurance (for individual, families, and domestic partners).
• Employees are eligible for our matching 401(k) plan and can enroll on the first day of employment with immediate vesting.
• Campbell’s offers unlimited sick time along with paid time off and holiday pay.
• If in WHQ – free access to the fitness center. Access to on-site day care (operated by Bright Horizons) and company store.
• Giving back to the communities where our employees work and live is very important to Campbell’s. Our “Campbell’s Cares” program matches employee donations and/or volunteer activity up to $1,500 annually.
• Campbell’s has a variety of Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) to support employees.

How You Will Make History Here…

As the Customer Sales Lead for Stop & Shop, you will own the development and execution of the joint business plan for the Campbell’s Snacks portfolio. You will drive sales, profit, share, and trade management objectives by building strong customer relationships, translating brand strategies into action, and partnering across the business to deliver sustainable growth.

The ideal candidate will live in the Northeastern United States.

What You Will Do…

• Lead the joint business planning process and annual strategic plan for Stop & Shop.
• Build and manage the business plan to achieve volume, profit, share, and trade investment objectives.
• Develop and execute trade promotion strategies and customer plans using sales planning and investment tools.
• Evaluate promotional performance, consumption, profit, and spending results, then apply insights to future opportunities.
• Manage trade funding, deduction balances, post audits, and monthly forecasts in accordance with company standards.
• Use syndicated, loyalty, shopper, and category data to lead business reviews, category assessments, and fact-based recommendations.
• Partner with Stop & Shop buyers, category managers, and merchandising leaders to implement Campbell brand strategies and identify growth opportunities.
• Sell in new items, optimize assortment and distribution, and secure additional product placements in Stop & Shop stores and digital channels.
• Identify profitable incremental volume opportunities and monitor competitive activity, consumer trends, inventory changes, and forecast risks.
• Partner with Customer Marketing to develop collaborative programs aligned with Campbell and Stop & Shop strategies.

Who You Will Work With…

You will build productive relationships with key decision-makers at Stop & Shop, including buyers, category managers, and merchandising leaders. Internally, you will collaborate closely with Finance, Category Management, Customer Marketing, Customer Business Managers, Supply Chain, Customer Service, Integrated Marketing, Customer Development, and Brand Management.

What You Bring to the Table… (Must Have)

• Bachelor’s degree.
• 6+ years of relevant experience in the CPG industry.
• Experience leading joint business planning, customer strategy, and trade promotion execution.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills.
• Excellent problem-solving, analytical thinking, and data analysis capabilities.
• Strong negotiation, interpersonal, and influencing skills.
• Ability to build relationships and conduct meetings with senior customer decision-makers.

It Would be Great if You Have… (Nice to Have)

• Experience using syndicated data sources such as IRI, Nielsen, or 1010data.
• Category and brand knowledge.
• Knowledge of supply chain operations.
• Experience managing a P&L.
• Experience with trade management systems.
• Experience using digital shelf solutions to improve availability and placement.

The target base salary range for this full-time, salaried position is between

$117,600-$161,700

jobs.title: Electrical & Manufacturing Engineer III (Semiconductor)
jobs.description:
Work Schedule

First Shift (Days)

Environmental Conditions

Cleanroom: no hair products, jewelry, makeup, nail polish, perfume, exposed piercings, facial hair etc... allowed, Office

Job Description

As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner, and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.

Location/Division-Specific Information:

Hillsboro, OR. Relocation assistance is NOT provided.

*Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship.

*Must be able to pass a comprehensive background check, which includes a drug screen.

Discover Impactful Work:

Our factory produces low-volume, high-complexity electron microscopy products for semiconductor designers and manufacturers to use in the creation and improvement of their products and manufacturing processes. The team is responsible for the smooth introduction of new electron microscopy products into the factory and field, as well as for ongoing improvements to products and the processes used to manufacture and service them.

You will play a critical, hands-on role supporting advanced electron microscopy systems used in semiconductor manufacturing. Acting as the bridge between R&D, manufacturing, and field service, you will ensure electrical systems perform reliably in real-world production environments.

This is not a pure design role—you will spend significant time on the manufacturing floor and in cleanroom environments, working directly with technicians to troubleshoot issues, improve system performance, and support new product introduction.

You will take ownership of one or more tools, becoming the go-to expert for electrical system performance, reliability, and continuous improvement.

A Day in the Life:

• Work on New Product Introduction (NPI) projects from initiation through release, following the Product Management Process (PMP).
• Troubleshoot complex electrical issues at system and component levels (e.g., power supplies, boards, connectors). Use lab equipment such as oscilloscopes, multimeters, and other diagnostic tools to identify and resolve electrical issues.
• Perform failure analysis and drive root cause resolution for electrical and system-level problems.
• Identify and resolve electrical integration issues during early builds.
• Assist logistics and document management with Technical Product Documentation (TPD) and specification support.
• Using available data, identify areas requiring sustaining projects for design and process improvements.
• Complete component obsolescence projects on current and near-end-of-life products and qualify replacements.
• Develop and optimize build, test, and validation processes for complex electro-mechanical systems, with a focus on electrical performance, reliability, and manufacturability.
• May design tooling required for manufacturing and service to meet cycle time and tool availability requirements.
• You will be the engineering point of contact for one or more tools during integration on the manufacturing floor and be the go-to expert for electrical system performance, reliability, and continuous improvement.
• Build and deliver initial training to Manufacturing, Technical Support, and Service personnel in new product build, test, install, and repair procedures.
• Support critical issues on the production floor to ensure on-time shipments. Drive follow-up actions to ensure issues are resolved.
• Respond to and support safety issues reported on the manufacturing floor and/or field service.
• Support our Global Technical Support team.
• Regularly work on the manufacturing floor and in cleanroom environments alongside technicians to diagnose and resolve system issues

Keys to Success:

Education

• Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering, or related fields (e.g., Systems) required.

Experience

• 3+ years’ experience as an Electrical Engineer, Hardware Engineer, Systems Engineer, or Manufacturing/NPI Engineer with strong electrical systems experience or a similar field is required.
• Experience in crafting technical documentation, procedures, and engineering reports.
• Experience in the analysis of data and basic experimental methods, test protocols, and procedures.
• Proven experience participating in and leading technical projects and managing multi-functional projects.
• Experience developing and deploying new products into a manufacturing environment.
• Experience with Practical Process Improvements (PPI), including cost reduction by workflow or design improvements.
• Experience in reviewing data and driving improvements that affect quality.

Knowledge, Skills, Abilities

• Strong practical troubleshooting mindset with the ability to diagnose and resolve real-world system issues with incomplete information.
• Planning, organizing, prioritizing, and goal setting.
• Detailed problem-solving using structured troubleshooting techniques.
• Failure Analysis.
• Collaboration and teamwork in cross-functional teams.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
• Motivated individual to work independently on projects and tasks with minimal direction.
• Ability to work on highly sophisticated electro-mechanical equipment.

Benefits:

We offer competitive remuneration, annual incentive plan bonus, healthcare, and a range of employee benefits. Thermo Fisher Scientific offers employment with an innovative, forward-thinking organization, and outstanding career and development prospects. We offer an exciting company culture that stands for integrity, intensity, involvement, and innovation!

jobs.title: Senior Cloud & AI Security Engineer
jobs.description:
Senior Cloud & AI Security  Engineer

Enthusiastic about securing cloud platforms and AI-driven solutions in a rapidly evolving technology landscape?
Do you enjoy designing security frameworks, enabling secure development practices, and partnering with engineering teams to build resilient, scalable, and compliant cloud and AI environments?

About the team:

LexisNexis Intellectual Property Solutions (LNIP) is the global leader in patent intelligence, bringing clarity to innovation for businesses, law firms, universities, and government agencies worldwide. Our mission is to help the innovation community make better decisions faster, with greater confidence, combining the world’s most trusted patent data with sophisticated analytics, AI-powered insights, and purpose-built workflows.

Protégé in PatentSight is LNIP’s next-generation agentic AI assistant, purpose-built for strategic patent analysis. Protégé replaces complex filter-based workflows with natural language questions, surfacing structured, decision-ready insights grounded in trusted data and established metrics.

About the role:

We are seeking a Senior Cloud & AI Security Enablement Engineer to provide hands-on cloud security engineering capability while also enabling the secure and effective use of AI across Information Security and product engineering teams.

This role sits between Security Architecture, BISO/Application Security, Cloud/Platform Engineering, and GRC. It is designed to reduce manual workload on Security Architecture and BISO/Application Security by turning recurring security requirements into reusable cloud guardrails, automated controls, AI-assisted workflows, secure design patterns, and developer-facing enablement materials.

The successful candidate will be a practical builder and security partner who can operate cloud security controls, support secure AI adoption, and use AI to improve the speed and consistency of security delivery.

Key Responsibilities:

Cloud Security Engineering

• Build and maintain reusable cloud security guardrails for identity, logging, encryption, network segmentation, secrets management, storage, workloads, containers, serverless services, and data protection.
• Translate security architecture standards into deployable cloud patterns, reference implementations, templates, and engineering-ready requirements.
• Partner with cloud, platform, DevOps, and product engineering teams to embed security controls into cloud landing zones, CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure-as-code workflows, and operational processes.
• Support the implementation and tuning of CSPM, CNAPP, cloud workload protection, IaC scanning, secrets scanning, and related cloud security tooling.
• Develop policy-as-code and control-as-code mechanisms to prevent, detect, and report common cloud misconfigurations.
• Support cloud-native vulnerability and misconfiguration remediation by providing prioritization logic, remediation guidance, and reusable fix patterns.
• Establish cloud security metrics and dashboards covering control adoption, misconfiguration trends, remediation progress, recurring issues, and exception patterns.

AI Security Enablement

• Design and maintain AI-assisted workflows for security intake triage, threat model drafting, architecture review summaries, control mapping, remediation guidance, and risk statement generation.
• Build prompt libraries, review rubrics, validation steps, and human-in-the-loop processes for approved AI use within Information Security.
• Identify repetitive BISO, AppSec, and Security Architecture tasks that can be safely accelerated through AI-assisted processes.
• Partner with GRC, Legal, Privacy, and security leadership to ensure AI-assisted security workflows are auditable, explainable, and aligned with internal risk expectations.
• Measure the effectiveness of AI-assisted workflows, including time saved, consistency improvements, review quality, and reduction in repeat manual work.

Secure AI Application and Cloud-AI Guardrails

• Define secure design patterns for AI-enabled applications, including LLM-based features, retrieval-augmented generation, AI agents, AI APIs, copilots, and automation workflows.
• Establish cloud security requirements for AI workloads, including identity, secrets, data storage, network access, observability, workload isolation, and third-party AI service integrations in partnership with Sec Architecture & AppSec.
• Support AI application threat modelling and risk reviews in partnership with BISO/AppSec.
• Create developer-facing guidance for safe use of AI coding assistants, AI APIs, data ingestion, vector stores, model outputs, and AI-generated code in partnership with BISO/AppSec.

Security Enablement and Workload Reduction

• Convert recurring BISO/AppSec and Security Architecture questions into reusable guidance, decision trees, approved patterns, checklists, and self-service workflows.
• Build lightweight intake and routing mechanisms that help determine when a request needs BISO review, AppSec review, architecture review, GRC input, or engineering remediation.
• Create and maintain a library of approved cloud and AI security patterns that product and engineering teams can reuse.
• Help reduce one-off security consultations by embedding approved security decisions into tooling, templates, and standard delivery workflows.

Requirements:

Essential -

• Experience in machine learning engineering. Strong experience in cloud security engineering, application security, security architecture, DevSecOps, or security automation.
• Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud platform such as AWS or Azure.
• Practical knowledge of IAM, logging, encryption, secrets management, network security, storage security, vulnerability management, and secure CI/CD.
• Experience with infrastructure-as-code and cloud security tooling such as CSPM, CNAPP, IaC scanning, SAST, SCA, secrets scanning, or policy-as-code.
• Ability to translate security standards and architecture requirements into practical implementation patterns.
• Familiarity with generative AI, LLM-enabled applications, AI-assisted development, or AI security risks.
• Strong scripting, automation, workflow design, or tooling integration experience.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to create clear security guidance for engineering teams.

Desirable-

• Experience building cloud security guardrails, landing zone controls, reusable modules, or automated remediation workflows.
• Experience supporting regulated environments or environments with strict customer, contractual, or compliance obligations.
• Familiarity with AI security frameworks and guidance such as the NIST AI Risk Management Framework, NIST Generative AI Profile, OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, or Cloud Security Alliance AI security guidance.
• Experience with RAG architecture, AI agents, vector databases, AI APIs, prompt engineering, or AI application threat modelling.
• Experience building security knowledge assistants, prompt libraries, AI-assisted review workflows, or security automation.

Why Join Us?

Join our team and contribute to a culture of innovation, collaboration, and excellence. If you are ready to advance your career and make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply.

Work in a way that works for you

We promote a healthy work/life balance across the organization. We offer an appealing working prospect for our people. With numerous wellbeing initiatives, shared parental leave, study assistance and sabbaticals, we will help you meet your immediate responsibilities and your long-term goals.

• Working flexible hours - flexing the times when you work in the day to help you fit everything in and work when you are the most productive.

Working for you

We know that your well-being and happiness are key to a long and successful career. These are some of the benefits we are delighted to offer:
